entry.summary: Empirically investigates how the choice of self-supervised learning pretext task (JEA vs JEPA vs reconstruction) impacts learned representations in medical imaging, focusing on alignment with spatial organization of clinical signal.

entry.title: TimeWeaver: Age-Consistent Reference-Based Face Restoration with Identity Preservation

author.name: Teer Song, Yue Zhang, Yu Tian, Ziyang Wang, Xianlin Zhang, Guixuan Zhang, Xuan Liu, Xueming Li, Yasen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TimeWeaver, the first reference-based face restoration framework supporting cross-age references, decoupling identity and age information to produce restorations with both identity fidelity and age consistency.

entry.title: Cross-Slice Knowledge Transfer via Masked Multi-Modal Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning for Spatial Gene Expression Inference

author.name: Zhiceng Shi, Changmiao Wang, Jun Wan, Wenwen Min

entry.summary: Proposes SpaHGC, a multi-modal heterogeneous graph model for predicting spatial transcriptomics from pathology images, capturing both intra-slice and inter-slice relationships using pathology foundation model embeddings.

entry.title: Gau-Occ: Geometry-Completed Gaussians for Multi-Modal 3D Occupancy Prediction

author.name: Chengxin Lv, Yihui Li, Hongyu Yang, YunHong Wang

entry.summary: Presents Gau-Occ, a multi-modal 3D occupancy prediction framework for autonomous driving that models scenes as semantic 3D Gaussians rather than dense voxels. Uses a LiDAR Completion Diffuser to recover missing structures and Gaussian Anchor Fusion for multi-view integration.

entry.title: Group Editing : Edit Multiple Images in One Go

author.name: Yue Ma, Xinyu Wang, Qianli Ma, Qinghe Wang, Mingzhe Zheng, Xiangpeng Yang, Hao Li, Chongbo Zhao, Jixuan Ying, Harry Yang, Hongyu Liu, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: Proposes GroupEditing, a framework for performing consistent edits across a set of related images that vary in pose, viewpoint, and layout. Builds both explicit geometric correspondences (via VGGT) and implicit relationships through pseudo-video reformulation.

entry.title: Generative Event Pretraining with Foundation Model Alignment

author.name: Jianwen Cao, Jiaxu Xing, Nico Messikommer, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Proposes GEP (Generative Event Pretraining), a two-stage framework that transfers knowledge from image foundation models to event camera data while learning event-specific temporal dynamics through generative pretraining.

entry.title: VoDaSuRe: A Large-Scale Dataset Revealing Domain Shift in Volumetric Super-Resolution

author.name: August Leander H{\o}eg, Sophia Wiinberg Bardenfleth, Hans Martin Kjer, Tim Bj{\o}rn Dyrby, Vedrana Andersen Dahl, Anders Bjorholm Dahl

entry.summary: Introduces VoDaSuRe, a large-scale volumetric dataset with paired high- and low-resolution scans, revealing that SR models trained on downsampled data perform much better than those trained on real low-resolution data, exposing a significant domain shift.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Image Fusion via Intervention-Stable Feature Learning

author.name: Xue Wang, Zheng Guan, Wenhua Qian, Chengchao Wang, Runzhuo Ma

entry.summary: Proposes an intervention-based framework for multi-modal image fusion inspired by causal principles, using complementary masking, random masking, and modality-swapping interventions to learn robust cross-modal dependencies.

entry.title: TETO: Tracking Events with Teacher Observation for Motion Estimation and Frame Interpolation

author.name: Jini Yang, Eunbeen Hong, Soowon Son, Hyunkoo Lee, Sunghwan Hong, Sunok Kim, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TETO, a teacher-student framework learning event camera motion estimation from only ~25 minutes of unannotated real-world data via knowledge distillation from an RGB tracker, avoiding synthetic data sim-to-real gap.

entry.title: AgentRVOS: Reasoning over Object Tracks for Zero-Shot Referring Video Object Segmentation

author.name: Woojeong Jin, Jaeho Lee, Heeseong Shin, Seungho Jang, Junhwan Heo, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes AgentRVOS, a training-free agentic pipeline for referring video object segmentation that builds on SAM3 and MLLM, performing temporal reasoning after obtaining object-level evidence rather than before.

entry.title: WildWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset for Dynamic World Modeling with Actions and Explicit State toward Generative ARPG

author.name: Zhen Li, Zian Meng, Shuwei Shi, Wenshuo Peng, Yuwei Wu, Bo Zheng, Chuanhao Li, Kaipeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WildWorld, a large-scale action-conditioned dataset from ARPGs with explicit state information for training world models, addressing the lack of structured action-state relationships in existing datasets.

entry.title: DA-Flow: Degradation-Aware Optical Flow Estimation with Diffusion Models

author.name: Jaewon Min, Jaeeun Lee, Yeji Choi, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Jin Hyeon Kim, Tae-Young Lee, Jongsik Ahn, Hwayeong Lee, Seonghyun Park, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: Proposes DA-Flow for degradation-aware optical flow estimation using diffusion model features with spatio-temporal attention, showing that restoration diffusion model features have inherent corruption awareness.

entry.title: Rectify, Don't Regret: Avoiding Pitfalls of Differentiable Simulation in Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Harsh Yadav, Christian Bohn, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Identifies a critical flaw in differentiable closed-loop simulators for trajectory prediction: shortcut learning where loss gradients leak future ground truth. Proposes a detached receding horizon rollout that severs the computation graph to prevent non-causal exploitation.

entry.title: Gaussian mixtures and non-parametric likelihoods through the lens of statistical mechanics

author.name: Subhroshekhar Ghosh, Adityanand Guntuboyina, Satyaki Mukherjee, Hoang-Son Tran

entry.summary: Establishes stability guarantees for nonparametric maximum likelihood estimation (NPMLE) of Gaussian mixture models using statistical mechanics tools. Provides KL divergence upper bounds between NPMLE estimators and true density, advancing beyond prior state of the art.

entry.title: Agents Can Get Stuck in Self-distrusting Equilibria

author.name: Ashe Vazquez Nuñez

entry.summary: Formalizes how temporal instances of an embedded agent can enter conflict through self-distrust, modeled as intrapersonal cooperative games. Defines time-version Nash equilibria and shows stable self-punishing patterns. Conjectures that identity/consistency serves as a replacement for common knowledge of rationality. From MATS 9.0 under Richard Ngo.

entry.title: SMSP: A Plug-and-Play Strategy of Multi-Scale Perception for MLLMs to Perceive Visual Illusions

author.name: Jinzhe Tu, Ruilei Guo, Zihan Guo, Junxiao Yang, Shiyao Cui, Minlie Huang

entry.summary: Introduces SMSP, a plug-and-play multi-scale perception strategy that helps MLLMs perceive hidden-pattern visual illusions by addressing high-frequency attention bias. Also introduces IlluChar benchmark dataset.

entry.title: Learning Actuator-Aware Spectral Submanifolds for Precise Control of Continuum Robots

author.name: Paul Leonard Wolff, Hugo Buurmeijer, Luis Pabon, John Irvin Alora, Mark Leone, Roshan S. Kaundinya, Amirhossein Kazemipour, Robert K. Katzschmann, Marco Pavone

entry.summary: Introduces control-augmented Spectral Submanifold (caSSM) models for continuum robots that capture nonlinear state-input couplings. Learns compact models from controlled decay trajectories, eliminating the need for separate actuation calibration. From Pavone (Stanford) and Katzschmann (ETH) labs.

entry.title: DiSCo: Diffusion Sequence Copilots for Shared Autonomy

author.name: Andy Wang, Xu Yan, Brandon McMahan, Michael Zhou, Yuyang Yuan, Johannes Y. Lee, Ali Shreif, Matthew Li, Zhenghao Peng, Bolei Zhou, Yuchen Cui, Jonathan C. Kao

entry.summary: DiSCo uses diffusion policy for shared autonomy, planning action sequences consistent with past user actions. Seeds and inpaints the diffusion process with user-provided actions, balancing conformity to expert behavior with alignment to user intent.

entry.title: We cannot safely automate value alignment evaluation and research without thinking about delegation and discretion

author.name: Maria Federica Martino Lena

entry.summary: Argues that automating alignment evaluation and research requires thinking carefully about delegation and discretion, not just verifying model alignment. Reframes the question from 'is the model aligned enough?' to 'what are the right conditions for safe delegation?' Building on Carlsmith and Leike's work.

entry.title: Shape-Adaptive Conditional Calibration for Conformal Prediction via Minimax Optimization

author.name: Yajie Bao, Chuchen Zhang, Zhaojun Wang, Haojie Ren, Changliang Zou

entry.summary: MOPI generalizes conformal prediction calibration by optimizing over flexible set-valued mappings via minimax optimization, achieving better shape adaptivity while maintaining coverage guarantees. Connected to minimization of mean squared coverage error.

entry.title: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Architectures for Financial Document Processing: A Comparative Study of Orchestration Patterns, Cost-Accuracy Tradeoffs and Production Scaling Strategies

author.name: Siddhant Kulkarni, Yukta Kulkarni

entry.summary: Benchmarks four multi-agent LLM orchestration architectures for financial document processing across five frontier models on 10K SEC filings. Evaluates cost-accuracy tradeoffs and production scaling strategies across 25 extraction field types.

entry.title: CoMaTrack: Competitive Multi-Agent Game-Theoretic Tracking with Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Youzhi Liu, Li Gao, Liu Liu, Mingyang Lv, Yang Cai

entry.summary: Introduces CoMaTrack, a competitive game-theoretic multi-agent RL framework for embodied visual tracking, along with CoMaTrack-Bench benchmark. Uses competition-driven capability evolution between tracker and adaptive opponent agents.

entry.title: SAiW: Source-Attributable Invisible Watermarking for Proactive Deepfake Defense

author.name: Bibek Das, Chandranath Adak, Soumi Chattopadhyay, Zahid Akhtar, Soumya Dutta

entry.summary: Introduces SAiW, a source-attributed invisible watermarking framework for proactive deepfake defense. Formulates watermark embedding as source-conditioned representation learning, enabling media provenance verification at creation time.

entry.title: Beyond Hard Constraints: Budget-Conditioned Reachability For Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Janaka Chathuranga Brahmanage, Akshat Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes budget-conditioned safety reachability analysis for offline RL that extends traditional hard-constraint reachability to cumulative cost constraints. Precomputes forward-invariant safe sets conditioned on cost budgets.

entry.title: Geometric Mixture-of-Experts with Curvature-Guided Adaptive Routing for Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Haifang Cao, Yu Wang, Timing Li, Xinjie Yao, Pengfei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes GeoMoE, a Geometric Mixture-of-Experts framework using Ollivier-Ricci Curvature as geometric prior to route graph representations across diverse Riemannian spaces. Addresses topological heterogeneity in graph data.

entry.title: Sparsely-Supervised Data Assimilation via Physics-Informed Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Dohyun Bu, Chanho Kim, Seokun Choi, Jong-Seok Lee

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed Schrödinger Bridge for data assimilation that avoids per-instance test-time optimization and full-field supervision during training. Handles sparse observations while respecting PDE constraints.

entry.title: Trained Persistent Memory for Frozen Decoder-Only LLMs

author.name: Hong Jeong

entry.summary: Explores adding persistent latent-space memory to frozen decoder-only LLMs (GPT-2) through trained memory adapters, comparing six memory injection methods. Tests whether persistent memory principles that work for encoder-decoder models transfer to the decoder-only setting where memory must enter through self-attention alone.

entry.title: Symbolic Graph Networks for Robust PDE Discovery from Noisy Sparse Data

author.name: Xingyu Chen, Junxiu An, Jun Guo, Yuqian Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Symbolic Graph Networks (SGN) for PDE discovery under noisy and sparse data conditions. Uses graph message passing for non-local spatial representation that is less sensitive to high-frequency noise than numerical differentiation approaches.

entry.title: Stability-Preserving Online Adaptation of Neural Closed-loop Maps

author.name: Danilo Saccani, Luca Furieri, Giancarlo Ferrari-Trecate

entry.summary: Introduces stability-preserving update mechanisms for neural network controllers in nonlinear systems. Addresses the critical problem that switching between stabilizing policies can itself destabilize the closed-loop, using bounded gain-based conditions.

entry.title: STRIATUM-CTF: A Protocol-Driven Agentic Framework for General-Purpose CTF Solving

author.name: James Hugglestone, Samuel Jacob Chacko, Dawson Stoller, Ryan Schmidt, Xiuwen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces STRIATUM-CTF, a modular agentic framework for cybersecurity CTF solving built on Model Context Protocol. Standardizes tool interfaces for system introspection, decompilation, and runtime debugging to maintain coherent context across exploit trajectories.

entry.title: LGSE: Lexically Grounded Subword Embedding Initialization for Low-Resource Language Adaptation

author.name: Hailay Teklehaymanot, Dren Fazlija, Wolfgang Nejdl

entry.summary: Proposes LGSE, a framework for adapting pretrained LMs to low-resource, morphologically rich languages using morphologically informed subword segmentation for embedding initialization, leveraging morpheme-level representations instead of arbitrary subwords.

entry.title: From Arithmetic to Logic: The Resilience of Logic and Lookup-Based Neural Networks Under Parameter Bit-Flips

author.name: Alan T. L. Bacellar, Sathvik Chemudupati, Shashank Nag, Allison Seigler, Priscila M. V. Lima, Felipe M. G. Fran\c{c}a, Lizy K. John

entry.summary: Analyzes resilience of neural networks to hardware bit-flip errors across different architectures, deriving expected MSE under bit flips and showing that lower precision, higher sparsity, bounded activations, and shallow depth improve fault tolerance.

entry.title: Looking Beyond the Window: Global-Local Aligned CLIP for Training-free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: ByeongCheol Lee, Hyun Seok Seong, Sangeek Hyun, Gilhan Park, WonJun Moon, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Proposes GLA-CLIP for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation that addresses semantic discrepancy across sliding windows by extending key-value attention across all windows with a bias correction mechanism.

entry.title: Parametric Knowledge and Retrieval Behavior in RAG Fine-Tuning for Electronic Design Automation

author.name: Julian Oestreich, Maximilian Bley, Frank Binder, Lydia M\"uller, Maksym Sydorenko, Andr\'e Alcalde

entry.summary: Evaluates RAG fine-tuning for electronic design automation, introducing TriFEX evaluation pipeline and Parametric Knowledge Precision metric. Shows that ROUGE/BERTScore fail to detect factual differences in generated text.

entry.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation

author.name: Yingzhi He, Yan Sun, Junfei Tan, Yuxin Chen, Xiaoyu Kong, Chunxu Shen, Xiang Wang, An Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Explores reasoning over Semantic IDs for generative recommendation, showing how LLM reasoning capabilities can enhance recommendation by reasoning about item token sequences rather than just generating them.

entry.title: Designing Agentic AI-Based Screening for Portfolio Investment

author.name: Mehmet Caner, Agostino Capponi, Nathan Sun, Jonathan Y. Tan

entry.summary: Introduces an agentic AI platform for portfolio management using two specialized LLM agents (fundamentals screening and sentiment analysis) that deliberate to generate trading signals, followed by high-dimensional portfolio optimization.

entry.title: InverFill: One-Step Inversion for Enhanced Few-Step Diffusion Inpainting

author.name: Duc Vu, Kien Nguyen, Trong-Tung Nguyen, Ngan Nguyen, Phong Nguyen, Khoi Nguyen, Cuong Pham, Anh Tran

entry.summary: Proposes InverFill, a one-step inversion method for few-step diffusion inpainting that injects semantic information from the masked image into initial noise, enabling high-fidelity inpainting with minimal sampling steps.

entry.title: Neural Structure Embedding for Symbolic Regression via Continuous Structure Search and Coefficient Optimization

author.name: Fateme Memar, Tao Zhe, Dongjie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SRCO, a framework for symbolic regression that embeds symbolic structures into continuous space using Transformers, enabling gradient-based optimization of equation discovery.

entry.title: Universal and efficient graph neural networks with dynamic attention for machine learning interatomic potentials

author.name: Shuyu Bi, Zhede Zhao, Qiangchao Sun, Tao Hu, Xionggang Lu, Hongwei Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces MLANet, a graph neural network for machine learning interatomic potentials with dual-path dynamic attention and multi-perspective pooling for molecular dynamics simulations.

entry.title: OrgForge-IT: A Verifiable Synthetic Benchmark for LLM-Based Insider Threat Detection

author.name: Jeffrey Flynt

entry.summary: Presents OrgForge-IT, a verifiable synthetic benchmark for LLM-based insider threat detection with architectural guarantees for cross-artifact consistency, spanning 51 simulated days and 2,904 telemetry records.

entry.title: TorR: Towards Brain-Inspired Task-Oriented Reasoning via Cache-Oriented Algorithm-Architecture Co-design

author.name: Hyunwoo Oh, SungHeon Jeong, Suyeon Jang, Hanning Chen, Sanggeon Yun, Tamoghno Das, Mohsen Imani

entry.summary: Presents TorR, a brain-inspired algorithm-architecture co-design replacing CLIP-style dense alignment with hyperdimensional computing for task-oriented object detection, achieving energy efficiency through temporal reuse.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving EHR Data Transformation via Geometric Operators: A Human-AI Co-Design Technical Report

author.name: Maolin Wang, Beining Bao, Gan Yuan, Hongyu Chen, Bingkun Zhao, Baoshuo Kan, Jiming Xu, Qi Shi, Yinggong Zhao, Yao Wang, Wei Ying Ma, Jun Yan

entry.summary: Proposes geometric operator-based privacy-preserving transformations for EHR data that maintain data utility for ML while being more efficient than cryptographic approaches.

entry.title: Post-Selection Distributional Model Evaluation

author.name: Amirmohammad Farzaneh, Osvaldo Simeone

entry.summary: Introduces post-selection distributional model evaluation to reliably estimate full KPI distributions when the same data is used for both model pre-selection and evaluation, addressing post-selection bias.

entry.title: High-Resolution Tensor-Network Fourier Methods for Exponentially Compressed Non-Gaussian Aggregate Distributions

author.name: Juan Jos\'e Rodr\'iguez-Aldavero, Juan Jos\'e Garc\'ia-Ripoll

entry.summary: Demonstrates that characteristic functions of weighted sums of independent random variables have low-rank structure in quantized tensor train format, enabling exponential compression of non-Gaussian distributions.

entry.title: PaperVoyager : Building Interactive Web with Visual Language Models

author.name: Dasen Dai, Biao Wu, Meng Fang, Wenhao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a Paper-to-Interactive-System Agent that converts research PDFs into executable interactive web systems using visual language models, enabling users to manipulate inputs and observe dynamic behaviors described in papers.

entry.title: From Synthetic to Native: Benchmarking Multilingual Intent Classification in Logistics Customer Service

author.name: Haoyu He, Jinyu Zhuang, Haoran Chu, Shuhang Yu, J, T AI Group, Hao Wang, Kunpeng Han

entry.summary: Presents a benchmark for hierarchical multilingual intent classification from real logistics customer-service logs (~30K queries from 600K records), showing that models trained on machine-translated data overestimate real-world robustness.

entry.title: Static Scene Reconstruction from Dynamic Egocentric Videos

author.name: Qifei Cui, Patrick Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline for static 3D reconstruction from egocentric videos with mask-aware reconstruction to suppress dynamic elements (hands) and chunked reconstruction with pose-graph stitching for long-form consistency.

entry.title: Dress-ED: Instruction-Guided Editing for Virtual Try-On and Try-Off

author.name: Fulvio Sanguigni, Davide Lobba, Bin Ren, Marcella Cornia, Nicu Sebe, Rita Cucchiara

entry.summary: Introduces Dress-ED, the first large-scale dataset unifying virtual try-on, try-off, and text-guided garment editing, built through a fully automated multimodal pipeline.

entry.title: How Far Can VLMs Go for Visual Bug Detection? Studying 19,738 Keyframes from 41 Hours of Gameplay Videos

author.name: Wentao Lu, Alexander Senchenko, Alan Sayle, Abram Hindle, Cor-Paul Bezemer

entry.summary: Conducts a real-world study evaluating VLMs for visual bug detection in industrial QA gameplay videos (41 hours, 19,738 keyframes), finding significant gaps between curated benchmark performance and practical deployment.

entry.title: ENC-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Electronic Navigational Chart Understanding

author.name: Ao Cheng, Xingming Li, Xuanyu Ji, Xixiang He, Qiyao Sun, Chunping Qiu, Runke Huang, Qingyong Hu

entry.summary: Introduces ENC-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on Electronic Navigational Chart understanding with 20,490 expert-validated samples from 840 NOAA charts, organized in a three-level hierarchy.

entry.title: Traffic Sign Recognition in Autonomous Driving: Dataset, Benchmark, and Field Experiment

author.name: Guoyang Zhao, Weiqing Qi, Kai Zhang, Chenguang Zhang, Zeying Gong, Zhihai Bi, Kai Chen, Benshan Ma, Ming Liu, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Presents TS-1M, a large-scale traffic sign dataset with over one million real-world images across 454 categories, along with a diagnostic benchmark for analyzing model capability boundaries in cross-region, long-tailed, and ambiguous scenarios.

entry.title: AgentFoX: LLM Agent-Guided Fusion with eXplainability for AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Yangxin Yu, Yue Zhou, Bin Li, Kaiqing Lin, Haodong Li, Jiangqun Ni, Bo Cao

entry.summary: Presents AgentFoX, an LLM-driven framework for AI-generated image detection that uses dynamic multi-phase analysis with calibrated expert profiles and clustering profiles to fuse multiple specialized forensic detectors.

entry.title: Automatic Segmentation of 3D CT scans with SAM2 using a zero-shot approach

author.name: Miquel Lopez Escoriza, Pau Amargant Alvarez

entry.summary: Studies zero-shot application of SAM2 for automatic 3D CT segmentation by treating CT slices as ordered sequences and adapting the video-based memory mechanism without any fine-tuning.

entry.title: ViKey: Enhancing Temporal Understanding in Videos via Visual Prompting

author.name: Yeonkyung Lee, Dayun Ju, Youngmin Kim, Seil Kang, Seong Jae Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes ViKey, a visual prompting approach to enhance temporal understanding in VideoLLMs by embedding temporal cues directly into video frames, improving temporal reasoning without additional computational overhead.

entry.title: FDIF: Formula-Driven supervised Learning with Implicit Functions for 3D Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Yukinori Yamamoto, Kazuya Nishimura, Tsukasa Fukusato, Hirokazu Nosato, Tetsuya Ogata, Hirokatsu Kataoka

entry.summary: Introduces FDIF, a formula-driven supervised learning framework using implicit functions (SDFs) for 3D medical image segmentation pre-training that requires no real data or expert annotations.

entry.title: GO-Renderer: Generative Object Rendering with 3D-aware Controllable Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Zekai Gu, Shuoxuan Feng, Yansong Wang, Hanzhuo Huang, Zhongshuo Du, Chengfeng Zhao, Chengwei Ren, Peng Wang, Yuan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes GO-Renderer, a framework integrating reconstructed 3D proxies with video diffusion models for high-quality, viewpoint-controllable object rendering from images.

entry.title: Pose-Free Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting for 360-Degree Videos with Consistent Depth Priors

author.name: Chuanqing Zhuang, Xin Lu, Zehui Deng, Zhengda Lu, Yiqun Wang, Junqi Diao, Jun Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes PFGS360, a pose-free omnidirectional 3D Gaussian Splatting method for 360° videos that estimates camera poses using spherical consistency-aware module without requiring SfM preprocessing.

entry.title: FHAvatar: Fast and High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Face-and-Hair Composable 3D Head Avatar from Few Casual Captures

author.name: Yujie Sun, Zhuoqiang Cai, Chaoyue Niu, Jianchuan Chen, Zhiwen Chen, Chengfei Lv, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Presents FHAvatar for fast 3D Gaussian avatar reconstruction with composable face and hair from few views, using planar Gaussians for face and strand-based Gaussians for hair with an aggregated transformer backbone.

entry.title: UniFunc3D: Unified Active Spatial-Temporal Grounding for 3D Functionality Segmentation

author.name: Jiaying Lin, Dan Xu

entry.summary: Presents UniFunc3D, a unified training-free framework for 3D functionality segmentation that uses an MLLM as an active observer for joint semantic, temporal, and spatial reasoning in a single forward pass.

entry.title: Allometric Scaling Laws for Bipedal Robots

author.name: Naomi Oke, Aja Carter, Ben Gu, Steven Man, Cordelia Pride, Sarah Bergbreiter, Aaron M. Johnson

entry.summary: Derives allometric scaling laws for bipedal robots across three orders of magnitude in leg length, finding that robot mass scales as L^2 (rather than L^3 as in biology). Combines literature review with controlled Drake simulations to establish design guidelines.

entry.title: Agile-VLA: Few-Shot Industrial Pose Rectification via Implicit Affordance Anchoring

author.name: Teng Yan, Zhengyang Pei, Chengyu Shi, Yue Yu, Yikun Chen, Zilong Zhu, Zelin Fang, Kaile Guo, Zihang Wang, Peigen Tian, Bingzhuo Zhong

entry.summary: Agile-VLA introduces a hierarchical VLA framework for edge deployment (NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano) with an Implicit Affordance Anchoring mechanism that maps geometric visual cues directly to action primitives, decoupling perception (10Hz) from reactive control.

entry.title: Design Guidelines for Nonlinear Kalman Filters via Covariance Compensation

author.name: Shida Jiang, Jaewoong Lee, Shengyu Tao, Scott Moura

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework for understanding when nonlinear Kalman filters succeed or fail, centered on 'covariance compensation' — the deviation between predicted and EKF covariance. Derives three design guidelines for improving nonlinear KFs.

entry.title: Every Major LLM is a 1-Box Smoking Thirder

author.name: Olivia Scharfman

entry.summary: Empirically tests current frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.5, GPT-5.2, Grok 4, Gemini 3, DeepSeek V3.2, Qwen3-Max) on Newcomb's problem, Sleeping Beauty, and the Smoking Lesion, finding all models consistently one-box and behave as 'thirders.' Tests robustness to parameter changes.

entry.title: CLiGNet: Clinical Label-Interaction Graph Network for Medical Specialty Classification from Clinical Transcriptions

author.name: Pronob Kumar Barman, Pronoy Kumar Barman

entry.summary: Documents data leakage in existing medical specialty classification benchmarks (SMOTE before train-test split) and introduces CLiGNet, combining Bio-ClinicalBERT with GCN over specialty label graphs. Establishes leakage-free benchmark.

entry.title: Beyond Preset Identities: How Agents Form Stances and Boundaries in Generative Societies

author.name: Hanzhong Zhang, Siyang Song, Jindong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a mixed-methods framework combining computational ethnography with socio-cognitive profiling to study how LLM-based agents form stances and boundaries in generative multi-agent communities. Introduces metrics for value bias, persuasion sensitivity, and trust-action decoupling.

entry.title: Graphs RAG at Scale: Beyond Retrieval-Augmented Generation With Labeled Property Graphs and Resource Description Framework for Complex and Unknown Search Spaces

author.name: Manie Tadayon, Mayank Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces a Graph RAG framework using both Labeled Property Graphs and RDF architectures for handling unknown search spaces and semi-structured documents. Proposes converting documents to RDF triplets via JSON key-value pairs and eliminates need for pre-specifying document count.

entry.title: Toward Faithful Segmentation Attribution via Benchmarking and Dual-Evidence Fusion

author.name: Abu Noman Md Sakib, OFM Riaz Rahman Aranya, Kevin Desai, Zijie Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark for evaluating segmentation attribution faithfulness through intervention-based tests and proposes Dual-Evidence Attribution (DEA), a lightweight correction fusing gradient evidence with region-level intervention signals.

entry.title: The Coordinate System Problem in Persistent Structural Memory for Neural Architectures

author.name: Abhinaba Basu

entry.summary: Introduces the Dual-View Pheromone Pathway Network (DPPN) and discovers that persistent structural memory in neural networks requires a stable coordinate system that cannot be learned jointly with the model. Identifies three key obstacles to persistent memory.

entry.title: MSR-HuBERT: Self-supervised Pre-training for Adaptation to Multiple Sampling Rates

author.name: Zikang Huang, Meng Ge, Tianrui Wang, Xuanchen Li, Xiaobao Wang, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: Proposes MSR-HuBERT, a multi-sampling-rate adaptive pre-training method for speech that handles mixed-rate audio data without resampling, using adaptive downsampling CNNs to map different rates to shared temporal resolution.

entry.title: DBAutoDoc: Automated Discovery and Documentation of Undocumented Database Schemas via Statistical Analysis and Iterative LLM Refinement

author.name: Amith Nagarajan, Thomas Altman

entry.summary: Presents DBAutoDoc, a system that automates discovery and documentation of undocumented database schemas by combining statistical analysis with iterative LLM refinement, propagating semantic corrections through dependency graphs.

entry.title: General Machine Learning: Theory for Learning Under Variable Regimes

author.name: Aomar Osmani

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical framework for learning under regime variation where the learner, memory state, and evaluation conditions evolve over time. Establishes foundational learning-theoretic objects for multi-regime settings.

entry.title: Bridging the Gap Between Climate Science and Machine Learning in Climate Model Emulation

author.name: Luca Schmidt, Nina Effenberger

entry.summary: Introduces a framework bridging climate science and ML for climate model emulation, addressing barriers of accessibility, trust, and physical fidelity.

entry.title: Bounding Box Anomaly Scoring for simple and efficient Out-of-Distribution detection

author.name: Mohamed Bahi Yahiaoui, Geoffrey Daniel, Lo\"ic Giraldi, J\'er\'emie Bruyelle, Julyan Arbel

entry.summary: Introduces Bounding Box Anomaly Scoring for out-of-distribution detection, using axis-aligned bounding boxes of hidden activations as an intermediate between parametric (Mahalanobis) and non-parametric (kNN) methods.

entry.title: Prompt Amplification and Zero-Shot Late Fusion in Audio-Language Models for Speech Emotion Recognition

author.name: Saurabh Kataria, Xiao Hu

entry.summary: Proposes ZS-Fuse for speech emotion recognition, combining zero-shot audio-language model estimates with specialist foundation models via late fusion, plus a novel prompt amplification technique.

entry.title: Evaluating Large Language Models' Responses to Sexual and Reproductive Health Queries in Nepali

author.name: Medha Sharma, Supriya Khadka, Udit Chandra Aryal, Bishnu Hari Bhatta, Bijayan Bhattarai, Santosh Dahal, Kamal Gautam, Pushpa Joshi, Saugat Kafle, Shristi Khadka, Shushila Khadka, Binod Lamichhane, Shilpa Lamichhane, Anusha Parajuli, Sabina Pokharel, Suvekshya Sitaula, Neha Verma, Bishesh Khanal

entry.summary: Introduces LEAF, a multi-criteria evaluation framework for LLM responses to sexual and reproductive health queries in Nepali, assessing accuracy, cultural appropriateness, safety, and usability. Finds significant gaps especially in sensitivity and cultural context.

entry.title: I Came, I Saw, I Explained: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs on Figurative Meaning in Memes

author.name: Shijia Zhou, Saif M. Mohammad, Barbara Plank, Diego Frassinelli

entry.summary: Evaluates 8 state-of-the-art MLLMs on their ability to detect and explain 6 types of figurative meaning in memes, including human evaluation of reasoning quality and faithfulness to original content.

entry.title: Generalized multi-object classification and tracking with sparse feature resonator networks

author.name: Lazar Supic, Alec Mullen, E. Paxon Frady

entry.summary: Uses resonator networks for analysis-by-synthesis approach to multi-object classification and tracking, factoring scenes into objects and their transformations using a generative model with hyperdimensional computing.

entry.title: Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection via Geometric Prior

author.name: Min Li, Jinghui He, Gang Li, Jiachen Li, Jin Wan, Delong Han

entry.summary: Proposes GPAD for multimodal industrial anomaly detection using geometric priors from point clouds, including differential normal vector computation and cross-modal fusion with 2D features for improved defect detection.

entry.title: When AVSR Meets Video Conferencing: Dataset, Degradation, and the Hidden Mechanism Behind Performance Collapse

author.name: Yihuan Huang, Jun Xue, Liu Jiajun, Daixian Li, Tong Zhang, Zhuolin Yi, Yanzhen Ren, Kai Li

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic evaluation of audio-visual speech recognition models on video conferencing platforms, revealing severe performance degradation. Introduces MLD-VC dataset with 31 speakers and identifies speech enhancement algorithms as primary degradation source.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Personalization of Objects via Textual Inversion

author.name: Aniket Roy, Maitreya Suin, Rama Chellappa

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-shot personalization framework for arbitrary objects in text-to-image diffusion models using a learned network to predict object-specific textual inversion embeddings, avoiding per-object optimization.

entry.title: NeuroSeg Meets DINOv3: Transferring 2D Self-Supervised Visual Priors to 3D Neuron Segmentation via DINOv3 Initialization

author.name: Yik San Cheng, Runkai Zhao, Weidong Cai

entry.summary: Proposes transferring 2D self-supervised visual priors from DINOv3 to 3D neuron segmentation via an inflation-based adaptation strategy that converts 2D filters into 3D operators for volumetric neuroimaging.

entry.title: PiCo: Active Manifold Canonicalization for Robust Robotic Visual Anomaly Detection

author.name: Teng Yan, Binkai Liu, Shuai Liu, Yue Yu, Bingzhuo Zhong

entry.summary: Introduces PiCo, a framework for robotic visual anomaly detection that actively projects observations onto a condition-invariant canonical manifold through robotic reorientation, shifting from passive feature learning to active canonicalization.

entry.title: Gaze-Regularized VLMs for Ego-Centric Behavior Understanding

author.name: Anupam Pani, Yanchao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces a gaze-regularized framework that incorporates eye gaze information into Vision Language Models during training for improved egocentric behavior understanding, using gaze-based queries and attention alignment.

entry.title: CCF: Complementary Collaborative Fusion for Domain Generalized Multi-Modal 3D Object Detection

author.name: Yuchen Wu, Kun Wang, Yining Pan, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes CCF for domain-generalized multi-modal 3D object detection, addressing modality degradation and LiDAR dominance through query-decoupled loss, modality augmentation, and cross-attention reweighting.

entry.title: Task-Agnostic Exoskeleton Control Supports Elderly Joint Energetics during Hip-Intensive Tasks

author.name: Jiefu Zhang, Nikhil V. Divekar, Chandramouli Krishnan, Robert D. Gregg

entry.summary: Validates a task-agnostic hip exoskeleton controller for elderly users across multiple hip-intensive activities (not just steady-state walking). Shows the controller is inherently sensitive to joint power and effective across diverse mobility tasks in 8 older adults.

entry.title: AeroScene: Progressive Scene Synthesis for Aerial Robotics

author.name: Nghia Vu, Tuong Do, Dzung Tran, Binh X. Nguyen, Hoan Nguyen, Erman Tjiputra, Quang D. Tran, Hai-Nguyen Nguyen, Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: AeroScene introduces a hierarchical diffusion model for progressive 3D scene synthesis tailored to aerial robotics simulation. Uses hierarchy-aware tokenization and multi-branch feature extraction for physically plausible scene generation.

entry.title: PinPoint: Monocular Needle Pose Estimation for Robotic Suturing via Stein Variational Newton and Geometric Residuals

author.name: Jesse F. d'Almeida, Tanner Watts, Susheela Sharma Stern, James Ferguson, Alan Kuntz, Robert J. Webster III

entry.summary: PinPoint is a probabilistic framework for monocular surgical needle pose estimation using Stein Variational Newton inference, maintaining a distribution over pose hypotheses to handle depth ambiguity and rotational symmetry inherent in single-camera settings.

entry.title: A Theory of Nonparametric Covariance Function Estimation for Discretely Observed Data

author.name: Yoshikazu Terada, Atsutomo Yara

entry.summary: Develops theory for nonparametric covariance function estimation from discretely observed functional data on multi-dimensional domains. Establishes oracle inequalities for learning-based estimators including deep learning, proving minimax optimality.

entry.title: A ToM-Inspired Agenda for AI Safety Research

author.name: Andrés Cotton

entry.summary: Proposes a Theory of Mind (ToM)-inspired research agenda for AI safety, arguing that better ToM in models could help with three problems: fragile agentic ecosystems, AI manipulation risk, and reward misspecification. Argues ToM research deserves more attention.

entry.title: Graph-Aware Late Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Biomedical Literature

author.name: Pouria Mortezaagha, Arya Rahgozar

entry.summary: Proposes GraLC-RAG, combining late chunking with graph-aware structural intelligence for biomedical RAG, including UMLS knowledge graph infusion and structure-aware chunk detection. Argues that retrieval breadth across document sections matters as much as precision.

entry.title: Ran Score: a LLM-based Evaluation Score for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Ran Zhang, Yucong Lin, Zhaoli Su, Bowen Liu, Danni Ai, Tianyu Fu, Deqiang Xiao, Jingfan Fan, Yuanyuan Wang, Mingwei Gao, Yuwan Hu, Shuya Gao, Jingtao Li, Jian Yang, Hong Song, Hongliang Sun

entry.summary: Develops Ran Score, an LLM-based evaluation metric for radiology report generation that uses clinician-guided multi-label finding extraction. Addresses poor recognition of low-prevalence abnormalities and handling of negation/ambiguity.

entry.title: Minibal: Balanced Game-Playing Without Opponent Modeling

author.name: Quentin Cohen-Solal, Tristan Cazenave

entry.summary: Introduces Minibal, a Minimax variant designed for balanced play where the AI challenges human opponents without dominating or conceding. Tested across seven board games, addressing the problem of superhuman AI being poor for human interaction.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Missing Data Imputation: Understanding Behavior, Hallucination Effects, and Control Mechanisms

author.name: Arthur Dantas Mangussi, Ricardo Cardoso Pereira, Ana Carolina Lorena, Pedro Henriques Abreu

entry.summary: Comprehensive benchmarking study of LLMs for missing data imputation in tabular datasets using zero-shot prompt engineering. Evaluates across multiple models, missingness mechanisms (MCAR, MAR, MNAR), and datasets, investigating hallucination effects and control mechanisms.

entry.title: flexvec: SQL Vector Retrieval with Programmatic Embedding Modulation

author.name: Damian Delmas

entry.summary: Proposes flexvec, a SQL-based retrieval kernel that exposes the embedding matrix and score array as a programmable surface, allowing arithmetic operations on embeddings at query time (Programmatic Embedding Modulation). Executes in 19ms on 240K chunks.

entry.title: Do Consumers Accept AIs as Moral Compliance Agents?

author.name: Greg Nyilasy, Abraham Ryan Ade Putra Hito, Jennifer Overbeck, Brock Bastian, Darren W. Dahl

entry.summary: Investigates whether consumers accept AI in moral compliance roles (upholding pre-existing norms without discretion), finding that consumers evaluate AI more positively than humans in these roles due to perceived lack of ulterior motives. Across five studies.

entry.title: URA-Net: Uncertainty-Integrated Anomaly Perception and Restoration Attention Network for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wei Luo, Peng Xing, Yunkang Cao, Haiming Yao, Weiming Shen, Zechao Li

entry.summary: Proposes URA-Net for unsupervised anomaly detection that explicitly restores anomalous patterns to normality rather than just reconstructing normal images, addressing the over-generalization problem in reconstruction-based methods.

entry.title: HUydra: Full-Range Lung CT Synthesis via Multiple HU Interval Generative Modelling

author.name: Ant\'onio Cardoso, Pedro Sousa, Tania Pereira, H\'elder P. Oliveira

entry.summary: Introduces a decomposition strategy for synthesizing lung CT images by generating one Hounsfield Unit interval at a time, rather than modeling the full HU range simultaneously. Addresses computational challenges in medical image generation.

entry.title: AuthorMix: Modular Authorship Style Transfer via Layer-wise Adapter Mixing

author.name: Sarubi Thillainathan, Ji-Ung Lee, Michael Sullivan, Alexander Koller

entry.summary: Proposes AuthorMix, a modular style transfer framework using style-specific LoRA adapters that can be mixed layer-wise to transfer writing style of new target authors from just a handful of examples.

entry.title: A Multimodal Framework for Human-Multi-Agent Interaction

author.name: Shaid Hasan, Breenice Lee, Sujan Sarker, Tariq Iqbal

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal framework for human-multi-agent interaction where each robot operates as an autonomous agent with LLM-driven planning, coordinated by centralized turn-taking mechanisms.

entry.title: Unilateral Relationship Revision Power in Human-AI Companion Interaction

author.name: Benjamin Lange

entry.summary: Examines the ethics of AI companion interactions, arguing they form a triadic structure where providers exercise constitutive control. Introduces concept of Unilateral Relationship Revision Power (URRP) where providers can unilaterally alter user-AI relationships.

entry.title: A Theoretical Framework for Energy-Aware Gradient Pruning in Federated Learning

author.name: Emmanouil M. Athanasakos

entry.summary: Formalizes gradient pruning in federated learning as an energy-constrained projection problem, proposing Cost-Weighted Magnitude Pruning that accounts for hardware-level cost disparities.

entry.title: Robustness Quantification and Uncertainty Quantification: Comparing Two Methods for Assessing the Reliability of Classifier Predictions

author.name: Adri\'an Detavernier, Jasper De Bock

entry.summary: Compares Robustness Quantification (RQ) and Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) for assessing classifier prediction reliability, showing RQ can outperform UQ and their combination yields better results.

entry.title: Robustness Quantification for Discriminative Models: a New Robustness Metric and its Application to Dynamic Classifier Selection

author.name: Rodrigo F. L. Lassance, Jasper De Bock

entry.summary: Proposes a new robustness metric for discriminative classifiers applicable to any type of features, and applies it to dynamic classifier selection, without requiring generative models.

entry.title: Neutrino Oscillation Parameter Estimation Using Structured Hierarchical Transformers

author.name: Giorgio Morales, Gregory Lehaut, Antonin Vacheret, Frederic Jurie, Jalal Fadili

entry.summary: Introduces a hierarchical transformer framework for neutrino oscillation parameter estimation, reformulating inference as supervised regression over structured oscillation maps to avoid expensive simulation.

entry.title: Wake Up to the Past: Using Memory to Model Fluid Wake Effects on Robots

author.name: Luca Vendruscolo, Eduardo Sebasti\'an, Amanda Prorok, Ajay Shankar

entry.summary: Proposes using memory-augmented neural networks to model fluid wake effects between robots, accounting for finite propagation time delays that memoryless models miss.

entry.title: CAPITU: A Benchmark for Evaluating Instruction-Following in Brazilian Portuguese with Literary Context

author.name: Giovana Kerche Bon\'as, Roseval Malaquias Junior, Marcos Piau, Thiago Laitz, Thales Sales Almeida, Hugo Abonizio, Celio Larcher, Ramon Pires, Rodrigo Nogueira

entry.summary: Introduces CAPITU, a benchmark for evaluating LLM instruction-following in Brazilian Portuguese using canonical literary works, with 59 automatically verifiable instruction types including Portuguese-specific linguistic constraints.

entry.title: Quality Over Clicks: Intrinsic Quality-Driven Iterative Reinforcement Learning for Cold-Start E-Commerce Query Suggestion

author.name: Qi Sun, Kejun Xiao, Huaipeng Zhao, Tao Luo, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes Cold-EQS, an iterative RL framework for e-commerce query suggestion that uses answerability, factuality, and information gain as rewards to handle cold-start scenarios where click data is unavailable.

entry.title: UrbanVGGT: Scalable Sidewalk Width Estimation from Street View Images

author.name: Kaizhen Tan, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents UrbanVGGT, a pipeline for estimating metric sidewalk widths from single street-view images using semantic segmentation, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, and ground-plane fitting. Achieves 9.5% mean error on Washington D.C. benchmark.

entry.title: A Vision Language Model for Generating Procedural Plant Architecture Representations from Simulated Images

author.name: Heesup Yun, Isaac Kazuo Uyehara, Ioannis Droutsas, Earl Ranario, Christine H. Diepenbrock, Brian N. Bailey, J. Mason Earles

entry.summary: Uses a VLM to generate 3D procedural plant architecture models from single images, creating functional structural models with organ-level geometric and topological parameters.

entry.title: Large-Scale Avalanche Mapping from SAR Images with Deep Learning-based Change Detection

author.name: Mattia Gatti, Alberto Mariani, Ignazio Gallo, Fabiano Monti

entry.summary: Presents large-scale avalanche mapping from Sentinel-1 SAR imagery using deep learning change detection, achieving 0.81 F1-score and demonstrating that unimodal SAR change detection outperforms more complex approaches.

entry.title: SOUPLE: Enhancing Audio-Visual Localization and Segmentation with Learnable Prompt Contexts

author.name: Khanh Binh Nguyen, Chae Jung Park

entry.summary: Proposes SOUPLE for audio-visual localization that replaces fixed CLIP prompts with learnable context tokens incorporating visual features, addressing the semantic gap between audio embeddings and text context.

entry.title: From Pixels to Semantics: A Multi-Stage AI Framework for Structural Damage Detection in Satellite Imagery

author.name: Bijay Shakya, Catherine Hoier, Khandaker Mamun Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid framework integrating AI super-resolution, deep learning object detection, and VLMs for post-disaster building damage assessment from satellite imagery, upscaling images 4× for improved detection.

entry.title: ForeSea: AI Forensic Search with Multi-modal Queries for Video Surveillance

author.name: Hyojin Park, Yi Li, Janghoon Cho, Sungha Choi, Jungsoo Lee, Taotao Jing, Shuai Zhang, Munawar Hayat, Dashan Gao, Ning Bi, Fatih Porikli

entry.summary: Introduces ForeSeaQA, a benchmark for forensic video surveillance search with multi-modal queries (image+text) and timestamped annotations. Proposes ForeSea framework for finding specific targets across long multi-camera video with temporal reasoning.

entry.title: InterDyad: Interactive Dyadic Speech-to-Video Generation by Querying Intermediate Visual Guidance

author.name: Dongwei Pan, Longwei Guo, Jiazhi Guan, Luying Huang, Yiding Li, Haojie Liu, Haocheng Feng, Wei He, Kaisiyuan Wang, Hang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes InterDyad for interactive dyadic speech-to-video generation that captures cross-individual dependencies through an Interactivity Injector and MetaQuery-based modality alignment using MLLMs.

entry.title: GSwap: Realistic Head Swapping with Dynamic Neural Gaussian Field

author.name: Jingtao Zhou, Xuan Gao, Dongyu Liu, Junhui Hou, Yudong Guo, Juyong Zhang

entry.summary: Presents GSwap, a video head-swapping system using dynamic neural Gaussian portrait priors that overcomes limitations of 2D generative and 3DMM-based approaches for 3D-consistent and realistic head replacement.

entry.title: Gimbal360: Differentiable Auto-Leveling for Canonicalized $360^\circ$ Panoramic Image Completion

author.name: Yuqin Lu, Haofeng Liu, Yang Zhou, Jun Liang, Shengfeng He, Jing Li

entry.summary: Presents Gimbal360, a framework for 360° panoramic image completion from unposed perspective images using a Canonical Viewing Space and Differentiable Auto-Leveling module without requiring camera parameters.

entry.title: From Feature Learning to Spectral Basis Learning: A Unifying and Flexible Framework for Efficient and Robust Shape Matching

author.name: Feifan Luo, Hongyang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Advanced Functional Maps that replace fixed spectral basis functions with learnable ones for shape matching, eliminating time-consuming functional map solvers during inference.

entry.title: Harnessing Lightweight Transformer with Contextual Synergic Enhancement for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Xinyu Liu, Zhen Chen, Wuyang Li, Chenxin Li, Yixuan Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes Light-UNETR, a lightweight transformer for 3D medical image segmentation with dimension-reductive attention and compact gated linear unit, plus a contextual synergic enhancement framework for data efficiency.

entry.title: Learning Sidewalk Autopilot from Multi-Scale Imitation with Corrective Behavior Expansion

author.name: Honglin He, Yukai Ma, Brad Squicciarini, Wayne Wu, Bolei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for sidewalk micromobility autopilot using corrective behavior expansion and multi-scale imitation learning that augments teleoperation data with diverse corrective behaviors.

entry.title: Single-Subject Multi-View MRI Super-Resolution via Implicit Neural Representations

author.name: Heejong Kim, Abhishek Thanki, Roel van Herten, Daniel Margolis, Mert R Sabuncu

entry.summary: Proposes using implicit neural representations for single-subject MRI super-resolution from multiple views, offering a self-supervised alternative to deep learning methods that require large training datasets.

entry.title: A Latency Coding Framework for Deep Spiking Neural Networks with Ultra-Low Latency

author.name: Yi Lu, Jianhao Ding, Zhaofei Yu

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive framework for training deep spiking neural networks using Time-To-First-Spike (TTFS) coding with BPTT, achieving ultra-low latency inference. Addresses key limitations of existing TTFS models in training efficiency and performance.

entry.title: Instrument-Splatting++: Towards Controllable Surgical Instrument Digital Twin Using Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Shuojue Yang, Zijian Wu, Chengjiaao Liao, Qian Li, Daiyun Shen, Chang Han Low, Septimiu E. Salcudean, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Instrument-Splatting++ uses 3D Gaussian Splatting to create controllable digital twins of surgical instruments from monocular video. Combines CAD-prior pretraining with semantics-aware pose estimation for high-fidelity, articulated instrument reconstruction.

entry.title: PHANTOM Hand

author.name: Teng Yan, Jiongxu Chen, Qixiang Hua, Yue Yu, Zihang Wang, Yaohua Liu, Bingzhuo Zhong

entry.summary: PHANTOM Hand is a modular, human-scale robotic hand with 6 actuators and 15 DOFs that bridges precise analytic shaping and robust compliant grasping. Uses a unified framework with sparse geometric mapping and mechanics-based compensation to suppress kinematic drift.

entry.title: Tightly-Coupled Radar-Visual-Inertial Odometry

author.name: Morten Nissov, Mohit Singh, Kostas Alexis

entry.summary: Combines visual-inertial odometry with FMCW radar in a tightly-coupled framework for robust state estimation across diverse conditions (dark, low-texture, obscured environments). Enables reliable operation where either sensor modality alone would fail.

entry.title: STEM Agent: A Self-Adapting, Tool-Enabled, Extensible Architecture for Multi-Protocol AI Agent Systems

author.name: Alfred Shen, Aaron Shen

entry.summary: Proposes STEM Agent, a modular architecture inspired by biological pluripotency that unifies five interoperability protocols (A2A, AG-UI, A2UI, UCP, AP2) behind a single gateway with a user profiler that learns preferences. Aims to solve the problem of agent frameworks committing to fixed interaction protocols.

entry.title: HyFI: Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation for Brain-Vision Alignment

author.name: Sangmin Jo, Wootaek Jeong, Da-Woon Heo, Yoohwan Hwang, Heung-Il Suk

entry.summary: Uses hyperbolic space for brain-vision alignment, addressing the modality gap between brain signals and images and the entanglement of semantic and perceptual features in neural activity. Proposes hyperbolic feature interpolation.

entry.title: PersonalQ: Select, Quantize, and Serve Personalized Diffusion Models for Efficient Inference

author.name: Qirui Wang, Qi Guo, Yiding Sun, Junkai Yang, Dongxu Zhang, Shanmin Pang, Qing Guo

entry.summary: Presents PersonalQ, a framework connecting personalized diffusion model checkpoint selection and quantization through trigger tokens. Addresses ambiguous routing and fragile personalized representations under quantization.

entry.title: Where Experts Disagree, Models Fail: Detecting Implicit Legal Citations in French Court Decisions

author.name: Avrile Floro (UPHF), Tamara Dhorasoo (UPHF), Soline Pellez (UPHF), Nils Holzenberger

entry.summary: Studies implicit legal citation detection in French court decisions, showing that expert disagreement (κ=0.33) predicts model failures. Supervised ensemble achieves F1=0.70 but fails on boundary cases between factual description and legal reasoning.

entry.title: JFTA-Bench: Evaluate LLM's Ability of Tracking and Analyzing Malfunctions Using Fault Trees

author.name: Yuhui Wang, Zhixiong Yang, Ming Zhang, Shihan Dou, Zhiheng Xi, Enyu Zhou, Senjie Jin, Yujiong Shen, Dingwei Zhu, Yi Dong, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang

entry.summary: Proposes JFTA-Bench for evaluating LLMs' ability to track and analyze malfunctions using fault trees. Includes 3,130 entries with average 40.75 turns per entry, with novel textual fault tree representation.

entry.title: Online library learning in human visual puzzle solving

author.name: Pinzhe Zhao, Emanuele Sansone, Marta Kryven, Bonan Zhao

entry.summary: Studies how humans form efficient reusable abstractions in visual puzzle solving, finding that helper creation shifts from completeness to efficiency with experience. Computational modeling shows human behavior aligns with Bayesian library learning models.

entry.title: MERIT: Memory-Enhanced Retrieval for Interpretable Knowledge Tracing

author.name: Runze Li, Kedi Chen, Guwei Feng, Mo Yu, Jun Wang, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MERIT, a training-free knowledge tracing framework combining frozen LLM reasoning with structured pedagogical memory. Transforms raw interaction logs into retrievable knowledge states without parameter updates.

entry.title: Enhancing AI-Based Tropical Cyclone Track and Intensity Forecasting via Systematic Bias Correction

author.name: Peisong Niu, Haifan Zhang, Yang Zhao, Tian Zhou, Ziqing Ma, Wenqiang Shen, Junping Zhao, Huiling Yuan, Liang Sun

entry.summary: Presents systematic bias correction for AI-based tropical cyclone track and intensity forecasting, addressing discretization errors from coarse-resolution training data and smoothing effects that limit strong TC intensity prediction.

entry.title: Emergency Preemption Without Online Exploration: A Decision Transformer Approach

author.name: Haoran Su, Hanxiao Deng, Yandong Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Decision Transformer approach for emergency vehicle signal preemption, eliminating online exploration by casting corridor optimization as offline return-conditioned sequence modeling. Reduces EV travel time by 37.7%.

entry.title: Beyond the Mean: Distribution-Aware Loss Functions for Bimodal Regression

author.name: Abolfazl Mohammadi-Seif, Carlos Soares, Rita P. Ribeiro, Ricardo Baeza-Yates

entry.summary: Proposes distribution-aware loss functions for regression tasks where prediction errors follow bimodal distributions, addressing the mean-collapse behavior of standard approaches that assume unimodal Gaussian noise. Offers an alternative to Mixture Density Networks that avoids their optimization instabilities.

entry.title: Unveiling the Mechanism of Continuous Representation Full-Waveform Inversion: A Wave Based Neural Tangent Kernel Framework

author.name: Ruihua Chen, Yisi Luo, Bangyu Wu, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Develops a wave-based neural tangent kernel framework to explain why continuous representation full-waveform inversion (CR-FWI) with neural networks works. Provides unified theoretical analysis and addresses slow high-frequency convergence in INR-based FWI.

entry.title: SynLeaF: A Dual-Stage Multimodal Fusion Framework for Synthetic Lethality Prediction Across Pan- and Single-Cancer Contexts

author.name: Zheming Xing, Siyuan Zhou, Ruinan Wang, Rui Han, Shiming Zhang, Shiqu Chen, Yurui Huang, Jiahao Ma, Yifan Chen, Xuan Wang, Yadong Wang, Junyi Li

entry.summary: Proposes SynLeaF, a dual-stage multimodal fusion framework for synthetic lethality prediction across pan-cancer and single-cancer contexts. Addresses 'modality laziness' in heterogeneous data fusion using VAE-based cross-encoder with product of experts.

entry.title: GraphRAG for Engineering Diagrams: ChatP&ID Enables LLM Interaction with P&IDs

author.name: Achmad Anggawirya Alimin, Artur M. Schweidtmann

entry.summary: Introduces ChatP&ID, a GraphRAG framework enabling natural-language interaction with engineering Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams by transforming DEXPI-standard smart P&IDs into structured knowledge graphs.

entry.title: WiFi2Cap: Semantic Action Captioning from Wi-Fi CSI via Limb-Level Semantic Alignment

author.name: Tzu-Ti Wei, Chu-Yu Huang, Yu-Chee Tseng, Jen-Jee Chen

entry.summary: Proposes WiFi2Cap, a three-stage framework for generating natural language action captions from WiFi CSI signals, bridging the gap between wireless sensing and language generation. Addresses left/right limb confusion through semantic alignment.

entry.title: DALDALL: Data Augmentation for Lexical and Semantic Diverse in Legal Domain by leveraging LLM-Persona

author.name: Janghyeok Choi, Jaewon Lee, Sungzoon Cho

entry.summary: Proposes DALDALL, a persona-based data augmentation framework for legal information retrieval that uses domain-specific professional personas (attorneys, prosecutors, judges) to generate diverse synthetic queries via LLMs.

entry.title: From Overload to Convergence: Supporting Multi-Issue Human-AI Negotiation with Bayesian Visualization

author.name: Mehul Parmar, Chaklam Silpasuwanchai

entry.summary: Designs a Bayesian visualization for multi-issue human-AI negotiation that shows how the space of mutually acceptable agreements narrows over time. Demonstrates improved negotiation performance (N=32) when cognitive load is high.

entry.title: DariMis: Harm-Aware Modeling for Dari Misinformation Detection on YouTube

author.name: Jawid Ahmad Baktash, Mosa Ebrahimi, Mohammad Zarif Joya, Mursal Dawodi

entry.summary: Creates DariMis, the first annotated dataset of 9,224 Dari-language YouTube videos for misinformation detection, labeled for information type and harm level. Shows that misinformation and harm are structurally coupled.

entry.title: Contrastive Metric Learning for Point Cloud Segmentation in Highly Granular Detectors

author.name: Max Marriott-Clarke, Lazar Novakovic, Elizabeth Ratzer, Robert J. Bainbridge, Loukas Gouskos, Benedikt Maier

entry.summary: Proposes contrastive metric learning for point cloud segmentation in particle physics calorimeters, learning latent representations where same-object points cluster together. Outperforms object condensation baseline.

entry.title: Planning over MAPF Agent Dependencies via Multi-Dependency PIBT

author.name: Zixiang Jiang, Yulun Zhang, Rishi Veerapaneni, Jiaoyang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Dependency PIBT for multi-agent path finding that plans over agent dependencies, extending beyond the single-conflict limitation of standard PIBT algorithms.

entry.title: Biased Error Attribution in Multi-Agent Human-AI Systems Under Delayed Feedback

author.name: Teerthaa Parakh, Karen M. Feigh

entry.summary: Studies how delayed outcomes shape decision-making and responsibility attribution in multi-agent human-AI tasks. Finds asymmetric responses to gains and losses with biased error attribution patterns.

entry.title: A graph neural network based chemical mechanism reduction method for combustion applications

author.name: Manuru Nithin Padiyar, Priyabrat Dash, Konduri Aditya

entry.summary: Presents GNN-based chemical mechanism reduction using message-passing transformer layers. Two formulations (surrogate-guided and autoencoder-based) learn to reduce complex combustion mechanisms.

entry.title: Coordinate Encoding on Linear Grids for Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Tetsuro Tsuchino, Motoki Shiga

entry.summary: Proposes a coordinate-encoding layer on linear grid cells for PINNs to address the spectral bias problem, improving training convergence speed for solving PDEs.

entry.title: Spiking Personalized Federated Learning for Brain-Computer Interface-Enabled Immersive Communication

author.name: Chen Shang, Dinh Thai Hoang, Diep N. Nguyen, Jiadong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a spiking neural network-based personalized federated learning framework for brain-computer interfaces in immersive communication, addressing energy constraints and individual variability in brain signals.

entry.title: SynForceNet: A Force-Driven Global-Local Latent Representation Framework for Lithium-Ion Battery Fault Diagnosis

author.name: Rongxiu Chen, Yuting Su

entry.summary: Develops an online battery fault diagnosis network combining kernel one-class classification with mechanical constraints and STDP-based dynamic representations, validated on 8.6M data points from 20 EVs.

entry.title: Estimating Flow Velocity and Vehicle Angle-of-Attack from Non-invasive Piezoelectric Structural Measurements Using Deep Learning

author.name: Chandler B. Smith, S. Hales Swift, Andrew Steyer, Ihab El-Kady

entry.summary: Uses deep learning to estimate aerodynamic state variables (velocity, angle of attack) from piezoelectric structural vibration measurements rather than direct flow instrumentation, demonstrated in hypersonic wind tunnel.

entry.title: CSTS: A Canonical Security Telemetry Substrate for AI-Native Cyber Detection

author.name: Abdul Rahman

entry.summary: Introduces CSTS, an entity-relational abstraction layer for cybersecurity telemetry that enables AI-driven detection systems to transfer across heterogeneous environments by enforcing identity persistence and temporal state invariants.

entry.title: Multilingual KokoroChat: A Multi-LLM Ensemble Translation Method for Creating a Multilingual Counseling Dialogue Dataset

author.name: Ryoma Suzuki, Zhiyang Qi, Michimasa Inaba
