entry.title: FluidWorld: Reaction-Diffusion Dynamics as a Predictive Substrate for World Models

author.name: Fabien Polly

entry.summary: Introduces FluidWorld, a world model using reaction-diffusion PDEs instead of transformers for predictive dynamics, demonstrating that PDE-based substrates can achieve comparable performance without self-attention.

entry.title: SSAM: Singular Subspace Alignment for Merging Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Md Kaykobad Reza, Ameya Patil, Edward Ayrapetian, M. Salman Asif

entry.summary: Proposes SSAM for merging multimodal LLMs (e.g., vision-language and audio-language) by aligning their singular subspaces before merging, enabling multi-modal capabilities without paired training data.

entry.title: Proximal Policy Optimization in Path Space: A Schr\"odinger Bridge Perspective

author.name: Yuehu Gong, Zeyuan Wang, Yulin Chen, Yanwei Fu

entry.summary: Proposes GSB-PPO, lifting PPO from action space to path space using Generalized Schrödinger Bridge theory, enabling on-policy RL with diffusion/flow-based generative policies.

entry.title: On the Interplay of Priors and Overparametrization in Bayesian Neural Network Posteriors

author.name: Julius Kobialka, Emanuel Sommer, Chris Kolb, Juntae Kwon, Daniel Dold, David R\"ugamer

entry.summary: Studies how overparametrization and priors interact to reshape Bayesian neural network posteriors, identifying three key phenomena: balancedness, weight reallocation on equal-probability manifolds, and prior conformity. Validates findings with extensive posterior sampling.

entry.title: Chimera: Latency- and Performance-Aware Multi-agent Serving for Heterogeneous LLMs

author.name: Kangqi Ni, Wenyue Hua, Xiaoxiang Shi, Jiang Guo, Shiyu Chang, Tianlong Chen

entry.summary: Presents Chimera, a predictive scheduling system for multi-agent LLM workflows on heterogeneous clusters that jointly optimizes end-to-end latency and task performance by routing stages to models of different sizes.

entry.title: VGS-Decoding: Visual Grounding Score Guided Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Medical VLMs

author.name: Govinda Kolli, Adinath Madhavrao Dukre, Behzad Bozorgtabar, Dwarikanath Mahapatra, Imran Razzak

entry.summary: Proposes VGS-Decoding, a training-free method to mitigate hallucinations in medical VLMs by measuring each token's visual dependency through comparing distributions from original and distorted images during decoding.

entry.title: JANUS: A Lightweight Framework for Jailbreaking Text-to-Image Models via Distribution Optimization

author.name: Haolun Zheng, Yu He, Tailun Chen, Shuo Shao, Zhixuan Chu, Hongbin Zhou, Lan Tao, Zhan Qin, Kui Ren

entry.summary: Proposes JANUS, a lightweight jailbreaking framework for text-to-image models that optimizes a structured prompt distribution under black-box end-to-end reward, replacing high-capacity generators with a low-dimensional mixing policy.

entry.title: All elementary functions from a single binary operator

author.name: Andrzej Odrzywo{\l}ek

entry.summary: Shows that a single binary operator eml(x,y)=exp(x)-ln(y) together with constant 1 can generate all elementary mathematical functions (sin, cos, sqrt, log, arithmetic). Analogous to universal gates in Boolean logic.

entry.title: The Golden Subspace: Where Efficiency Meets Generalization in Continual Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Guannan Lai, Da-Wei Zhou, Zhenguo Li, Han-Jia Ye

entry.summary: Identifies a 'golden subspace' for continual test-time adaptation that achieves both efficiency and generalization. Proves it coincides with the row space of the pretrained classifier and introduces AGOP as an efficient proxy.

entry.title: Entropy Alone is Insufficient for Safe Selective Prediction in LLMs

author.name: Edward Phillips, Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Sean Wu, Anshul Thakur, David A. Clifton

entry.summary: Identifies a failure mode in entropy-based uncertainty methods for selective prediction in LLMs. Proposes combining entropy with correctness probes, improving risk-coverage tradeoffs across 3 QA benchmarks and 4 model families.

entry.title: Beyond Memorization: Distinguishing between Reductive and Epistemic Reasoning in LLMs using Classic Logic Puzzles

author.name: Adi Gabay, Gabriel Stanovsky, Liat Peterfreund

entry.summary: Introduces a 'reduction ladder' to distinguish between epistemic reasoning and reduction (mapping to known problems) in LLMs on logic puzzles. Shows large models succeed via reduction but struggle when instances diverge from canonical forms.

entry.title: Semantic Shift: the Fundamental Challenge in Text Embedding and Retrieval

author.name: Hang Gao, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of 'semantic shift' in transformer embeddings, showing how semantic diversity causes pooled representations to smooth and collapse. Identifies when and why known pathologies harm retrieval.

entry.title: Cross-Context Verification: Hierarchical Detection of Benchmark Contamination through Session-Isolated Analysis

author.name: Tae-Eun Song

entry.summary: Introduces Cross-Context Verification (CCV), a black-box method for detecting benchmark contamination by solving problems in N independent sessions and measuring solution diversity. Combined with hierarchical multi-agent analysis.

entry.title: MemDLM: Memory-Enhanced DLM Training

author.name: Zehua Pei, Hui-Ling Zhen, Weizhe Lin, Sinno Jialin Pan, Yunhe Wang, Mingxuan Yuan, Bei Yu

entry.summary: Proposes MemDLM, a memory-enhanced training approach for diffusion language models that addresses train-inference mismatch via bi-level optimization with parametric memory, improving performance across multiple benchmarks.

entry.title: On the Challenges and Opportunities of Learned Sparse Retrieval for Code

author.name: Simon Lupart, Maxime Louis, Thibault Formal, Herv\'e D\'ejean, St\'ephane Clinchant

entry.summary: Introduces SPLADE-Code, the first family of learned sparse retrieval models for code retrieval (600M-8B parameters). Achieves SOTA performance on code retrieval benchmarks despite lightweight training, and offers interpretability advantages.

entry.title: ScaleEdit-12M: Scaling Open-Source Image Editing Data Generation via Multi-Agent Framework

author.name: Guanzhou Chen, Erfei Cui, Changyao Tian, Danni Yang, Ganlin Yang, Yu Qiao, Hongsheng Li, Gen Luo, Hongjie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ScaleEditor, a fully open-source multi-agent framework for constructing large-scale image editing datasets (12M examples) without proprietary APIs, enabling cost-effective scaling.

entry.title: GIDE: Unlocking Diffusion LLMs for Precise Training-Free Image Editing

author.name: Zifeng Zhu, Jiaming Han, Jiaxiang Zhao, Minnan Luo, Xiangyu Yue

entry.summary: Introduces GIDE for training-free image editing with Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs). Proposes Discrete Noise Inversion to capture latent patterns in discrete token space, enabling precise editing without structural degradation.

entry.title: Reframing Long-Tailed Learning via Loss Landscape Geometry

author.name: Shenghan Chen, Yiming Liu, Yanzhen Wang, Yujia Wang, Xiankai Lu

entry.summary: Reframes long-tailed learning through loss landscape geometry, showing different classes have divergent convergence points. Proposes a continual learning-inspired framework to prevent tail performance degradation by seeking flat, shared minima.

entry.title: Which Concepts to Forget and How to Refuse? Decomposing Concepts for Continual Unlearning in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Hyundong Jin, Dongyoon Han, Eunwoo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a continual unlearning framework for large vision-language models that decomposes deletion targets into fine-grained visual and textual concepts, grounding refusal behavior in these descriptions to avoid spurious associations.

entry.title: Rethinking Visual Privacy: A Compositional Privacy Risk Framework for Severity Assessment with VLMs

author.name: Efthymios Tsaprazlis, Tiantian Feng, Anil Ramakrishna, Sai Praneeth Karimireddy, Rahul Gupta, Shrikanth Narayanan

entry.summary: Introduces the Compositional Privacy Risk Taxonomy (CPRT) that treats visual privacy as compositional rather than binary, defining severity levels based on how benign attributes combine to create privacy violations.

entry.title: Principled Steering via Null-space Projection for Jailbreak Defense in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xingyu Zhu, Beier Zhu, Shuo Wang, Junfeng Fang, Kesen Zhao, Hanwang Zhang, Xiangnan He

entry.summary: Proposes NullSteer, a null-space projected activation steering method for jailbreak defense in VLMs that balances safety and utility by projecting steering vectors into the null space of benign activations.

entry.title: ACPO: Counteracting Likelihood Displacement in Vision-Language Alignment with Asymmetric Constraints

author.name: Kaili Huang, Hongming Zhang, Rui Shen, Linjun Dai, Jiahao Wang, Hanming Deng, Lewei Lu

entry.summary: Proposes ACPO to address Likelihood Displacement in DPO for LVLMs, introducing asymmetric constraints with complexity-aware scaling to prevent Visual Anchor Collapse and reduce hallucinations.

entry.title: Omni-WorldBench: Towards a Comprehensive Interaction-Centric Evaluation for World Models

author.name: Meiqi Wu, Zhixin Cai, Fufangchen Zhao, Xiaokun Feng, Rujing Dang, Bingze Song, Ruitian Tian, Jiashu Zhu, Jiachen Lei, Hao Dou, Jing Tang, Lei Sun, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Zeming Liu, Kaiqi Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Omni-WorldBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating world models on interactive response capability — how well they model state transitions driven by interaction actions across space and time.

entry.title: Experimental Evidence for Simulator Theory— Part 2: The Scalers Strike Back

author.name: RogerDearnaley

entry.summary: Part 2 of a detailed analysis arguing that Simulator Theory is well-supported by experimental evidence, examining frontier lab papers on Emergent Misalignment including work from Google DeepMind's interpretability team. Analyzes how scaling and training procedures affect EM phenomena.

entry.title: Experimental Evidence for Simulator Theory— Part 1: Emergent Misalignment and Weird Generalizations

author.name: RogerDearnaley

entry.summary: Part 1 of a two-part series providing detailed analysis of experimental evidence supporting Simulator Theory, primarily through Emergent Misalignment and Weird Generalization phenomena from Owain Evans' research. Wraps statistical formalism around the theory and works through practical applications.

entry.title: Ablating Split Personality Training

author.name: OscarGilg

entry.summary: Ablates Split Personality Training for detecting AI misbehavior, finding that simple user follow-up prompts work as well as the split-personality framing (2-3x faster convergence), and that a cheap LoRA trained on generic alignment topics transfers to detecting specific reward hacking.

entry.title: Let's Think with Images Efficiently! An Interleaved-Modal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Framework with Dynamic and Precise Visual Thoughts

author.name: Xu Liu, Yongheng Zhang, Qiguang Chen, Yao Li, Sheng Wang, Libo Qin

entry.summary: Proposes DaP-ICoT for interleaved-modal chain-of-thought reasoning with dynamic visual thought positioning (instead of static fixed-step insertion) and precise visual thought representation to improve multimodal reasoning efficiency.

entry.title: Repurposing Geometric Foundation Models for Multi-view Diffusion

author.name: Wooseok Jang, Seonghu Jeon, Jisang Han, Jinhyeok Choi, Minkyung Kwon, Seungryong Kim, Saining Xie, Sainan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Geometric Latent Diffusion (GLD) that repurposes geometric foundation model features as the latent space for multi-view diffusion, enabling geometrically consistent novel view synthesis.

entry.title: Dreaming the Unseen: World Model-regularized Diffusion Policy for Out-of-Distribution Robustness

author.name: Ziou Hu, Xiangtong Yao, Yuan Meng, Zhenshan Bing, Alois Knoll

entry.summary: Introduces Dream Diffusion Policy (DDP) that integrates a diffusion world model with policy training for OOD robustness, using internal 'imagination' to bypass corrupted visual observations during inference.

entry.title: ProMAS: Proactive Error Forecasting for Multi-Agent Systems Using Markov Transition Dynamics

author.name: Xinkui Zhao, Sai Liu, Yifan Zhang, Qingyu Ma, Guanjie Cheng, Naibo Wang, Chang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PROMAS, a proactive error prediction framework for multi-agent systems using Markov transition dynamics. It models reasoning as probabilistic state transitions to detect errors before they propagate through the system.

entry.title: Attention in Space: Functional Roles of VLM Heads for Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Xueqi Ma, Shuo Yang, Yanbei Jiang, Shu Liu, Zhenzhen Liu, Jiayang Ao, Xingjun Ma, Sarah Monazam Erfani, James Bailey

entry.summary: Investigates how attention heads in VLMs contribute to spatial reasoning through mechanistic interpretability. Introduces CogVSR dataset decomposing spatial questions into cognitive substeps and identifies specialized attention heads.

entry.title: Knowledge Boundary Discovery for Large Language Models

author.name: Ziquan Wang, Zhongqi Lu

entry.summary: Proposes Knowledge Boundary Discovery (KBD), an RL-based framework that automatically generates questions to map what an LLM knows and doesn't know, modeling this as exploration of a partially observable environment.

entry.title: Does AI Homogenize Student Thinking? A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of Structural Convergence in AI-Augmented Essays

author.name: Keito Inoshita, Michiaki Omura, Tsukasa Yamanaka, Go Maeda, Kentaro Tsuji

entry.summary: Analyzes 6,875 essays to provide first empirical evidence of a Quality-Homogenization Tradeoff in AI-assisted writing: quality improves but structural diversity decreases, with cohesion architecture losing 70-78% variance.

entry.title: A transformer architecture alteration to incentivise externalised reasoning

author.name: Elizabeth Pavlova, Mariia Koroliuk, Karthik Viswanathan, Cameron Tice, Edward James Young, Puria Radmard

entry.summary: Proposes a transformer architecture change with early-exit mechanisms at intermediate layers, trained via RL to truncate forward passes when deep computation isn't needed, encouraging externalized reasoning.

entry.title: Stabilizing Iterative Self-Training with Verified Reasoning via Symbolic Recursive Self-Alignment

author.name: Xinyu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Neuro-Symbolic Recursive Self-Alignment (NSRSA) to stabilize iterative self-training by verifying each reasoning step symbolically before including it in training data, preventing recursive drift.

entry.title: Mind over Space: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Mentally Navigate?

author.name: Qihui Zhu, Shouwei Ruan, Xiao Yang, Hao Jiang, Yao Huang, Shiji Zhao, Hanwei Fan, Hang Su, Xingxing Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Video2Mental, a benchmark evaluating MLLMs' mental navigation capabilities — constructing cognitive maps from egocentric videos and generating landmark-based path plans, inspired by cognitive science.

entry.title: CurvZO: Adaptive Curvature-Guided Sparse Zeroth-Order Optimization for Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Shuo Wang, Ziyu Chen, Ming Tang

entry.summary: Proposes CurvZO, a zeroth-order optimization method for LLM fine-tuning that uses curvature information to guide sparse parameter perturbation. Addresses memory limitations of backpropagation-based fine-tuning on resource-constrained hardware.

entry.title: Beyond Scalar Rewards: Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Preordered Objectives for Safe and Reliable Autonomous Driving

author.name: Ahmed Abouelazm, Jonas Michel, Daniel Bogdoll, Philip Sch\"orner, J. Marius Z\"ollner

entry.summary: Introduces Preordered Multi-Objective MDP with Quantile Dominance metric for autonomous driving RL, maintaining a hierarchy of objectives (safety > efficiency > comfort) instead of collapsing them into scalar rewards.

entry.title: From Human Interfaces to Agent Interfaces: Rethinking Software Design in the Age of AI-Native Systems

author.name: Shaolin Wang, Yi Mei, Haoyang Che, He Jiang, Shui Yu, Ying Gu

entry.summary: Argues software engineering is shifting from human-oriented interfaces to agent-oriented invocation systems, formalizing 'agent interfaces' and 'invocable capabilities' as design principles for AI-native software.

entry.title: InjectFlow: Weak Guides Strong via Orthogonal Injection for Flow Matching

author.name: Dayu Wang, Jiaye Yang, Weikang Li, Jiahui Liang, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes InjectFlow, a training-free method for flow matching models that addresses dataset biases by injecting orthogonal corrections to prevent trajectory lock-in during inference. Provides mathematical formalization of the 'Bias Manifold'.

entry.title: Bypassing Document Ingestion: An MCP Approach to Financial Q&A

author.name: Sasan Mansouri, Edoardo Pilla, Mark Wahrenburg, Fabian Woebbeking

entry.summary: Studies whether MCP-based direct data interaction offers a more reliable alternative to standard RAG for financial Q&A, building a custom MCP server over LSEG APIs and evaluating on FinDER benchmark with up to 80.4% accuracy.

entry.title: ContractSkill: Repairable Contract-Based Skills for Multimodal Web Agents

author.name: Zijian Lu, Yiping Zuo, Yupeng Nie, Xin He, Weibei Fan, Chen Dai

entry.summary: Presents ContractSkill, a framework that converts agent skills into contracted executable artifacts with explicit preconditions, postconditions, and recovery rules, enabling deterministic verification and localized repair.

entry.title: SymCircuit: Bayesian Structure Inference for Tractable Probabilistic Circuits via Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Y. Sungtaek Ju

entry.summary: Proposes SymCircuit, which replaces greedy structure learning for probabilistic circuits with entropy-regularized RL, showing the optimal policy is a tempered Bayesian posterior. Uses a grammar-constrained autoregressive Transformer (SymFormer) for valid circuit generation.

entry.title: Permutation-Consensus Listwise Judging for Robust Factuality Evaluation

author.name: Tianyi Huang, Nathan Huang, Justin Tang, Wenqian Chen, Elsa Fan

entry.summary: Introduces PCFJudge, which reruns listwise factuality evaluation prompts over multiple orderings of candidates and aggregates scores/ranks/uncertainty into consensus decisions, improving factuality evaluation by up to 7 absolute points on RewardBench 2.

entry.title: AEGIS: From Clues to Verdicts -- Graph-Guided Deep Vulnerability Reasoning via Dialectics and Meta-Auditing

author.name: Sen Fang, Weiyuan Ding, Zhezhen Cao, Zhou Yang, Bowen Xu

entry.summary: Presents AEGIS, a multi-agent framework for LLM-based vulnerability detection that grounds reasoning in hypothesis-specific evidence bases derived from repository data-flow topology, addressing fabrication in agent-based debate approaches.

entry.title: ALL-FEM: Agentic Large Language models Fine-tuned for Finite Element Methods

author.name: Rushikesh Deotale, Adithya Srinivasan, Yuan Tian, Tianyi Zhang, Pavlos Vlachos, Hector Gomez

entry.summary: Introduces ALL-FEM, an autonomous simulation system that combines agentic AI with domain-specific fine-tuned LLMs for finite element code generation across multiple physics domains. Closes the loop from problem statement to verified FEniCS solution, addressing hallucination and lack of variational structure awareness.

entry.title: TRACE: A Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Physical Reasoning in Seismological Science

author.name: Feng Liu, Jian Xu, Xin Cui, Xinghao Wang, Zijie Guo, Jiong Wang, S. Mostafa Mousavi, Xinyu Gu, Hao Chen, Ben Fei, Lihua Fang, Fenghua Ling, Zefeng Li, Lei Bai

entry.summary: Presents TRACE, a multi-agent system combining LLM planning with formal seismological constraints for automated mechanistic inference from earthquake observations, enabling auditable and physically grounded reasoning.

entry.title: Aggregation Alignment for Federated Learning with Mixture-of-Experts under Data Heterogeneity

author.name: Zihan Fang, Qianru Wang, Haonan An, Zheng Lin, Yiqin Deng, Xianhao Chen, Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: Addresses federated fine-tuning of MoE-based LLMs under data heterogeneity, tackling divergent gating preferences and expert assignment inconsistencies across clients through aggregation alignment.

entry.title: Riemannian Geometry Speaks Louder Than Words: From Graph Foundation Model to Next-Generation Graph Intelligence

author.name: Philip S. Yu, Li Sun

entry.summary: Argues that Riemannian geometry provides a better foundation for Graph Foundation Models than language-based approaches, proposing to move beyond GNNs and graph serialization for LLMs toward geometry-aware graph intelligence.

entry.title: Efficient Zero-Shot AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Ryosuke Sonoda, Ramya Srinivasan

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free method for detecting AI-generated images by measuring representation sensitivity to structured frequency perturbations via Fourier transforms. The approach is computationally lightweight and avoids the generalization issues of trained detectors.

entry.title: Sim-to-Real of Humanoid Locomotion Policies via Joint Torque Space Perturbation Injection

author.name: Junhyeok Rui Cha, Woohyun Cha, Jaeyong Shin, Donghyeon Kim, Jaeheung Park

entry.summary: Proposes injecting state-dependent perturbations into joint torques during simulation as an alternative to domain randomization for sim-to-real transfer of humanoid locomotion policies, using neural networks as flexible perturbation generators.

entry.title: Chronological Contrastive Learning: Few-Shot Progression Assessment in Irreversible Diseases

author.name: Clemens Watzenb\"ock, Daniel Aletaha, Micha\"el Deman, Thomas Deimel, Jana Eder, Ivana Janickova, Robert Janiczek, Peter Mandl, Philipp Seeb\"ock, Gabriela Supp, Paul Weiser, Georg Langs

entry.summary: Introduces ChronoCon, a contrastive learning method that uses chronological ordering of longitudinal scans (rather than expert labels) to learn disease severity representations, assuming monotonic progression in irreversible diseases.

entry.title: More Isn't Always Better: Balancing Decision Accuracy and Conformity Pressures in Multi-AI Advice

author.name: Yuta Tsuchiya, Yukino Baba

entry.summary: Studies how the number and consensus level of multiple AI advisors affects human decision-making, finding that small panels improve accuracy but larger panels yield no gains, and high consensus fosters overreliance.

entry.title: WorldCache: Content-Aware Caching for Accelerated Video World Models

author.name: Umair Nawaz, Ahmed Heakl, Ufaq Khan, Abdelrahman Shaker, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan

entry.summary: Proposes WorldCache, a perception-constrained dynamic caching framework for video world models that uses motion-adaptive thresholds and saliency-weighted drift estimation to improve when and how features are reused.

entry.title: AE-LLM: Adaptive Efficiency Optimization for Large Language Models

author.name: Kaito Tanaka, Masato Ito, Yuji Nishimura, Keisuke Matsuda, Aya Nakayama

entry.summary: Proposes AE-LLM, a unified framework that automatically selects and combines optimal efficiency techniques (attention, MoE, PEFT, quantization) for specific LLM deployment scenarios.

entry.title: RMNP: Row-Momentum Normalized Preconditioning for Scalable Matrix-Based Optimization

author.name: Shenyang Deng, Zhuoli Ouyang, Tianyu Pang, Zihang Liu, Ruochen Jin, Shuhua Yu, Yaoqing Yang

entry.summary: Proposes RMNP, an optimizer that replaces Newton-Schulz iteration in Muon with simple row-wise normalization for preconditioning, achieving better computational efficiency while maintaining preconditioning effectiveness for deep neural network training.

entry.title: Neural collapse in the orthoplex regime

author.name: James Alcala, Rayna Andreeva, Vladimir A. Kobzar, Dustin G. Mixon, Sanghoon Na, Shashank Sule, Yangxinyu Xie

entry.summary: Characterizes the geometric figures that emerge from neural collapse in the orthoplex regime where the number of classes exceeds the feature dimension (d+2 ≤ n ≤ 2d), using Radon's theorem and convexity.

entry.title: AutoKernel: Autonomous GPU Kernel Optimization via Iterative Agent-Driven Search

author.name: Jaber Jaber, Osama Jaber

entry.summary: Presents AutoKernel, an autonomous agent framework for GPU kernel optimization that profiles PyTorch models, identifies bottlenecks, and iteratively refines Triton/CUDA kernels through automated experimentation.

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Distribution-to-Distribution Flow Matching in Scientific Imaging

author.name: Dongxia Wu, Yuhui Zhang, Serena Yeung-Levy, Emma Lundberg, Emily B. Fox

entry.summary: Presents Bayesian Stochastic Flow Matching (BSFM) for uncertainty quantification in distribution-to-distribution generative models, disentangling aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty for scientific imaging.

entry.title: DiscoUQ: Structured Disagreement Analysis for Uncertainty Quantification in LLM Agent Ensembles

author.name: Bo Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces DiscoUQ, a framework for uncertainty quantification in LLM agent ensembles that analyzes structured disagreement patterns (linguistic and geometric) to produce calibrated confidence estimates.

entry.title: HELIX: Scaling Raw Audio Understanding with Hybrid Mamba-Attention Beyond the Quadratic Limit

author.name: Khushiyant, Param Thakkar

entry.summary: Introduces HELIX, a controlled framework comparing pure Mamba, pure attention, and hybrid architectures for raw audio understanding. Shows that input representation preferences depend on backbone architecture and sequence length.

entry.title: BenchBench: Benchmarking Automated Benchmark Generation

author.name: Yandan Zheng, Haoran Luo, Zhenghong Lin, Wenjin Liu, Luu Anh Tuan

entry.summary: Introduces BenchBench, a pipeline for benchmarking automated benchmark generation by LLMs. Evaluates how well models can design benchmarks rather than just answer them.

entry.title: Multi-Perspective LLM Annotations for Valid Analyses in Subjective Tasks

author.name: Navya Mehrotra, Adam Visokay, Kristina Gligori\'c

entry.summary: Introduces Perspective-Driven Inference for correcting LLM annotation errors in subjective tasks where demographic disagreement is meaningful. Uses adaptive sampling to concentrate human annotation on groups where LLM proxies are least accurate.

entry.title: Probing How Scalable Table Data Enhances General Long-Context Reasoning

author.name: Huaibing Xie, Guoliang Zhao, Yang Liu, Shihan Dou, Siming Huang, Yanling Xiao, Shaolei Wang, Yiting Liu, Cheng Zhang, Shaofan Liu, Pluto Zhou

entry.summary: Finds that structured table data with periodic structures enhances long-context reasoning in LLMs. Provides mathematical analysis using mutual information showing periodic non-vanishing dependencies in table data.

entry.title: Autoregressive vs. Masked Diffusion Language Models: A Controlled Comparison

author.name: Caio Vicentino

entry.summary: Provides a controlled comparison between autoregressive and masked diffusion language models on identical data, compute, and hardware. Finds AR converges faster but overfits earlier, while MDLM produces more diverse outputs.

entry.title: Training-Free Instance-Aware 3D Scene Reconstruction and Diffusion-Based View Synthesis from Sparse Images

author.name: Jiatong Xia, Lingqiao Liu

entry.summary: Presents a training-free system for 3D indoor scene reconstruction from sparse unposed RGB images, combining point cloud filtering, instance-aware lifting, and diffusion-based view synthesis without any per-scene optimization.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Knowledge Distillation for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Jingchen Sun, Shaobo Han, Deep Patel, Wataru Kohno, Can Jin, Changyou Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Beta-KD, an uncertainty-aware knowledge distillation framework for multimodal LLMs that adaptively modulates student reliance on teacher guidance using a Bayesian formulation with Gibbs prior interpretation.

entry.title: StreamingEval: A Unified Evaluation Protocol towards Realistic Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Guowei Tang, Tianwen Qian, Huanran Zheng, Yifei Wang, Xiaoling Wang

entry.summary: Introduces StreamingEval, a unified evaluation framework for assessing streaming video understanding capabilities of Video-LLMs under realistic resource constraints, benchmarking both offline and online models.

entry.title: No Dense Tensors Needed: Fully Sparse Object Detection on Event-Camera Voxel Grids

author.name: Mohamad Yazan Sadoun, Sarah Sharif, Yaser Mike Banad

entry.summary: Proposes SparseVoxelDet, claimed to be the first fully sparse object detector for event cameras where all pipeline stages operate on occupied voxel positions through 3D sparse convolutions, achieving 83.38% mAP with only 14,900 active voxels per frame.

entry.title: HumanOmni-Speaker: Identifying Who said What and When

author.name: Detao Bai, Shimin Yao, Weixuan Chen, Xihan Wei, Zhiheng Ma

entry.summary: Introduces HumanOmni-Speaker benchmark for identifying 'who said what and when' in multi-person conversations, revealing that current omni-modal LLMs exploit visual biases and lack genuine cross-modal alignment for speaker diarization.

entry.title: Getting to the Point: Why Pointing Improves LVLMs

author.name: Simone Alghisi, Massimo Rizzoli, Seyed Mahed Mousavi, Giuseppe Riccardi

entry.summary: Studies why pointing (predicting object coordinates as intermediate step) improves Large Vision-Language Models, investigating the mechanisms in zero-shot counting tasks and the reliability of intermediate points as visual explanations.

entry.title: Unified Spatiotemporal Token Compression for Video-LLMs at Ultra-Low Retention

author.name: Junhao Du, Jialong Xue, Anqi Li, Jincheng Dai, Guo Lu

entry.summary: Reformulates Video-LLM token compression as a unified spatiotemporal allocation task with a global token retention pool. Proposes a selection mechanism combining attention weights and semantic similarity for ultra-low retention ratios.

entry.title: DA-VAE: Plug-in Latent Compression for Diffusion via Detail Alignment

author.name: Xin Cai, Zhiyuan You, Zhoutong Zhang, Tianfan Xue

entry.summary: Proposes DA-VAE, a plug-in latent compression method for diffusion models that expands latent dimensionality while preserving the structured latent space of pretrained models, avoiding costly diffusion retraining.

entry.title: OpenEarth-Agent: From Tool Calling to Tool Creation for Open-Environment Earth Observation

author.name: Sijie Zhao, Feng Liu, Xueliang Zhang, Hao Chen, Xinyu Gu, Zhe Jiang, Fenghua Ling, Ben Fei, Wenlong Zhang, Junjue Wang, Weihao Xuan, Pengfeng Xiao, Naoto Yokoya, Lei Bai

entry.summary: Introduces OpenEarth-Agent, the first tool-creation agent framework for open-environment Earth Observation that creates new tools rather than calling predefined ones, enabling generalization to unseen data and tasks.

entry.title: PRM-as-a-Judge: A Dense Evaluation Paradigm for Fine-Grained Robotic Auditing

author.name: Yuheng Ji, Yuyang Liu, Huajie Tan, Xuchuan Huang, Fanding Huang, Yijie Xu, Cheng Chi, Yuting Zhao, Huaihai Lyu, Peterson Co, Mingyu Cao, Qiongyu Zhang, Zhe Li, Enshen Zhou, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Shanghang Zhang, Xiaolong Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes PRM-as-a-Judge, a dense evaluation paradigm using Process Reward Models to audit robotic policy execution from trajectory videos, going beyond binary success rates with the OPD metric system.

entry.title: Speedup Patch: Learning a Plug-and-Play Policy to Accelerate Embodied Manipulation

author.name: Zhichao Wu, Junyin Ye, Zhilong Zhang, Yihao Sun, Haoxin Lin, Jiaheng Luo, Haoxiang Ren, Lei Yuan, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Speedup Patch (SuP), a lightweight, policy-agnostic framework for accelerating embodied manipulation by adaptively downsampling action chunks, formalized as a Constrained MDP.

entry.title: VP-VLA: Visual Prompting as an Interface for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zixuan Wang, Yuxin Chen, Yuqi Liu, Jinhui Ye, Pengguang Chen, Changsheng Lu, Shu Liu, Jiaya Jia

entry.summary: VP-VLA decouples high-level reasoning from low-level execution in Vision-Language-Action models using a visual prompting interface. A System 2 Planner identifies targets and goals which are overlaid on images as visual prompts for a System 1 controller.

entry.title: How Far Can Observation Take Us?

author.name: unruly abstractions

entry.summary: Explores observational faithfulness in mechanistic interpretability - whether subcircuits can be distinguished from full models using only input-output behavior. Finds that even extensive out-of-distribution testing is insufficient to uniquely identify the correct circuit explanation.

entry.title: Measuring and improving coding audit realism with deployment resources

author.name: Connor Kissane

entry.summary: Studies how to make automated auditing (Petri) more realistic by giving auditors real deployment resources (system prompts, tool definitions, codebases). Providing these resources increases realism win rate from 4.6% to 32.8% for reward hacking audits without significantly changing hack detection rate.

entry.title: AI character is a big deal

author.name: wdmacaskill

entry.summary: Argues that AI character (how obedient, honest, cooperative AIs are) will meaningfully impact concentration of power, moral reflection, catastrophic risk, AI takeover probability, and the value of AI-dominated futures. Claims figuring out desired AI character is among the most valuable current work.

entry.title: Efficient Counterfactual Reasoning in ProbLog via Single World Intervention Programs

author.name: Saimun Habib, Vaishak Belle, Fengxiang He

entry.summary: Proposes efficient counterfactual reasoning in ProbLog via Single World Intervention Programs (SWIPs), a program transformation that avoids asymptotic complexity increases while improving accuracy and stability.

entry.title: ORACLE: Optimizing Reasoning Abilities of Large Language Models via Constraint-Led Synthetic Data Elicitation

author.name: Zhuojie Yang, Wentao Wan, Keze Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ORACLE, a framework for generating high-quality synthetic reasoning data using constraint-led approaches that verify intermediate reasoning steps, not just final answers.

entry.title: Graph of States: Solving Abductive Tasks with Large Language Models

author.name: Yu Luo, Rongchen Gao, Lu Teng, Xidao Wen, Jiamin Jiang, Qingliang Zhang, Yongqian Sun, Shenglin Zhang, Jiasong Feng, Tong Liu, Wenjie Zhang, Dan Pei

entry.summary: Introduces Graph of States (GoS), a neuro-symbolic framework for abductive reasoning with LLMs that uses causal graphs and structured belief states to address evidence fabrication, context drift, and failed backtracking.

entry.title: AdaRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for LLM Agent Evaluation

author.name: Liang Ding

entry.summary: Presents AdaRubric, which generates task-specific evaluation rubrics on the fly for LLM agent assessment, achieving 0.79 Pearson correlation with human judgments (+0.16 over static baselines) on WebArena and ToolBench.

entry.title: Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Zhongyi Li, Wan Tian, Yikun Ban, Jinju Chen, Huiming Zhang, Yang Liu, Fuzhen Zhuang

entry.summary: Introduces Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization (CCPO) for multi-agent LLM collaboration, estimating each agent's marginal contribution through counterfactual trajectories to solve credit assignment.

entry.title: Silicon Bureaucracy and AI Test-Oriented Education: Contamination Sensitivity and Score Confidence in LLM Benchmarks

author.name: Yiliang Song, Hongjun An, Jiangan Chen, Xuanchen Yan, Huan Song, Jiawei Shao, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes an audit framework analyzing contamination sensitivity and score confidence in LLM benchmarks, framing the benchmark-centered evaluation regime as 'Silicon Bureaucracy' and showing contamination vulnerability.

entry.title: A Context Engineering Framework for Improving Enterprise AI Agents based on Digital-Twin MDP

author.name: Xi Yang, Aurelie Lozano, Naoki Abe, Bhavya, Saurabh Jha, Noah Zheutlin, Rohan R. Arora, Yu Deng, Daby M. Sow

entry.summary: Proposes DT-MDP-CE, a framework for improving enterprise AI agents via offline RL using a Digital-Twin MDP abstraction of agent reasoning, contrastive inverse RL for reward inference, and context engineering for prompt optimization.

entry.title: GSEM: Graph-based Self-Evolving Memory for Experience Augmented Clinical Reasoning

author.name: Xiao Han, Yuzheng Fan, Sendong Zhao, Haochun Wang, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes GSEM, a graph-based memory framework for clinical decision-making that organizes experiences in a dual-layer memory graph with applicability-aware retrieval and online calibration. Outperforms baselines on MedR-Bench and MedAgentsBench.

entry.title: The Arrival of AGI? When Expert Personas Exceed Expert Benchmarks

author.name: Drake Mullens, Stella Shen

entry.summary: Challenges a Wharton Lab finding that expert personas don't help LLMs, demonstrating five structural flaws in the original study and showing that controlled trials reveal meaningful persona benefits when design confounds are removed.

entry.title: Semantic Tool Discovery for Large Language Models: A Vector-Based Approach to MCP Tool Selection

author.name: Sarat Mudunuri, Jian Wan, Ally Qin, Srinivasan Manoharan

entry.summary: Presents a semantic tool discovery architecture using vector embeddings to efficiently retrieve relevant MCP tools for LLMs, addressing scalability challenges when many tools are available.

entry.title: GEM: A Native Graph-based Index for Multi-Vector Retrieval

author.name: Yao Tian, Zhoujin Tian, Xi Zhao, Ruiyuan Zhang, Xiaofang Zhou

entry.summary: Presents GEM, a native graph-based index for multi-vector retrieval that constructs proximity graphs directly over vector sets, with set-level clustering and efficient navigation for fine-grained semantic matching.

entry.title: ALICE: A Multifaceted Evaluation Framework of Large Audio-Language Models' In-Context Learning Ability

author.name: Yen-Ting Piao, Jay Chiehen Liao, Wei-Tang Chien, Toshiki Ogimoto, Shang-Tse Chen, Yun-Nung Chen, Chun-Yi Lee, Shao-Yuan Lo

entry.summary: Presents ALICE, a three-stage framework evaluating in-context learning ability of Large Audio-Language Models under audio conditioning. Finds that in-context demonstrations improve format compliance but fail to improve core task performance.

entry.title: ReBOL: Retrieval via Bayesian Optimization with Batched LLM Relevance Observations and Query Reformulation

author.name: Anton Korikov, Scott Sanner

entry.summary: Proposes ReBOL, which uses LLM query reformulations to initialize Bayesian Optimization over document relevance, iteratively acquiring document batches for LLM scoring to overcome top-k retrieval stage failures.

entry.title: Does This Gradient Spark Joy?

author.name: Ian Osband

entry.summary: Extends the Delightful Policy Gradient with a 'Kondo gate' that selectively performs backward passes only when samples provide sufficient learning value, tracing quality-cost Pareto frontiers.

entry.title: PAVE: Premise-Aware Validation and Editing for Retrieval-Augmented LLMs

author.name: Tianyi Huang, Caden Yang, Emily Yin, Eric Wang, Michael Zhang

entry.summary: Presents PAVE, an inference-time validation layer for RAG that decomposes context into atomic facts, scores draft answer support, and revises low-support outputs, making answer commitment auditable at the premise level.

entry.title: SNAP: Speaker Nulling for Artifact Projection in Speech Deepfake Detection

author.name: Kyudan Jung, Jihwan Kim, Minwoo Lee, Soyoon Kim, Jeonghoon Kim, Jaegul Choo, Cheonbok Park

entry.summary: Introduces SNAP, a speaker-nulling framework for speech deepfake detection that estimates and projects out speaker-dependent subspaces to force detectors to rely on artifact cues rather than speaker-specific correlations.

entry.title: Causally-Guided Diffusion for Stable Feature Selection

author.name: Arun Vignesh Malarkkan, Xinyuan Wang, Kunpeng Liu, Denghui Zhang, Yanjie Fu

entry.summary: Introduces CGDFS, formulating feature selection as stability-aware posterior sampling using diffusion models, combining causal invariance principles with diffusion-based sampling for robust feature selection under distribution shifts.

entry.title: Domain Elastic Transform: Bayesian Function Registration for High-Dimensional Scientific Data

author.name: Osamu Hirose, Emanuele Rodola

entry.summary: Proposes Domain Elastic Transform (DET), a Bayesian framework for nonrigid registration that unifies point set and image registration for high-dimensional vector-valued functions on irregular manifolds, motivated by spatial transcriptomics data.

entry.title: WARBENCH: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs in Military Decision-Making

author.name: Zongjie Li, Chaozheng Wang, Yuchong Xie, Pingchuan Ma, Shuai Wang

entry.summary: Presents WARBENCH, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs in military decision-making that addresses gaps in existing frameworks including IHL compliance, edge computing limitations, fog of war robustness, and explicit reasoning evaluation.

entry.title: SafePilot: A Framework for Assuring LLM-enabled Cyber-Physical Systems

author.name: Weizhe Xu, Mengyu Liu, Fanxin Kong

entry.summary: Proposes SafePilot, a hierarchical framework for assuring LLM-enabled cyber-physical systems against hallucination-induced unsafe actions, focusing on planning and navigation applications.

entry.title: AgenticRec: End-to-End Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization for Ranking-Oriented Recommender Agents

author.name: Tianyi Li, Zixuan Wang, Guidong Lei, Xiaodong Li, Hui Li

entry.summary: Presents AgenticRec, a ranking-oriented recommendation framework that optimizes the entire LLM agent decision trajectory including reasoning, tool invocation, and ranking under sparse implicit feedback using theoretically grounded reward design.

entry.title: CoRA: Boosting Time Series Foundation Models for Multivariate Forecasting through Correlation-aware Adapter

author.name: Hanyin Cheng, Xingjian Wu, Yang Shu, Zhongwen Rao, Lujia Pan, Bin Yang, Chenjuan Guo

entry.summary: Proposes CoRA, a lightweight plug-and-play adapter that captures time-varying and time-invariant channel correlations to improve multivariate time series forecasting when used with time series foundation models.

entry.title: Select, Label, Evaluate: Active Testing in NLP

author.name: Antonio Purificato, Maria Sofia Bucarelli, Andrea Bacciu, Amin Mantrach, Fabrizio Silvestri

entry.summary: Formalizes Active Testing in NLP, where the goal is to select the most informative test samples for annotation to estimate model performance efficiently. Benchmarks existing approaches across 18 datasets.

entry.title: On the Failure of Topic-Matched Contrast Baselines in Multi-Directional Refusal Abliteration

author.name: Valentin Petrov

entry.summary: Investigates whether topic-matched contrast baselines improve refusal direction extraction for abliteration (removing safety refusal from LLMs), finding on Qwen 3.5 2B that they do not yield superior results.

entry.title: Evaluating the Reliability and Fidelity of Automated Judgment Systems of Large Language Models

author.name: Tom Biskupski, Stephan Kleber

entry.summary: Evaluates the reliability and fidelity of LLM-as-judge systems, investigating their agreement with human judgment and consistency across different judge models and prompts.

entry.title: One Model, Two Markets: Bid-Aware Generative Recommendation

author.name: Yanchen Jiang, Zhe Feng, Christopher P. Mah, Aranyak Mehta, Di Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GEM-Rec, a unified generative recommender framework that integrates ad monetization directly into the generative sequence using control tokens to decouple ad placement decisions from item selection.

entry.title: 3D-Layout-R1: Structured Reasoning for Language-Instructed Spatial Editing

author.name: Haoyu Zhen, Xiaolong Li, Yilin Zhao, Han Zhang, Sifei Liu, Kaichun Mo, Chuang Gan, Subhashree Radhakrishnan

entry.summary: Introduces a structured reasoning framework (3D-Layout-R1) for text-conditioned spatial layout editing via scene-graph reasoning, where LLMs reason over and update scene graphs to satisfy spatial instructions.

entry.title: From Data to Laws: Neural Discovery of Conservation Laws Without False Positives

author.name: Rahul D Ray

entry.summary: Introduces NGCG, a neural-symbolic pipeline for discovering conservation laws from data that decouples dynamics learning from invariant discovery with strict constancy gates to eliminate false positives.

entry.title: RECLAIM: Cyclic Causal Discovery Amid Measurement Noise

author.name: Muralikrishnna G. Sethuraman, Faramarz Fekri

entry.summary: Proposes RECLAIM, a causal discovery framework handling both cyclic causal graphs and measurement noise using expectation-maximization with residual normalizing flows for tractable likelihood computation.

entry.title: Interpreting the Synchronization Gap: The Hidden Mechanism Inside Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Emil Albrychiewicz, Andr\'es Franco Valiente, Li-Ching Chen, Viola Zixin Zhao

entry.summary: Investigates how the synchronization gap predicted by theoretical diffusion models manifests mechanistically in pretrained Diffusion Transformers, finding concrete architectural realizations of replica coupling.

entry.title: ResPrune: Text-Conditioned Subspace Reconstruction for Visual Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xu Li, Yi Zheng, Yuxuan Liang, Zhe Liu, Xiaolei Chen, Haotian Chen, Rui Zhu, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: Proposes ResPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for large vision-language models that formulates pruning as subspace reconstruction guided by residual energy and textual relevance.

entry.title: The Workload-Router-Pool Architecture for LLM Inference Optimization: A Vision Paper from the vLLM Semantic Router Project

author.name: Huamin Chen, Xunzhuo Liu, Bowei He, Fuyuan Lyu, Yankai Chen, Xue Liu, Yuhan Liu, Junchen Jiang

entry.summary: Presents a vision paper from the vLLM Semantic Router project describing a Workload-Router-Pool architecture for LLM inference optimization, covering routing mechanisms, fleet optimization, and agentic multimodal routing.

entry.title: TIDE: Token-Informed Depth Execution for Per-Token Early Exit in LLM Inference

author.name: Jaber Jaber, Osama Jaber

entry.summary: Proposes TIDE, a post-training early exit system for LLMs that uses learned routers at checkpoint layers to select the earliest converged layer for each token, achieving 7.2% prefill latency reduction without retraining.

entry.title: Data-Free Layer-Adaptive Merging via Fisher Information for Long-to-Short Reasoning LLMs

author.name: Tian Xia

entry.summary: Proposes Fisher-information-based layer-adaptive merging for Long-to-Short reasoning LLMs, proving merging error is bounded by per-layer Hessian norm and achieving data-free model merging.

entry.title: CellFluxRL: Biologically-Constrained Virtual Cell Modeling via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dongxia Wu, Shiye Su, Yuhui Zhang, Elaine Sui, Emma Lundberg, Emily B. Fox, Serena Yeung-Levy

entry.summary: Proposes CellFluxRL, using reinforcement learning with biologically meaningful reward functions to post-train virtual cell generative models, producing more biologically plausible cell images.

entry.title: An experimental study of KV cache reuse strategies in chunk-level caching systems

author.name: Samuel Cestola, Tianxiang Xia, Zheng Weiyan, Zheng Pengfei, Diego Didona

entry.summary: Experimentally evaluates chunk-level KV cache reuse strategies for retrieval-augmented generation, identifying fundamental limitations of existing approaches and showing that combining complementary techniques improves accuracy.

entry.title: From Cross-Validation to SURE: Asymptotic Risk of Tuned Regularized Estimators

author.name: Karun Adusumilli, Maximilian Kasy, Ashia Wilson

entry.summary: Derives the asymptotic risk function of regularized ERM estimators tuned by n-fold cross-validation, showing convergence to SURE-tuned shrinkage estimators and providing fine-grained risk characterization.

entry.title: Gradient Descent with Projection Finds Over-Parameterized Neural Networks for Learning Low-Degree Polynomials with Nearly Minimax Optimal Rate

author.name: Yingzhen Yang, Ping Li

entry.summary: Shows that gradient descent with projection on overparametrized two-layer neural networks achieves nearly minimax optimal sample complexity for learning low-degree spherical polynomials.

entry.title: AnimalCLAP: Taxonomy-Aware Language-Audio Pretraining for Species Recognition and Trait Inference

author.name: Risa Shinoda, Kaede Shiohara, Nakamasa Inoue, Hiroaki Santo, Fumio Okura

entry.summary: Introduces AnimalCLAP, a taxonomy-aware language-audio framework for species recognition with 4,225 hours of recordings covering 6,823 species and 22 ecological traits. Enables zero-shot species classification.

entry.title: A Training-Free Regeneration Paradigm: Contrastive Reflection Memory Guided Self-Verification and Self-Improvement

author.name: Yuran Li, Di Wu, Benoit Boulet

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free regeneration paradigm using contrastive Reflection Memory for LLM self-improvement. Uses offline-curated memory to guide self-verification and single-pass regeneration to escape faulty reasoning.

entry.title: Hear Both Sides: Efficient Multi-Agent Debate via Diversity-Aware Message Retention

author.name: Manh Nguyen, Anh Nguyen, Dung Nguyen, Svetha Venkatesh, Hung Le

entry.summary: Proposes Diversity-Aware Retention (DAR) for efficient multi-agent debate, selecting maximally disagreeing agent responses at each round. Addresses noise and redundancy in broadcasting all agent messages.

entry.title: Generalizable Self-Evolving Memory for Automatic Prompt Optimization

author.name: Guanbao Liang, Yuanchen Bei, Sheng Zhou, Yuheng Qin, Huan Zhou, Bingxin Jia, Bin Li, Jiajun Bu

entry.summary: Proposes MemAPO, a memory-driven framework for generalizable automatic prompt optimization. Uses dual-memory mechanism with strategy templates and error pattern organization for reusable prompting knowledge.

entry.title: Riding Brainwaves in LLM Space: Understanding Activation Patterns Using Individual Neural Signatures

author.name: Ajan Subramanian, Sumukh Bettadapura, Rohan Sathish

entry.summary: Tests whether frozen LLM representations encode person-specific EEG signals. Person-specific probes mapping Qwen 2.5 7B hidden states to individual EEG power outperform population probes by 9x for high-gamma.

entry.title: Transferable Multi-Bit Watermarking Across Frozen Diffusion Models via Latent Consistency Bridges

author.name: Hong-Hanh Nguyen-Le, Van-Tuan Tran, Thuc D. Nguyen, Nhien-An Le-Khac

entry.summary: Proposes DiffMark, a plug-and-play watermarking method for diffusion models offering single-pass multi-bit detection, per-image key flexibility, and cross-model transferability without retraining.

entry.title: When Negation Is a Geometry Problem in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Fawaz Sammani, Tzoulio Chamiti, Paul Gavrikov, Nikos Deligiannis

entry.summary: Identifies that CLIP fails at negation understanding, proposes using multimodal LLMs as judges for evaluation, and shows that negation understanding involves geometric relationships in embedding space.

entry.title: When Minor Edits Matter: LLM-Driven Prompt Attack for Medical VLM Robustness in Ultrasound

author.name: Yasamin Medghalchi, Milad Yazdani, Amirhossein Dabiriaghdam, Moein Heidari, Mojan Izadkhah, Zahra Kavian, Giuseppe Carenini, Lele Wang, Dena Shahriari, Ilker Hacihaliloglu

entry.summary: Studies adversarial robustness of medical VLMs in ultrasound, showing that minor prompt perturbations generated by LLMs can significantly alter model predictions, revealing vulnerability in clinical deployment.

entry.title: Text-Image Conditioned 3D Generation

author.name: Jiazhong Cen, Jiemin Fang, Sikuang Li, Guanjun Wu, Chen Yang, Taoran Yi, Zanwei Zhou, Zhikuan Bao, Lingxi Xie, Wei Shen, Qi Tian

entry.summary: Proposes combining text and image conditioning for 3D generation, showing that simple late fusion is insufficient and developing a more effective approach for multi-modal 3D content creation.

entry.title: F4Splat: Feed-Forward Predictive Densification for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Injae Kim, Chaehyeon Kim, Minseong Bae, Minseok Joo, Hyunwoo J. Kim

entry.summary: Presents F4Splat, introducing feed-forward predictive densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting with a score-guided allocation strategy that adaptively distributes Gaussians according to spatial complexity and multi-view overlap.

entry.title: PAS3R: Pose-Adaptive Streaming 3D Reconstruction for Long Video Sequences

author.name: Lanbo Xu, Liang Guo, Caigui Jiang, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PAS3R for pose-adaptive streaming 3D reconstruction from monocular video, dynamically modulating state updates based on camera motion and scene structure to handle the stability-adaptation dilemma.

entry.title: VIGIL: Part-Grounded Structured Reasoning for Generalizable Deepfake Detection

author.name: Xinghan Li, Junhao Xu, Jingjing Chen

entry.summary: Introduces VIGIL, a part-centric structured forensic framework for deepfake detection that separates evidence generation from manipulation localization through a plan-then-examine pipeline inspired by expert forensic practice.

entry.title: From Part to Whole: 3D Generative World Model with an Adaptive Structural Hierarchy

author.name: Bi'an Du, Daizong Liu, Pufan Li, Wei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a 3D generative world model with adaptive structural hierarchy for single-image 3D generation, learning to decompose objects into a variable number of parts rather than using fixed decomposition.

entry.title: Climate Prompting: Generating the Madden-Julian Oscillation using Video Diffusion and Low-Dimensional Conditioning

author.name: Sulian Thual, Feiyang Cai, Jingjing Wang, Feng Luo

entry.summary: Uses video diffusion models conditioned on low-dimensional climate metrics to generate Madden-Julian Oscillation sequences, enabling 'climate prompting' for tractable idealized experiments.

entry.title: Tuning Real-World Image Restoration at Inference: A Test-Time Scaling Paradigm for Flow Matching Models

author.name: Purui Bai, Junxian Duan, Pin Wang, Jinhua Hao, Ming Sun, Chao Zhou, Huaibo Huang

entry.summary: Proposes ResFlow-Tuner for real-world image restoration based on FLUX.1-dev flow matching model, combining unified multi-modal fusion with test-time scaling for unprecedented restoration performance.

entry.title: SpatialBoost: Enhancing Visual Representation through Language-Guided Reasoning

author.name: Byungwoo Jeon, Dongyoung Kim, Huiwon Jang, Insoo Kim, Jinwoo Shin

entry.summary: Proposes SpatialBoost to enhance pre-trained vision encoders with 3D spatial awareness by converting dense 3D information into linguistic descriptions and injecting this knowledge into vision features.

entry.title: Mixture of Mini Experts: Overcoming the Linear Layer Bottleneck in Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Daniel Shao, Joel Runevic, Richard J. Chen, Drew F. K. Williamson, Ahrong Kim, Andrew H. Song, Faisal Mahmood

entry.summary: Proposes Mixture of Mini Experts (MoME) for computational pathology MIL, addressing the overlooked bottleneck of the linear projection layer that transforms general features to task-specific ones using low-rank expert routing.

entry.title: DualCoT-VLA: Visual-Linguistic Chain of Thought via Parallel Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zhide Zhong, Junfeng Li, Junjie He, Haodong Yan, Xin Gong, Guanyi Zhao, Yingjie Cai, Jiantao Gao, Xu Yan, Bingbing Liu, Yingcong Chen, Liuqing Yang, Haoang Li

entry.summary: Proposes DualCoT-VLA with parallel visual and linguistic chain-of-thought reasoning for vision-language-action models, addressing limitations of single-modal CoT in robotic manipulation.

entry.title: CounterScene: Counterfactual Causal Reasoning in Generative World Models for Safety-Critical Closed-Loop Evaluation

author.name: Bowen Jing, Ruiyang Hao, Weitao Zhou, Haibao Yu

entry.summary: Presents CounterScene, a framework for generating safety-critical driving scenarios through structured counterfactual reasoning in BEV world models, asking 'what if the critical agent behaved differently?'

entry.title: EnergyAction: Unimanual to Bimanual Composition with Energy-Based Models

author.name: Mingchen Song, Xiang Deng, Jie Wei, Dongmei Jiang, Liqiang Nie, Weili Guan

entry.summary: Proposes EnergyAction, which transfers unimanual manipulation policies to bimanual tasks using Energy-Based Models for compositional action generation without bimanual demonstration data.

entry.title: Deep reflective reasoning in interdependence constrained structured data extraction from clinical notes for digital health

author.name: Jingwei Huang, Kuroush Nezafati, Zhikai Chi, Ruichen Rong, Colin Treager, Tingyi Wanyan, Yueshuang Xu, Xiaowei Zhan, Patrick Leavey, Guanghua Xiao, Wenqi Shi, Yang Xie

entry.summary: Proposes deep reflective reasoning, an LLM agent framework that iteratively self-critiques structured outputs from clinical notes by checking consistency among interdependent variables, with evaluation across three oncology applications.

entry.title: Improving Coherence and Persistence in Agentic AI for System Optimization

author.name: Pantea Karimi, Kimia Noorbakhsh, Mohammad Alizadeh, Hari Balakrishnan

entry.summary: Presents Engram, an agentic researcher architecture that addresses coherence ceiling and evolutionary neighborhood bias in LLM-driven system optimization through persistent knowledge accumulation.

entry.title: Persona Vectors in Games: Measuring and Steering Strategies via Activation Vectors

author.name: Johnathan Sun, Andrew Zhang

entry.summary: Uses activation steering methods to construct persona vectors for strategic traits (altruism, forgiveness) in game-theoretic settings, finding that steering shifts both strategies and justifications but they can diverge.

entry.title: Behavioural feasible set: Value alignment constraints on AI decision support

author.name: Taejin Park

entry.summary: Formalizes the 'behavioural feasible set' — the range of recommendations AI can actually produce given vendor alignment constraints — and shows alignment compresses this set, potentially conflicting with organizational needs.

entry.title: Future-Interactions-Aware Trajectory Prediction via Braid Theory

author.name: Caio Azevedo, Stefano Sabatini, Sascha Hornauer, Fabien Moutarde

entry.summary: Applies braid theory from topology to multi-agent trajectory prediction for autonomous vehicles, using braids as exact descriptors of how trajectories cross over time to capture coordination modes between agents.

entry.title: Children's Intelligence Tests Pose Challenges for MLLMs? KidGym: A 2D Grid-Based Reasoning Benchmark for MLLMs

author.name: Hengwei Ye, Yuanting Guan, Yuxuan Ge, Tianying Zhu, Zhenhan Guan, Yijia Zhong, Yijing Zhang, Han Zhang, Yingna Wu, Zheng Tian

entry.summary: Introduces KidGym, a 2D grid-based benchmark inspired by Wechsler Intelligence Scales for evaluating five core MLLM capabilities: Execution, Perception Reasoning, Learning, Memory, and Planning across 12 tasks.

entry.title: Decoding the decoder: Contextual sequence-to-sequence modeling for intracortical speech decoding

author.name: Michal Olak, Tommaso Boccato, Matteo Ferrante

entry.summary: Evaluates a multitask Transformer sequence-to-sequence model for intracortical speech decoding from area 6v recordings, jointly predicting phoneme sequences, word sequences, and acoustic features with a 'Neural Hamming' distance for session adaptation.

entry.title: JointFM-0.1: A Foundation Model for Multi-Target Joint Distributional Prediction

author.name: Stefan Hackmann

entry.summary: Introduces JointFM, a foundation model for multi-target joint distributional prediction trained on synthetic SDEs, claiming to be the first foundation model for distributional predictions of coupled time series.

entry.title: Understanding Pruning Regimes in Vision-Language Models Through Domain-Aware Layer Selection

author.name: Saeed Khaki, Nima Safaei, Kamal Ginotra

entry.summary: Studies structured decoder layer pruning in vision-language models through domain-aware activation similarity, uncovering a consistent three-regime structure where different layer removal strategies affect math vs. general tasks differently.

entry.title: MARLIN: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Incremental DAG Discovery

author.name: Dong Li, Zhengzhang Chen, Xujiang Zhao, Linlin Yu, Zhong Chen, Yi He, Haifeng Chen, Chen Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MARLIN, a multi-agent RL approach for incremental DAG (causal structure) discovery that uses state-specific and state-invariant agents within an incremental learning framework for online causal discovery.

entry.title: HCAG: Hierarchical Abstraction and Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Theoretical Repositories with LLMs

author.name: Yusen Wu, Xiaotie Deng

entry.summary: Proposes HCAG, a hierarchical RAG framework for repository-level code generation that recursively parses code and aligned theoretical texts to construct hierarchical knowledge, enabling planning-oriented code generation.

entry.title: Probing the Latent World: Emergent Discrete Symbols and Physical Structure in Latent Representations

author.name: Liu hung ming

entry.summary: Proposes the AI Mother Tongue (AIM) framework as a passive quantization probe for V-JEPA 2 models, investigating whether video world models develop emergent discrete symbols that encode physical structure.

entry.title: Memory poisoning and secure multi-agent systems

author.name: Vicen\c{c} Torra, Maria Bras-Amor\'os

entry.summary: Analyzes memory poisoning attacks on multi-agent AI systems, categorizing different memory types (semantic, episodic, short-term) and their vulnerabilities, proposing countermeasures.

entry.title: CAMA: Exploring Collusive Adversarial Attacks in c-MARL

author.name: Men Niu, Xinxin Fan, Quanliang Jing, Shaoye Luo, Yunfeng Lu

entry.summary: Studies collusive adversarial attacks in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (c-MARL), introducing three attack modes: Collective, Disguised, and Spied Malicious Agents. Extends beyond single-adversary perturbation to multi-agent collusion scenarios.

entry.title: CFNN: Continued Fraction Neural Network

author.name: Chao Wang, Xuancheng Zhou, Ruilin Hou, Xiaoyu Cheng, Ruiyi Ding

entry.summary: Introduces Continued Fraction Neural Networks (CFNNs) that integrate continued fractions with gradient optimization, providing rational inductive bias for capturing singularities and discontinuities with extreme parameter efficiency.

entry.title: Compass: Optimizing Compound AI Workflows for Dynamic Adaptation

author.name: Milos Gravara, Juan Luis Herrera, Stefan Nastic

entry.summary: Introduces Compass, an optimization framework for compound AI workflows that discovers Pareto-optimal configurations and dynamically switches between them based on workload conditions to balance accuracy, latency, and cost.

entry.title: RubricRAG: Towards Interpretable and Reliable LLM Evaluation via Domain Knowledge Retrieval for Rubric Generation

author.name: Kaustubh D. Dhole, Eugene Agichtein

entry.summary: Presents RubricRAG, which uses retrieval-augmented generation to automatically generate query-specific evaluation rubrics from domain knowledge, making LLM evaluation more interpretable and reliable.

entry.title: User Preference Modeling for Conversational LLM Agents: Weak Rewards from Retrieval-Augmented Interaction

author.name: Yuren Hao, Shuhaib Mehri, ChengXiang Zhai, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Proposes VARS, a pipeline-agnostic framework for persistent user modeling in LLM assistants using long-term and short-term preference vectors updated from weak scalar rewards, enabling personalization without per-user fine-tuning.

entry.title: ECI: Effective Contrastive Information to Evaluate Hard-Negatives

author.name: Aarush Sinha, Rahul Seetharaman, Aman Bansal

entry.summary: Introduces ECI (Effective Contrastive Information), an information-theoretic metric to assess hard negative quality for dense retrieval before model fine-tuning, avoiding costly ablation studies.

entry.title: Emergent Formal Verification: How an Autonomous AI Ecosystem Independently Discovered SMT-Based Safety Across Six Domains

author.name: Octavian Untila

entry.summary: Claims that an autonomous AI ecosystem (SUBSTRATE S3) independently discovered formal verification (Z3 SMT solver) across six AI safety domains without explicit instructions, suggesting formal verification is an 'emergent property' of systems reasoning about safety.

entry.title: QMoP: Query Guided Mixture-of-Projector for Efficient Visual Token Compression

author.name: Zhongyang Li, Yaqian Li, Faming Fang, Rinyoichi Takezoe, Zi-Hao Bo, Cheng Qian, Mo Guang, Guixu Zhang, Kaiwen Long

entry.summary: Proposes QMoP, a query-guided mixture-of-projector framework for adaptive visual token compression in multimodal LLMs, combining pooling, resampler, and pruning branches for flexible compression.

entry.title: Sonny: Breaking the Compute Wall in Medium-Range Weather Forecasting

author.name: Minjong Cheon

entry.summary: Introduces Sonny, an efficient hierarchical transformer for weather forecasting that achieves competitive medium-range performance while being feasible within limited compute budgets, using a two-stage StepsNet design.

entry.title: COINBench: Moving Beyond Individual Perspectives to Collective Intent Understanding

author.name: Xiaozhe Li, Tianyi Lyu, Siyi Yang, Yizhao Yang, Yuxi Gong, Jinxuan Huang, Ligao Zhang, Zhuoyi Huang, Qingwen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces COIN-BENCH, a dynamic live-updating benchmark for evaluating LLMs on collective intent understanding—distilling consensus, resolving contradictions, and inferring trends from multi-source public discussions.

entry.title: Rule-State Inference (RSI): A Bayesian Framework for Compliance Monitoring in Rule-Governed Domains

author.name: Abdou-Raouf Atarmla

entry.summary: Proposes Rule-State Inference (RSI), a Bayesian framework that inverts the typical ML compliance paradigm by encoding regulatory rules as structured priors and inferring latent rule activation states from noisy observations.

entry.title: Cognitive Agency Surrender: Defending Epistemic Sovereignty via Scaffolded AI Friction

author.name: Kuangzhe Xu, Yu Shen, Longjie Yan, Yinghui Ren

entry.summary: Examines how zero-friction AI interface design leads to 'cognitive agency surrender,' using a classification pipeline on 1,223 AI-HCI papers from 2023-2026 to track the trend of declining research on human epistemic sovereignty.

entry.title: Ctrl-A: Control-Driven Online Data Augmentation

author.name: Jesper B. Christensen, Ciaran Bench, Spencer A. Thomas, H\"usn\"u Aslan, David Balslev-Harder, Nadia A. S. Smith, Alessandra Manzin

entry.summary: Introduces ControlAugment (Ctrl-A), an automated data augmentation algorithm using control theory principles to dynamically adjust augmentation strength distributions during training, eliminating manual policy engineering.

entry.title: Multimodal Survival Analysis with Locally Deployable Large Language Models

author.name: Moritz G\"ogl, Christopher Yau

entry.summary: Studies multimodal survival analysis using locally deployable LLMs, integrating clinical text, tabular data, and genomics via teacher-student distillation for calibrated survival predictions without cloud dependencies.

entry.title: Seeing is Improving: Visual Feedback for Iterative Text Layout Refinement

author.name: Junrong Guo, Shancheng Fang, Yadong Qu, Hongtao Xie

entry.summary: Proposes VFLM, a self-improving framework for text layout generation that uses visual feedback from rendered outputs for iterative refinement, enabling MLLMs to assess and improve layout readability and aesthetics.

entry.title: Rolling-Origin Validation Reverses Model Rankings in Multi-Step PM10 Forecasting: XGBoost, SARIMA, and Persistence

author.name: Federico Garcia Crespi, Eduardo Yubero Funes, Marina Alfosea Simon

entry.summary: Demonstrates that rolling-origin validation with periodic model updates can reverse model rankings compared to static evaluation in PM10 air quality forecasting, with XGBoost losing to SARIMA and persistence.

entry.title: Graph-Aware Text-Only Backdoor Poisoning for Text-Attributed Graphs

author.name: Qi Luo, Minghui Xu, Dongxiao Yu, Xiuzhen Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes TAGBD, a text-only backdoor attack for text-attributed graphs that poisons node text without changing graph structure, using shadow graph models to generate natural-looking trigger text.

entry.title: SDE-Driven Spatio-Temporal Hypergraph Neural Networks for Irregular Longitudinal fMRI Connectome Modeling in Alzheimer's Disease

author.name: Ruiying Chen, Yutong Wang, Houliang Zhou, Wei Liang, Yong Chen, Lifang He

entry.summary: Proposes SDE-HGNN, combining stochastic differential equations with hypergraph neural networks for modeling irregular longitudinal fMRI connectomes in Alzheimer's disease progression.

entry.title: LJ-Bench: Ontology-Based Benchmark for U.S. Crime

author.name: Hung Yun Tseng, Wuzhen Li, Blerina Gkotse, Grigorios Chrysos

entry.summary: Introduces LJ-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM robustness against illegal activity queries, grounded in the Model Penal Code and California law, spanning 76 distinct criminal categories.

entry.title: A Knowledge-Informed Pretrained Model for Causal Discovery

author.name: Wenbo Xu, Yue He, Yunhai Wang, Xingxuan Zhang, Kun Kuang, Yueguo Chen, Peng Cui

entry.summary: Proposes a knowledge-informed pretrained model for causal discovery that integrates weak prior domain knowledge through a dual-source encoder-decoder architecture with curriculum learning.

entry.title: Show Me What You Don't Know: Efficient Sampling from Invariant Sets for Model Validation

author.name: Armand Rousselot, Joran Wendebourg, Ullrich K\"othe

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free method to sample from feature extractor fibers (equivalence classes) using pretrained diffusion models, enabling visualization of what models consider invariant.

entry.title: Noise Titration: Exact Distributional Benchmarking for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Qilin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes 'noise titration' - systematically adding calibrated Gaussian noise to known dynamical systems to create exact-statistical benchmarks for probabilistic time series forecasting, enabling evaluation with exact log-likelihoods.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Debate with Memory Masking

author.name: Hongduan Tian, Xiao Feng, Ziyuan Zhao, Xiangyu Zhu, Rolan Yan, Bo Han

entry.summary: Identifies that erroneous memories in multi-agent debate (MAD) frameworks mislead LLM reasoning, and proposes memory masking to filter out harmful historical context during debate rounds.

entry.title: Auto-differentiable data assimilation: Co-learning of states, dynamics, and filtering algorithms

author.name: Melissa Adrian, Daniel Sanz-Alonso, Rebecca Willett

entry.summary: Introduces auto-differentiable filtering, a framework for jointly learning states, dynamics, and filtering algorithm parameters in data assimilation using auto-differentiation and a theoretically motivated loss.

entry.title: Hard labels sampled from sparse targets mislead rotation invariant algorithms

author.name: Avrajit Ghosh, Bin Yu, Manfred Warmuth, Peter Bartlett

entry.summary: Shows that in logistic regression, hard labels sampled from sparse soft targets fundamentally mislead rotation-invariant algorithms, revealing a problem even in favorable learning settings.

entry.title: Task-Specific Efficiency Analysis: When Small Language Models Outperform Large Language Models

author.name: Jinghan Cao, Yu Ma, Xinjin Li, Qingyang Ren, Xiangyun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Performance-Efficiency Ratio (PER) metric comparing 16 language models across 5 NLP tasks. Finds small models (0.5-3B parameters) achieve superior PER scores, establishing quantitative foundations for efficient deployment.

entry.title: GaussianSSC: Triplane-Guided Directional Gaussian Fields for 3D Semantic Completion

author.name: Ruiqi Xian, Jing Liang, He Yin, Xuewei Qi, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Presents GaussianSSC, a two-stage approach to semantic scene completion using Gaussian-weighted image aggregation and triplane-guided refinement. Introduces Gaussian Anchoring for sub-pixel voxel-image alignment.

entry.title: Beyond Test-Time Compute Strategies: Advocating Energy-per-Token in LLM Inference

author.name: Patrick Wilhelm, Thorsten Wittkopp, Odej Kao

entry.summary: Analyzes energy-per-token tradeoffs in LLM inference, showing that small language models with reasoning strategies like CoT can approach larger model performance while reducing energy costs, though with caveats.

entry.title: JUBAKU: An Adversarial Benchmark for Exposing Culturally Grounded Stereotypes in Japanese LLMs

author.name: Taihei Shiotani, Masahiro Kaneko, Ayana Niwa, Yuki Maruyama, Daisuke Oba, Masanari Ohi, Naoaki Okazaki

entry.summary: Introduces JUBAKU, an adversarial benchmark for evaluating culturally grounded stereotypes in Japanese LLMs. Addresses limitations of translated English bias benchmarks that miss Japan-specific stereotypes.

entry.title: Evaluating Reasoning-Based Scaffolds for Human-AI Co-Annotation: The ReasonAlign Annotation Protocol

author.name: Smitha Muthya Sudheendra, Jaideep Srivastava

entry.summary: Introduces ReasonAlign, a reasoning-based annotation scaffold that shows LLM-generated explanations to human annotators while withholding labels. Studies how reasoning affects human annotation behavior.

entry.title: PROMPT2BOX: Uncovering Entailment Structure among LLM Prompts

author.name: Neeladri Bhuiya, Shib Sankar Dasgupta, Andrew McCallum, Haw-Shiuan Chang

entry.summary: Proposes PROMPT2BOX, using box embeddings to capture both semantic similarity and specificity relations between LLM prompts. Enables fine-grained weakness analysis by distinguishing prompts that share topics but differ in difficulty.

entry.title: TAMTRL: Teacher-Aligned Reward Reshaping for Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning in Long-Context Compression

author.name: Li Wang, Yandong Wang, Xin Yu, Kui Zhang, Tianhao Peng, Wenjun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes TAMTRL, a teacher-aligned reward reshaping method for multi-turn RL training of LLMs in long-context compression. Addresses temporal credit assignment when supervision comes only from final outcomes.

entry.title: STAC: Plug-and-Play Spatio-Temporal Aware Cache Compression for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Runze Wang, Yuxuan Song, Youcheng Cai, Ligang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes STAC, a spatio-temporally aware cache compression framework for streaming 3D reconstruction that exploits attention sparsity patterns in causal transformers to reduce memory usage while maintaining reconstruction quality.

entry.title: Toward a Multi-View Brain Network Foundation Model: Cross-View Consistency Learning Across Arbitrary Atlases

author.name: Jiaxing Xu, Jingying Ma, Xin Lin, Yuxiao Liu, Kai He, Qika Lin, Yiping Ke, Yang Li, Dinggang Shen, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: Proposes MV-BrainFM, a multi-view brain network foundation model that learns generalizable representations from brain networks constructed with arbitrary atlases, incorporating anatomical distance priors.

entry.title: MFSR: MeanFlow Distillation for One Step Real-World Image Super Resolution

author.name: Ruiqing Wang, Kai Zhang, Yuanzhi Zhu, Hanshu Yan, Shilin Lu, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MFSR for one-step real-world image super-resolution using MeanFlow distillation, achieving photorealistic results in a single step while retaining optional multi-step refinement.

entry.title: GOLDMARK: Governed Outcome-Linked Diagnostic Model Assessment Reference Kit

author.name: Chad Vanderbilt, Gabriele Campanella, Siddharth Singi, Swaraj Nanda, Jie-Fu Chen, Ali Kamali, Amir Momeni Boroujeni, David Kim, Mohamed Yakoub, Jamal Benhamida, Meera Hameed, Neeraj Kumar, Gregory Goldgof

entry.summary: Introduces GOLDMARK, a standardized benchmarking framework for computational biomarkers in pathology, built on curated TCGA cohorts with standardized data formats, provenance tracking, and reproducible evaluation.

entry.title: Mitigating Objectness Bias and Region-to-Text Misalignment for Open-Vocabulary Panoptic Segmentation

author.name: Nikolay Kormushev, Josip \v{S}ari\'c, Matej Kristan

entry.summary: Introduces OVRCOAT for open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation, addressing objectness bias from closed-vocabulary training and limited regional understanding in CLIP through CLIP-conditioned objectness adjustment and mask-to-text refinement.

entry.title: Learning Trajectory-Aware Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Reasoning Segmentation

author.name: Jingnan Luo, Mingqi Gao, Jun Liu, Bin-Bin Gao, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes TrajSeg for video reasoning segmentation using trajectory-aware MLLMs with bidirectional text-trajectory alignment, enabling both grounding (text-to-trajectory) and captioning (trajectory-to-text) for better object tracking.

entry.title: Back to Point: Exploring Point-Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Kaiqiang Li, Gang Li, Mingle Zhou, Min Li, Delong Han, Jin Wan

entry.summary: Proposes BTP (Back To Point) for zero-shot 3D anomaly detection using pre-trained Point-Language Models instead of rendering 3D point clouds to 2D images, preserving geometric details for better anomaly detection.

entry.title: 4DGS360: 360{\deg} Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Objects from a Single Video

author.name: Jae Won Jang, Yeonjin Chang, Wonsik Shin, Juhwan Cho, Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: Introduces 4DGS360 for 360° dynamic object reconstruction from monocular video without diffusion priors, using AnchorTAP3D for reliable 3D point trajectories that preserve geometry in occluded regions.

entry.title: OmniFM: Toward Modality-Robust and Task-Agnostic Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Medical Imaging

author.name: Meilin Liu, Jiaying Wang, Jing Shan

entry.summary: Proposes OmniFM, a modality- and task-agnostic federated learning framework that unifies training across multiple medical imaging tasks using frequency-domain insights about cross-modality alignment.

entry.title: Image-Conditioned Adaptive Parameter Tuning for Visual Odometry Frontends

author.name: Simone Nascivera, Leonard Bauersfeld, Jeff Delaune, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Proposes the first image-conditioned RL framework for online tuning of visual odometry frontend parameters, adapting feature detection and tracking hyperparameters based on scene characteristics during deployment.

entry.title: Anatomical Token Uncertainty for Transformer-Guided Active MRI Acquisition
