author.name: Lev Ayzenberg, Shady Abu-Hussein, Raja Giryes, Hayit Greenspan

entry.summary: Proposes anatomical token uncertainty for transformer-guided active MRI acquisition, using token entropy from a pretrained medical image tokenizer to guide k-space sampling for accelerated MRI reconstruction.

entry.title: Beyond Strict Pairing: Arbitrarily Paired Training for High-Performance Infrared and Visible Image Fusion

author.name: Yanglin Deng, Tianyang Xu, Chunyang Cheng, Hui Li, Xiao-jun Wu, Josef Kittler

entry.summary: Challenges the necessity of strictly paired training for infrared-visible image fusion, systematically investigating unpaired and arbitrarily paired training paradigms with theoretical justification.

entry.title: GeoFusion-CAD: Structure-Aware Diffusion with Geometric State Space for Parametric 3D Design

author.name: Xiaolei Zhou, Chuangjie Fang, Jie Wu, Jingyi Yang, Boyi Lin, Jianwei Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes GeoFusion-CAD, a diffusion framework for parametric CAD generation using hierarchical tree encoding with state-space models (C-Mamba) to handle long command sequences and complex geometric dependencies.

entry.title: StreamingClaw Technical Report

author.name: Jiawei Chen, Zhe Chen, Chaoqun Du, Maokui He, Wei He, Hengtao Li, Qizhen Li, Zide Liu, Hao Ma, Xuhao Pan, Chang Ren, Xudong Rao, Xintian Shen, Chenfeng Wang, Tao Wei, Chengjun Yu, Pengfei Yu, Shengyu Yao, Chunpeng Zhou, Kun Zhan, Lihao Zheng, Pan Zhou, Xuhan Zhu, Yufei Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes StreamingClaw, a unified agent framework for streaming video understanding and embodied intelligence with real-time perception, long-term memory, and proactive interaction capabilities.

entry.title: PAM: A Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for Sim-to-Real HOI Video Generation

author.name: Mingju Gao, Kaisen Yang, Huan-ang Gao, Bohan Li, Ao Ding, Wenyi Li, Yangcheng Yu, Jinkun Liu, Shaocong Xu, Yike Niu, Haohan Chi, Hao Chen, Hao Tang, Li Yi, Hao Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes PAM, a unified engine for sim-to-real hand-object interaction video generation that brings together pose, appearance, and motion in one framework, addressing the fragmentation across existing HOI tracks.

entry.title: Memory Over Maps: 3D Object Localization Without Reconstruction

author.name: Rui Zhou, Xander Yap, Jianwen Cao, Allison Lau, Boyang Sun, Marc Pollefeys

entry.summary: Proposes a map-free object localization pipeline that stores only posed RGB-D keyframes as lightweight visual memory, questioning whether full 3D reconstruction is necessary for object localization.

entry.title: Swim2Real: VLM-Guided System Identification for Sim-to-Real Transfer

author.name: Kevin Qiu, Kyle Walker, Mike Y. Michelis, Marek Cygan, Josie Hughes

entry.summary: Presents Swim2Real, which uses VLM feedback to calibrate a robotic fish simulator from swimming videos without hand-designed search stages, achieving sim-to-real transfer for soft aquatic robots.

entry.title: Do World Action Models Generalize Better than VLAs? A Robustness Study

author.name: Zhanguang Zhang, Zhiyuan Li, Behnam Rahmati, Rui Heng Yang, Yintao Ma, Amir Rasouli, Sajjad Pakdamansavoji, Yangzheng Wu, Lingfeng Zhang, Tongtong Cao, Feng Wen, Xingyue Quan, Yingxue Zhang

entry.summary: Compares world action models (WAMs) against vision-language-action (VLA) models on robustness and generalization. Tests whether WAMs' ability to predict environmental evolution leads to better performance under distribution shifts and contextual perturbations.

entry.title: More Than Sum of Its Parts: Deciphering Intent Shifts in Multimodal Hate Speech Detection

author.name: Runze Sun, Yu Zheng, Zexuan Xiong, Zhongjin Qu, Lei Chen, Jiwen Lu, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Moves beyond binary hate speech classification to characterize semantic intent shifts where modality interactions create implicit hate from benign cues or neutralize toxicity, curating a dataset for this fine-grained formulation.

entry.title: {\lambda}-GELU: Learning Gating Hardness for Controlled ReLU-ization in Deep Networks

author.name: Cristian P\'erez-Corral, Alberto Fern\'andez-Hern\'andez, Jose I. Mestre, Manuel F. Dolz, Enrique S. Quintana-Ort\'i

entry.summary: Studies λ-GELU, a hardness-parameterized GELU activation that can smoothly transition to ReLU, enabling a controlled path from smooth to piecewise-linear networks useful for deployment and compression.

entry.title: Improving Diffusion Generalization with Weak-to-Strong Segmented Guidance

author.name: Liangyu Yuan, Yufei Huang, Mingkun Lei, Tong Zhao, Ruoyu Wang, Changxi Chi, Yiwei Wang, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes weak-to-strong segmented guidance for diffusion models, conducting systematic analysis of guidance methods and introducing strategies that improve generalization beyond CFG and AutoGuidance.

entry.title: EruDiff: Refactoring Knowledge in Diffusion Models for Advanced Text-to-Image Synthesis

author.name: Xiefan Guo, Xinzhu Ma, Haoxiang Ma, Zihao Zhou, Di Huang

entry.summary: Proposes EruDiff to refactor knowledge in diffusion models for handling implicit prompts requiring world knowledge. Uses Diffusion Knowledge Distribution Matching to align implicit prompt processing with explicit counterparts.

entry.title: PEARL: Geometry Aligns Semantics for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Gensheng Pei, Xiruo Jiang, Xinhao Cai, Tao Chen, Yazhou Yao, Byeungwoo Jeon

entry.summary: Presents PEARL for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation using Procrustes alignment and text-aware Laplacian propagation, following an align-then-propagate principle without auxiliary models.

entry.title: RefracGS: Novel View Synthesis Through Refractive Water Surfaces with 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing

author.name: Yiming Shao, Qiyu Dai, Chong Gao, Guanbin Li, Yeqiang Wang, He Sun, Qiong Zeng, Baoquan Chen, Wenzheng Chen

entry.summary: Introduces RefracGS for novel view synthesis through non-planar refractive water surfaces, explicitly modeling the refractive boundary via a neural height field while representing the underwater scene as a 3D Gaussian field.

entry.title: Group3D: MLLM-Driven Semantic Grouping for Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Detection

author.name: Youbin Kim, Jinho Park, Hogun Park, Eunbyung Park

entry.summary: Proposes Group3D, which uses MLLMs to provide semantic grouping for open-vocabulary 3D object detection from multi-view RGB. Addresses geometry-only merging failures by incorporating semantic constraints during instance construction.

entry.title: StageCraft: Execution Aware Mitigation of Distractor and Obstruction Failures in VLA Models

author.name: Kartikay Milind Pangaonkar, Prabin Rath, Omkar Patil, Nakul Gopalan

entry.summary: Proposes StageCraft, a training-free approach using VLMs to reason about distractors and obstructions in VLA model execution, leveraging internet-scale pretraining for failure mitigation.

entry.title: Domain-Specialized Tree of Thought through Plug-and-Play Predictors

author.name: Xuanqi Gao, Haoyu Wang, Jun Sun, Shiqing Ma, Chao Shen

entry.summary: Introduces DST, a lightweight plug-and-play predictor that guides Tree-of-Thought search with supervised heuristics for dynamic branch pruning. This achieves near-greedy efficiency on simple steps while expanding search on harder ones.

entry.title: DiffGraph: An Automated Agent-driven Model Merging Framework for In-the-Wild Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Zhuoling Li, Hossein Rahmani, Jiarui Zhang, Yu Xue, Majid Mirmehdi, Jason Kuen, Jiuxiang Gu, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Presents DiffGraph, an agent-driven graph-based framework for merging specialized text-to-image diffusion models. It organizes online expert models in a scalable graph and dynamically activates subgraphs based on user needs.

entry.title: AutoMOOSE: An Agentic AI for Autonomous Phase-Field Simulation

author.name: Sukriti Manna, Henry Chan, Subramanian K. R. S. Sankaranarayanan

entry.summary: Introduces AutoMOOSE, an agentic AI framework that automates the full lifecycle of MOOSE phase-field simulations from natural language prompts, including input file generation, failure diagnosis, and result extraction.

entry.title: KLDrive: Fine-Grained 3D Scene Reasoning for Autonomous Driving based on Knowledge Graph

author.name: Ye Tian, Jingyi Zhang, Zihao Wang, Xiaoyuan Ren, Xiaofan Yu, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing

entry.summary: Presents KLDrive, the first knowledge-graph-augmented LLM reasoning framework for fine-grained 3D scene question answering in autonomous driving, combining energy-based scene fact construction with KG-grounded reasoning.

entry.title: The Myhill-Nerode Theorem for Bounded Interaction: Canonical Abstractions via Agent-Bounded Indistinguishability

author.name: Anthony T. Nixon

entry.summary: Formalizes a bounded-interaction analogue of the Myhill-Nerode theorem for finite POMDPs, showing that capacity-limited observers induce canonical quotients on their environment.

entry.title: Adaptive Robust Estimator for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhongyi Li, Wan Tian, Jingyu Chen, Kangyao Huang, Huiming Zhang, Hui Yang, Tao Ren, Jinyang Jiang, Yijie Peng, Yikun Ban, Fuzhen Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes DACR and Adaptive Robust Estimator for multi-agent RL that decomposes reasoning into answer-critique-rewrite stages with robust advantage estimation handling heavy-tailed rewards.

entry.title: EvoIdeator: Evolving Scientific Ideas through Checklist-Grounded Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Andreas Sauter, Yuyue Zhao, Jacopo Urbani, Wenxiang Hu, Zaiqiao Meng, Lun Zhou, Xiaohui Yan, Yougang Lyu

entry.summary: Introduces EvoIdeator, an RL framework for evolving scientific ideas using checklist-grounded rewards instead of scalar rubric scores. Bridges the gap between rubric-based RL and language-based refinement for scientific proposal generation.

entry.title: Guideline-grounded retrieval-augmented generation for ophthalmic clinical decision support

author.name: Shuying Chen, Sen Cui, Zhong Cao

entry.summary: Proposes Oph-Guid-RAG, a multimodal RAG system for ophthalmology that treats guideline pages as independent evidence units, preserving visual layout information. Includes controllable retrieval with routing and filtering, evaluated on HealthBench.

entry.title: REMI: Reconstructing Episodic Memory During Internally Driven Path Planning

author.name: Zhaoze Wang, Genela Morris, Dori Derdikman, Pratik Chaudhari, Vijay Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Proposes a system-level theory of MEC-HC (grid cell/place cell) wiring that explains cue-triggered goal retrieval, path planning, and sensory reconstruction. Models how place cells autoassociate sensory inputs with grid cell patterns.

entry.title: Characterizing the ability of LLMs to recapitulate Americans' distributional responses to public opinion polling questions across political issues

author.name: Eric Gong, Nathan E. Sanders, Bruce Schneier

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to predict distributional responses to political polling questions by directly prompting for response distributions, comparing against the Cooperative Election Study across demographics and issues.

entry.title: SciNav: A General Agent Framework for Scientific Coding Tasks

author.name: Tianshu Zhang, Huan Sun

entry.summary: Introduces SciNav, an agent framework for scientific coding tasks that enables structured solution exploration with objective evaluation through executable outputs. Addresses the gap between open-ended science agents and verifiable scientific coding.

entry.title: Efficient AI-Driven Multi-Section Whole Slide Image Analysis for Biochemical Recurrence Prediction in Prostate Cancer

author.name: Yesung Cho, Dongmyung Shin, Sujeong Hong, Jooyeon Lee, Seongmin Park, Geongyu Lee, Jongbae Park, Hong Koo Ha

entry.summary: Proposes an AI framework for prostate cancer biochemical recurrence prediction that simultaneously processes multiple pathology slides across the prostate gland, trained on 23,451 slides from 789 patients.

entry.title: KV Cache Optimization Strategies for Scalable and Efficient LLM Inference

author.name: Yichun Xu, Navjot K. Khaira, Tejinder Singh

entry.summary: Provides a systematic review of KV cache optimization techniques for LLM inference, organizing them into five categories: cache eviction, compression, hybrid memory, novel attention architectures, and quantization strategies.

entry.title: Detecting Neurovascular Instability from Multimodal Physiological Signals Using Wearable-Compatible Edge AI: A Responsible Computational Framework

author.name: Truong Quynh Hoa, Hoang Dinh Cuong, Truong Xuan Khanh

entry.summary: Proposes Melaguard, a lightweight multimodal ML framework for detecting neurovascular instability from wearable signals before stroke onset, designed for edge inference on Cortex-M4 processors with under 4ms latency.

entry.title: Meeting in the Middle: A Co-Design Paradigm for FHE and AI Inference

author.name: Bernardo Magri, Benjamin Marsh, Paul Gebheim

entry.summary: Argues for co-designing FHE schemes with AI inference architectures to make privacy-preserving inference practical, outlining optimization targets on both the cryptographic and model architecture sides.

entry.title: Modernizing Amdahl's Law: How AI Scaling Laws Shape Computer Architecture

author.name: Chien-Ping Lu

entry.summary: Reformulates Amdahl's Law for modern heterogeneous AI systems with specialized accelerators, incorporating AI scaling laws to analyze resource allocation across different hardware types and workload structures.

entry.title: Beyond the Birkhoff Polytope: Spectral-Sphere-Constrained Hyper-Connections

author.name: Zhaoyi Liu, Haichuan Zhang, Ang Li

entry.summary: Proposes spectral-sphere-constrained Hyper-Connections that overcome three limitations of Birkhoff polytope constraints: identity degeneration, expressivity bottlenecks, and computational overhead of Sinkhorn iterations.

entry.title: From Causal Discovery to Dynamic Causal Inference in Neural Time Series

author.name: Valentina Kuskova, Dmitry Zaytsev, Michael Coppedge

entry.summary: Proposes DCNAR, a two-stage framework integrating data-driven causal discovery with time-varying causal inference for neural time series, removing the assumption that causal structure is known a priori.

entry.title: One Pool Is Not Enough: Multi-Cluster Memory for Practical Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Yu-Wen Tseng, Xingyi Zheng, Ya-Chen Wu, I-Bin Liao, Yung-Hui Li, Hong-Han Shuai, Wen-Huang Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Cluster Memory (MCM) for practical test-time adaptation, showing that single-pool memory designs are mismatched to the inherently multi-modal nature of temporally correlated test streams, and proposes organizing samples into multiple clusters.

entry.title: Conversation Tree Architecture: A Structured Framework for Context-Aware Multi-Branch LLM Conversations

author.name: Pranav Hemanth, Sampriti Saha

entry.summary: Introduces Conversation Tree Architecture (CTA) for LLM conversations, organizing multi-topic conversations as trees of context-isolated nodes to prevent 'logical context poisoning' from topic bleeding in flat conversation structures.

entry.title: A Framework for Closed-Loop Robotic Assembly, Alignment and Self-Recovery of Precision Optical Systems

author.name: Seou Choi, Sachin Vaidya, Caio Silva, Shiekh Zia Uddin, Sajib Biswas Shuvo, Shrish Choudhary, Marin Solja\v{c}i\'c

entry.summary: Presents a robotics framework for autonomous construction, alignment, and maintenance of precision optical systems, integrating computer vision, optimization, and custom tools. Demonstrates fully autonomous construction of a tabletop optical system.

entry.title: CatRAG: Functor-Guided Structural Debiasing with Retrieval Augmentation for Fair LLMs

author.name: Ravi Ranjan, Utkarsh Grover, Mayur Akewar, Xiaomin Lin, Agoritsa Polyzou

entry.summary: Proposes CatRAG Debiasing, using category theory functors combined with RAG to perform structural debiasing of LLMs through structure-preserving projections that suppress bias while maintaining retrieval-augmented factual grounding.

entry.title: When Exploration Comes for Free with Mixture-Greedy: Do we need UCB in Diversity-Aware Multi-Armed Bandits?

author.name: Bahar Dibaei Nia, Farzan Farnia

entry.summary: Shows that in diversity-aware multi-armed bandits for generative model selection, a simple Mixture-Greedy strategy without UCB exploration bonus consistently outperforms UCB-augmented approaches, achieving faster convergence.

entry.title: Extending Precipitation Nowcasting Horizons via Spectral Fusion of Radar Observations and Foundation Model Priors

author.name: Yuze Qin, Qingyong Li, Zhiqing Guo, Wen Wang, Yan Liu, Yangli-ao Geng

entry.summary: Proposes PW-FouCast, a frequency-domain fusion framework that integrates Pangu-Weather foundation model forecasts as spectral priors for radar-based precipitation nowcasting, extending prediction horizons.

entry.title: SHAPE: Structure-aware Hierarchical Unsupervised Domain Adaptation with Plausibility Evaluation for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Linkuan Zhou, Yinghao Xia, Yufei Shen, Xiangyu Li, Wenjie Du, Cong Cong, Leyi Wei, Ran Su, Qiangguo Jin

entry.summary: Proposes SHAPE for unsupervised domain adaptation in medical image segmentation, using DINOv3 foundation with hierarchical feature modulation and plausibility evaluation to enforce global anatomical constraints.

entry.title: SecureBreak -- A dataset towards safe and secure models

author.name: Marco Arazzi, Vignesh Kumar Kembu, Antonino Nocera

entry.summary: Introduces SecureBreak, a dataset for evaluating and improving LLM safety alignment against jailbreaking and prompt injection attacks, providing qualitative feedback on robustness.

entry.title: Uncertainty-guided Compositional Alignment with Part-to-Whole Semantic Representativeness in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models

author.name: Hayeon Kim, Ji Ha Jang, Junghun James Kim, Se Young Chun

entry.summary: Proposes UNCHA for hyperbolic vision-language models, modeling part-to-whole semantic representativeness using hyperbolic uncertainty to improve compositional alignment.

entry.title: TiCo: Time-Controllable Training for Spoken Dialogue Models

author.name: Kai-Wei Chang, Wei-Chih Chen, En-Pei Hu, Hung-yi Lee, James Glass

entry.summary: Proposes TiCo, a post-training method enabling spoken dialogue models to generate responses with controllable duration based on time-constrained instructions.

entry.title: SLE-FNO: Single-Layer Extensions for Task-Agnostic Continual Learning in Fourier Neural Operators

author.name: Mahmoud Elhadidy, Roshan M. D'Souza, Amirhossein Arzani

entry.summary: Introduces SLE-FNO for continual learning in Fourier Neural Operators, enabling adaptation to new physics regimes without catastrophic forgetting through single-layer extensions.

entry.title: Breaking the $O(\sqrt{T})$ Cumulative Constraint Violation Barrier while Achieving $O(\sqrt{T})$ Static Regret in Constrained Online Convex Optimization

author.name: Haricharan Balasundaram, Karthick Krishna Mahendran, Rahul Vaze

entry.summary: Breaks the O(√T) cumulative constraint violation barrier in constrained online convex optimization while maintaining O(√T) static regret, achieving O(T^{1/4}) CCV without sacrificing regret bounds.

entry.title: Bayesian Scattering: A Principled Baseline for Uncertainty on Image Data

author.name: Bernardo Fichera, Zarko Ivkovic, Kjell Jorner, Philipp Hennig, Viacheslav Borovitskiy

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian scattering as an interpretable baseline for uncertainty quantification on image data, coupling wavelet scattering transforms with probabilistic heads to provide sensible uncertainty estimates under distribution shift.

entry.title: Model Evolution Under Zeroth-Order Optimization: A Neural Tangent Kernel Perspective

author.name: Chen Zhang, Yuxin Cheng, Chenchen Ding, Shuqi Wang, Jingreng Lei, Runsheng Yu, Yik-Chung WU, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Zeroth-order Kernel (NZK) to describe model evolution under zeroth-order optimization, proving expected NZK remains constant for linear models and deriving closed-form training dynamics.

entry.title: Does Mechanistic Interpretability Transfer Across Data Modalities? A Cross-Domain Causal Circuit Analysis of Variational Autoencoders

author.name: Dip Roy, Rajiv Misra, Sanjay Kumar Singh, Anisha Roy

entry.summary: Investigates whether mechanistic interpretability findings from image VAEs transfer to tabular data, introducing posterior-calibrated interventions and three new techniques across five VAE architectures.

entry.title: Stream separation improves Bregman conditioning in transformers

author.name: James Clayton Kerce

entry.summary: Shows that stream separation in transformers improves Bregman geometry conditioning, validating theoretical predictions about softmax-induced curvature at intermediate layers.

entry.title: TrustFed: Enabling Trustworthy Medical AI under Data Privacy Constraints

author.name: Vagish Kumar, Syed Bahauddin Alam, Souvik Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes TrustFed, a federated UQ framework providing distribution-free coverage guarantees under data heterogeneity for medical AI, addressing reliability in multi-institutional healthcare deployment.

entry.title: RAMPAGE: RAndomized Mid-Point for debiAsed Gradient Extrapolation

author.name: Abolfazl Hashemi

entry.summary: Introduces RAMPAGE, a randomized mid-point method for variational inequalities that removes discretization bias from the Extragradient method, with a variance-reduced variant RAMPAGE+ using antithetic sampling.

entry.title: A chemical language model for reticular materials design

author.name: Dhruv Menon, Vivek Singh, Xu Chen, Mohammad Reza Alizadeh Kiapi, Ivan Zyuzin, Hamish W. Macleod, Nakul Rampal, William Shepard, Omar M. Yaghi, David Fairen-Jimenez

entry.summary: Introduces Nexerra-R1, a building-block chemical language model for inverse design in reticular chemistry (metal-organic frameworks) that generates organic linkers for targeted material properties.

entry.title: LassoFlexNet: Flexible Neural Architecture for Tabular Data

author.name: Kry Yik Chau Lui, Cheng Chi, Kishore Basu, Yanshuai Cao

entry.summary: Proposes LassoFlexNet, a neural architecture for tabular data incorporating five key inductive biases (feature selection, axis alignment, localized irregularities, feature heterogeneity, training stability) with per-feature embeddings and tied group lasso.

entry.title: Stochastic approximation in non-markovian environments revisited

author.name: Vivek Shripad Borkar

entry.summary: Extends stochastic approximation theory to non-markovian, non-ergodic environments and proposes an analytic framework for understanding transformer attention mechanisms and continual learning.

entry.title: HamVision: Hamiltonian Dynamics as Inductive Bias for Medical Image Analysis

author.name: Mohamed A Mabrok

entry.summary: Proposes HamVision, a framework using damped harmonic oscillator dynamics as inductive bias for medical image analysis. Generates position, momentum, and energy representations from dynamics without supervision for segmentation and classification.

entry.title: RAFL: Generalizable Sim-to-Real of Soft Robots with Residual Acceleration Field Learning

author.name: Dong Heon Cho, Boyuan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes RAFL, a residual acceleration field learning approach for sim-to-real transfer of soft robots. Addresses the sim-to-real gap when geometry is a design variable by learning residual corrections.

entry.title: FinReflectKG -- HalluBench: GraphRAG Hallucination Benchmark for Financial Question Answering Systems

author.name: Mahesh Kumar, Bhaskarjit Sarmah, Stefano Pasquali

entry.summary: Introduces FinBench-QA-Hallucination, a benchmark for evaluating hallucination detection in KG-augmented financial QA over SEC 10-K filings. Contains 755 annotated examples with conservative evidence-linkage protocol.

entry.title: NoveltyAgent: Autonomous Novelty Reporting Agent with Point-wise Novelty Analysis and Self-Validation

author.name: Jiajun Hou, Hexuan Deng, Wenxiang Jiao, Xuebo Liu, Xiaopeng Ke, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces NoveltyAgent, a multi-agent system for generating comprehensive novelty reports for academic papers. Decomposes manuscripts into novelty points for fine-grained retrieval and comparison with self-validation.

entry.title: SqueezeComposer: Temporal Speed-up is A Simple Trick for Long-form Music Composing

author.name: Jianyi Chen, Rongxiu Zhong, Shilei Zhang, Kun Qian, Jinglei Liu, Yike Guo, Wei Xue

entry.summary: Proposes a simple trick for long-form music generation: generate time-accelerated audio (2-8x speed), then restore to original speed. Reduces memory/compute requirements while maintaining coherence for long-form music.

entry.title: Uni-Classifier: Leveraging Video Diffusion Priors for Universal Guidance Classifier

author.name: Yujie Zhou, Pengyang Ling, Jiazi Bu, Bingjie Gao, Li Niu

entry.summary: Proposes Uni-Classifier, a plug-and-play module leveraging video diffusion priors to guide upstream generative models, addressing distributional mismatches in chained generation pipelines.

entry.title: CTCal: Rethinking Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Cross-Timestep Self-Calibration

author.name: Xiefan Guo, Xinzhu Ma, Haiyu Zhang, Di Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CTCal, a cross-timestep self-calibration method for text-to-image diffusion models that leverages reliable text-image alignment from smaller timesteps to improve alignment at larger timesteps.

entry.title: Does Peer Observation Help? Vision-Sharing Collaboration for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Qunchao Jin, Yiliao Song, Qi Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Co-VLN, a framework for vision-language navigation where concurrently navigating agents share visual observations at common locations, expanding each agent's receptive field at no exploration cost.

entry.title: Two Experts Are Better Than One Generalist: Decoupling Geometry and Appearance for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Hwasik Jeong, Seungryong Lee, Gyeongjin Kang, Seungkwon Yang, Xiangyu Sun, Seungtae Nam, Eunbyung Park

entry.summary: Proposes 2Xplat, a two-expert architecture for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that decouples geometry and appearance modeling into separate specialized networks rather than a monolithic approach.

entry.title: NoOVD: Novel Category Discovery and Embedding for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Yupeng Zhang, Ruize Han, Zhiwei Chen, Wei Feng, Liang Wan

entry.summary: Proposes NoOVD for open-vocabulary object detection, integrating self-distillation with vision-language model knowledge to discover and properly handle novel-category objects during training.

entry.title: LiFR-Seg: Anytime High-Frame-Rate Segmentation via Event-Guided Propagation

author.name: Xiaoshan Wu, Xiaoyang Lyu, Yifei Yu, Bo Wang, Zhongrui Wang, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: Introduces anytime interframe semantic segmentation using a single past RGB frame and asynchronous event camera data. LiFR-Seg propagates deep semantic features through time using event-derived motion fields for high-frame-rate segmentation.

entry.title: Focus on Background: Exploring SAM's Potential in Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation with Background-centric Prompting

author.name: Yuntian Bo, Yazhou Zhu, Piotr Koniusz, Haofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FoB (Focus on Background), a background-centric prompt generator for SAM-based few-shot medical image segmentation. Provides background prompts to constrain SAM's over-segmentation tendencies in medical images.

entry.title: Identity-Consistent Video Generation under Large Facial-Angle Variations

author.name: Bin Hu, Zipeng Qi, Guoxi Huang, Zunnan Xu, Ruicheng Zhang, Chongjie Ye, Jun Zhou, Xiu Li, Jingdong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Mv²ID for identity-consistent video generation under large facial-angle variations using multi-view facial references with a region-masking training strategy to prevent copy-paste artifacts.

entry.title: Clinical Graph-Mediated Distillation for Unpaired MRI-to-CFI Hypertension Prediction

author.name: Dillan Imans, Phuoc-Nguyen Bui, Duc-Tai Le, Hyunseung Choo

entry.summary: Introduces Clinical Graph-Mediated Distillation for transferring MRI-derived hypertension knowledge to fundus imaging models without paired multimodal data, using shared clinical biomarkers as a bridge between cohorts.

entry.title: Thermal Topology Collapse: Universal Physical Patch Attacks on Infrared Vision Systems

author.name: Chengyin Hu, Yikun Guo, Yuxian Dong, Qike Zhang, Kalibinuer Tiliwalidi, Yiwei Wei, Haitao Shi, Jiujiang Guo, Jiahuan Long, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes UPPA, the first universal physical patch attack method in the infrared domain, using Bezier-parameterized perturbations with Particle Swarm Optimization for attacks that generalize across instances.

entry.title: MultiBind: A Benchmark for Attribute Misbinding in Multi-Subject Generation

author.name: Wenqing Tian, Hanyi Mao, Zhaocheng Liu, Lihua Zhang, Qiang Liu, Jian Wu, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MultiBind, a benchmark for diagnosing cross-subject attribute misbinding in multi-subject image generation. Built from real multi-person photographs with slot-ordered subject crops, masks, and bounding boxes.

entry.title: DTVI: Dual-Stage Textual and Visual Intervention for Safe Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Binhong Tan, Zhaoxin Wang, Handing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DTVI, a dual-stage defense framework for safe text-to-image generation that combines category-aware sequence-level text intervention with visual-space intervention to capture distributed malicious semantics.

entry.title: GenOpticalFlow: A Generative Approach to Unsupervised Optical Flow Learning

author.name: Yixuan Luo, Feng Qiao, Zhexiao Xiong, Yanjing Li, Nathan Jacobs

entry.summary: Proposes GenOpticalFlow, which synthesizes large-scale frame-flow data pairs using depth estimation and diffusion models for supervised optical flow training without human annotations.

entry.title: Optimal Memory Encoding Through Fluctuation-Response Structure

author.name: Lianxiang Cui, Kohei Nakajima, Kazuyuki Aihara

entry.summary: Shows that optimal input encoding in physical reservoir computing is a geometric problem governed by fluctuation-response structure, deriving the ROME criterion for maximizing task-specific linear memory.

entry.title: High-Speed, All-Terrain Autonomy: Ensuring Safety at the Limits of Mobility

author.name: James R. Baxter, Bogdan I. Epureanu, Paramsothy Jayakumar, Tulga Ersal

entry.summary: Presents a novel MPC-based local trajectory planner for high-speed autonomous off-road driving with an energy-based rollover constraint that safely enables extreme mobility including tire liftoff.

entry.title: Implementing Robust M-Estimators with Certifiable Factor Graph Optimization

author.name: Zhexin Xu, Hanna Jiamei Zhang, Helena Calatrava, Pau Closas, David M. Rosen

entry.summary: Introduces certifiable M-estimation for factor graph optimization in robotics, using adaptive reweighting with certifiably optimal WLS subproblem solutions to handle outliers and nonconvexity.

entry.title: Conformal Koopman for Embedded Nonlinear Control with Statistical Robustness: Theory and Real-World Validation

author.name: Koki Hirano, Hiroyasu Tsukamoto

entry.summary: Proposes a Koopman-based framework combining contraction theory with conformal prediction for statistically robust nonlinear control. Provides distribution-free probabilistic bounds on tracking error in closed-loop settings, validated on real hardware.

entry.title: DexDrummer: In-Hand, Contact-Rich, and Long-Horizon Dexterous Robot Drumming

author.name: Hung-Chieh Fang, Amber Xie, Jennifer Grannen, Kenneth Llontop, Dorsa Sadigh

entry.summary: DexDrummer is a hierarchical bimanual drumming system that combines in-hand control, contact-rich interaction, and long-horizon coordination. Drumming serves as a challenging testbed integrating multiple dexterous manipulation capabilities.

entry.title: Sinkhorn Based Associative Memory Retrieval Using Spherical Hellinger Kantorovich Dynamics

author.name: Aratrika Mustafi, Soumya Mukherjee

entry.summary: Proposes a dense associative memory for probability measures using debiased Sinkhorn divergence, deriving retrieval dynamics as a spherical Hellinger-Kantorovich gradient flow with provable convergence guarantees.

entry.title: OmniPatch: A Universal Adversarial Patch for ViT-CNN Cross-Architecture Transfer in Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Aarush Aggarwal, Akshat Tomar, Amritanshu Tiwari, Sargam Goyal

entry.summary: Introduces OmniPatch, a universal adversarial patch that transfers across both ViT and CNN architectures for attacking semantic segmentation models in autonomous driving without target model access.

entry.title: Instruction Set and Language for Symbolic Regression

author.name: Ezequiel Lopez-Rubio, Mario Pascual-Gonzalez

entry.summary: Introduces IsalSR, a representation framework for symbolic regression that encodes expression DAGs as canonical strings to eliminate structural redundancy (multiple equivalent representations of the same expression).

entry.title: SARe: Structure-Aware Large-Scale 3D Fragment Reassembly

author.name: Hanze Jia, Chunshi Wang, Yuxiao Yang, Zhonghua Jiang, Yawei Luo, Shuainan Ye, Tan Tang

entry.summary: Proposes SARe for large-scale 3D fragment reassembly with explicit contact modeling, using a generative framework for assembly generation and inference-time refinement to handle cascading failures.

entry.title: VideoDetective: Clue Hunting via both Extrinsic Query and Intrinsic Relevance for Long Video Understanding

author.name: Ruoliu Yang, Chu Wu, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Chaoyou Fu

entry.summary: Proposes VideoDetective for long video understanding that integrates query-to-segment relevance and inter-segment affinity through a visual-temporal affinity graph with hypothesis-verification-refinement cycles.

entry.title: TRGS-SLAM: IMU-Aided Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Blurry, Rolling Shutter, and Noisy Thermal Images

author.name: Spencer Carmichael, Katherine A. Skinner

entry.summary: Presents TRGS-SLAM, a 3DGS-based thermal-inertial SLAM system that handles motion blur, rolling shutter distortions, and fixed pattern noise from uncooled microbolometer thermal cameras.

entry.title: ROI-Driven Foveated Attention for Unified Egocentric Representations in Vision-Language-Action Systems

author.name: Xinhai Sun, Xiang Shi, Menglin Zou, Wenlong Huang

entry.summary: Proposes an ROI-driven foveated attention workflow for VLA systems using egocentric hand-centric ROIs derived from forward kinematics, reducing data collection cost and improving cross-embodiment transfer.

entry.title: Fingerprinting Deep Neural Networks for Ownership Protection: An Analytical Approach

author.name: Guang Yang, Ziye Geng, Yihang Chen, Changqing Luo

entry.summary: Proposes AnaFP, an analytical fingerprinting scheme for DNN ownership protection that provides a theoretical solution for optimal fingerprint-to-boundary distance, satisfying both robustness and uniqueness properties.

entry.title: Efficient Failure Management for Multi-Agent Systems with Reasoning Trace Representation

author.name: Lingzhe Zhang, Tong Jia, Mingyu Wang, Weijie Hong, Chiming Duan, Minghua He, Rongqian Wang, Xi Peng, Meiling Wang, Gong Zhang, Renhai Chen, Ying Li

entry.summary: Proposes EAGER for efficient failure management in LLM-based multi-agent systems, leveraging historical failure patterns through reasoning trace representation rather than per-trace reasoning.

entry.title: TREX: Trajectory Explanations for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dilina Rajapakse, Juan C. Rosero, Ivana Dusparic

entry.summary: Introduces TREX, a trajectory-based explanation method for multi-objective reinforcement learning that explains the trade-offs between competing objectives in MORL policies.

entry.title: FAAR: Efficient Frequency-Aware Multi-Task Fine-Tuning via Automatic Rank Selection

author.name: Maxime Fontana, Michael Spratling, Miaojing Shi

entry.summary: Proposes FAAR for efficient multi-task fine-tuning with automatic rank selection in frequency space, enabling different ranks for different tasks and positions in the architecture.

entry.title: Lessons and Open Questions from a Unified Study of Camera-Trap Species Recognition Over Time

author.name: Sooyoung Jeon, Hongjie Tian, Lemeng Wang, Zheda Mai, Vidhi Bakshi, Jiacheng Hou, Ping Zhang, Arpita Chowdhury, Jianyang Gu, Wei-Lun Chao

entry.summary: Presents the first unified study of camera-trap species recognition over time, introducing a streaming benchmark with 546 camera traps and revealing that temporal shifts are a primary challenge overlooked by the CV community.

entry.title: RayMap3R: Inference-Time RayMap for Dynamic 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Feiran Wang, Zezhou Shang, Gaowen Liu, Yan Yan

entry.summary: Proposes RayMap3R, a training-free streaming framework for dynamic scene reconstruction that identifies dynamic regions by contrasting RayMap and image predictions, suppressing interference during memory updates.

entry.title: Glove2Hand: Synthesizing Natural Hand-Object Interaction from Multi-Modal Sensing Gloves

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Ziyi Kou, Chuan Qin, Mia Huang, Ergys Ristani, Ankit Kumar, Lele Chen, Kun He, Abdeslam Boularias, Li Guan

entry.summary: Proposes Glove2Hand, translating multi-modal sensing glove HOI videos into photorealistic bare hands using 3D Gaussian hand models and diffusion-based restoration, preserving physical interaction dynamics.

entry.title: GraPHFormer: A Multimodal Graph Persistent Homology Transformer for the Analysis of Neuroscience Morphologies

author.name: Uzair Shah, Marco Agus, Mahmoud Gamal, Mahmood Alzubaidi, Corrado Cali, Pierre J. Magistretti, Abdesselam Bouzerdoum, Mowafa Househ

entry.summary: Introduces GraPHFormer, a multimodal architecture for neuronal morphology analysis that unifies topological (persistent homology) and graph-structural views through CLIP-style contrastive learning.

entry.title: Incentivizing Generative Zero-Shot Learning via Outcome-Reward Reinforcement Learning with Visual Cues

author.name: Wenjin Hou, Xiaoxiao Sun, Hehe Fan

entry.summary: Proposes RLVC, using outcome-reward reinforcement learning with visual cues for generative zero-shot learning. The RL framework allows the generative model to self-evolve by generating task-aware features for unseen class classification.

entry.title: EmoTaG: Emotion-Aware Talking Head Synthesis on Gaussian Splatting with Few-Shot Personalization

author.name: Haolan Xu, Keli Cheng, Lei Wang, Ning Bi, Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: Presents EmoTaG for few-shot emotion-aware 3D talking head synthesis using Gaussian Splatting, reformulating motion prediction in FLAME parameter space rather than directly deforming Gaussians.

entry.title: EpiMask: Leveraging Epipolar Distance Based Masks in Cross-Attention for Satellite Image Matching

author.name: Rahul Deshmukh, Aditya Chauhan, Avinash Kak

entry.summary: Proposes EpiMask, a semi-dense image matching network for satellite images that incorporates patch-wise affine approximations to handle pushbroom camera geometry and uses epipolar distance-based masks in cross-attention.

entry.title: Exploring Multimodal Prompts For Unsupervised Continuous Anomaly Detection

author.name: Mingle Zhou, Jiahui Liu, Jin Wan, Gang Li, Min Li

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal prompting framework for unsupervised continual anomaly detection using a Continual Multimodal Prompt Memory Bank that distills normal patterns from both visual and textual domains across tasks.

entry.title: Dynamic Exposure Burst Image Restoration

author.name: Woohyeok Kim, Jaesung Rim, Daeyeon Kim, Sunghyun Cho

entry.summary: Presents DEBIR, a burst image restoration pipeline that dynamically predicts optimal exposure times for each burst frame based on shooting conditions, rather than using manually designed exposure settings.

entry.title: GeoFlow: Real-Time Fine-Grained Cross-View Geolocalization via Iterative Flow Prediction

author.name: Ayesh Abu Lehyeh, Xiaohan Zhang, Ahmad Arrabi, Waqas Sultani, Chen Chen, Safwan Wshah

entry.summary: Introduces GeoFlow for real-time fine-grained cross-view geolocalization, learning a direct probabilistic mapping for displacement prediction with iterative refinement. Breaks the accuracy-speed trade-off in ground-to-satellite localization.

entry.title: GHOST: Ground-projected Hypotheses from Observed Structure-from-Motion Trajectories

author.name: Tomasz Frelek, Rohan Patil, Akshar Tumu, Henrik I. Christensen

entry.summary: GHOST presents a scalable self-supervised approach for segmenting feasible vehicle trajectories from monocular images using SfM-recovered camera trajectories projected onto the ground plane as implicit supervision.

entry.title: Geometrically Plausible Object Pose Refinement using Differentiable Simulation

author.name: Anil Zeybek, Rhys Newbury, Snehal Dikhale, Nawid Jamali, Soshi Iba, Akansel Cosgun

entry.summary: Proposes multi-modal pose refinement combining differentiable physics simulation, differentiable rendering, and visuo-tactile sensing for physically consistent object poses in dexterous manipulation.

entry.title: Make Tracking Easy: Neural Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Whole-body Control

author.name: Qingrui Zhao, Kaiyue Yang, Xiyu Wang, Shiqi Zhao, Yi Lu, Xinfang Zhang, Wei Yin, Qiu Shen, Xiao-Xiao Long, Xun Cao

entry.summary: NMR (Neural Motion Retargeting) reformulates human-to-humanoid motion retargeting as distribution learning rather than optimization, addressing the non-convexity of traditional approaches. Uses Clustered-Expert Physics Refinement for dynamics-aware retargeting.

entry.title: LLM-Driven Heuristic Synthesis for Industrial Process Control: Lessons from Hot Steel Rolling

author.name: Nima H. Siboni, Seyedreza Kiamousavi, Emad Scharifi

entry.summary: Studies LLM-driven heuristic synthesis for hot steel rolling industrial control, where an LLM iteratively proposes and refines interpretable Python controllers using physics simulator feedback.

entry.title: Multi-RF Fusion with Multi-GNN Blending for Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Zacharie Bugaud

entry.summary: Achieves #1 on the OGB molhiv leaderboard (ROC-AUC 0.8476) using an ensemble of Random Forest models on molecular fingerprints blended with GNN predictions, with key insights about hyperparameter tuning.

entry.title: Can LLMs Fool Graph Learning? Exploring Universal Adversarial Attacks on Text-Attributed Graphs

author.name: Zihui Chen, Yuling Wang, Pengfei Jiao, Kai Wu, Xiao Wang, Xiang Ao, Dalin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs to generate universal adversarial attacks on text-attributed graphs that generalize across GNN and PLM architectures, exploring cross-architecture vulnerability.

entry.title: Unified-MAS: Universally Generating Domain-Specific Nodes for Empowering Automatic Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Hehai Lin, Yu Yan, Zixuan Wang, Bo Xu, Sudong Wang, Weiquan Huang, Ruochen Zhao, Minzhi Li, Chengwei Qin

entry.summary: Proposes Unified-MAS, a framework that decouples domain-specific node generation from high-level topology optimization in automatic multi-agent system generation for knowledge-intensive domains.

entry.title: Compensating Visual Insufficiency with Stratified Language Guidance for Long-Tail Class Incremental Learning

author.name: Xi Wang, Xu Yang, Donghao Sun, Cheng Deng

entry.summary: Addresses long-tail class incremental learning by using LLMs to generate a stratified language tree that hierarchically organizes semantic information. The language guidance helps compensate for scarce visual samples in tail classes and mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Beyond Detection: Governing GenAI in Academic Peer Review as a Sociotechnical Challenge

author.name: Tatiana Chakravorti, Pranav Narayanan Venkit, Sourojit Ghosh, Sarah Rajtmajer

entry.summary: Mixed-method study combining discourse analysis of 448 social media posts with 14 expert interviews examining how GenAI is used and perceived in academic peer review, finding broad agreement that core evaluative judgments should remain human.

entry.title: Email in the Era of LLMs

author.name: Dang Nguyen, Harvey Yiyun Fu, Peter West, Chenhao Tan, Ari Holtzman

entry.summary: Introduces HR Simulator, a game where players write emails to solve workplace scenarios, comparing human and LLM email performance. Finds humans underperform LLMs under LLM judges but human+LLM collaboration can outperform LLM-only.

entry.title: Stability of AI Governance Systems: A Coupled Dynamics Model of Public Trust and Social Disruptions

author.name: Jiaqi Lai, Hou Liang, Weihong Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a coupled dynamics model of AI governance combining a Hawkes process for AI controversy events with Friedkin-Johnsen opinion dynamics to characterize conditions under which public trust in AI systems collapses.

entry.title: Reason-to-Transmit: Deliberative Adaptive Communication for Cooperative Perception

author.name: Aayam Bansal, Ishaan Gangwani

entry.summary: Introduces Reason-to-Transmit (R2T), a framework for cooperative perception where agents reason about why messages benefit receivers before deciding what to transmit, using a lightweight transformer module under bandwidth constraints.

entry.title: GIP-RAG: An Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Interpretable Gene Interaction and Pathway Impact Analysis

author.name: Fujian Jia, Jiwen Gu, Cheng Lu, Dezhi Zhao, Mengjiang Huang, Yuanzhi Lu, Xin Liu, Kang Liu

entry.summary: Presents GIP-RAG, a framework combining biomedical knowledge graphs with LLMs to infer and interpret gene interactions, integrating curated data from multiple databases for interpretable multi-step reasoning.

entry.title: ALARA for Agents: Least-Privilege Context Engineering Through Portable Composable Multi-Agent Teams

author.name: Christopher J. Agostino, Nayan D'Souza

entry.summary: Proposes ALARA, a least-privilege context engineering approach for multi-agent systems that provides a unified mechanism for managing agent behavioral specifications across frameworks. It addresses fragmentation of agent configuration across prose instructions, framework configs, and MCP servers.

entry.title: Interpretable Operator Learning for Inverse Problems via Adaptive Spectral Filtering: Convergence and Discretization Invariance

author.name: Hang-Cheng Dong, Pengcheng Cheng, Shuhuan Li

entry.summary: Proposes SC-Net, an operator learning framework for inverse problems that learns adaptive spectral filters, with theoretical guarantees of discretization invariance and convergence analysis.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning Diffusion Transformers via Dynamic Patch Sampling and Block Skipping

author.name: Sunghyun Park, Jeongho Kim, Hyoungwoo Park, Debasmit Das, Sungrack Yun, Munawar Hayat, Jaegul Choo, Fatih Porikli, Seokeon Choi

entry.summary: Proposes DiT-BlockSkip, a memory-efficient fine-tuning framework for Diffusion Transformers using timestep-aware dynamic patch sampling and block skipping with precomputed residual features.

entry.title: Restoring Neural Network Plasticity for Faster Transfer Learning

author.name: Xander Coetzer, Arn\'e Schreuder, Anna Sergeevna Bosman

entry.summary: Studies loss of neural plasticity in transfer learning contexts, proposing methods to restore plasticity of pretrained weights for more effective fine-tuning on downstream tasks.

entry.title: Beyond Expression Similarity: Contrastive Learning Recovers Functional Gene Associations from Protein Interaction Structure

author.name: Jason Dury

entry.summary: Tests Contrastive Association Learning (CAL) on gene perturbation data, showing protein-protein interaction-trained models outperform expression-similarity baselines for recovering functional gene associations.

entry.title: Detection of adversarial intent in Human-AI teams using LLMs

author.name: Abed K. Musaffar, Ambuj Singh, Francesco Bullo

entry.summary: Studies LLMs as defensive supervisors in human-AI teams to detect adversarial intent, examining whether LLMs can identify when team members are being manipulated through various attack vectors.

entry.title: DMMRL: Disentangled Multi-Modal Representation Learning via Variational Autoencoders for Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Long Xu, Junping Guo, Jianbo Zhao, Jianbo Lu, Yuzhong Peng

entry.summary: Proposes DMMRL using variational autoencoders to disentangle molecular representations into shared and private factors across graphs, sequences, and geometries for molecular property prediction.

entry.title: Benchmarking Bengali Dialectal Bias: A Multi-Stage Framework Integrating RAG-Based Translation and Human-Augmented RLAIF

author.name: K. M. Jubair Sami, Dipto Sumit, Ariyan Hossain, Farig Sadeque

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to evaluate dialectal bias in LLMs for Bengali question-answering across nine dialects, using RAG-based translation and benchmarking 19 LLMs on 68K+ evaluations.

entry.title: When Documents Disagree: Measuring Institutional Variation in Transplant Guidance with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models

author.name: Yubo Li, Ramayya Krishnan, Rema Padman

entry.summary: Introduces a RAG-based framework for measuring institutional variation in transplant patient education materials across 102 handbooks from 23 U.S. centers, finding 20.8% of comparisons exhibit clinically meaningful divergence.

entry.title: LLM-Based Test Case Generation in DBMS through Monte Carlo Tree Search

author.name: Yujia Chen, Yingli Zhou, Fangyuan Zhang, Cuiyun Gao

entry.summary: Proposes using Monte Carlo Tree Search with LLMs for SQL test case generation in database systems, addressing challenges of lightweight models with proprietary dialects and insufficient test diversity.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 12: Abductive Event Reasoning: Towards Real-World Event Causal Inference for Large Language Models

author.name: Pengfei Cao, Mingxuan Yang, Yubo Chen, Chenlong Zhang, Mingxuan Liu, Kang Liu, Jun Zhao

entry.summary: Describes SemEval-2026 Task 12 on abductive event reasoning, a shared task asking systems to identify the most plausible direct cause of a target event from supporting evidence, formulated as evidence-grounded multiple-choice.

entry.title: Adversarial Camouflage

author.name: Pawe{\l} Borsukiewicz, Daniele Lunghi, Melissa Tessa, Jacques Klein, Tegawend\'e F. Bissyand\'e

entry.summary: Introduces Adversarial Camouflage, a method that generates optimized facial patterns (color, shape, angle) projected onto semantically valid facial regions to fool facial recognition systems across multiple architectures.

entry.title: Camera-Agnostic Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splats via Descriptor-Based Beta Evidence

author.name: Peter Fasogbon, Ugurcan Budak, Patrice Rondao Alface, Hamed Rezazadegan Tavakoli

entry.summary: Proposes a camera-agnostic, one-shot pruning method for 3D Gaussian splats that relies solely on attribute-derived neighborhood descriptors, enabling pruning without camera parameters or rendered images.

entry.title: Large Neighborhood Search meets Iterative Neural Constraint Heuristics

author.name: Yudong W. Xu, Wenhao Li, Scott Sanner, Elias B. Khalil

entry.summary: Connects iterative neural constraint satisfaction heuristics with Large Neighborhood Search (LNS), adapting ConsFormer into an LNS procedure with novel prediction-guided destroy operators.

entry.title: Incentive-Aware Federated Averaging with Performance Guarantees under Strategic Participation

author.name: Fateme Maleki, Krishnan Raghavan, Farzad Yousefian

entry.summary: Proposes an incentive-aware federated averaging method where clients dynamically adjust dataset sizes via Nash equilibrium-seeking updates to balance learning payoff against contribution costs.

entry.title: LLM-ODE: Data-driven Discovery of Dynamical Systems with Large Language Models

author.name: Amirmohammad Ziaei Bideh, Jonathan Gryak

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-ODE, using large language models to guide symbolic evolution for discovering governing equations of dynamical systems, improving upon genetic programming approaches.

entry.title: Pruned Adaptation Modules: A Simple yet Strong Baseline for Continual Foundation Models

author.name: Elif Ceren Gok Yildirim, Murat Onur Yildirim, Joaquin Vanschoren

entry.summary: Introduces Pruned Adaptation Modules (PAM) as a simple baseline for continual learning with foundation models, freezing most of ResNet while enabling sparse task-specific adaptation, achieving competitive results with 5x fewer parameters.

entry.title: On the Role of Batch Size in Stochastic Conditional Gradient Methods

author.name: Rustem Islamov, Roman Machacek, Aurelien Lucchi, Antonio Silveti-Falls, Eduard Gorbunov, Volkan Cevher

entry.summary: Studies batch size effects in stochastic conditional gradient methods under KL conditions, revealing regime-dependent behavior where increasing batch size initially helps but saturates beyond a critical threshold.

entry.title: PLR: Plackett-Luce for Reordering In-Context Learning Examples

author.name: Pawel Batorski, Paul Swoboda

entry.summary: Proposes PLR, using a Plackett-Luce distribution to learn optimal orderings of in-context learning examples, replacing discrete ordering search with probabilistic modeling.

entry.title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Ranking Policies under Deterministic Logging Policies

author.name: Koichi Tanaka, Kazuki Kawamura, Takanori Muroi, Yusuke Narita, Yuki Sasamoto, Kei Tateno, Takuma Udagawa, Wei-Wei Du, Yuta Saito

entry.summary: Proposes click-based inverse propensity score estimators for off-policy evaluation of ranking policies under deterministic logging, exploiting user click stochasticity instead of policy stochasticity.

entry.title: Do Papers Match Code? A Benchmark and Framework for Paper-Code Consistency Detection in Bioinformatics Software

author.name: Tianxiang Xu, Xiaoyan Zhu, Xin Lai, Sizhe Dang, Xin Lian, Hangyu Cheng, Jiayin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a paper-code consistency detection task and benchmark for bioinformatics software, systematically aligning sentence-level algorithmic descriptions with function-level code snippets using expert annotations and hybrid negative sampling.

entry.title: Operator Learning for Smoothing and Forecasting

author.name: Edoardo Calvello, Elizabeth Carlson, Nikola Kovachki, Michael N. Manta, Andrew M. Stuart

entry.summary: Develops theory for data-driven smoothing and forecasting of dynamical systems using operator learning, establishing existence of target mappings and approximation properties of operator learning architectures.

entry.title: CogFormer: Learn All Your Models Once

author.name: Jerry M. Huang, Lukas Schumacher, Niek Stevenson, Stefan T. Radev

entry.summary: Introduces CogFormer, a meta-amortized transformer-based framework for simulation-based inference in cognitive modeling that remains valid across varying parameterizations, generative functions, and priors.

entry.title: Frequency Switching Mechanism for Parameter-E!cient Multi-Task Learning

author.name: Shih-Wen Liu, Yen-Chang Chen, Wei-Ta Chu, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Free Sinewich, a parameter-efficient multi-task learning framework using frequency switching with sinusoidal weight modulation and a lightweight Clock Net for task specialization.

entry.title: Closed-form conditional diffusion models for data assimilation

author.name: Brianna Binder, Assad Oberai

entry.summary: Proposes closed-form conditional diffusion models using kernel density estimation for data assimilation, leveraging analytical tractability of the score function instead of neural network approximation.

entry.title: FedCVU: Federated Learning for Cross-View Video Understanding

author.name: Shenghan Zhang, Run Ling, Ke Cao, Ao Ma, Zhanjie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes FedCVU, a federated learning framework for cross-view video understanding with three components: VS-Norm for view-specific statistics, CV-Align for contrastive regularization, and communication-efficient mechanisms.

entry.title: PARHAF, a human-authored corpus of clinical reports for fictitious patients in French

author.name: Xavier Tannier, Salam Abbara, R\'emi Flicoteaux, Youness Khalil, Aur\'elie N\'ev\'eol, Pierre Zweigenbaum, Emmanuel Bacry

Mazurowski (Duke University Medical Center, Durham NC, Duke University School of Medicine, Durham NC), Evan Calabrese (Duke University Medical Center, Durham NC, Duke Center for Artificial Intelligence in Radiology, Durham NC)

entry.title: SwiftBot: A Decentralized Platform for LLM-Powered Federated Robotic Task Execution

entry.title: VisFly-Lab: Unified Differentiable Framework for First-Order Reinforcement Learning of Quadrotor Control

author.name: Fanxing Li, Fangyu Sun, Tianbao Zhang, Shuyu Wu, Dexin Zuo, yufei Yan, Wenxian Yu, Danping Zou

Uses a two-layer unsupervised method where the first layer detects outliers and the second predicts future outlier scores based on temporal structure.

entry.title: Architecture for Multi-Unmanned Aerial Vehicles based Autonomous Precision Agriculture Systems

author.name: Ebasa Temesgen, Nathnael Minyelshowa, Lebsework Negash

entry.summary: Defines an architectural framework for multi-UAV systems in precision agriculture, modeling tasks like image processing, path planning, and field mapping.

entry.title: BHDD: A Burmese Handwritten Digit Dataset

author.name: Swan Htet Aung, Hein Htet, Htoo Say Wah Khaing, Thuya Myo Nyunt

entry.summary: Introduces BHDD, a Burmese handwritten digit dataset with 87,561 images following MNIST format. Provides baselines reaching 99.8% accuracy and analyzes confusion patterns in Myanmar script.

entry.title: Some things I noticed while LARPing as a grantmaker

author.name: Zach Stein-Perlman

entry.summary: Practical advice for grantmakers in AI safety, arguing that most value comes from finding/creating projects far above the funding bar rather than discriminating between marginal proposals. Emphasizes proactive research identification over reactive evaluation.

entry.title: Representative Futarchy

author.name: goldfine

entry.summary: Proposes 'representative futarchy' as a governance model where elected representatives make policy decisions guided by prediction markets, combining representative democracy with futarchy's information aggregation benefits.

entry.title: Set the Line Before It's Crossed

author.name: nomagicpill

entry.summary: Discusses the importance of proactively setting behavioral lines/boundaries before they are crossed, with relevance to AI governance and policy. Covers soft, firm, and hard lines and how normalization of deviance erodes standards.

entry.title: AI-Driven Multi-Agent Simulation of Stratified Polyamory Systems: A Computational Framework for Optimizing Social Reproductive Efficiency

author.name: Yicai Xing

entry.summary: Proposes a computational framework for modeling a 'Stratified Polyamory System' (SPS) using AI multi-agent simulation, framed as addressing declining fertility rates.

entry.title: Fuel Consumption Prediction: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Paradigms

author.name: Ali Akram

entry.summary: Comparative analysis of ML methods (linear regression, SVM, logistic regression) for vehicle fuel consumption prediction using the Motor Trend dataset.

entry.title: Universal Coefficients and Mayer-Vietoris for Moore Homology of Ample Groupoids

author.name: Luciano Melodia

entry.summary: Establishes universal coefficient theorem and Mayer-Vietoris sequence for Moore homology of ample groupoids.

entry.title: Hollywood ACX Meetup - April 2026

author.name: Timothy M.

entry.summary: A meetup announcement for an ACX group in Hollywood, April 2026. No research content.

entry.title: Research Summary: March 23, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is headlined by a landmark empirical study and several results that challenge fundamental assumptions about transformer training and deployment.

  • OXRL benchmarks 51 post-training algorithms under controlled conditions, revealing that algorithm rankings invert across model scales — a critical finding for practitioners selecting RL methods
  • The Autonomy Tax exposes a capability-alignment paradox: defense training against prompt injection systematically destroys agent competence, posing hard tradeoffs for deployed LLM agents
  • Hyperagents from Clune, Faldor et al. extend self-improving AI via meta-agents that recursively optimize their own architecture and prompts
  • LeWorldModel achieves the first stable end-to-end JEPA trained from raw pixels using only two loss terms, advancing LeCun's self-supervised vision agenda

On the theory side, a proof that the KV cache is entirely redundant (recoverable from the residual stream) could reshape efficient inference design. A complementary result identifies missing Markov states as the structural bottleneck causing RL capability ceilings in LLMs. In mathematical physics, a new equivalence between the Franz-Parisi potential and low-degree MMSE bounds unifies two major computational hardness frameworks.

  • Claude Code autonomously performs substantial portions of a high-energy physics analysis pipeline, demonstrating real scientific agent capability
  • Speculating Experts prefetches MoE experts using current-layer representations, significantly accelerating sparse model inference
  • Goedel-Code-Prover advances automated code verification in Lean 4 via hierarchical proof decomposition

entry.title: Do Post-Training Algorithms Actually Differ? A Controlled Study Across Model Scales Uncovers Scale-Dependent Ranking Inversions

author.name: Xiaoyi Li

entry.summary: Presents OXRL, a unified framework implementing 51 post-training algorithms with identical infrastructure, enabling the first large-scale controlled comparison. Key finding: algorithm rankings are unstable across model scales, with complete ranking inversions between 1.5B and 7B parameters.

entry.title: The monotonicity of the Franz-Parisi potential is equivalent with Low-degree MMSE lower bounds

author.name: Konstantinos Tsirkas, Leda Wang and Ilias Zadik

entry.summary: Establishes a precise mathematical equivalence between the Franz-Parisi potential's monotonicity (statistical physics) and low-degree MMSE lower bounds (computational complexity), resolving a long-standing open problem connecting these two frameworks.

entry.title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels

author.name: Lucas Maes, Quentin Le Lidec, Damien Scieur, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero

entry.summary: Introduces LeWorldModel (LeWM), the first Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture that trains stably end-to-end from raw pixels using only two loss terms, without needing pre-trained encoders, EMA, or auxiliary supervision. Plans up to 48x faster than foundation-model-based world models with ~15M parameters trainable on a single GPU.

entry.title: The Autonomy Tax: Defense Training Breaks LLM Agents

author.name: Shawn Li, Yue Zhao

entry.summary: Reveals a capability-alignment paradox: defense training designed to protect LLM agents from prompt injection systematically destroys agent competence while failing to prevent sophisticated attacks. Evaluates across 97 agent tasks and 1,000 adversarial prompts.

entry.title: Hyperagents

author.name: Jenny Zhang, Bingchen Zhao, Wannan Yang, Jakob Foerster, Jeff Clune, Minqi Jiang, Sam Devlin, Tatiana Shavrina

entry.summary: Introduces 'hyperagents' - self-referential AI agents that integrate a task agent and a meta agent, extending the Darwin Gödel Machine concept beyond coding to general domains. The meta agent modifies the task agent's components, enabling open-ended self-improvement across diverse tasks.

entry.title: The Residual Stream Is All You Need: On the Redundancy of the KV Cache in Transformer Inference

author.name: Kaleem Ullah Qasim, Jiashu Zhang, Muhammad Kafeel Shaheen, Razan Alharith, Heying Zhang

entry.summary: Proves that the KV cache in transformer inference is entirely redundant: keys and values are deterministic projections of the residual stream, and recomputing them yields bit-identical results. Verified across six models showing the residual stream satisfies a Markov property.

entry.title: Breaking the Capability Ceiling of LLM Post-Training by Reintroducing Markov States

author.name: Yurun Yuan, Tengyang Xie

entry.summary: Identifies a fundamental structural bottleneck in LLM post-training RL: the absence of compact Markov states leading to a 'capability ceiling'. Proposes reintroducing explicit Markov states with theoretical guarantees showing significant sample complexity reduction.

entry.title: Goedel-Code-Prover: Hierarchical Proof Search for Open State-of-the-Art Code Verification

author.name: Zenan Li, Ziran Yang, Deyuan (Mike) He, Haoyu Zhao, Andrew Zhao, Shange Tang, Kaiyu Yang, Aarti Gupta, Zhendong Su, Chi Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical proof search framework for automated code verification in Lean 4 that decomposes complex verification goals into simpler subgoals before tactic-level proving. Trains Goedel-Code-Prover-8B achieving state-of-the-art results on code verification benchmarks.

entry.title: AI Agents Can Already Autonomously Perform Experimental High Energy Physics

author.name: Eric A. Moreno, Samuel Bright-Thonney, Andrzej Novak, Dolores Garcia, Philip Harris

entry.summary: Claude Code autonomously performs substantial portions of a high energy physics analysis pipeline including event selection, background estimation, uncertainty quantification, statistical inference, and paper drafting. Authors argue the HEP community is underestimating AI agent capabilities.

entry.title: Speculating Experts Accelerates Inference for Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Vivan Madan, Prajwal Singhania, Abhinav Bhatele, Tom Goldstein, Ashwinee Panda

entry.summary: Proposes an expert prefetching scheme for Mixture-of-Experts models that predicts future expert activations using current internal representations, enabling CPU-GPU memory transfers to overlap with computation. Demonstrates reliable prediction across multiple MoE architectures while maintaining task accuracy.

entry.title: Neural Uncertainty Principle: A Unified View of Adversarial Fragility and LLM Hallucination

author.name: Dong-Xiao Zhang, Hu Lou, Jun-Jie Zhang, Jun Zhu, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Proposes the Neural Uncertainty Principle (NUP), arguing that adversarial vulnerability in vision and LLM hallucination share a common geometric origin: input and loss gradient are conjugate observables with an irreducible uncertainty bound. Provides theoretical framework and practical probe.

entry.title: Beyond Single Tokens: Distilling Discrete Diffusion Models via Discrete MMD

author.name: Emiel Hoogeboom, David Ruhe, Jonathan Heek, Thomas Mensink, Tim Salimans

entry.summary: Introduces Discrete Moment Matching Distillation (D-MMD) for distilling discrete diffusion models, adapting continuous distillation ideas to the discrete domain. Distilled models maintain quality and diversity and can outperform teacher models.

entry.title: A Framework for Formalizing LLM Agent Security

author.name: Vincent Siu, Jingxuan He, Kyle Montgomery, Zhun Wang, Neil Gong, Chenguang Wang, Dawn Song

entry.summary: Presents a formal framework for LLM agent security that contextualizes attacks and defenses based on whose instruction, what objective, and whether the action serves that objective. Systematizes existing attacks/defenses to address the utility-security tradeoff.

entry.title: Pitfalls in Evaluating Interpretability Agents

author.name: Tal Haklay, Nikhil Prakash, Sana Pandey, Antonio Torralba, Aaron Mueller, Jacob Andreas, Tamar Rott Shaham, Yonatan Belinkov

entry.summary: Investigates pitfalls in evaluating automated interpretability agents for circuit analysis. Shows that three different classifiers produce significantly different faithfulness rates (69.7-82.6%) on identical data, with per-model gaps up to 30.6 percentage points.

entry.title: Measuring Faithfulness Depends on How You Measure: Classifier Sensitivity in LLM Chain-of-Thought Evaluation

author.name: Richard J. Young

entry.summary: Shows that measuring chain-of-thought faithfulness depends heavily on the classifier used: three classifiers produce rates of 74.4%, 82.6%, and 69.7% on the same data, with per-model gaps up to 30.6 percentage points, all statistically significant.

entry.title: ResNets of All Shapes and Sizes: Convergence of Training Dynamics in the Large-scale Limit

author.name: Louis-Pierre Chaintron and L\'ena\"ic Chizat and Javier Maass

entry.summary: Establishes convergence rates for ResNet training dynamics in the joint limit of infinite depth, width, and embedding dimension. Proves error bounds of O(1/L + sqrt(D/(LM)) + 1/sqrt(D)) and derives optimal parameter scaling for a given budget, yielding O(P^(-1/6)) convergence.

entry.title: Transformers are Stateless Differentiable Neural Computers

author.name: Bo Tang and Weiwei Xie

entry.summary: This paper formally proves that a causal Transformer layer is exactly equivalent to a stateless Differentiable Neural Computer (sDNC), mapping attention to content-based addressing and multi-head attention to parallel read heads. The equivalence extends to cross-attention in encoder-decoder Transformers. This provides a unifying theoretical lens connecting two major architecture families.

entry.title: Maximizing mutual information between user-contexts and responses improve LLM personalization with no additional data

author.name: Hyunji Nam, Haoran Li, Natasha Jaques

entry.summary: Proposes MIPO (Mutual Information Preference Optimization), a self-improvement method for LLM personalization that constructs preference pairs by generating responses conditioned on correct vs. random prompts. Maximizes mutual information between user contexts and responses using DPO without requiring external labels.

entry.title: Global Convergence of Multiplicative Updates for the Matrix Mechanism: A Collaborative Proof with Gemini 3

author.name: Keith Rush

entry.summary: Proves global convergence of a fixed-point iteration for the matrix mechanism in private ML, notably with the bulk of the proof provided by Gemini 3. Represents a commentary on practical AI-assisted mathematical research.

entry.title: Learning to Disprove: Formal Counterexample Generation with Large Language Models

author.name: Zenan Li, Zhaoyu Li, Kaiyu Yang, Xiaoxing Ma, Zhendong Su

entry.summary: Addresses LLM-based formal counterexample generation - training models to not only propose counterexamples but produce verifiable proofs in Lean 4. Introduces symbolic mutation for training data synthesis and demonstrates improved counterexample finding.

entry.title: Demonstrations, CoT, and Prompting: A Theoretical Analysis of ICL

author.name: Xuhan Tong, Yuchen Zeng, Jiawei Zhang

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of In-Context Learning under mild assumptions, deriving upper bounds on ICL test loss that connect demonstration selection quality, Chain-of-Thought reasoning, number of demonstrations, and prompt templates to generalization behavior.

entry.title: FIPO: Eliciting Deep Reasoning with Future-KL Influenced Policy Optimization

author.name: Chiyu Ma, Shuo Yang, Kexin Huang, Jinda Lu, Haoming Meng, Shangshang Wang, Bolin Ding, Soroush Vosoughi, Guoyin Wang, Jingren Zhou

entry.summary: Presents FIPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that uses discounted future-KL divergence for dense credit assignment in LLM training, addressing the coarse-grained token-level advantage problem in GRPO-style methods. Enables models to break through length stagnation.

entry.title: A Super Fast K-means for Indexing Vector Embeddings

author.name: Leonardo Kuffo, Sven Hepkema, Peter Boncz

entry.summary: Presents SuperKMeans, a k-means variant for clustering high-dimensional vector embeddings that achieves up to 7x speedup over FAISS/Scikit-Learn on CPUs and 4x over cuVS on GPUs. The key innovation is dimension pruning during centroid assignment and a novel early termination mechanism based on retrieval recall quality.

entry.title: How Out-of-Equilibrium Phase Transitions can Seed Pattern Formation in Trained Diffusion Models

author.name: Luca Ambrogioni

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework interpreting diffusion model generation as out-of-equilibrium phase transitions, where reverse diffusion passes through critical regimes that seed pattern formation. Shows how architectural constraints transform memorization instabilities into collective spatial modes.

entry.title: TTQ: Activation-Aware Test-Time Quantization to Accelerate LLM Inference On The Fly

author.name: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Jing Liu, Ye Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TTQ (Test-Time Quantization), a framework that compresses LLMs on-the-fly during inference using efficient online calibration, adapting quantization to each prompt to avoid domain shift issues with static calibration data.

entry.title: Any-Subgroup Equivariant Networks via Symmetry Breaking

author.name: Abhinav Goel, Derek Lim, Hannah Lawrence, Stefanie Jegelka, Ningyuan Huang

entry.summary: Presents Any-Subgroup Equivariant Networks (ASEN), a single model simultaneously equivariant to multiple symmetry groups by modulating an auxiliary input. Built on permutation-equivariant base with symmetry-breaking inputs for flexible multi-modal foundation models.

entry.title: Evaluating Evidence Grounding Under User Pressure in Instruction-Tuned Language Models

author.name: Sai Koneru, Elphin Joe, Christine Kirchhoff, Jian Wu, Sarah Rajtmajer

entry.summary: Evaluates how instruction-tuned LLMs balance user-alignment pressure against faithfulness to in-context evidence, using a controlled framework grounded in U.S. National Climate Assessment data. Tests 19 models (0.27B-32B) and identifies three failure modes under user pressure.

entry.title: PhysMaster: Building an Autonomous AI Physicist for Theoretical and Computational Physics Research

author.name: Tingjia Miao (1 and 2 and 5), Jiawen Dai (2), Jingkun Liu (2), Jinxin Tan (2 and 3 and 4), Muhua Zhang (2 and 3 and 4), Wenkai Jin (1), Yuwen Du (1), Tian Jin (1), Xianghe Pang (1), Zexi Liu (1), Tu Guo (2 and 4), Zhengliang Zhang (2 and 4 and 5), Yunjie Huang (1), Shuo Chen (6), Rui Ye (1), Yuzhi Zhang (7), Linfeng Zhang (7), Kun Chen (6), Wei Wang (2 and 3 and 4), Weinan E (1), Siheng Chen (1) ((1) School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (2) School of Physics and Astronomy, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (3) State Key Laboratory of Dark Matter Physics, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (4) Tsung-Dao Lee Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (5) Zhiyuan College, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (6) Institute of Theoretical Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, (7) DP Technology)

entry.summary: Proposes PhysMaster, an LLM-based autonomous agent for theoretical and computational physics research that couples abstract reasoning with numerical computation using the LANDAU knowledge system.

entry.title: LSR: Linguistic Safety Robustness Benchmark for Low-Resource West African Languages

author.name: Godwin Abuh Faruna

entry.summary: Introduces LSR, the first benchmark measuring how LLM safety refusal mechanisms degrade when harmful prompts are expressed in low-resource West African languages (Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Igala). Proposes Refusal Centroid Drift (RCD) as a metric and evaluates Gemini 2.5 Flash across culturally grounded attack probes. Finds significant safety gaps for non-English languages.

entry.title: MemReward: Graph-Based Experience Memory for LLM Reward Prediction with Limited Labels

author.name: Tianyang Luo, Tao Feng, Zhigang Hua, Yan Xie, Shuang Yang, Ge Liu, Jiaxuan You

entry.summary: Introduces MemReward, a graph-based experience memory framework for predicting reward labels in LLM reinforcement learning when labels are scarce. Stores rollouts as graph-structured experience memory and propagates known rewards through semantic similarity to label unlabeled rollouts.

entry.title: Target Concept Tuning Improves Extreme Weather Forecasting

author.name: Shijie Ren, Xinyue Gu, Ziheng Peng, Haifan Zhang, Peisong Niu, Bo Wu, Xiting Wang, Liang Sun, Jirong Wen

entry.summary: Proposes TaCT, an interpretable concept-gated fine-tuning framework for weather forecasting that uses Sparse Autoencoders and counterfactual analysis to discover failure-related internal concepts, selectively adapting models for extreme events like typhoons while preserving general performance.

entry.title: VAMPO: Policy Optimization for Improving Visual Dynamics in Video Action Models

author.name: Zirui Ge, Pengxiang Ding, Baohua Yin, Qishen Wang, Zhiyong Xie, Yemin Wang, Jinbo Wang, Hengtao Li, Runze Suo, Wenxuan Song, Han Zhao, Shangke Lyu, Zhaoxin Fan, Haoang Li, Ran Cheng, Cheng Chi, Huibin Ge, Yaozhi Luo, Donglin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VAMPO, a post-training framework for video action models that uses policy optimization to directly improve visual dynamics precision for robot manipulation, formulating multi-step denoising as sequential decision-making.

entry.title: Is Evaluation Awareness Just Format Sensitivity? Limitations of Probe-Based Evidence under Controlled Prompt Structure

author.name: Viliana Devbunova

entry.summary: Tests whether linear probe evidence of 'evaluation awareness' in LLMs actually reflects benchmark-canonical structure rather than genuine context understanding. Finds probes primarily track surface formatting and fail to generalize to free-form prompts.

entry.title: Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation: Unifying Off-Policy Corrections for LLM RL

author.name: Chenlu Ye, Xuanchang Zhang, Yifan Hao, Zhou Yu, Ziji Zhang, Abhinav Gullapalli, Hao Chen, Jing Huang, Tong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation (ALP) to address off-policy problems in LLM reinforcement learning, injecting learnable perturbations into hidden states during updates to smooth importance ratios. Demonstrates improved training stability for LLM RL.

entry.title: Physion-Eval: Evaluating Physical Realism in Generated Video via Human Reasoning

author.name: Qin Zhang, Peiyu Jing, Hong-Xing Yu, Fangqiang Ding, Fan Nie, Weimin Wang, Yilun Du, James Zou, Jiajun Wu, Bing Shuai

entry.summary: Physion-Eval is a large-scale benchmark with 10,990 expert reasoning traces for diagnosing physical realism failures in generated videos across 5 SOTA models, covering 22 fine-grained physical categories in egocentric and exocentric views.

entry.title: ContractionPPO: Certified Reinforcement Learning via Differentiable Contraction Layers

author.name: Vrushabh Zinage, Narek Harutyunyan, Eric Verheyden, Fred Y. Hadaegh, Soon-Jo Chung

entry.summary: ContractionPPO augments PPO reinforcement learning with a state-dependent contraction metric layer to provide certified robustness guarantees for legged locomotion policies, combining RL's performance benefits with formal stability guarantees.

entry.title: RiboSphere: Learning Unified and Efficient Representations of RNA Structures

author.name: Zhou Zhang, Hanqun Cao, Cheng Tan, Fang Wu, Pheng Ann Heng, Tianfan Fu
