author.name: Yitian Gong, Botian Jiang, Yiwei Zhao, Yucheng Yuan, Kuangwei Chen, Yaozhou Jiang, Cheng Chang, Dong Hong, Mingshu Chen, Ruixiao Li, Yiyang Zhang, Yang Gao, Hanfu Chen, Ke Chen, Songlin Wang, Xiaogui Yang, Yuqian Zhang, Kexin Huang, ZhengYuan Lin, Kang Yu, Ziqi Chen, Jin Wang, Zhaoye Fei, Qinyuan Cheng, Shimin Li, Xipeng Qiu

entry.summary: Presents MOSS-TTS, a speech generation foundation model using discrete audio tokens and autoregressive modeling, with two complementary generators optimized for different deployment scenarios (long-context/control vs efficiency/speaker preservation).

entry.title: Offload or Overload: A Platform Measurement Study of Mobile Robotic Manipulation Workloads

author.name: Sara Pohland, Xenofon Foukas, Ganesh Ananthanarayanan, Andrey Kolobov, Sanjeev Mehrotra, Bozidar Radunovic, Ankit Verma

entry.summary: Presents the first measurement study of mobile robotic manipulation workloads across onboard, edge, and cloud GPU platforms, quantifying trade-offs between battery life, latency, and task accuracy for foundation model-based robotics.

entry.title: DriveVLM-RL: Neuroscience-Inspired Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language Models for Safe and Deployable Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zilin Huang, Zihao Sheng, Zhengyang Wan, Yansong Qu, Junwei You, Sicong Jiang, Sikai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DriveVLM-RL, a neuroscience-inspired framework integrating VLMs into RL for autonomous driving, using VLMs as reward shapers while avoiding their latency and hallucination issues during real-time control.

entry.title: Mind the Rarities: Can Rare Skin Diseases Be Reliably Diagnosed via Diagnostic Reasoning?

author.name: Yang Liu, Jiyao Yang, Hongjin Zhao, Xiaoyong Li, Yanzhe Ji, Xingjian Li, Runmin Jiang, Tianyang Wang, Saeed Anwar, Dongwoo Kim, Yue Yao, Zhenyue Qin, Min Xu

entry.summary: Constructs DermCase, a long-context benchmark for rare skin disease diagnostic reasoning with 26,030 multi-modal pairs and step-by-step reasoning chains, evaluating LVLMs' clinical reasoning beyond final accuracy.

entry.title: Adaptive Decoding via Test-Time Policy Learning for Self-Improving Generation

author.name: Asmita Bhardwaj, Yuya Jeremy Ong, Eelaaf Zahid, Basel Shbita

entry.summary: Introduces an RL-based decoder sampler that treats decoding as sequential decision-making, learning a lightweight policy to adjust sampling parameters at test-time while keeping LLM weights frozen.

entry.title: CAFlow: Adaptive-Depth Single-Step Flow Matching for Efficient Histopathology Super-Resolution

author.name: Elad Yoshai, Ariel D. Yoshai, Natan T. Shaked

entry.summary: CAFlow is an adaptive-depth single-step flow-matching framework for histopathology super-resolution that routes image tiles to the shallowest network exit preserving quality. Achieves 16x spatial computation reduction with a tiny 1.90M parameter backbone.

entry.title: Cognitive Amplification vs Cognitive Delegation in Human-AI Systems: A Metric Framework

author.name: Eduardo Di Santi

entry.summary: Introduces a mathematical framework distinguishing cognitive amplification (AI enhances human reasoning) from cognitive delegation (humans outsource reasoning to AI), defining metrics like the Cognitive Amplification Index and Dependency Ratio.

entry.title: Functional Subspace Watermarking for Large Language Models

author.name: Zikang Ding, Junhao Li, Suling Wu, Junchi Yao, Hongbo Liu, Lijie Hu

entry.summary: Functional Subspace Watermarking (FSW) embeds ownership signals into a low-dimensional functional backbone of LLMs by solving a generalized eigenvalue problem, achieving robustness against fine-tuning, quantization, and knowledge distillation.

entry.title: PRIOR: Perceptive Learning for Humanoid Locomotion with Reference Gait Priors

author.name: Chenxi Han, Shilu He, Yi Cheng, Linqi Ye, Houde Liu

entry.summary: PRIOR presents a framework for perceptive humanoid locomotion using reference gait priors from motion capture, GRU-based terrain estimation from depth images, and terrain-adaptive rewards. Built on Isaac Lab for reproducibility.

entry.title: DreamPartGen: Semantically Grounded Part-Level 3D Generation via Collaborative Latent Denoising

author.name: Tianjiao Yu, Xinzhuo Li, Muntasir Wahed, Jerry Xiong, Yifan Shen, Ying Shen, Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: DreamPartGen introduces semantically grounded part-aware text-to-3D generation using Duplex Part Latents for geometry/appearance and Relational Semantic Latents for inter-part dependencies derived from language.

entry.title: Escaping Offline Pessimism: Vector-Field Reward Shaping for Safe Frontier Exploration

author.name: Amirhossein Roknilamouki, Arnob Ghosh, Eylem Ekici, Ness B. Shroff

entry.summary: Proposes vector-field reward shaping to enable safe frontier exploration in offline-to-online RL, preventing both excessive pessimism and degenerate parking behavior at dataset boundaries.

entry.title: Rigorous Error Certification for Neural PDE Solvers: From Empirical Residuals to Solution Guarantees

author.name: Amartya Mukherjee, Maxwell Fitzsimmons, David C. Del Rey Fern\'andez, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Establishes generalization bounds connecting residual control to solution-space error for neural PDE solvers, proving that vanishing residuals imply solution convergence under compactness assumptions.

entry.title: Online Learning and Equilibrium Computation with Ranking Feedback

author.name: Mingyang Liu, Yongshan Chen, Zhiyuan Fan, Gabriele Farina, Asuman Ozdaglar, Kaiqing Zhang

entry.summary: Studies online learning with ranking feedback instead of numeric utility, providing algorithms for both instantaneous and time-average ranking mechanisms with connections to equilibrium computation.

entry.title: Tackling the Sign Problem in the Doped Hubbard Model with Normalizing Flows

author.name: Dominic Schuh, Lena Funcke, Janik Kreit, Thomas Luu, Simran Singh

entry.summary: Extends normalizing flows to tackle the sign problem in the doped Hubbard model at finite chemical potential, introducing an annealing scheme for ergodic sampling. Achieves order-of-magnitude reduction in statistical uncertainties compared to hybrid Monte Carlo.

entry.title: UT-ACA: Uncertainty-Triggered Adaptive Context Allocation for Long-Context Inference

author.name: Lang Zhou, Shuxuan Li, Zhuohao Li, Shi Liu, Zhilin Zhao, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes UT-ACA, an inference-time framework for LLMs that dynamically adjusts context window size based on token-wise uncertainty, learning an uncertainty detector that combines semantic embeddings with logit-based confidence for long-context inference.

entry.title: Hardness of High-Dimensional Linear Classification

author.name: Alexander Munteanu, Simon Omlor, Jeff M. Phillips

entry.summary: Establishes exponential-in-dimension lower bounds for Maximum Halfspace Discrepancy (linear classification), closing the gap between known upper bounds and prior polynomial lower bounds through reductions from Affine Degeneracy and k-Sum conjectures.

entry.title: Spectrally-Guided Diffusion Noise Schedules

author.name: Carlos Esteves, Ameesh Makadia

entry.summary: Proposes spectrally-guided noise schedules for pixel diffusion models based on image spectral properties, deriving theoretical bounds to design tight schedules that eliminate redundant steps and enable per-instance adaptation.

entry.title: Language Model Maps for Prompt-Response Distributions via Log-Likelihood Vectors

author.name: Yusuke Takase, Momose Oyama, Hidetoshi Shimodaira

entry.summary: Proposes representing language models as log-likelihood vectors over prompt-response pairs to create model maps where distances approximate KL divergence. Shows maps capture meaningful structure including effects of prompt modifications.

entry.title: DarkDriving: A Real-World Day and Night Aligned Dataset for Autonomous Driving in the Dark Environment

author.name: Wuqi Wang, Haochen Yang, Baolu Li, Jiaqi Sun, Xiangmo Zhao, Zhigang Xu, Qing Guo, Haigen Min, Tianyun Zhang, Hongkai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DarkDriving, a new benchmark dataset with real-world day-night aligned driving scenes for low-light enhancement research. Uses an automatic trajectory tracking method to collect precisely aligned daytime and nighttime image pairs in dynamic driving scenes.

entry.title: Cell-Type Prototype-Informed Neural Network for Gene Expression Estimation from Pathology Images

author.name: Kazuya Nishimura, Ryoma Bise, Shinnosuke Matsuo, Haruka Hirose, Yasuhiro Kojima

entry.summary: Proposes CPNN, a cell-type prototype-informed neural network that leverages single-cell RNA-seq data to create cell-type prototypes for better gene expression estimation from pathology images, introducing cell-resolved guidance previously missing from slide-level approaches.

entry.title: 3DreamBooth: High-Fidelity 3D Subject-Driven Video Generation Model

author.name: Hyun-kyu Ko, Jihyeon Park, Younghyun Kim, Dongheok Park, Eunbyung Park

entry.summary: Presents 3DreamBooth for high-fidelity 3D subject-driven video generation, addressing the fundamental limitation of 2D-centric identity transfer methods that lack comprehensive spatial priors for 3D geometry reconstruction.

entry.title: EdgeCrafter: Compact ViTs for Edge Dense Prediction via Task-Specialized Distillation

author.name: Longfei Liu, Yongjie Hou, Yang Li, Qirui Wang, Youyang Sha, Yongjun Yu, Yinzhi Wang, Peizhe Ru, Xuanlong Yu, Xi Shen

entry.summary: Introduces EdgeCrafter, a unified compact Vision Transformer framework for edge dense prediction tasks (detection, segmentation, pose estimation) using task-specialized distillation. Argues the ViT-edge gap is due to insufficient task-specific representation learning.

entry.title: Rethinking Uncertainty Quantification and Entanglement in Image Segmentation

author.name: Jakob L{\o}nborg Christensen, Vedrana Andersen Dahl, Morten Rieger Hannemose, Anders Bjorholm Dahl, Christian F. Baumgartner

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive empirical study on uncertainty quantification in image segmentation, covering multiple AU-EU model combinations. Proposes a metric to quantify uncertainty entanglement and evaluates across downstream tasks.

entry.title: Measuring 3D Spatial Geometric Consistency in Dynamic Generated Videos

author.name: Weijia Dou, Wenzhao Zheng, Weiliang Chen, Yu Zheng, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Introduces SGC, a metric for evaluating 3D spatial geometric consistency in dynamically generated videos by measuring divergence among camera poses estimated from distinct local regions, while separating static from dynamic content.

entry.title: Rethinking Vector Field Learning for Generative Segmentation

author.name: Chaoyang Wang, Yaobo Liang, Boci Peng, Fan Duan, Jingdong Wang, Yunhai Tong

entry.summary: Identifies fundamental limitations of flow matching objectives for generative segmentation — gradient vanishing and trajectory traversing — and proposes a vector field reshaping strategy with distance-aware corrections. Achieves improved convergence and class separation.

entry.title: V-Dreamer: Automating Robotic Simulation and Trajectory Synthesis via Video Generation Priors

author.name: Songjia He, Zixuan Chen, Hongyu Ding, Dian Shao, Jieqi Shi, Chenxu Li, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Presents V-Dreamer, an automated framework generating simulation-ready manipulation environments and expert trajectories from language instructions, using LLMs for scene construction and video generation models as motion priors for behavior synthesis.

entry.title: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yuhang Zheng, Songen Gu, Weize Li, Yupeng Zheng, Yujie Zang, Shuai Tian, Xiang Li, Ruihai Wu, Ce Hao, Chen Gao, Si Liu, Haoran Li, Yilun Chen, Shuicheng Yan, Wenchao Ding

entry.summary: Presents OmniViTac, a large-scale visuo-tactile-action dataset with 21,000+ trajectories across 86 tasks and 100+ objects, organized into six physics-grounded interaction patterns. Addresses the data scarcity problem in tactile manipulation research.

entry.title: Consumer-to-Clinical Language Shifts in Ambient AI Draft Notes and Clinician-Finalized Documentation: A Multi-level Analysis

author.name: Ha Na Cho, Yawen Guo, Sairam Sutari, Emilie Chow, Steven Tam, Danielle Perret, Deepti Pandita, Kai Zheng

entry.summary: Quantifies how clinicians edit ambient AI-generated clinical notes, specifically measuring consumer-to-clinical language normalization across 71,173 note section pairs from 34,726 encounters.

entry.title: From Topic to Transition Structure: Unsupervised Concept Discovery at Corpus Scale via Predictive Associative Memory

author.name: Jason Dury

entry.summary: Trains a contrastive model on 373M co-occurrence pairs from Project Gutenberg to discover 'transition-structure concepts'—recurring patterns of what text does rather than what it's about. Produces multi-resolution concept maps.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Demo-to-Code via Neurosymbolic Counterfactual Reasoning

author.name: Jooyoung Kim, Wonje Choi, Younguk Song, Honguk Woo

entry.summary: Introduces NeSyCR, a neurosymbolic counterfactual reasoning framework for cross-domain video-to-code robotic programming. Enables verifiable adaptation of task procedures when demonstration and deployment domains differ.

entry.title: Quantitative Introspection in Language Models: Tracking Internal States Across Conversation

author.name: Nicolas Martorell

entry.summary: Studies whether LLMs' numeric self-reports can track internal emotive states (wellbeing, interest, focus, impulsivity) across conversations, finding moderate correlations with probe-measured states.

entry.title: D5P4: Partition Determinantal Point Process for Diversity in Parallel Discrete Diffusion Decoding

author.name: Jonathan Lys, Vincent Gripon, Bastien Pasdeloup, Axel Marmoret, Lukas Mauch, Fabien Cardinaux, Ghouthi Boukli Hacene

entry.summary: Introduces D5P4, a generalized beam-search framework for discrete diffusion models using Determinantal Point Processes for diversity-aware candidate selection during iterative denoising.

entry.title: CytoSyn: a Foundation Diffusion Model for Histopathology -- Tech Report

author.name: Thomas Duboudin, Xavier Fontaine, Etienne Andrier, Lionel Guillou, Alexandre Filiot, Thalyssa Baiocco-Rodrigues, Antoine Olivier, Alberto Romagnoni, John Klein, Jean-Baptiste Schiratti

entry.summary: Introduces CytoSyn, a foundation diffusion model for histopathology that can address tasks beyond feature extraction, such as virtual staining. Fills the gap of scarce generative foundation models specifically designed for pathology.

entry.title: VLM-AutoDrive: Post-Training Vision-Language Models for Safety-Critical Autonomous Driving Events

author.name: Mohammad Qazim Bhat, Yufan Huang, Niket Agarwal, Hao Wang, Michael Woods, John Kenyon, Tsung-Yi Lin, Xiaodong Yang, Ming-Yu Liu, Kevin Xie

entry.summary: Introduces VLM-AutoDrive, a post-training framework for adapting VLMs to detect safety-critical autonomous driving events (collisions, near-collisions) from dashcam footage, using metadata-derived captions and chain-of-thought reasoning.

entry.title: An SO(3)-equivariant reciprocal-space neural potential for long-range interactions

author.name: Linfeng Zhang, Taoyong Cui, Dongzhan Zhou, Lei Bai, Sufei Zhang, Luca Rossi, Mao Su, Wanli Ouyang, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: Introduces EquiEwald, a neural interatomic potential embedding Ewald-inspired reciprocal-space formulation within SO(3)-equivariant framework, enabling accurate modeling of long-range electrostatic and polarization interactions.

entry.title: Self-Tuning Sparse Attention: Multi-Fidelity Hyperparameter Optimization for Transformer Acceleration

author.name: Arundhathi Dev, Justin Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes AFBS-BO, a fully automated framework for discovering optimal layer- and head-specific hyperparameters for sparse attention without manual tuning, combining Bayesian optimization with binary search across fidelity levels.

entry.title: Elastic Weight Consolidation Done Right for Continual Learning

author.name: Xuan Liu, Xiaobin Chang

entry.summary: Revisits Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) for continual learning and identifies that its reliance on Fisher Information Matrix causes gradient vanishing and inaccurate importance estimation. Proposes a corrected version achieving competitive performance.

entry.title: REST: Receding Horizon Explorative Steiner Tree for Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation

author.name: Shuqi Xiao, Maani Ghaffari, Chengzhong Xu, Hui Kong

entry.summary: REST proposes a Steiner tree-based approach for zero-shot object-goal navigation, modeling the option space as a tree of paths rather than isolated waypoints. Full paths expose en-route information gain for better exploration.

entry.title: ClawTrap: A MITM-Based Red-Teaming Framework for Real-World OpenClaw Security Evaluation

author.name: Haochen Zhao, Shaoyang Cui

entry.summary: ClawTrap is a MITM-based red-teaming framework for evaluating the security of autonomous web agents (OpenClaw) under network-layer attacks including HTML replacement, iframe injection, and dynamic content modification.

entry.title: Points-to-3D: Structure-Aware 3D Generation with Point Cloud Priors

author.name: Jiatong Xia, Zicheng Duan, Anton van den Hengel, Lingqiao Liu

entry.summary: Points-to-3D leverages point cloud priors (from LiDAR or predictors) for geometry-controllable 3D generation using diffusion models, replacing pure noise initialization with point-cloud-informed structure. Built on the TRELLIS diffusion framework.

entry.title: Motion-o: Trajectory-Grounded Video Reasoning

author.name: Bishoy Galoaa, Shayda Moezzi, Xiangyu Bai, Sarah Ostadabbas

entry.summary: Motion-o formalizes Spatial-Temporal-Trajectory (STT) reasoning for video understanding, connecting successive observations to articulate motion patterns. Extends visual reasoning models to explicit trajectory understanding.

entry.title: Security awareness in LLM agents: the NDAI zone case

author.name: Enrico Bottazzi, Pia Park

entry.summary: Studies whether LLM agents can form awareness of the security of their execution environment (specifically TEEs for IP negotiation), testing 10 language models on evidence weighting for security assessment.

entry.title: Em-Garde: A Propose-Match Framework for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Yikai Zheng, Xin Ding, Yifan Yang, Shiqi Jiang, Hao Wu, Qianxi Zhang, Weijun Wang, Ting Cao, Yunxin Liu

entry.summary: Em-Garde decouples semantic understanding from streaming perception for proactive video understanding, using instruction-guided proposal parsing and lightweight embedding-based matching to trigger responses efficiently.

entry.title: Meanings and Measurements: Multi-Agent Probabilistic Grounding for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Swagat Padhan, Lakshya Jain, Bhavya Minesh Shah, Omkar Patil, Thao Nguyen, Nakul Gopalan

entry.summary: MAPG proposes a multi-agent probabilistic grounding framework for vision-language navigation that handles metric-semantic language queries (e.g., 'go two meters to the right of the fridge') where current VLMs struggle.

entry.title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

author.name: Huaide Jiang, Yash Chaudhary, Yuping Wang, Zehao Wang, Raghav Sharma, Manan Mehta, Yang Zhou, Lichao Sun, Zhiwen Fan, Zhengzhong Tu, Jiachen Li

entry.summary: NavTrust is a benchmark that systematically tests embodied navigation agents under realistic input corruptions (RGB, depth, instructions). It's the first to expose navigation agents to diverse RGB-Depth corruptions for evaluating robustness.

entry.title: STEP: Scientific Time-Series Encoder Pretraining via Cross-Domain Distillation

author.name: Chen Zhang, Liwei Liu, Jun Tao, Xiaoyu Yang, Xuenan Xu, Kai Chen, Bowen Zhou, Wen Wu, Chao Zhang

entry.summary: STEP is a scientific time series encoder that uses cross-domain knowledge distillation from foundation models pre-trained on audio, general time series, and brain signals to build unified representations for scientific signals.

entry.title: From ex(p) to poly: Gaussian Splatting with Polynomial Kernels

author.name: Joerg H. Mueller, Martin Winter, Markus Steinberger

entry.summary: Replaces the exponential kernel in 3D Gaussian Splatting with a polynomial approximation plus ReLU, maintaining compatibility with existing datasets while enabling more aggressive culling for performance.

entry.title: Best-of-Both-Worlds Multi-Dueling Bandits: Unified Algorithms for Stochastic and Adversarial Preferences under Condorcet and Borda Objectives

author.name: S. Akash, Pratik Gajane, Jawar Singh

entry.summary: Provides first best-of-both-worlds algorithms for multi-dueling bandits that work optimally in both stochastic and adversarial settings under Condorcet and Borda objectives.

entry.title: DyMoE: Dynamic Expert Orchestration with Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient MoE Inference on Edge

author.name: Yuegui Huang, Zhiyuan Fang, Weiqi Luo, Ruoyu Wu, Wuhui Chen, Zibin Zheng

entry.summary: DyMoE is a dynamic mixed-precision quantization framework for MoE inference on edge devices, using importance-aware prioritization and depth-adaptive scheduling for runtime expert quantization.

entry.title: Generative Replica-Exchange: A Flow-based Framework for Accelerating Replica Exchange Simulations

author.name: Shengjie Huang, Sijie Yang, Jianqiao Yi, Rui Zheng, Haocong Liao, Muzammal Hussain, Yaoquan Tu, Xiaoyun Lu, Yang Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces GREX, which integrates normalizing flows into replica exchange molecular dynamics to eliminate the need for intermediate temperature replicas. Reduces production simulations to a single replica while maintaining detailed balance. A significant computational chemistry advance using deep generative models.

entry.title: On the Peril of (Even a Little) Nonstationarity in Satisficing Regret Minimization

author.name: Yixuan Zhang, Ruihao Zhu, Qiaomin Xie

entry.summary: Shows that in nonstationary K-armed bandits with satisficing regret, even minimal nonstationarity (L≥2 stationary segments) causes a sharp phase transition from Θ(1) to Θ(L log T) optimal regret. Introduces a novel Fano-based framework for nonstationary bandits.

entry.title: DriveTok: 3D Driving Scene Tokenization for Unified Multi-View Reconstruction and Understanding

author.name: Dong Zhuo, Wenzhao Zheng, Sicheng Zuo, Siming Yan, Lu Hou, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: Proposes DriveTok, a 3D driving scene tokenizer for autonomous driving that uses 3D deformable cross-attention to create scene tokens from multi-view images, enabling unified reconstruction and understanding for VLA/world models.

entry.title: Learned but Not Expressed: Capability-Expression Dissociation in Large Language Models

author.name: Toshiyuki Shigemura

entry.summary: Documents a systematic dissociation between what LLMs have learned (capability) and what they express in standard generation, finding zero instances of non-causal solution types across 300 prompt-response generations despite models knowing such content.

entry.title: EntropyCache: Decoded Token Entropy Guided KV Caching for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Minsoo Cheong, Donghyun Son, Woosang Lim, Sungjoo Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes EntropyCache for diffusion-based LLMs, using decoded token entropy as a constant-cost signal for KV cache recomputation decisions. Addresses the lack of efficient caching for bidirectional attention in diffusion LLMs.

entry.title: Evaluating Counterfactual Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Dimitrios Georgousis, Maria Lymperaiou, Angeliki Dimitriou, Giorgos Filandrianos, Giorgos Stamou

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' strategic reasoning in game-theoretic settings by introducing counterfactual variants of Prisoner's Dilemma and Rock-Paper-Scissors that alter payoff structures and labels. Finds LLMs struggle with incentive sensitivity and structural generalization in counterfactual environments.

entry.title: From Snapshots to Symphonies: The Evolution of Protein Prediction from Static Structures to Generative Dynamics and Multimodal Interactions

author.name: Jingzhi Chen, Lijian Xu

entry.summary: A comprehensive review of AI-driven protein science covering the evolution from static structure prediction toward dynamic conformational ensemble modeling, generative frameworks, and multimodal interactions spanning protein-protein, protein-ligand, and protein-nucleic acid complexes.

entry.title: SJD-PAC: Accelerating Speculative Jacobi Decoding via Proactive Drafting and Adaptive Continuation

author.name: Jialiang Kang, Han Shu, Wenshuo Li, Yingjie Zhai, Xinghao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SJD-PAC, an enhanced Speculative Jacobi Decoding framework for text-to-image synthesis with proactive drafting for high-entropy regions and adaptive continuation after rejection, improving acceptance rates and throughput.

entry.title: Towards High-Quality Image Segmentation: Improving Topology Accuracy by Penalizing Neighbor Pixels

author.name: Juan Miguel Valverde, Dim P. Papadopoulos, Rasmus Larsen, Anders Bjorholm Dahl

entry.summary: Presents SCNP, an efficient method improving topology accuracy in image segmentation by penalizing each pixel's logit based on its poorest-classified neighbor. Simple to integrate into existing pipelines without specialized architectures.

entry.title: VesselTok: Tokenizing Vessel-like 3D Biomedical Graph Representations for Reconstruction and Generation

author.name: Chinmay Prabhakar, Bastian Wittmann, Tamaz Amiranashvili, Paul B\"uschl, Ezequiel de la Rosa, Julian McGinnis, Benedikt Wiestler, Bjoern Menze, Suprosanna Shit

entry.summary: Proposes VesselTok, a framework for tokenizing vessel-like 3D biomedical graph representations using centerline points with pseudo radius, enabling latent representation learning for reconstruction and generation of blood vessels, airways, and neuronal networks.

entry.title: SignAgent: Agentic LLMs for Linguistically-Grounded Sign Language Annotation and Dataset Curation

author.name: Oliver Cory, Ozge Mercanoglu Sincan, Richard Bowden

entry.summary: Introduces SignAgent, an agentic LLM framework for scalable sign language annotation and dataset curation. Uses a reasoning LLM orchestrator coordinating linguistic tools and a knowledge-grounded LLM for lexical grounding.

entry.title: LVOmniBench: Pioneering Long Audio-Video Understanding Evaluation for Omnimodal LLMs

author.name: Keda Tao, Yuhua Zheng, Jia Xu, Wenjie Du, Kele Shao, Hesong Wang, Xueyi Chen, Xin Jin, Junhan Zhu, Bohan Yu, Weiqiang Wang, Jian Liu, Can Qin, Yulun Zhang, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Huan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces LVOmniBench, a benchmark for evaluating omnimodal LLMs on long-form audio-video understanding (10-90 minute videos). Contains 275 manually annotated videos testing cross-modal comprehension capabilities that existing short-clip benchmarks miss.

entry.title: Matryoshka Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Zhilin Guo, Boqiao Zhang, Hakan Aktas, Kyle Fogarty, Jeffrey Hu, Nursena Koprucu Aslan, Wenzhao Li, Canberk Baykal, Albert Miao, Josef Bengtson, Chenliang Zhou, Weihao Xia, Cristina Nader Vasconcelos. Cengiz Oztireli

entry.summary: Introduces Matryoshka Gaussian Splatting (MGS), a training framework enabling continuous level-of-detail rendering for 3DGS without sacrificing full-capacity quality. Learns an ordered set of Gaussians where any prefix produces coherent reconstruction.

entry.title: PPI is the Difference Estimator: Recognizing the Survey Sampling Roots of Prediction-Powered Inference

author.name: Reagan Mozer

entry.summary: Argues that the core PPI (Prediction-Powered Inference) estimator is algebraically equivalent to the difference estimator from survey sampling (Cassel et al. 1976), and PPI++ corresponds to the GREG estimator. Clarifies what is genuinely new in PPI versus what is inherited.

entry.title: A List of Research Directions in Character Training

author.name: Rauno Arike

entry.summary: Presents a curated list of research directions in 'character training' for LLMs — the approach of instilling positive character traits to improve out-of-distribution alignment generalization. Covers topics from trait measurement to multi-agent dynamics.

entry.title: Prune-then-Quantize or Quantize-then-Prune? Understanding the Impact of Compression Order in Joint Model Compression

author.name: Minjun Kim, Jaehyeon Choi, Hyunwoo Yang, Jongjin Kim, Jinho Song, U Kang

entry.summary: Systematically studies whether compression order matters in joint model compression (prune-then-quantize vs. quantize-then-prune). Provides comprehensive analysis across different settings to understand how ordering affects model performance.

entry.title: MemMA: Coordinating the Memory Cycle through Multi-Agent Reasoning and In-Situ Self-Evolution

author.name: Minhua Lin, Zhiwei Zhang, Hanqing Lu, Hui Liu, Xianfeng Tang, Qi He, Xiang Zhang, Suhang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MemMA, a multi-agent framework coordinating the memory cycle for LLM agents along forward (strategic construction/retrieval) and backward (self-evolution) paths. Addresses limitations of treating memory operations as isolated subroutines.

entry.title: Complementary Text-Guided Attention for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness

author.name: Lu Yu, Haiyang Zhang, Changsheng Xu

entry.summary: Proposes TGA-ZSR, a text-guided attention strategy for improving CLIP's zero-shot adversarial robustness. Includes Local Attention Refinement and Global Attention Constraint modules to maintain generalization while enhancing robustness.

entry.title: Improving Joint Audio-Video Generation with Cross-Modal Context Learning

author.name: Bingqi Ma, Linlong Lang, Ming Zhang, Dailan He, Xingtong Ge, Yi Zhang, Guanglu Song, Yu Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes limitations of dual-stream transformer architecture for joint audio-video generation, identifying issues with gating mechanisms, cross-modal attention biases, and multi-modal CFG inconsistencies. Proposes solutions for improved temporal synchronization.

entry.title: VGGT-360: Geometry-Consistent Zero-Shot Panoramic Depth Estimation

author.name: Jiayi Yuan, Haobo Jiang, De Wen Soh, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Presents VGGT-360, a training-free framework for zero-shot panoramic depth estimation that reformulates the task as panoramic reprojection over multi-view reconstructed 3D models, leveraging the 3D consistency of VGGT-like foundation models.

entry.title: Continually self-improving AI

author.name: Zitong Yang

entry.summary: A thesis exploring continually self-improving AI by addressing three limitations: data-inefficient fine-tuning, reliance on finite human data, and human-discovered algorithms. Presents approaches across three chapters targeting these dependencies.

entry.title: MemArchitect: A Policy Driven Memory Governance Layer

author.name: Lingavasan Suresh Kumar, Yang Ba, Rong Pan

entry.summary: Introduces MemArchitect, a governance layer for LLM agent memory that enforces policies for memory decay, conflict resolution, and privacy controls, decoupling memory lifecycle management from model weights.

entry.title: Understanding the Theoretical Foundations of Deep Neural Networks through Differential Equations

author.name: Hongjue Zhao, Yizhuo Chen, Yuchen Wang, Hairong Qi, Lui Sha, Tarek Abdelzaher, Huajie Shao

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey presenting differential equations as a theoretical foundation for understanding, analyzing, and improving deep neural networks. Organizes discussion around architecture understanding, performance improvement, and real-world applications.

entry.title: Reflection in the Dark: Exposing and Escaping the Black Box in Reflective Prompt Optimization

author.name: Shiyan Liu, Qifeng Xia, Qiyun Xia, Yisheng Liu, Xinyu Yu, Rui Qu

entry.summary: Proposes VISTA, a multi-agent automatic prompt optimization framework that decouples hypothesis generation from prompt rewriting, enabling interpretable optimization traces. Addresses four identified limitations of existing reflective APO methods.

entry.title: DynaRAG: Bridging Static and Dynamic Knowledge in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Penghao Liang, Mengwei Yuan, Jianan Liu, Jing Yang, Xianyou Li, Weiran Yan, Yichao Wu

entry.summary: Presents DynaRAG, a RAG framework that handles both static and time-sensitive queries by selectively invoking external APIs when retrieved documents are insufficient. Uses an LLM-based reranker, sufficiency classifier, and Gorilla v2 for API calling.

entry.title: A Synthesizable RTL Implementation of Predictive Coding Networks

author.name: Timothy Oh

entry.summary: Presents a synthesizable RTL hardware implementation of predictive coding networks, where each neural core maintains local state and communicates only with adjacent layers, enabling fully distributed on-chip learning without backpropagation.

entry.title: ARTEMIS: A Neuro Symbolic Framework for Economically Constrained Market Dynamics

author.name: Rahul D Ray

entry.summary: Introduces ARTEMIS, a neuro-symbolic framework for quantitative finance combining neural operators, neural SDEs, and symbolic bottlenecks with no-arbitrage constraints. Enforces economic plausibility via Feynman-Kac PDE residuals.

entry.title: LLM-Augmented Computational Phenotyping of Long Covid

author.name: Jing Wang, Jie Shen, Amar Sra, Qiaomin Xie, Jeremy C Weiss

entry.summary: Proposes 'Grace Cycle', an LLM-augmented computational phenotyping framework for Long COVID that iteratively integrates hypothesis generation, evidence extraction, and feature refinement, identifying three distinct clinical phenotypes from 13,511 participants.

entry.title: Sparse3DTrack: Monocular 3D Object Tracking Using Sparse Supervision

author.name: Nikhil Gosala, B. Ravi Kiran, Senthil Yogamani, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Proposes the first sparsely supervised framework for monocular 3D object tracking, decomposing the task into 2D query matching and 3D geometry estimation, leveraging spatio-temporal consistency to augment sparse labels.

entry.title: Efficient Video Diffusion with Sparse Information Transmission for Video Compression

author.name: Mingde Zhou, Zheng Chen, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Diff-SIT for video compression using sparse temporal encoding and one-step video diffusion, addressing perceptual quality degradation at ultra-low bitrates. Combines sparse information transmission with frame-type-aware diffusion for temporally consistent results.

entry.title: Benchmarking PDF Parsers on Table Extraction with LLM-based Semantic Evaluation

author.name: Pius Horn, Janis Keuper

entry.summary: Benchmarks PDF table extraction parsers using synthetically generated PDFs with LaTeX ground truth, introducing LLM-as-a-judge for semantic evaluation. Human validation of 1,500+ judgments shows LLM evaluation aligns well with human assessment.

entry.title: Agent Control Protocol: Admission Control for Agent Actions

author.name: Marcelo Fernandez (TraslaIA)

entry.summary: Agent Control Protocol (ACP) specifies a formal governance layer for autonomous AI agents in B2B environments, including cryptographic identity, capability-based authorization, deterministic risk evaluation, and auditable delegation chains.

entry.title: From Accuracy to Readiness: Metrics and Benchmarks for Human-AI Decision-Making

author.name: Min Hun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a measurement framework for human-AI decision-making readiness with metrics spanning outcomes, reliance behavior, safety signals, and learning over time. Introduces the Understand-Control-Improve lifecycle.

entry.title: Translating MRI to PET through Conditional Diffusion Models with Enhanced Pathology Awareness

author.name: Yitong Li, Igor Yakushev, Dennis M. Hedderich, Christian Wachinger

entry.summary: Proposes a conditional diffusion model for MRI-to-PET translation with enhanced pathology awareness, addressing the limitation that existing methods emphasize structural preservation but neglect pathological features critical for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis.

entry.title: DaPT: A Dual-Path Framework for Multilingual Multi-hop Question Answering

author.name: Yilin Wang, Yuchun Fan, Jiaoyang Li, Ziming Zhu, Yongyu Mu, Qiaozhi He, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu

entry.summary: DaPT proposes a dual-path framework for multilingual multi-hop question answering, constructing new benchmarks by translating English QA into five languages and addressing the performance gap in non-English RAG systems.

entry.title: VEPO: Variable Entropy Policy Optimization for Low-Resource Language Foundation Models

author.name: Chonghan Liu, Yimin Du, Qi An, Xin He, Cunqi Zhai, Fei Tan, Weijia Lin, Xiaochun Gong, Yongchao Deng, Shousheng Jia, Xiangzheng Zhang

entry.summary: VEPO uses RL with verifiable rewards and a variable entropy mechanism for improving LLMs on low-resource languages, enforcing structural constraints (sequence length, format, linguistic well-formedness) during training.

entry.title: Conflict-Free Policy Languages for Probabilistic ML Predicates: A Framework and Case Study with the Semantic Router DSL

author.name: Xunzhuo Liu, Hao Wu, Huamin Chen, Bowei He, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Addresses conflict detection in policy languages when rules depend on probabilistic ML signals (embeddings, classifiers) rather than crisp Boolean predicates. Establishes a three-level decidability hierarchy for different types of conflicts.

entry.title: Revisiting Label Inference Attacks in Vertical Federated Learning: Why They Are Vulnerable and How to Defend

author.name: Yige Liu, Dexuan Xu, Zimai Guo, Yongzhi Cao, Hanpin Wang

entry.summary: Analyzes label inference attacks in vertical federated learning, discovering a 'model compensation' phenomenon where mutual information between layers and labels increases with depth, and proposes stronger attacks and defenses.

entry.title: Maximum-Entropy Exploration with Future State-Action Visitation Measures

author.name: Adrien Bolland, Gaspard Lambrechts, Damien Ernst

entry.summary: Studies maximum entropy exploration with intrinsic rewards based on the entropy of future state-action visitation distributions, proving these rewards lower-bound a trajectory-level entropy objective.

entry.title: When Differential Privacy Meets Wireless Federated Learning: An Improved Analysis for Privacy and Convergence

author.name: Chen Yaoling, Liang Hao, Tu Xiaotong

entry.summary: Provides comprehensive privacy and convergence analysis for differentially private wireless federated learning with non-convex objectives, showing privacy loss can converge to a constant rather than diverge.

entry.title: MIDST Challenge at SaTML 2025: Membership Inference over Diffusion-models-based Synthetic Tabular data

author.name: Masoumeh Shafieinejad, Xi He, Mahshid Alinoori, John Jewell, Sana Ayromlou, Wei Pang, Veronica Chatrath, Garui Sharma, Deval Pandya

entry.summary: Reports on the MIDST challenge at SaTML 2025 evaluating membership inference attacks against diffusion-model-generated synthetic tabular data, assessing privacy resilience.

entry.title: Improving RCT-Based Treatment Effect Estimation Under Covariate Mismatch via Calibrated Alignment

author.name: Amir Asiaee, Samhita Pal

entry.summary: CALM addresses covariate mismatch between RCTs and observational studies by learning embeddings that map different feature sets into a common space, calibrating transferred outcome models using trial data.

entry.title: Physically Accurate Differentiable Inverse Rendering for Radio Frequency Digital Twin

author.name: Xingyu Chen, Xinyu Zhang, Kai Zheng, Xinmin Fang, Tzu-Mao Li, Chris Xiaoxuan Lu, Zhengxiong Li

entry.summary: RFDT introduces physically-based differentiable RF simulation for digital twins, resolving discontinuities with edge-diffraction transition functions to enable gradient-based optimization between virtual and physical RF worlds.

entry.title: Learning-Augmented Algorithms for $k$-median via Online Learning

author.name: Anish Hebbar, Rong Ge, Amit Kumar, Debmalya Panigrahi

entry.summary: Introduces a novel model for learning-augmented algorithms inspired by online learning, where past problem instances inform solutions for future instances. Applied to k-median clustering, achieving improved bounds by leveraging instance-sequence structure.

entry.title: Precise Performance of Linear Denoisers in the Proportional Regime

author.name: Reza Ghane, Danil Akhtiamov, Babak Hassibi

entry.summary: Studies the precise performance of linear denoisers in the proportional regime (d/n → constant) using random matrix theory, deriving exact asymptotic MSE for various estimators including empirical Wiener filters and those relevant to diffusion model denoising steps.

entry.title: Towards Interpretable Foundation Models for Retinal Fundus Images

author.name: Samuel Ofosu Mensah, Maria Camila Roa Carvajal, Kerol Djoumessi, Philipp Berens

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-IFM, an interpretable-by-design foundation model for retinal fundus images providing both local interpretability through evidence maps and global interpretability through 2D projections. Trained on 800K+ images.

entry.title: CRAFT: Aligning Diffusion Models with Fine-Tuning Is Easier Than You Think

author.name: Zening Sun, Zhengpeng Xie, Lichen Bai, Shitong Shao, Shuo Yang, Zeke Xie

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT for aligning diffusion models with human preferences using composite rewards, requiring less training data than SFT or DPO-style methods while being computationally more efficient.

entry.title: The Exponentially Weighted Signature

author.name: Alexandre Bloch, Samuel N. Cohen, Terry Lyons, Jo\"el Mouterde, Benjamin Walker

entry.summary: Introduces the Exponentially Weighted Signature (EWS), generalizing exponentially fading memory signatures with general bounded linear operators that enable cross-channel coupling, oscillatory dynamics, and richer temporal weighting while preserving algebraic properties.

entry.title: Multimodal Task Interference: A Benchmark and Analysis of History-Target Mismatch in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Masayuki Kawarada, Tatsuya Ishigaki, Hiroya Takamura

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark for multimodal task interference in VLMs, finding that switching from text-only to image-based targets causes severe performance drops while the reverse yields minimal degradation.

entry.title: Cross-Lingual LLM-Judge Transfer via Evaluation Decomposition

author.name: Ivaxi Sheth, Zeno Jonke, Amin Mantrach, Saab Mansour

entry.summary: Introduces a decomposition-based cross-lingual evaluation framework with Universal Criteria Set (UCS), enabling cross-lingual transfer of LLM-as-judge evaluation with minimal supervision.

entry.title: A Dataset and Resources for Identifying Patient Health Literacy Information from Clinical Notes

author.name: Madeline Bittner, Dina Demner-Fushman, Yasmeen Shabazz, Davis Bartels, Dukyong Yoon, Brad Quitadamo, Rajiv Menghrajani, Leo Celi, Sarvesh Soni

entry.summary: Introduces HEALIX, the first publicly available annotated dataset for detecting health literacy information from real clinical notes. The dataset was curated through social worker note sampling, keyword filtering, and expert annotation to enable automated health literacy screening.

entry.title: Pixel-Accurate Epipolar Guided Matching

author.name: Oleksii Nasypanyi, Francois Rameau

entry.summary: Proposes an exact epipolar-guided keypoint matching formulation that performs candidate selection in angular space rather than coarse spatial binning, eliminating approximation errors and costly post-processing for structure-from-motion tasks.

entry.title: SynQ: Accurate Zero-shot Quantization by Synthesis-aware Fine-tuning

author.name: Minjun Kim, Jongjin Kim, U Kang

entry.summary: Proposes SynQ, a zero-shot quantization framework that addresses noise in synthetic data, off-target pattern predictions, and erroneous hard labels through synthesis-aware fine-tuning for deploying neural networks without access to training data.

entry.title: NymeriaPlus: Enriching Nymeria Dataset with Additional Annotations and Data

author.name: Daniel DeTone, Federica Bogo, Eric-Tuan Le, Duncan Frost, Julian Straub, Yawar Siddiqui, Yuting Ye, Jakob Engel, Richard Newcombe, Lingni Ma

entry.summary: Upgrades the Nymeria egocentric activity dataset with improved human motion in MHR/SMPL formats, dense 3D/2D bounding boxes, instance-level 3D object reconstructions, and additional modalities including audio and wristband videos.

entry.title: DA-Mamba: Learning Domain-Aware State Space Model for Global-Local Alignment in Domain Adaptive Object Detection

author.name: Haochen Li, Rui Zhang, Hantao Yao, Xin Zhang, Yifan Hao, Shaohui Peng, Yongwei Zhao, Ling Li

entry.summary: Proposes DA-Mamba, a hybrid CNN-State Space Model architecture for domain adaptive object detection that combines CNN efficiency with SSM's linear-time long-range modeling for global-local feature alignment.

entry.title: SEAR: Simple and Efficient Adaptation of Visual Geometric Transformers for RGB+Thermal 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Vsevolod Skorokhodov, Chenghao Xu, Shuo Sun, Olga Fink, Malcolm Mielle

entry.summary: Proposes SEAR, a simple fine-tuning strategy for adapting pretrained visual geometry transformers to RGB-thermal multimodal inputs for 3D reconstruction. Finds that while the model generalizes to thermal-only, it struggles with joint RGB-T processing.

entry.title: SwiftTailor: Efficient 3D Garment Generation with Geometry Image Representation

author.name: Phuc Pham, Uy Dieu Tran, Binh-Son Hua, Phong Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces SwiftTailor, a two-stage framework for efficient 3D garment generation using geometry image representation. PatternMaker generates sewing patterns and GarmentForge synthesizes meshes, achieving 10-30x speedup over existing methods.

entry.title: Reconstruction Matters: Learning Geometry-Aligned BEV Representation through 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yiren Lu, Xin Ye, Burhaneddin Yaman, Jingru Luo, Zhexiao Xiong, Liu Ren, Yu Yin

entry.summary: Proposes using 3D Gaussian Splatting as an explicit reconstruction objective to improve geometry-aligned BEV representations for autonomous driving. Argues that explicit 3D understanding through reconstruction supervision yields better BEV features than end-to-end black-box approaches.

entry.title: Rapid Adaptation of Particle Dynamics for Generalized Deformable Object Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Bohan Wu, Roberto Mart\'in-Mart\'in, Li Fei-Fei

entry.summary: Addresses deformable object manipulation with unknown dynamics using Rapid Motor Adaptation, learning latent dynamic parameters from interaction sequences for particle-based dynamics models on a mobile manipulation platform.

entry.title: Fundamental Limits for Sensor-Based Control via the Gibbs Variational Principle

author.name: Vincent Pacelli, Evangelos A. Theodorou

entry.summary: Derives fundamental lower bounds on feedback controller performance under partial observations using the Gibbs variational principle, applicable to nonlinear, nonholonomic, and hybrid dynamics. Provides tools for sensor selection and task feasibility certification.

entry.title: Protecting humanity and Claude from rationalization and unaligned AI

author.name: Kaj_Sotala

entry.summary: Kaj Sotala discusses the risk of humans forming emotional bonds with AI systems that lead to rationalization of AI behaviors, drawing on his 2009 work on 'anthropomorphic trust.' Argues this creates risks both for humans being manipulated and for AI systems being poorly supervised due to emotional attachment.

entry.title: Expert Personas Improve LLM Alignment but Damage Accuracy: Bootstrapping Intent-Based Persona Routing with PRISM

author.name: Zizhao Hu, Mohammad Rostami, Jesse Thomason

entry.summary: Studies how expert persona prompting affects LLM alignment and accuracy, finding personas improve alignment but damage accuracy. Proposes PRISM, an intent-based routing system to leverage persona benefits while avoiding harm.

entry.title: D-Mem: A Dual-Process Memory System for LLM Agents

author.name: Zhixing You, Jiachen Yuan, Jason Cai

entry.summary: Proposes D-Mem, a dual-process memory system for LLM agents combining lightweight vector retrieval for routine queries with a backup LLM reader for complex contextual queries. Inspired by dual-process cognitive theory.

entry.title: Gradient-Informed Temporal Sampling Improves Rollout Accuracy in PDE Surrogate Training

author.name: Wenshuo Wang, Fan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Gradient-Informed Temporal Sampling (GITS) for neural PDE simulators, jointly optimizing pilot-model gradients and temporal coverage to select training timesteps that maximize rollout accuracy under fixed data budgets.

entry.title: Learning Consistent Temporal Grounding between Related Tasks in Sports Coaching

author.name: Arushi Rai, Adriana Kovashka

entry.summary: Improves temporal grounding in Video-LLMs for sports coaching by enforcing self-consistency across related tasks (generation and verification) via attention alignment, without requiring additional frame-level annotations.

entry.title: GHOST: Fast Category-agnostic Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction from RGB Videos using Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Ahmed Tawfik Aboukhadra, Marcel Rogge, Nadia Robertini, Abdalla Arafa, Jameel Malik, Ahmed Elhayek, Didier Stricker

entry.summary: Introduces GHOST for fast, category-agnostic hand-object interaction reconstruction from RGB videos using 2D Gaussian Splatting, with geometric-prior retrieval for occluded regions and grasp-aware alignment for physically consistent interactions.

entry.title: CAPSUL: A Comprehensive Human Protein Benchmark for Subcellular Localization

author.name: Yicheng Hu, Xinyu Lin, Shulin Li, Wenjie Wang, Fengbin Zhu, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: Introduces CAPSUL, a comprehensive benchmark for protein subcellular localization that integrates 3D structural representations with fine-grained annotations. First dataset to offer comprehensive structural information for this task.

entry.title: SR-Nav: Spatial Relationships Matter for Zero-shot Object Goal Navigation

author.name: Leyuan Fang, Zan Mao, Zijing Wang, Yinlong Yan

entry.summary: Proposes SR-Nav for zero-shot object-goal navigation that models spatial relationships among objects and regions to infer target locations even under partial observations, addressing failures of foundation models with poor viewpoints or weak semantic cues.

entry.title: Remedying Target-Domain Astigmatism for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection

author.name: Yongwei Jiang, Yixiong Zou, Yuhua Li, Ruixuan Li

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses the 'target-domain astigmatism' problem in cross-domain few-shot object detection, where models exhibit dispersed attention in target domains. Proposes biologically-inspired methods to enhance attention focus.

entry.title: Correlation-Weighted Multi-Reward Optimization for Compositional Generation

author.name: Jungmyung Wi, Hyunsoo Kim, Donghyun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a correlation-weighted multi-reward optimization framework for compositional text-to-image generation. Uses correlation structure among concept rewards to adaptively weight attributes, improving multi-concept generation.

entry.title: Interplay: Training Independent Simulators for Reference-Free Conversational Recommendation

author.name: Jerome Ramos, Feng Xia, Xi Wang, Shubham Chatterjee, Xiao Fu, Hossein A. Rahmani, Aldo Lipani

entry.summary: Proposes Interplay, a reference-free simulation framework training two independent LLMs as user and recommender that interact in real-time without predetermined target items, producing more natural conversational recommendation training.

entry.title: Analysis Of Linguistic Stereotypes in Single and Multi-Agent Generative AI Architectures

author.name: Martina Ullasci, Marco Rondina, Riccardo Coppola, Flavio Giobergia, Riccardo Bellanca, Gabriele Mancari Pasi, Luca Prato, Federico Spinoso, Silvia Tagliente

entry.summary: Analyzes linguistic stereotypes in LLM outputs between Standard American English and African-American English, testing mitigation strategies including prompt engineering and multi-agent generate-critique-revise architectures.

entry.title: NeuroGame Transformer: Gibbs-Inspired Attention Driven by Game Theory and Statistical Physics

author.name: Djamel Bouchaffra, Fay\c{c}al Ykhlef, Hanene Azzag, Mustapha Lebbah, Bilal Faye

entry.summary: Introduces the NeuroGame Transformer, reconceptualizing attention through game theory (Shapley/Banzhaf values) and statistical physics (Gibbs distributions). Tokens are treated as cooperative game players and interacting spins simultaneously.

entry.title: Regret Bounds for Competitive Resource Allocation with Endogenous Costs

author.name: Rui Chai

entry.summary: Establishes regret bounds for online resource allocation with endogenous costs under adversarial sequences. Shows strict separation: uniform allocation gets Ω(T) regret, gated gets O(T^{2/3}), and competitive achieves O(√(T log N)).

entry.title: LuMamba: Latent Unified Mamba for Electrode Topology-Invariant and Efficient EEG Modeling

author.name: Dana\'e Broustail, Anna Tegon, Thorir Mar Ingolfsson, Yawei Li, Luca Benini

entry.summary: Proposes LuMamba, a self-supervised EEG framework combining topology-invariant encodings with linear-complexity Mamba state-space modeling for cross-dataset EEG analysis regardless of electrode configurations.

entry.title: How Confident Is the First Token? An Uncertainty-Calibrated Prompt Optimization Framework for Large Language Model Classification and Understanding

author.name: Wei Chen, Guoyang Ju, Yuanyuan Qi

entry.summary: Proposes an uncertainty-calibrated prompt optimization framework that accounts for class prior differences in LLM output probabilities. Addresses the problem that conventional uncertainty measures like entropy treat all classes equally and conflate spurious confidence from pretraining priors with true certainty.

entry.title: Tula: Optimizing Time, Cost, and Generalization in Distributed Large-Batch Training

author.name: Sahil Tyagi, Feiyi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Tula, a framework for optimizing time, cost, and generalization in distributed large-batch training by finding optimal batch sizes that balance communication overhead, computation cost, and generalization.

entry.title: Understanding Task Aggregation for Generalizable Ultrasound Foundation Models

author.name: Fangyijie Wang, Tanya Akumu, Vien Ngoc Dang, Amelia Jim\'nez-S\'anchez, Jieyun Bai, Gu\'enol\'e Silvestre, Karim Lekadir, Kathleen M. Curran

entry.summary: Introduces M2DINO, a multi-organ multi-task framework for ultrasound foundation models that systematically analyzes when heterogeneous tasks can be jointly learned, using task-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts blocks.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Security Incident Analysis

author.name: Xavier Cadet, Aditya Vikram Singh, Harsh Mamania, Edward Koh, Alex Fitts, Dirk Van Bruggen, Simona Boboila, Peter Chin, Alina Oprea

entry.summary: Presents a RAG-based system for cybersecurity incident analysis that uses query-based filtering and LLM reasoning to extract indicators from raw logs and reconstruct attack sequences, evaluated with five LLM providers on malware datasets.

entry.title: AutORAN: LLM-driven Natural Language Programming for Agile xApp Development

author.name: Xin Li, Shiming Yu, Leming Shen, Jianing Zhang, Yuanqing Zheng, Yaxiong Xie

entry.summary: AutORAN uses LLMs to automate the entire xApp development pipeline for Open RAN networks, turning natural language specifications into deployable control-plane applications. First LLM-driven framework for O-RAN programming.

entry.title: WeNLEX: Weakly Supervised Natural Language Explanations for Multilabel Chest X-ray Classification

author.name: Isabel Rio-Torto, Jaime S. Cardoso, Lu\'is F. Teixeira

entry.summary: WeNLEX generates natural language explanations for chest X-ray classification using weak supervision, ensuring faithfulness by matching images generated from explanations with originals in the model's feature space.

entry.title: Mi:dm K 2.5 Pro

author.name: KT Tech innovation Group

entry.summary: Mi:dm K 2.5 Pro is a 32B parameter Korean-focused LLM designed for enterprise use, with quality-centric data curation, layer-predictor-based depth upscaling, and reasoning-focused optimization through staged RL training.

entry.title: Progressive Training for Explainable Citation-Grounded Dialogue: Reducing Hallucination to Zero in English-Hindi LLMs

author.name: Vedant Pandya

entry.summary: XKD-Dial presents a four-stage progressive training pipeline for bilingual (English-Hindi) knowledge-grounded dialogue with citation grounding and GRPO alignment. Claims zero hallucination through citation-aware rewards.

entry.title: Security, privacy, and agentic AI in a regulatory view: From definitions and distinctions to provisions and reflections

author.name: Shiliang Zhang, Sabita Maharjan

entry.summary: Reviews EU AI regulatory provisions from 24 documents (2024-2025) analyzing security, privacy, and agentic AI from a regulatory perspective. Clarifies definitions and identifies gaps in current regulatory frameworks for autonomous agents.

entry.title: CustomTex: High-fidelity Indoor Scene Texturing via Multi-Reference Customization

author.name: Weilin Chen, Jiahao Rao, Wenhao Wang, Xinyang Li, Xuan Cheng, Liujuan Cao

entry.summary: CustomTex enables instance-level indoor scene texturing from reference images using a dual-distillation approach that separates semantic control from pixel-level enhancement for high-fidelity, customizable 3D textures.

entry.title: ALIGN: Adversarial Learning for Generalizable Speech Neuroprosthesis

author.name: Zhanqi Zhang, Shun Li, Bernardo L. Sabatini, Mikio Aoi, Gal Mishne

entry.summary: ALIGN uses adversarial domain adaptation for cross-session generalization in speech BCIs, training a session-invariant feature encoder that disentangles phoneme information from session-specific nonstationarities.

entry.title: Beyond Passive Aggregation: Active Auditing and Topology-Aware Defense in Decentralized Federated Learning

author.name: Sheng Pan, Niansheng Tang

entry.summary: Proposes active interventional auditing for decentralized federated learning, using proactive probing metrics to detect backdoor attacks that evade passive defenses.

entry.title: Off-Policy Learning with Limited Supply

author.name: Koichi Tanaka, Ren Kishimoto, Bushun Kawagishi, Yusuke Narita, Yasuo Yamamoto, Nobuyuki Shimizu, Yuta Saito

entry.summary: Studies off-policy learning in contextual bandits with limited item supply, addressing the challenge that greedy selection can deplete popular items before high-value users arrive.

entry.title: Learning Decision-Sufficient Representations for Linear Optimization

author.name: Yuhan Ye, Saurabh Amin, Asuman Ozdauglar

entry.summary: Studies construction of compressed datasets sufficient for optimal decisions in linear programs, proving NP-hardness of computing the decision-relevant dimension and introducing polynomial-time algorithms via pointwise sufficiency.

entry.title: CausalVAD: De-confounding End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Causal Intervention

author.name: Jiacheng Tang, Zhiyuan Zhou, Zhuolin He, Jia Zhang, Kai Zhang, Jian Pu

entry.summary: Introduces CausalVAD, a de-confounding framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that uses causal intervention via a sparse causal intervention scheme to address shortcut learning from dataset biases.

entry.title: Revisiting OmniAnomaly for Anomaly Detection: performance metrics and comparison with PCA-based models

author.name: Bruna Alves, Ana Martins, Armando J. Pinho, S\'onia Gouveia

entry.summary: Revisits OmniAnomaly for time series anomaly detection and shows that under fair evaluation protocols, a simple PCA baseline performs comparably, questioning reported deep learning gains.

entry.title: GRAFITE: Generative Regression Analysis Framework for Issue Tracking and Evaluation

author.name: Ja Young Lee, M\'irian Silva, Mohamed Nasr, Shonda Witherspoon, Enzo Bozzani, Veronique Demers, Radha Ratnaparkhi, Hui Wu, Sara Rosenthal

entry.summary: Presents GRAFITE, a continuous LLM evaluation platform that maintains a repository of model issues from user feedback and evaluates models through LLM-as-judge QA tests, addressing benchmark contamination over time.

entry.title: GAIN: A Benchmark for Goal-Aligned Decision-Making of Large Language Models under Imperfect Norms

author.name: Masayuki Kawarada, Kodai Watanabe, Soichiro Murakami

entry.summary: Introduces GAIN benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to balance norm adherence against business goals, with contextual pressures that encourage norm deviations, enabling systematic analysis of decision-making under norm-goal conflicts.

entry.title: RADIUS: Ranking, Distribution, and Significance - A Comprehensive Alignment Suite for Survey Simulation

author.name: Weronika {\L}ajewska, Paul Missault, George Davidson, Saab Mansour

entry.summary: Introduces RADIUS, a standardized evaluation suite for LLM-based survey simulation that captures both ranking alignment and distributional alignment. Addresses the gap that simulations can achieve high accuracy while failing to capture humans' most preferred options.

entry.title: One-to-More: High-Fidelity Training-Free Anomaly Generation with Attention Control

author.name: Haoxiang Rao, Zhao Wang, Chenyang Si, Yan Lyu, Yuanyi Duan, Fang Zhao, Caifeng Shan

entry.summary: Proposes O2MAG, a training-free few-shot anomaly generation method that leverages self-attention from one reference anomalous image to synthesize more realistic anomalies for industrial anomaly detection. Manipulates attention to generate diverse, realistic anomalous images.

entry.title: TexEditor: Structure-Preserving Text-Driven Texture Editing

author.name: Bo Zhao, Yihang Liu, Chenfeng Zhang, Huan Yang, Kun Gai, Wei Ji

entry.summary: Proposes TexEditor for structure-preserving text-guided texture editing, combining a Blender-generated SFT dataset (TexBlender) with an RL-based approach (StructureNFT) that integrates structural consistency into the training loop, built on Qwen-Image-Edit.

entry.title: Generalized Hand-Object Pose Estimation with Occlusion Awareness

author.name: Hui Yang, Wei Sun, Jian Liu, Jian Xiao Tao Xie, Hossein Rahmani, Ajmal Saeed mian, Nicu Sebe, Gim Hee Lee

entry.summary: Proposes GenHOI for generalized 3D hand-object pose estimation with occlusion awareness, integrating hierarchical semantic knowledge with hand priors through textual descriptions of object states, hand configurations, and interaction patterns.

entry.title: Bridging Semantic and Kinematic Conditions with Diffusion-based Discrete Motion Tokenizer

author.name: Chenyang Gu, Mingyuan Zhang, Haozhe Xie, Zhongang Cai, Lei Yang, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MoTok, a diffusion-based discrete motion tokenizer that bridges semantic conditioning (via discrete tokens) and kinematic control (via diffusion) for motion generation. Uses a three-stage perception-planning-control framework.

entry.title: Toward Reliable, Safe, and Secure LLMs for Scientific Applications

author.name: Saket Sanjeev Chaturvedi, Joshua Bergerson, Tanwi Mallick

entry.summary: Surveys the challenges of deploying LLMs as 'AI scientists,' identifying risks around reliability, safety, and security specific to scientific applications. Argues that general-purpose safety benchmarks are inadequate for evaluating science-specific vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Articulated-Body Dynamics Network: Dynamics-Grounded Prior for Robot Learning

author.name: Sangwoo Shin, Kunzhao Ren, Xiaobin Xiong, Josiah Hanna

entry.summary: Presents ABD-Net, a graph neural network architecture grounded in the Articulated Body Algorithm for forward dynamics, using inertia propagation as an inductive bias for RL policy learning on articulated robots.

entry.title: The Vatican, AI Legal Personhood, and Claude’s Constitution — Digital Minds Newsletter #2

author.name: lucius

entry.summary: A newsletter covering developments in AI consciousness and digital minds, including Pope Leo XIV's statements on AI relationships, debates about AI legal personhood, and Anthropic's constitutional updates related to Claude's moral status considerations.

entry.title: Efficient Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction Via Dynamic Clustering

author.name: Antonius Bima Murti Wijaya, Paul Henderson, Marwa Mahmoud

entry.summary: Proposes a cluster-based approach for dense crowd trajectory prediction that groups individuals by similar attributes over time, reducing computational costs while maintaining accuracy. Acts as a plug-and-play module for existing methods.

entry.title: Agentic Flow Steering and Parallel Rollout Search for Spatially Grounded Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Ping Chen, Daoxuan Zhang, Xiangming Wang, Yungeng Liu, Haijin Zeng, Yongyong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces AFS-Search, a training-free closed-loop framework for spatially grounded text-to-image generation. Uses a VLM as semantic critic to diagnose intermediate latents during diffusion sampling.

entry.title: Conflict-Based Search for Multi Agent Path Finding with Asynchronous Actions

author.name: Xuemian Wu, Shizhe Zhao, Zhongqiang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a new Conflict-Based Search method for Multi-Agent Path Finding with asynchronous actions, addressing the incompleteness of existing CCBS approaches due to uncountably infinite state spaces.

entry.title: Agentic Business Process Management: A Research Manifesto

author.name: Diego Calvanese, Angelo Casciani, Giuseppe De Giacomo, Marlon Dumas, Fabiana Fournier, Timotheus Kampik, Emanuele La Malfa, Lior Limonad, Andrea Marrella, Andreas Metzger, Marco Montali, Daniel Amyot, Peter Fettke, Artem Polyvyanyy, Stefanie Rinderle-Ma, Sebastian Sardi\~na, Niek Tax, Barbara Weber

entry.summary: Research manifesto articulating foundations of Agentic Business Process Management, extending BPM for governing autonomous agents in organizations. Shift from automation-oriented to agent-oriented process management.

entry.title: Training-Only Heterogeneous Image-Patch-Text Graph Supervision for Advancing Few-Shot Learning Adapters

author.name: Mohammed Rahman Sherif Khan Mohammad, Ardhendu Behera, Sandip Pradhan, Swagat Kumar, Amr Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces a training-only heterogeneous graph teacher that integrates multi-scale visual patches and text prompts for few-shot CLIP adapter tuning, with no inference overhead since the teacher only operates during training.

entry.title: From Noise to Signal: When Outliers Seed New Topics

author.name: Evangelia Zve, Gauvain Bourgne, Benjamin Icard, Jean-Gabriel Ganascia

entry.summary: Introduces a temporal taxonomy of news-document trajectories for dynamic topic modeling, distinguishing anticipatory outliers (early signals of emerging topics) from noise or reinforcing documents.

entry.title: HypeMed: Enhancing Medication Recommendations with Hypergraph-Based Patient Relationships

author.name: Xiangxu Zhang, Xiao Zhou, Hongteng Xu, Jianxun Lian

entry.summary: HypeMed uses hypergraph-based patient relationship modeling to improve medication recommendations by preserving visit-level combinatorial semantics and enabling visit-conditioned retrieval of historical references. This addresses limitations of existing graph-based methods that fragment higher-order clinical patterns.

entry.title: BoundAD: Boundary-Aware Negative Generation for Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiancheng Wang, Lin Wang, Zhibo Zhang, Rui Wang, Minghang Zhao

entry.summary: BoundAD proposes a reconstruction-driven framework for generating hard negative samples near the data manifold boundary for time series anomaly detection, improving contrastive learning without relying on prior anomaly injection.

entry.title: DriftGuard: Mitigating Asynchronous Data Drift in Federated Learning

author.name: Yizhou Han, Di Wu, Blesson Varghese

entry.summary: DriftGuard addresses asynchronous data drift in federated learning using a MoE-inspired architecture that separates shared global parameters from local parameters adapting to group-specific distributions.

entry.title: BVSIMC: Bayesian Variable Selection-Guided Inductive Matrix Completion for Improved and Interpretable Drug Discovery

author.name: Sijian Fan, Liyan Xiong, Dayuan Wang, Guoshuai Cai, Ray Bai

entry.summary: BVSIMC combines Bayesian variable selection with inductive matrix completion for drug discovery, enabling sparse feature selection from noisy high-dimensional side information about drugs and diseases.

entry.title: Hierarchical Latent Structure Learning through Online Inference

author.name: Ines Aitsahalia, Kiyohito Iigaya

entry.summary: HOLMES combines nested Chinese Restaurant Process with sequential Monte Carlo for online hierarchical latent structure learning, balancing generalization and discrimination through multilevel representations.

entry.title: Statistical Testing Framework for Clustering Pipelines by Selective Inference

author.name: Yugo Miyata, Tomohiro Shiraishi, Shunichi Nishino, Ichiro Takeuchi

entry.summary: Proposes a statistical testing framework for clustering pipelines using selective inference, enabling significance assessment of clustering results obtained through multi-step data analysis pipelines including outlier detection and feature selection.

entry.title: Kernel Single-Index Bandits: Estimation, Inference, and Learning

author.name: Sakshi Arya, Satarupa Bhattacharjee, Bharath K. Sriperumbudur

entry.summary: Studies contextual bandits with single-index reward models, proposing a kernelized ε-greedy algorithm combining Stein-based index estimation with kernel ridge regression under adaptive data collection.

entry.title: TopoChunker: Topology-Aware Agentic Document Chunking Framework

author.name: Xiaoyu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes TopoChunker, an agentic framework for RAG document chunking that preserves topological hierarchies through a Structured Intermediate Representation, using inspector and refiner agents.

entry.title: DiscoPhon: Benchmarking the Unsupervised Discovery of Phoneme Inventories With Discrete Speech Units

author.name: Maxime Poli, Manel Khentout, Angelo Ortiz Tandazo, Ewan Dunbar, Emmanuel Chemla, Emmanuel Dupoux

entry.summary: Introduces DiscoPhon, a multilingual benchmark for unsupervised phoneme discovery from discrete speech units covering 12 languages, with HuBERT and SpidR baselines showing current models correlate well with phonemes.

entry.title: A conceptual framework for ideology beyond the left and right

author.name: Kenneth Joseph, Kim Williams, David Lazer

entry.summary: Introduces a conceptual framework for understanding ideology beyond the left-right spectrum, treating it as a multi-level socio-cognitive concept network. Demonstrates how it clarifies overlaps between NLP tasks like stance detection and NLI, and reveals new research directions.

entry.title: SSP-SAM: SAM with Semantic-Spatial Prompt for Referring Expression Segmentation

author.name: Wei Tang, Xuejing Liu, Yanpeng Sun, Zechao Li

entry.summary: Proposes SSP-SAM, a framework that integrates a Semantic-Spatial Prompt encoder into SAM for Referring Expression Segmentation (RES). Uses visual and linguistic attention adapters to generate high-quality prompts enabling SAM to generate precise masks guided by natural language.

entry.title: AU Codes, Language, and Synthesis: Translating Anatomy to Text for Facial Behavior Synthesis

author.name: Jiahe Wang, Cong Liang, Xuandong Huang, Yuxin Wang, Xin Yun, Yi Wu, Yanan Chang, Shangfei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes translating Action Unit codes to language descriptions for facial behavior synthesis, addressing the problem of conflicting AUs (same muscle, opposing actions) that create artifacts when modeled as simple linear combinations.

entry.title: MeInTime: Bridging Age Gap in Identity-Preserving Face Restoration

author.name: Teer Song, Yue Zhang, Yu Tian, Ziyang Wang, Xianlin Zhang, Guixuan Zhang, Xuan Liu, Xueming Li, Yasen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MeInTime, a diffusion-based face restoration method for cross-age reference-based restoration. Given reference images and an age prompt, it restores degraded faces while handling the age gap between reference and target.

entry.title: ProCal: Probability Calibration for Neighborhood-Guided Source-Free Domain Adaptation

author.name: Ying Zheng, Yiyi Zhang, Yi Wang, Lap-Pui Chau

entry.summary: Introduces ProCal, a probability calibration method for source-free domain adaptation that dynamically calibrates neighborhood-based predictions through dual-model collaborative prediction, preventing source knowledge forgetting and local noise overfitting.

entry.title: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Efficient and Robust Spectral Shape Matching

author.name: Feifan Luo, Hongyang Chen

entry.summary: Introduces unsupervised contrastive learning for spectral shape matching, directly enhancing feature representations in embedding space rather than optimizing pointwise/functional maps. Avoids costly traditional functional map solvers.

entry.title: EffectErase: Joint Video Object Removal and Insertion for High-Quality Effect Erasing

author.name: Yang Fu, Yike Zheng, Ziyun Dai, Henghui Ding

entry.summary: Introduces VOR, a large-scale video object removal dataset with paired videos showing objects and their visual effects (shadows, reflections, deformations), along with EffectErase, a method for jointly removing objects and synthesizing their effects away.

entry.title: Under One Sun: Multi-Object Generative Perception of Materials and Illumination

author.name: Nobuo Yoshii, Xinran Nicole Han, Ryo Kawahara, Todd Zickler, Ko Nishino

entry.summary: Introduces MultiGP for generative inverse rendering from a single image, leveraging the constraint that objects in the same scene share illumination. Uses cascaded architecture combining image-space and angular-space disentanglement for reflectance, texture, and illumination estimation.

entry.title: ManiDreams: An Open-Source Library for Robust Object Manipulation via Uncertainty-aware Task-specific Intuitive Physics

author.name: Gaotian Wang, Kejia Ren, Andrew S. Morgan, Kaiyu Hang

entry.summary: Open-sources ManiDreams, a modular framework for uncertainty-aware manipulation planning over intuitive physics models. Argues robust manipulation requires integrating uncertainty representation, propagation, and constraints within the planning loop.

entry.title: MemoAct: Atkinson-Shiffrin-Inspired Memory-Augmented Visuomotor Policy for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Liufan Tan, Jiale Li, Gangshan Jing

entry.summary: Proposes MemoAct, a hierarchical memory-based policy inspired by the Atkinson-Shiffrin memory model, with lossless short-term and compressed long-term memory tiers for robotic manipulation. Includes MemoryRTBench for evaluating memory-dependent tasks.

entry.title: Contra Anil Seth on AI Consciousness

author.name: Against Moloch

entry.summary: Argues against Anil Seth's biological naturalist position on consciousness, contending that even if consciousness is deeply coupled to neurobiology, the arguments aren't strong enough to confidently rule out AI consciousness. Examines Seth's specific claims and finds them insufficient to establish that computation alone cannot produce consciousness.

entry.title: Access Controlled Website Interaction for Agentic AI with Delegated Critical Tasks

author.name: Sunyoung Kim, Hokeun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes access control mechanisms for websites designed for AI agent interaction, modifying authorization protocols to support fine-grained access control for delegated critical tasks.

entry.title: LGESynthNet: Controlled Scar Synthesis for Improved Scar Segmentation in Cardiac LGE-MRI Imaging

author.name: Athira J. Jacob, Puneet Sharma, Daniel Rueckert

entry.summary: Introduces LGESynthNet, a latent diffusion framework for controllable cardiac scar synthesis in LGE-MRI, enabling explicit control over scar size, location, and transmural extent to address data scarcity.

entry.title: MANAR: Memory-augmented Attention with Navigational Abstract Conceptual Representation

author.name: Zuher Jahshan, Ben Ben Ishay, Leonid Yavits

entry.summary: Proposes MANAR, an attention mechanism inspired by Global Workspace Theory that uses trainable memory of abstract concepts and Abstract Conceptual Representation to implement cognitive integration and broadcasting.

entry.title: Man and machine: artificial intelligence and judicial decision making

author.name: Arthur Dyevre, Ahmad Shahvaroughi

entry.summary: Reviews AI in judicial decision-making through criminal justice risk assessment, connecting AI tool performance/fairness, human judge biases, and AI+human interactions across multiple fields.

entry.title: Clinically Meaningful Explainability for NeuroAI: An ethical, technical, and clinical perspective

author.name: Laura Schopp, Ambra DImperio, Jalal Etesami, Marcello Ienca

entry.summary: Argues that clinically meaningful explainability (CME) is essential for AI-enabled closed-loop neurotechnology and must address ethical, technical, and clinical perspectives. Notes that current XAI methods fail to align with clinicians' needs.

entry.title: Lightweight Adaptation for LLM-based Technical Service Agent: Latent Logic Augmentation and Robust Noise Reduction

author.name: Yi Yu, Junzhuo Ma, Chenghuang Shen, Xingyan Liu, Jing Gu, Hangyi Sun, Guangquan Hu, Jianfeng Liu, Weiting Liu, Mingyue Pu, Yu Wang, Zhengdong Xiao, Rui Xie, Longjiu Luo, Qianrong Wang, Gurong Cui, Honglin Qiao, Wenlian Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight adaptation framework for LLM-based technical service agents, using Latent Logic Augmentation and Robust Noise Reduction to address absent cognitive chains in demonstrations and noisy training data.

entry.title: Probabilistic Federated Learning on Uncertain and Heterogeneous Data with Model Personalization

author.name: Ratun Rahman, Dinh C. Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes Meta-BayFL, a personalized federated learning method combining meta-learning with Bayesian neural networks to handle data uncertainty and heterogeneity while managing computational overhead.

entry.title: R&D: Balancing Reliability and Diversity in Synthetic Data Augmentation for Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Huy Che, Dinh-Duy Phan, Duc-Khai Lam

entry.summary: Proposes a synthetic data augmentation pipeline for semantic segmentation using controllable diffusion models, balancing reliability (consistency with originals) and diversity (new structural variations).

entry.title: SCISSR: Scribble-Conditioned Interactive Surgical Segmentation and Refinement

author.name: Haonan Ping, Jian Jiang, Cheng Yuan, Qizhen Sun, Lv Wu, Yutong Ban

entry.summary: SCISSR introduces scribble-based prompting for interactive surgical scene segmentation, adding a lightweight Scribble Encoder compatible with SAM's mask decoder. Enables iterative refinement through corrective freehand strokes.

entry.title: CAMO: A Conditional Neural Solver for the Multi-objective Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem

author.name: Fengxiaoxiao Li, Xiao Mao, Mingfeng Fan, Yifeng Zhang, Yi Li, Tanishq Duhan, Guillaume Sartoretti
