entry.summary: SLowRL combines LoRA-based fine-tuning with safety-constrained recovery policies for safely adapting sim-trained locomotion policies directly on real robot hardware.

entry.title: KineVLA: Towards Kinematics-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models with Bi-Level Action Decomposition

author.name: Gaoge Han, Zhengqing Gao, Ziwen Li, Jiaxin Huang, Shaoli Huang, Fakhri Karray, Mingming Gong, Tongliang Liu

entry.summary: KineVLA introduces a kinematics-rich VLA task with dense kinematic attribute encoding in language commands and proposes a bi-level action decomposition framework separating goal-level and kinematics-level processing.

entry.title: VolumeDP: Modeling Volumetric Representation for Manipulation Policy Learning

author.name: Tianxing Zhou, Feiyang Xue, Zhangchen Ye, Tianyuan Yuan, Hang Zhao, Tao Jiang

entry.summary: VolumeDP lifts 2D image features into volumetric 3D representations for robot manipulation policy learning, selecting task-relevant voxels as spatial tokens for action prediction, resolving 2D-3D mismatch.

entry.title: NextMem: Towards Latent Factual Memory for LLM-based Agents

author.name: Zeyu Zhang, Rui Li, Xiaoyan Zhao, Yang Zhang, Wenjie Wang, Xu Chen, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Introduces NextMem, a latent factual memory framework for LLM-based agents using an autoregressive autoencoder. It proposes a two-stage training process to construct latent memory efficiently while avoiding catastrophic forgetting and heavy context burdens.

entry.title: AsgardBench - Evaluating Visually Grounded Interactive Planning Under Minimal Feedback

author.name: Andrea Tupini, Lars Liden, Reuben Tan, Yu Wang, Jianfeng Gao

entry.summary: Introduces AsgardBench for evaluating visually grounded interactive planning under minimal feedback, focusing on plan adaptation during execution based on visual observations rather than navigation or manipulation.

entry.title: BenchPreS: A Benchmark for Context-Aware Personalized Preference Selectivity of Persistent-Memory LLMs

author.name: Sangyeon Yoon, Sunkyoung Kim, Hyesoo Hong, Wonje Jeung, Yongil Kim, Wooseok Seo, Heuiyeen Yeen, Albert No

entry.summary: Introduces BenchPreS to evaluate whether persistent-memory LLMs appropriately apply or suppress user preferences across communication contexts, finding even frontier models struggle with context-sensitive preference application.

entry.title: Runtime Governance for AI Agents: Policies on Paths

author.name: Maurits Kaptein, Vassilis-Javed Khan, Andriy Podstavnychy

entry.summary: Proposes runtime governance for AI agents by formalizing compliance policies as functions over execution paths, arguing that prompt-level instructions and static access control are insufficient for non-deterministic agent behavior.

entry.title: SocialOmni: Benchmarking Audio-Visual Social Interactivity in Omni Models

author.name: Tianyu Xie, Jinfa Huang, Yuexiao Ma, Rongfang Luo, Yan Yang, Wang Chen, Yuhui Zeng, Ruize Fang, Yixuan Zou, Xiawu Zheng, Jiebo Luo, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Introduces SocialOmni, a benchmark evaluating social interactivity in omnimodal models across speaker identification, interruption timing, and natural interruption generation. Fills a gap in evaluating conversational dynamics rather than just static accuracy.

entry.title: This Is Taking Too Long -- Investigating Time as a Proxy for Energy Consumption of LLMs

author.name: Lars Krupp, Daniel Gei{\ss}ler, Francisco M. Calatrava-Nicolas, Vishal Banwari, Paul Lukowicz, Jakob Karolus

entry.summary: Investigates inference time as a proxy for energy consumption of API-based LLMs, showing that time measurements can help infer GPU models and estimate energy costs when direct measurements are unavailable.

entry.title: SEMAG: Self-Evolutionary Multi-Agent Code Generation

author.name: Yulin Peng, Haowen Hou, Xinxin Zhu, Ying Tiffany He, F. Richard Yu

entry.summary: Proposes SEMAG, a self-evolutionary multi-agent code generation framework that adapts workflows to task difficulty and can automatically upgrade backbone models, achieving SOTA Pass@1 accuracy on coding benchmarks.

entry.title: 100x Cost & Latency Reduction: Performance Analysis of AI Query Approximation using Lightweight Proxy Models

author.name: Yeounoh Chung, Rushabh Desai, Jian He, Yu Xiao, Thibaud Hottelier, Yves-Laurent Kom Samo, Pushkar Kadilkar, Xianshun Chen, Sam Idicula, Fatma \"Ozcan, Alon Halevy, Yannis Papakonstantinou

entry.summary: Evaluates lightweight proxy models for approximating expensive LLM-based AI queries in databases, demonstrating 100x cost and latency reduction while maintaining acceptable accuracy for analytics applications.

entry.title: ASDA: Automated Skill Distillation and Adaptation for Financial Reasoning

author.name: Tik Yu Yim, Wenting Tan, Sum Yee Chan, Tak-Wah Lam, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Introduces ASDA, a training-free framework that automatically generates structured skill artifacts through iterative error-corrective learning for financial reasoning, where a teacher model analyzes a student model's failures and clusters errors by subfield.

entry.title: When Generative Augmentation Hurts: A Benchmark Study of GAN and Diffusion Models for Bias Correction in AI Classification Systems

author.name: Shesh Narayan Gupta, Nik Bear Brown

entry.summary: Controlled benchmark comparing traditional augmentation, FastGAN, and LoRA-finetuned Stable Diffusion for bias correction in classification. Finds FastGAN actively increases classifier bias at low data sizes (+20.7% bias gap, Cohen's d=5.03).

entry.title: VisBrowse-Bench: Benchmarking Visual-Native Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents

author.name: Zhengbo Zhang, Jinbo Su, Zhaowen Zhou, Changtao Miao, Yuhan Hong, Qimeng Wu, Yumeng Liu, Feier Wu, Yihe Tian, Yuhao Liang, Zitong Shan, Wanke Xia, Yi-Fan Zhang, Bo Zhang, Zhe Li, Shiming Xiang, Ying Yan

entry.summary: Introduces VisBrowse-Bench, a benchmark for visual-native search by multimodal browsing agents with 169 VQA instances requiring text-image cross-validation and joint reasoning during web search.

entry.title: Trained Persistent Memory for Frozen Encoder--Decoder LLMs: Six Architectural Methods

author.name: Hong Jeong

entry.summary: Proof-of-concept pilot study on persistent memory in frozen encoder-decoder LLMs via six architectural methods using continuous latent space. Memory writes and reads are differentiable operations on dense vectors, persisting across sessions without gradient updates.

entry.title: EngGPT2: Sovereign, Efficient and Open Intelligence

author.name: G. Ciarfaglia, A. Rosanova, S. Cipolla, J. Bartoli, A. Di Domenico, C. Fioroni, A. Fontana, M. R. Scoleri, M. I. Mone, D. Franchi, M. C. Del Gaudio, F. Picariello, M. Gabusi, S. Bonura, V. Morreale, I. Bailo

entry.summary: Presents EngGPT2-16B-A3B, an Italian MoE LLM trained from scratch on 2.5T tokens with 16B parameters (3B active), achieving competitive performance to 8B-16B dense models with significantly less compute and training data.

entry.title: EmoLLM: Appraisal-Grounded Cognitive-Emotional Co-Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yifei Zhang, Mingyang Li, Henry Gao, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes EmoLLM, an appraisal-theory-grounded framework for IQ/EQ co-reasoning in LLMs using an Appraisal Reasoning Graph to structure reasoning over user needs, appraisal dimensions, emotional states, and response strategies.

entry.title: Federated Learning with Multi-Partner OneFlorida+ Consortium Data for Predicting Major Postoperative Complications

author.name: Yuanfang Ren, Varun Sai Vemuri, Zhenhong Hu, Benjamin Shickel, Ziyuan Guan, Tyler J. Loftus, Parisa Rashidi, Tezcan Ozrazgat-Baslanti, Azra Bihorac

entry.summary: Develops federated learning models for predicting postoperative complications using data from 358K patients across five healthcare institutions. Demonstrates robust generalizability while preserving data privacy across the OneFlorida Data Trust.

entry.title: SparkVSR: Interactive Video Super-Resolution via Sparse Keyframe Propagation

author.name: Jiongze Yu, Xiangbo Gao, Pooja Verlani, Akshay Gadde, Yilin Wang, Balu Adsumilli, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Proposes SparkVSR, an interactive video super-resolution framework where users can control the process by super-resolving sparse keyframes, which are then propagated to the full video sequence.

entry.title: Formal verification of tree-based machine learning models for lateral spreading

author.name: Krishna Kumar

entry.summary: Encodes trained tree ensemble models as logical formulas in SMT solvers to formally verify physical consistency properties across the entire input domain. Applied to geotechnical lateral spreading prediction.

entry.title: SENSE: Efficient EEG-to-Text via Privacy-Preserving Semantic Retrieval

author.name: Akshaj Murhekar, Christina Liu, Abhijit Mishra, Shounak Roychowdhury, Jacek Gwizdka

entry.summary: Introduces SENSE, a lightweight privacy-preserving framework for EEG-to-text translation without LLM fine-tuning. Decouples decoding into on-device semantic retrieval and prompt-based language generation.

entry.title: On the Cone Effect and Modality Gap in Medical Vision-Language Embeddings

author.name: David Restrepo, Miguel L Martins, Chenwei Wu, Luis Filipe Nakayama, Diego M Lopez, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Enzo Ferrante

entry.summary: Studies the cone effect and modality gap in medical vision-language models. Introduces a lightweight post-hoc mechanism with a single hyperparameter to control cross-modal separation without retraining.

entry.title: Large-Scale 3D Ground-Motion Synthesis with Physics-Inspired Latent Operator Flow Matching

author.name: Yaozhong Shi, Grigorios Lavrentiadis, Konstantinos Tsalouchidis, Zachary E. Ross, David McCallen, Caifeng Zou, Kamyar Azizzadenesheli, Domniki Asimaki

entry.summary: Introduces GMFlow, a physics-inspired latent operator flow matching framework for generating large-scale regional ground-motion time histories conditioned on physical earthquake parameters. Validated on San Francisco Bay Area scenarios.

entry.title: The Phasor Transformer: Resolving Attention Bottlenecks on the Unit Circle

author.name: Dibakar Sigdel

entry.summary: Introduces the Phasor Transformer, representing sequence states on the unit circle with DFT-based token coupling achieving O(N log N) global mixing. Validated on synthetic time-series benchmarks.

entry.title: Baguan-TS: A Sequence-Native In-Context Learning Model for Time Series Forecasting with Covariates

author.name: Linxiao Yang, Xue Jiang, Gezheng Xu, Tian Zhou, Min Yang, ZhaoYang Zhu, Linyuan Geng, Zhipeng Zeng, Qiming Chen, Xinyue Gu, Rong Jin, Liang Sun

entry.summary: Baguan-TS introduces a sequence-native in-context learning model for time series forecasting using a 3D Transformer that jointly attends over temporal, variable, and context axes. It addresses the gap between ICL approaches using hand-crafted features and end-to-end models lacking adaptation.

entry.title: ARES: Scalable and Practical Gradient Inversion Attack in Federated Learning through Activation Recovery

author.name: Zirui Gong, Leo Yu Zhang, Yanjun Zhang, Viet Vo, Tianqing Zhu, Shirui Pan, Cong Wang

entry.summary: ARES introduces a scalable active gradient inversion attack on federated learning that reconstructs training samples from large batches without requiring architectural modifications, unlike existing approaches.

entry.title: Dependence Fidelity and Downstream Inference Stability in Generative Models

author.name: Nazia Riasat

entry.summary: Introduces covariance-level dependence fidelity as a criterion for evaluating generative models, showing that marginal distribution matching is insufficient and that dependence structure preservation affects downstream inference stability.

entry.title: Physics-informed offline reinforcement learning eliminates catastrophic fuel waste in maritime routing

author.name: Aniruddha Bora, Julie Chalfant, Chryssostomos Chryssostomidis

entry.summary: Presents PIER, an offline RL framework for fuel-efficient maritime routing that learns from physics-calibrated environments grounded in historical vessel data. Reduces mean CO2 emissions by 10% and eliminates catastrophic fuel waste events on Gulf of Mexico routes.

entry.title: Multi-Armed Sequential Hypothesis Testing by Betting

author.name: Ricardo J. Sandoval, Ian Waudby-Smith, Michael I. Jordan

entry.summary: Develops multi-armed sequential hypothesis testing using e-processes and betting strategies, seeking tests that perform well even with oracle knowledge of which arm is non-null, with applications to adaptive clinical trials.

entry.title: Agent-based imitation dynamics can yield efficiently compressed population-level vocabularies

author.name: Nathaniel Imel, Richard Futrell, Michael Franke, Noga Zaslavsky

entry.summary: Provides a unified model integrating evolutionary game theory with the Information Bottleneck framework, showing how near-optimal compression can arise in agent populations through imitation dynamics, explaining how languages evolve efficient vocabularies.

entry.title: AdaMem: Adaptive User-Centric Memory for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents

author.name: Shannan Yan, Jingchen Ni, Leqi Zheng, Jiajun Zhang, Peixi Wu, Dacheng Yin, Jing Lyu, Chun Yuan, Fengyun Rao

entry.summary: Proposes AdaMem, an adaptive memory framework for long-horizon dialogue agents organizing history into working, episodic, persona, and graph memories with adaptive granularity for different question types.

entry.title: Domain Mixture Design via Log-Likelihood Differences for Aligning Language Models with a Target Model

author.name: Ryo Kishino, Riku Shiomi, Hiroaki Yamagiwa, Momose Oyama, Hidetoshi Shimodaira

entry.summary: Proposes a method for aligning a base language model with a target model by designing domain mixture weights for pretraining data, using log-likelihood space geometry to determine optimal training directions. Offers an alternative to direct knowledge distillation.

entry.title: EmergeNav: Structured Embodied Inference for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments

author.name: Kun Luo, Xiaoguang Ma

entry.summary: Proposes EmergeNav, a zero-shot framework for continuous vision-and-language navigation that formulates VLN as structured embodied inference with Plan-Solve-Transition hierarchy and goal-conditioned perceptual extraction.

entry.title: EvoGuard: An Extensible Agentic RL-based Framework for Practical and Evolving AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Chenyang Zhu, Maorong Wang, Jun Liu, Ching-Chun Chang, Isao Echizen

entry.summary: Proposes EvoGuard, an agentic framework for AI-generated image detection that encapsulates multiple SOTA detectors as callable tools and coordinates them through a learned policy for evolving real-world detection scenarios.

entry.title: Stereo World Model: Camera-Guided Stereo Video Generation

author.name: Yang-Tian Sun, Zehuan Huang, Yifan Niu, Lin Ma, Yan-Pei Cao, Yuewen Ma, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: StereoWorld presents a camera-conditioned stereo world model for end-to-end stereo video generation, operating purely in RGB while grounding geometry from disparity. Introduces camera-frame RoPE and stereo-aware attention decomposition for consistent binocular generation.

entry.title: Video Understanding: From Geometry and Semantics to Unified Models

author.name: Zhaochong An, Zirui Li, Mingqiao Ye, Feng Qiao, Jiaang Li, Zongwei Wu, Vishal Thengane, Chengzu Li, Lei Li, Luc Van Gool, Guolei Sun, Serge Belongie

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on video understanding organized into three perspectives: low-level geometry, high-level semantics, and unified models. Highlights shift from task-specific pipelines to unified modeling paradigms.

entry.title: Edit Spillover as a Probe: Do Image Editing Models Implicitly Understand World Relations?

author.name: Guandong Li, Zhaobin Chu

entry.summary: EditSpilloverProbe uses edit spillover in image editing models as a probe for implicit world understanding, proposing a taxonomy of spillover types and a framework to distinguish genuine world knowledge from attention leakage.

entry.title: Efficient and Reliable Teleoperation through Real-to-Sim-to-Real Shared Autonomy

author.name: Shuo Sha, Yixuan Wang, Binghao Huang, Antonio Loquerico, Yunzhu Li

entry.summary: Proposes a real-to-sim-to-real shared autonomy framework for teleoperation using a kNN human surrogate built from <5 minutes of real data, enabling stable RL training of corrective behaviors.

entry.title: DexEXO: A Wearability-First Dexterous Exoskeleton for Operator-Agnostic Demonstration and Learning

author.name: Alvin Zhu, Mingzhang Zhu, Beom Jun Kim, Jose Victor S. H. Ramos, Yike Shi, Yufeng Wu, Raayan Dhar, Fuyi Yang, Ruochen Hou, Hanzhang Fang, Quanyou Wang, Yuchen Cui, Dennis W. Hong

entry.summary: DexEXO is a wearability-first hand exoskeleton for cross-operator demonstration collection that aligns visual appearance, contact geometry, and kinematics at the hardware level, supporting diverse hand sizes.

entry.title: REAL: Robust Extreme Agility via Spatio-Temporal Policy Learning and Physics-Guided Filtering

author.name: Jialong Liu, Dehan Shen, Yanbo Wen, Zeyu Jiang, Changhao Chen

entry.summary: REAL proposes an end-to-end framework for robust legged parkour under sensory corruption, using a FiLM-modulated Mamba backbone to filter visual noise while maintaining extreme agility.

entry.title: ProbeFlow: Training-Free Adaptive Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zhou Fang, Jiaqi Wang, Yi Zhou, Qiongfeng Shi

entry.summary: ProbeFlow is a training-free adaptive inference framework for Vision-Language-Action models that dynamically schedules flow matching integration steps based on trajectory complexity, reducing latency.

entry.title: RoboForge: Physically Optimized Text-guided Whole-Body Locomotion for Humanoids

author.name: Xichen Yuan, Zhe Li, Bofan Lyu, Kuangji Zuo, Yanshuo Lu, Gen Li, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: RoboForge bridges text-to-motion generation and humanoid locomotion through a retarget-free, physics-optimized pipeline with Physical Plausibility Optimization coupling generation and control bidirectionally.

entry.title: An Auditable AI Agent Loop for Empirical Economics: A Case Study in Forecast Combination

author.name: Minchul Shin

entry.summary: Proposes an auditable AI agent loop for empirical economics where multiple independent agent runs with logged search and holdout evaluation make adaptive specification search transparent and reproducible.

entry.title: SQL-ASTRA: Alleviating Sparse Feedback in Agentic SQL via Column-Set Matching and Trajectory Aggregation

author.name: Long Li, Zhijian Zhou, Jiangxuan Long, Peiyang Liu, Weidi Xu, Zhe Wang, Shirui Pan, Chao Qu

entry.summary: Proposes SQL-ASTRA for agentic Text-to-SQL with a two-tiered reward mechanism: Aggregated Trajectory Reward for multi-turn credit assignment and column-set matching for dense step-level signals.

entry.title: Operator-Theoretic Foundations and Policy Gradient Methods for General MDPs with Unbounded Costs

author.name: Abhishek Gupta, Aditya Mahajan

entry.summary: Provides operator-theoretic foundations for policy gradient methods in general MDPs with unbounded costs, using perturbation theory of linear operators. Generalizes known RL results beyond finite-state settings and derives new PPO-type algorithms.

entry.title: Temporal Fact Conflicts in LLMs: Reproducibility Insights from Unifying DYNAMICQA and MULAN

author.name: Ritajit Dey, Iadh Ounis, Graham McDonald, Yashar Moshfeghi

entry.summary: Reproducibility study investigating conflicting findings from DYNAMICQA and MULAN on whether external context can resolve temporal fact conflicts in LLMs. Cross-reproduces both studies' experiments on each other's datasets to reconcile discrepancies.

entry.title: Omni-I2C: A Holistic Benchmark for High-Fidelity Image-to-Code Generation

author.name: Jiawei Zhou, Chi Zhang, Xiang Feng, Qiming Zhang, Haibo Qiu, Lihuo He, Dengpan Ye, Xinbo Gao, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Omni-I2C presents a benchmark evaluating Large Multimodal Models on converting complex digital graphics into executable code, requiring synergy between visual perception and code generation. Features 1080 curated examples testing holistic understanding.

entry.title: S-VGGT: Structure-Aware Subscene Decomposition for Scalable 3D Foundation Models

author.name: Xinze Li, Pengxu Chen, Yiyuan Wang, Weifeng Su, Wentao Cheng

entry.summary: S-VGGT addresses quadratic computational cost in feed-forward 3D foundation models by performing redundancy reduction at the structural frame level rather than token level. Builds dense scene graphs to characterize structural redundancy.

entry.title: Omni-3DEdit: Generalized Versatile 3D Editing in One-Pass

author.name: Chen Liyi, Wang Pengfei, Zhang Guowen, Ma Zhiyuan, Zhang Lei

entry.summary: Omni-3DEdit proposes a unified learning-based model for various 3D editing tasks (appearance, removal, etc.) in a single forward pass, avoiding task-dependent rules and iterative optimization of existing methods.

entry.title: Universal Skeleton Understanding via Differentiable Rendering and MLLMs

author.name: Ziyi Wang, Peiming Li, Xinshun Wang, Yang Tang, Kai-Kuang Ma, Mengyuan Liu

entry.summary: SkeletonLLM achieves universal skeleton understanding by translating arbitrary skeleton sequences into images via DrAction, a differentiable format-agnostic renderer, allowing MLLMs to process skeleton data in their native visual modality.

entry.title: How often do Answers Change? Estimating Recency Requirements in Question Answering

author.name: Bhawna Piryani, Zehra Mert, Adam Jatowt

entry.summary: Introduces a recency-stationarity taxonomy for QA, categorizing questions by how often their answers change and whether this is time-invariant, addressing LLMs' difficulty with temporal knowledge.

entry.title: AIDABench: AI Data Analytics Benchmark

author.name: Yibo Yang, Fei Lei, Yixuan Sun, Yantao Zeng, Chengguang Lv, Jiancao Hong, Jiaojiao Tian, Tianyu Qiu, Xin Wang, Yanbing Chen, Yanjie Li, Zheng Pan, Xiaochen Zhou, Guanzhou Chen, Haoran Lv, Yuning Xu, Yue Ou, Haodong Liu, Shiqi He, Anya Jia, Yulei Xin, Huan Wu, Liang Liu, Jiaye Ge, Jianxin Dong, Dahua Lin, Wenxiu Sun

entry.summary: Introduces AIDABench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating AI systems on complex data analytics tasks including question answering, data visualization, and file generation across 600+ document analysis tasks. Targets end-to-end evaluation gaps in existing benchmarks.

entry.title: I Know What I Don't Know: Latent Posterior Factor Models for Multi-Evidence Probabilistic Reasoning

author.name: Aliyu Agboola Alege

entry.summary: Introduces Latent Posterior Factors (LPF), a framework combining VAE latent posteriors with Sum-Product Network inference for tractable probabilistic reasoning over unstructured multi-evidence data with calibrated uncertainty.

entry.title: An Agentic Evaluation Framework for AI-Generated Scientific Code in PETSc

author.name: Hong Zhang, Barry Smith, Satish Balay, Le Chen, Murat Keceli, Lois Curfman McInnes, Junchao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces petscagent-bench, an agentic framework for evaluating AI-generated scientific code in PETSc using an agents-evaluating-agents paradigm with a 14-evaluator pipeline covering compilation, execution, and performance.

entry.title: MedCL-Bench: Benchmarking stability-efficiency trade-offs and scaling in biomedical continual learning

author.name: Min Zeng, Shuang Zhou, Zaifu Zhan, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MedCL-Bench, a benchmark streaming ten biomedical NLP datasets across five task families for evaluating eleven continual learning strategies with retention, transfer, and GPU-hour metrics.

entry.title: DASH: Dynamic Audio-Driven Semantic Chunking for Efficient Omnimodal Token Compression

author.name: Bingzhou Li, Tao Huang

entry.summary: Proposes DASH, a training-free token compression framework for omnimodal LLMs that uses audio embeddings as semantic anchors to detect boundaries and create variable-length segments for efficient compression.

entry.title: BadLLM-TG: A Backdoor Defender powered by LLM Trigger Generator

author.name: Ruyi Zhang, Heng Gao, Songlei Jian, Yusong Tan, Haifang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes BadLLM-TG, using LLMs as trigger generators for backdoor defense in NLP through prompt-driven reinforcement learning, with generated triggers used for adversarial training to mitigate backdoors.

entry.title: Tackling Over-smoothing on Hypergraphs: A Ricci Flow-guided Neural Diffusion Approach

author.name: Mengyao Zhou, Zhiheng Zhou, Xiao Han, Xingqin Qi, Guanghui Wang, Guiying Yan

entry.summary: Proposes Ricci Flow-guided Hypergraph Neural Diffusion (RFHND) to address over-smoothing in hypergraph neural networks by using discrete Ricci flow from differential geometry to regulate node feature evolution.

entry.title: When Stability Fails: Hidden Failure Modes Of LLMS in Data-Constrained Scientific Decision-Making

author.name: Nazia Riasat

entry.summary: Introduces a framework separating four dimensions of LLM decision-making (stability, correctness, prompt sensitivity, output validity) for scientific workflows, showing that stability doesn't guarantee correctness.

entry.title: Informationally Compressive Anonymization: Non-Degrading Sensitive Input Protection for Privacy-Preserving Supervised Machine Learning

author.name: Jeremy J Samuelson

entry.summary: Introduces Informationally Compressive Anonymization (ICA) and the VEIL architecture for privacy-preserving ML that transforms sensitive inputs through architectural design rather than noise injection or cryptography.

entry.title: LICA: Layered Image Composition Annotations for Graphic Design Research

author.name: Elad Hirsch, Shubham Yadav, Mohit Garg, Purvanshi Mehta

entry.summary: Introduces LICA, a large-scale dataset of 1.55M multi-layer graphic design compositions with rich per-element metadata (text, image, vector, group) spanning 20 design categories and 972K templates. Also introduces graphic design video as a challenge for VLMs.

entry.title: Generative AI for Quantum Circuits and Quantum Code: A Technical Review and Taxonomy

author.name: Juhani Merilehto

entry.summary: Reviews 13 generative systems and 5 datasets for quantum circuit/code generation, organizing the field by artifact type and training regime. Finds no system reports end-to-end hardware executability evaluation.

entry.title: Visual Prompt Discovery via Semantic Exploration

author.name: Jaechang Kim, Yotaro Shimose, Zhao Wang, Kuang-Da Wang, Jungseul Ok, Shingo Takamatsu

entry.summary: Proposes an automated semantic exploration framework for discovering visual prompts (image manipulations) that mitigate LVLM perception failures, replacing manual trial-and-error with systematic search.

entry.title: Robust Physics-Guided Diffusion for Full-Waveform Inversion

author.name: Jishen Peng, Enze Jiang, Zheng Ma, Xiongbin Yan

entry.summary: Develops a robust physics-guided diffusion framework for full-waveform inversion combining score-based generative priors with Wasserstein-2 data consistency and preconditioned guided reverse-diffusion for stable inference.

entry.title: SF-Mamba: Rethinking State Space Model for Vision

author.name: Masakazu Yoshimura, Teruaki Hayashi, Yuki Hoshino, Wei-Yao Wang, Takeshi Ohashi

entry.summary: Rethinks Mamba's scan operation for vision, addressing non-causal interaction limitations and slow speed under short token lengths. Proposes SF-Mamba as an efficient alternative to Vision Transformers.

entry.title: From Language to Action in Arabic: Reliable Structured Tool Calling via Data-Centric Fine-Tuning

author.name: Omer Nacar, Deema Alquffari, Saleh Alsharideh, Adeem AlOtaibi, Abdulaziz Alabdulkarim, Leen Alhazmi, Nada Alomar, Wareef Alzubaidi, Nada Alsultan, Ahmed Alrabghi, Demah Alhoshan, Rana Alsayyari, Hamed Alruwaili, Albaraa Jaafar, Khaled Alusmani, Abdulaziz Alsohimy, Munirah Alsubaie, Shahd Aldukhayil, Arwa Alali, Yazeed BinShihah, Razan Alsulaymi, Nourah Alhumaid, Razan Abdulsalam, Reem Alamoudi, Mohammed Alkhalifa

entry.summary: Presents AISA-AR-FunctionCall, a production-oriented Arabic function-calling framework built on a 270M-parameter backbone. Fine-tuning reduces parse failures from 87% to below 1% for Arabic tool calling.

entry.title: Topology-Preserving Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding for Semantic Communication

author.name: Omar Erak, Omar Alhussein, Fang Fang, Sami Muhaidat

entry.summary: Proposes TopoJSCC, a topology-aware deep joint source-channel coding framework that preserves global structural information using persistent-homology regularizers for wireless vision applications.

entry.title: Causal Representation Learning on High-Dimensional Data: Benchmarks, Reproducibility, and Evaluation Metrics

author.name: Alireza Sadeghi, Wael AbdAlmageed

entry.summary: Provides comprehensive benchmarking of causal representation learning models, analyzing evaluation metrics across reconstruction, disentanglement, causal discovery, and counterfactual reasoning dimensions.

entry.title: Unsupervised Symbolic Anomaly Detection

author.name: Md Maruf Hossain, Tim Katzke, Simon Kl\"uttermann, Emmanuel M\"uller

entry.summary: SYRAN uses symbolic regression for unsupervised anomaly detection, learning human-readable equations that describe invariants constant on normal data. Deviations from these invariants serve as anomaly scores, providing interpretability by construction.

entry.title: DSS-GAN: Directional State Space GAN with Mamba backbone for Class-Conditional Image Synthesis

author.name: Aleksander Ogonowski, Konrad Klimaszewski, Przemys{\l}aw Rokita

entry.summary: DSS-GAN is the first GAN to use Mamba as a hierarchical generator backbone for image synthesis, introducing Directional Latent Routing (DLR) for class conditioning that decomposes latent vectors into direction-specific subvectors.

entry.title: Embedding World Knowledge into Tabular Models: Towards Best Practices for Embedding Pipeline Design

author.name: Oksana Kolomenko, Ricardo Knauer, Erik Rodner

entry.summary: Systematically benchmarks 256 LLM-based embedding pipeline configurations for tabular prediction, covering preprocessing strategies, embedding models, and downstream models. Finds that concatenating embeddings outperforms replacing original columns.

entry.title: Rewarding DINO: Predicting Dense Rewards with Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Pierre Krack, Tobias J\"ulg, Wolfram Burgard, Florian Walter

entry.summary: Rewarding DINO predicts dense reward functions for robot manipulation from camera images using DINOv2 vision foundation model features, without requiring privileged state information or being biased toward specific demonstrations.

entry.title: Self-Regularized Learning Methods

author.name: Max Sch\"olpple, Liu Fanghui, Ingo Steinwart

entry.summary: Introduces a general framework for analyzing self-regularized learning algorithms, capturing implicit complexity control without explicit regularization. Covers both regularized ERM and gradient descent, providing minimax-optimal guarantees.

entry.title: Anonymous-by-Construction: An LLM-Driven Framework for Privacy-Preserving Text

author.name: Federico Albanese, Pablo Ronco, Nicol\'as D'Ippolito

entry.summary: Proposes an on-premise LLM-driven pipeline for anonymizing text by replacing PII with realistic surrogates, preventing data egress while preserving fluency. Benchmarks against Microsoft Presidio and Google DLP on the Action-Based Conversation Dataset.

entry.title: BANGLASOCIALBENCH: A Benchmark for Evaluating Sociopragmatic and Cultural Alignment of LLMs in Bangladeshi Social Interaction

author.name: Tanvir Ahmed Sijan, S. M Golam Rifat, Pankaj Chowdhury Partha, Md. Tanjeed Islam, Md. Musfique Anwar

entry.summary: Introduces BANGLASOCIALBENCH, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM sociopragmatic competence in Bangla, testing social hierarchy sensitivity, kinship reasoning, and culturally embedded customs rather than factual recall.

entry.title: POLAR:A Per-User Association Test in Embedding Space

author.name: Pedro Bento, Arthur Buzelin, Arthur Chagas, Yan Aquino, Victoria Estanislau, Samira Malaquias, Pedro Robles Dutenhefner, Gisele L. Pappa, Virgilio Almeida, Wagner MeiraJr

entry.summary: Presents POLAR, a per-user lexical association test in embedding space using private deterministic tokens to detect biases and associations at the individual author level, successfully separating bots from humans on Twitter.

entry.title: PashtoCorp: A 1.25-Billion-Word Corpus, Evaluation Suite, and Reproducible Pipeline for Low-Resource Language Development

author.name: Hanif Rahman

entry.summary: Presents PashtoCorp, a 1.25-billion-word Pashto corpus (40x larger than OSCAR Pashto) from 39 sources with reproducible pipeline, showing 25% perplexity reduction and 10% NER F1 improvement when used for continued pretraining of XLM-R.

entry.title: SpokenUS: A Spoken User Simulator for Task-Oriented Dialogue

author.name: Jonggeun Lee, Junseong Pyo, Jeongmin Park, Yohan Jo

entry.summary: Introduces SpokenTOD, a 52K-dialogue spoken task-oriented dataset augmented with realistic spoken behaviors (barge-in, disfluency, emotional prosody), and SpokenUS, a spoken user simulator that can generate diverse speech interactions for training dialogue agents.

entry.title: Chronos: Temporal-Aware Conversational Agents with Structured Event Retrieval for Long-Term Memory

author.name: Sahil Sen, Elias Lumer, Anmol Gulati, Vamse Kumar Subbiah

entry.summary: Introduces Chronos, a temporal-aware memory framework for conversational agents that decomposes dialogue into structured event tuples with datetime ranges, enabling multi-hop time-sensitive retrieval over long conversation histories.

entry.title: How to Utilize Complementary Vision-Text Information for 2D Structure Understanding

author.name: Jiancheng Dong, Pengyue Jia, Derong Xu, Jiawei Cheng, Jingyu Peng, Chao Zhang, Bowen Liu, Xin Sun, Lixin Su, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin, Xiangyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes DiVA-Former for integrating vision and text information for 2D table understanding, using visual tokens as dynamic queries to distill textual sequences and addressing cross-modal interference that limits naive fusion approaches.

entry.title: Symphony: A Cognitively-Inspired Multi-Agent System for Long-Video Understanding

author.name: Haiyang Yan, Hongyun Zhou, Peng Xu, Xiaoxue Feng, Mengyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Symphony, a cognitively-inspired multi-agent system for long-form video understanding that emulates human cognition patterns with fine-grained task decomposition and deep reasoning collaboration enhanced by reflection.

entry.title: Recurrent Reasoning with Vision-Language Models for Estimating Long-Horizon Embodied Task Progress

author.name: Yuelin Zhang, Sijie Cheng, Chen Li, Zongzhao Li, Yuxin Huang, Yang Liu, Wenbing Huang

entry.summary: Proposes R²VLM for estimating task progress in long-horizon embodied tasks using recurrent reasoning over local video snippets with evolving Chain of Thought that maintains global context.

entry.title: SHIFT: Motion Alignment in Video Diffusion Models with Adversarial Hybrid Fine-Tuning

author.name: Xi Ye, Wenjia Yang, Yangyang Xu, Xiaoyang Liu, Duo Su, Mengfei Xia, Jun Zhu

entry.summary: SHIFT introduces pixel-motion rewards and Smooth Hybrid Fine-tuning for motion alignment in video diffusion models post-training. Fuses supervised and advantage-weighted fine-tuning with adversarial advantages to improve motion fidelity.

entry.title: AdaZoom-GUI: Adaptive Zoom-based GUI Grounding with Instruction Refinement

author.name: Siqi Pei, Liang Tang, Tiaonan Duan, Long Chen, Shuxian Li, Kaer Huang, Yanzhe Jing, Yiqiang Yan, Bo Zhang, Chenghao Jiang, Borui Zhang, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: AdaZoom-GUI proposes an adaptive zoom-based framework for GUI grounding in VLMs, with instruction refinement to rewrite ambiguous commands and conditional zoom for precise element localization in high-resolution screenshots.

entry.title: Rel-Zero: Harnessing Patch-Pair Invariance for Robust Zero-Watermarking Against AI Editing

author.name: Pengzhen Chen, Yanwei Liu, Xiaoyan Gu, Xiaojun Chen, Wu Liu, Weiping Wang

entry.summary: Rel-Zero proposes relational zero-watermarking that exploits the invariance of patch-pair relational distances under AI editing. Discovers that while individual patches change during diffusion-based editing, inter-patch relations remain stable.

entry.title: Edit-As-Act: Goal-Regressive Planning for Open-Vocabulary 3D Indoor Scene Editing

author.name: Seongrae Noh, SeungWon Seo, Gyeong-Moon Park, HyeongYeop Kang

entry.summary: Edit-As-Act reframes 3D scene editing as goal-regressive planning, where user instructions define desired world states and editing finds minimal action sequences to achieve them. Open-vocabulary approach preserving spatial consistency.

entry.title: Does YOLO Really Need to See Every Training Image in Every Epoch?

author.name: Xingxing Xie, Jiahua Dong, Junwei Han, Gong Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Anti-Forgetting Sampling Strategy for YOLO training that dynamically determines which images to use or skip each epoch, measuring learning progress per sample. Potentially significant training efficiency gains.

entry.title: Concept-to-Pixel: Prompt-Free Universal Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Haoyun Chen, Fenghe Tang, Wenxin Ma, Shaohua Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Concept-to-Pixel (C2P) proposes prompt-free universal medical image segmentation, separating anatomical knowledge into geometric and semantic representations. Uses MLLMs to distill medical concepts into learnable tokens.

entry.title: M2P: Improving Visual Foundation Models with Mask-to-Point Weakly-Supervised Learning for Dense Point Tracking

author.name: Qiangqiang Wu, Tianyu Yang, Bo Fang, Jia Wan, Matias Di Martino, Guillermo Sapiro, Antoni B. Chan

entry.summary: M2P proposes Mask-to-Point learning to improve Vision Foundation Models for dense point tracking by leveraging video object segmentation mask annotations, introducing three mask-based constraints for weakly-supervised representation learning.

entry.title: SegFly: A 2D-3D-2D Paradigm for Aerial RGB-Thermal Semantic Segmentation at Scale

author.name: Markus Gross, Sai Bharadhwaj Matha, Rui Song, Viswanathan Muthuveerappan, Conrad Christoph, Julius Huber, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: SegFly proposes a 2D-3D-2D paradigm for scaling aerial RGB-Thermal semantic segmentation by propagating labels from <3% manually annotated images through 3D point clouds to all views. This dramatically reduces annotation cost for UAV datasets.

entry.title: DancingBox: A Lightweight MoCap System for Character Animation from Physical Proxies

author.name: Haocheng Yuan, Adrien Bousseau, Hao Pan, Lei Zhong, Changjian Li

entry.summary: DancingBox enables accessible motion capture for character animation using everyday objects as proxies manipulated in front of a webcam, with a generative motion model refining coarse proxy motions into realistic animations.

entry.title: Contingency-Aware Planning via Certified Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability

author.name: Kasidit Muenprasitivej, Derya Aksaray

entry.summary: Presents a contingency-aware navigation framework combining Fourier Neural Operator-based Hamilton-Jacobi reachability with sampling-based planning, providing formal safety guarantees for multi-goal navigation.

entry.title: TeleDex: Accessible Dexterous Teleoperation

author.name: Omar Rayyan, Maximilian Gillesm, Yuchen Cui

entry.summary: TeleDex is an open-source system for teleoperating dexterous robot hands using any phone, streaming 6-DoF wrist poses and 21-DoF hand states with low latency.

entry.title: OmniVLN: Omnidirectional 3D Perception and Token-Efficient LLM Reasoning for Visual-Language Navigation across Air and Ground Platforms

author.name: Zhongyuang Liu, Min He, Shaonan Yu, Xinhang Xu, Muqing Cao, Jianping Li, Jianfei Yang, Lihua Xie

entry.summary: OmniVLN combines omnidirectional 3D perception with token-efficient hierarchical LLM reasoning for zero-shot visual-language navigation across both aerial and ground platforms.

entry.title: FloorPlan-VLN: A New Paradigm for Floor Plan Guided Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Kehan Chen, Yan Huang, Dong An, Jiawei He, Yifei Su, Jing Liu, Nianfeng Liu, Liang Wang

entry.summary: FloorPlan-VLN introduces a new navigation paradigm using structured semantic floor plans as global spatial priors, constructing a 10k+ episode dataset with annotated floor plans for vision-language navigation.

entry.title: DexViTac: Collecting Human Visuo-Tactile-Kinematic Demonstrations for Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Xitong Chen, Yifeng Pan, Min Li, Xiaotian Ding

entry.summary: DexViTac is a portable data collection system capturing first-person vision, high-density tactile sensing, end-effector poses, and hand kinematics for contact-rich dexterous manipulation demonstrations.

entry.title: L4acados: Learning-based models for acados, applied to Gaussian process-based predictive control

author.name: Amon Lahr, Joshua N\"af, Kim P. Wabersich, Jonathan Frey, Pascal Siehl, Andrea Carron, Moritz Diehl, Melanie N. Zeilinger

entry.summary: L4acados provides a general framework for incorporating Python-based learning models (neural networks, Gaussian processes) into the real-time optimal control software acados for model predictive control.

entry.title: Real-Time Online Learning for Model Predictive Control using a Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Process Approximation

author.name: Lars Bartels, Amon Lahr, Andrea Carron, Melanie N. Zeilinger

entry.summary: Presents an efficient spatio-temporal Gaussian process approximation for real-time online learning in model predictive control, achieving constant computational complexity for online dynamics learning.

entry.title: Selective Memory for Artificial Intelligence: Write-Time Gating with Hierarchical Archiving

author.name: Oliver Zahn, Simran Chana

entry.summary: Proposes write-time gating for AI memory that filters incoming knowledge using composite salience scores while maintaining version chains, achieving 100% accuracy vs 13% for ungated stores under distractor scaling.

entry.title: V-DyKnow: A Dynamic Benchmark for Time-Sensitive Knowledge in Vision Language Models

author.name: Seyed Mahed Mousavi, Christian Moiola, Massimo Rizzoli, Simone Alghisi, Giuseppe Riccardi

entry.summary: Presents V-DyKnow, a benchmark for evaluating time-sensitive factual knowledge in Vision-Language Models, analyzing reliability across modalities and efficacy of knowledge editing and multimodal RAG for updates.

entry.title: Identifying Latent Actions and Dynamics from Offline Data via Demonstrator Diversity

author.name: Felix Schur

entry.summary: Studies recovery of latent actions and environment dynamics from action-free offline trajectories tagged with demonstrator identity. Shows the problem reduces to nonnegative matrix factorization and provides identifiability conditions.

entry.title: Flow Matching Policy with Entropy Regularization

author.name: Ting Gao, Stavros Orfanoudakis, Nan Lin, Elvin Isufi, Winnie Daamen, Serge Hoogendoorn

entry.summary: FMER proposes flow matching-based policies with entropy regularization for online RL, using ODE-based sampling along straight probability paths. Overcomes the computational issues of SDE-based diffusion policies.

entry.title: Text-to-Stage: Spatial Layouts from Long-form Narratives

author.name: Jefferson Hernandez, Swarnadeep Saha, Chenxi Whitehouse, Sanjeel Parekh, Calvin Murdock, Yuliang Li, W. Owen Brimijoin, Vamsi Krishna Ithapu, Ishwarya Ananthabhotla

entry.summary: Studies the narrative-to-play task: inferring stage-play layouts from text without explicit spatial cues. Introduces a dramaturgy-inspired evaluation suite and a training recipe combining rejection SFT with RL from verifiable rewards (GRPO).

entry.title: RECOVER: Robust Entity Correction via agentic Orchestration of hypothesis Variants for Evidence-based Recovery

author.name: Abhishek Kumar, Aashraya Sachdeva

entry.summary: Introduces RECOVER, an agentic framework for correcting ASR entity recognition errors using multiple hypothesis strategies and LLM correction under constraints, evaluated across five diverse domains.

entry.title: Tokenization Tradeoffs in Structured EHR Foundation Models

author.name: Lin Lawrence Guo, Santiago Eduardo Arciniegas, Joseph Jihyung Lee, Adam Paul Yan, George Tomlinson, Jason Fries, Lillian Sung

entry.summary: Studies tokenization design choices for structured EHR foundation models through a factorial experiment, varying event encoding, time encoding, and workflow annotation. Finds that tokenization significantly impacts both downstream performance and computational efficiency.

entry.title: MSRAMIE: Multimodal Structured Reasoning Agent for Multi-instruction Image Editing

author.name: Zhaoyuan Qiu, Ken Chen, Xiangwei Wang, Yu Xia, Sachith Seneviratne, Saman Halgamuge

entry.summary: Proposes MSRAMIE, a training-free agent framework for multi-instruction image editing that uses MLLM-based reasoning to decompose complex editing instructions and orchestrate existing editing models iteratively.

entry.title: VisionNVS: Self-Supervised Inpainting for Novel View Synthesis under the Virtual-Shift Paradigm

author.name: Hongbo Lu, Liang Yao, Chenghao He, Fan Liu, Wenlong Liao, Tao He, Pai Peng

entry.summary: VisionNVS reformulates novel view synthesis for autonomous driving from an extrapolation problem into a self-supervised inpainting task using a 'Virtual-Shift' strategy with monocular depth proxies. Eliminates domain gap by using recorded images as supervision.

entry.title: PanoVGGT: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Panoramic Imagery

author.name: Yijing Guo, Mengjun Chao, Luo Wang, Tianyang Zhao, Haizhao Dai, Yingliang Zhang, Jingyi Yu, Yujiao Shi

entry.summary: PanoVGGT introduces a Transformer framework for joint pose estimation, depth prediction, and 3D reconstruction from panoramic images in a single forward pass. Incorporates spherical-aware positional embeddings and panorama-specific SO(3) augmentation.

entry.title: Few-Step Diffusion Sampling Through Instance-Aware Discretizations

author.name: Liangyu Yuan, Ruoyu Wang, Tong Zhao, Dingwen Fu, Mingkun Lei, Beier Zhu, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes instance-aware discretization for few-step diffusion sampling, adapting timestep schedules per sample rather than using globally shared schedules. Addresses the limitation that uniform treatment ignores instance-specific complexity.

entry.title: The Truth, the Whole Truth, and Nothing but the Truth: Automatic Visualization Evaluation from Reconstruction Quality

author.name: Roxana Bujack, Li-Ta Lo, Ethan Stam, Ayan Biswas, David Rogers

entry.summary: Proposes an automated metric for evaluating AI-generated visualizations by measuring how well the original data can be reconstructed from the visualization, eliminating need for human-labeled evaluation datasets.

entry.title: VIGIL: Towards Edge-Extended Agentic AI for Enterprise IT Support

author.name: Sarthak Ahuja, Neda Kordjazi, Evren Yortucboylu, Vishaal Kapoor, Mariam Dundua, Yiming Li, Derek Ho, Vaibhavi Padala, Jennifer Whitted, Rebecca Steinert

entry.summary: Presents VIGIL, an edge-extended agentic AI system deploying desktop-resident agents for enterprise IT support, reducing interaction rounds by 39% and achieving 82% self-service resolution in a 10-week pilot.

entry.title: One-Step Sampler for Boltzmann Distributions via Drifting

author.name: Wenhan Cao, Keyu Yan, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: Presents a one-step neural generator for sampling Boltzmann distributions using a drifting-based framework with Gaussian-smoothed score fields. Derives practical estimators for targets with unknown normalization constants.

entry.title: Shot-Aware Frame Sampling for Video Understanding

author.name: Mengyu Zhao, Di Fu, Yongyu Xie, Jiaxing Zhang, Zhigang Yuan, Shirin Jalali, Yong Cao

entry.summary: InfoShot proposes a shot-aware frame sampling strategy for long-video understanding with VLMs, partitioning videos into semantically consistent shots and selecting complementary keyframes from each. Uses information-theoretic principles to balance coverage with critical event capture.

entry.title: Revisiting foundation models for cell instance segmentation

author.name: Anwai Archit, Constantin Pape

entry.summary: Comprehensively evaluates cell segmentation foundation models (CellPoseSAM, CellSAM, µSAM) alongside SAM, SAM2, and SAM3 on diverse microscopy datasets. Introduces automatic prompt generation strategy for fair comparison.

entry.title: TransText: Transparency Aware Image-to-Video Typography Animation

author.name: Fei Zhang, Zijian Zhou, Bohao Tang, Sen He, Hang Li, Zhe Wang, Soubhik Sanyal, Pengfei Liu, Viktar Atliha, Tao Xiang, Frost Xu, Semih Gunel

entry.summary: TransText introduces the first method for layer-aware text/glyph animation in image-to-video models, handling transparency (alpha channels) without retraining the VAE. Uses a novel Alpha-Aware Dual Branch design to preserve learned semantic priors.

entry.title: Form Follows Function: Recursive Stem Model

author.name: Navid Hakimi

entry.summary: Introduces Recursive Stem Model (RSM), which keeps a TRM-style backbone but changes training to learn a stable, depth-agnostic transition operator by detaching hidden-state history and applying loss only at the final step.

entry.title: Did You Check the Right Pocket? Cost-Sensitive Store Routing for Memory-Augmented Agents

author.name: Madhava Gaikwad

entry.summary: Formulates memory retrieval in multi-store agent systems as a store-routing problem, showing that an oracle router achieves higher accuracy with fewer context tokens compared to uniform retrieval across all stores.

entry.title: POaaS: Minimal-Edit Prompt Optimization as a Service to Lift Accuracy and Cut Hallucinations on On-Device sLLMs

author.name: Jungwoo Shim, Dae Won Kim, Sun Wook Kim, Soo Young Kim, Myungcheol Lee, Jae-geun Cha, Hyunhwa Choi

entry.summary: Proposes POaaS, a minimal-edit prompt optimization layer for on-device small language models that routes queries to lightweight specialists (Cleaner, Paraphraser, Fact-Adder) under strict drift constraints to reduce hallucinations.

entry.title: NeSy-Route: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark for Constrained Route Planning in Remote Sensing

author.name: Ming Yang, Zhi Zhou, Shi-Yu Tian, Kun-Yang Yu, Lan-Zhe Guo, Yu-Feng Li

entry.summary: Introduces NeSy-Route, a neuro-symbolic benchmark for constrained route planning in remote sensing with automated data generation, evaluating MLLMs on combined perception, reasoning, and planning capabilities.

entry.title: FactorEngine: A Program-level Knowledge-Infused Factor Mining Framework for Quantitative Investment

author.name: Qinhong Lin, Ruitao Feng, Yinglun Feng, Zhenxin Huang, Yukun Chen, Zhongliang Yang, Linna Zhou, Binjie Fei, Jiaqi Liu, Yu Li

entry.summary: Introduces FactorEngine, a program-level alpha factor discovery framework for quantitative investment that casts factors as Turing-complete code, combining LLM-guided search with Bayesian optimization.

entry.title: RetailBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Autonomous Decision-Making and Strategy Stability of LLM Agents in Realistic Retail Environments

author.name: Linghua Zhang, Jun Wang, Jingtong Wu, Zhisong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces RetailBench for evaluating long-horizon autonomous LLM decision-making in retail environments with stochastic demand, plus an Evolving Strategy & Execution framework separating strategic reasoning from action execution.

entry.title: Attribution-Guided Model Rectification of Unreliable Neural Network Behaviors

author.name: Peiyu Yang, Naveed Akhtar, Jiantong Jiang, Ajmal Mian

entry.summary: Proposes an attribution-guided framework using rank-one model editing to locate and correct unreliable behaviors in neural networks without full retraining. Distinguishes the rectification setting from standard model editing.

entry.title: Loosely-Structured Software: Engineering Context, Structure, and Evolution Entropy in Runtime-Rewired Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Weihao Zhang, Yitong Zhou, Huanyu Qu, Hongyi Li

entry.summary: Introduces Loosely-Structured Software (LSS), a new software engineering paradigm for LLM-based multi-agent systems that manages context pressure, coordination errors, and system drift through architectural discipline.

entry.title: Data-Local Autonomous LLM-Guided Neural Architecture Search for Multiclass Multimodal Time-Series Classification

author.name: Emil Hardarson, Luka Biedebach, \'Omar Bessi \'Omarsson, Teitur Hr\'olfsson, Anna Sigridur Islind, Mar\'ia \'Oskarsd\'ottir

entry.summary: Presents a data-local LLM-guided neural architecture search framework for multimodal time-series classification that keeps sensitive data on-premise while using LLMs for architecture exploration.

entry.title: Standardizing Medical Images at Scale for AI

author.name: Callen MacPhee, Yiming Zhou, Koichiro Kishima, Bahram Jalali

entry.summary: Presents a physics-based preprocessing framework using PhyCV algorithms that standardizes medical images through deterministic optical physics transformations to address cross-institution domain shift.

entry.title: Interact3D: Compositional 3D Generation of Interactive Objects

author.name: Hui Shan, Keyang Luo, Ming Li, Sizhe Zheng, Yanwei Fu, Zhen Chen, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: Presents Interact3D for generating physically plausible interacting 3D compositional objects from single images, handling occlusions and preserving object-object spatial relationships through a two-stage composition pipeline with generative priors.

entry.title: 360{\deg} Image Perception with MLLMs: A Comprehensive Benchmark and a Training-Free Method

author.name: Huyen T. T. Tran, Van-Quang Nguyen, Farros Alferro, Kang-Jun Liu, Takayuki Okatani

entry.summary: Introduces 360Bench, a VQA benchmark for 360° image perception by MLLMs, featuring 7K-resolution images and seven subtasks. Evaluates seven MLLMs and proposes a training-free method for handling distortion challenges.

entry.title: Sample-Efficient Adaptation of Drug-Response Models to Patient Tumors under Strong Biological Domain Shift

author.name: Camille Jimenez Cortes, Philippe Lalanda, German Vega

entry.summary: Proposes a staged transfer-learning framework for adapting drug-response models from cell lines to patient tumors, separating representation learning from task supervision for sample-efficient adaptation under biological domain shift.

entry.title: DynamicGate MLP Conditional Computation via Learned Structural Dropout and Input Dependent Gating for Functional Plasticity

author.name: Yong Il Choi

entry.summary: Proposes DynamicGate-MLP unifying dropout regularization and conditional computation by learning input-dependent gates that decide unit activation, combining both regularization and sample-dependent execution.

entry.title: What on Earth is AlphaEarth? Hierarchical structure and functional interpretability for global land cover

author.name: Ivan Felipe Benavides-Martinez, Justin Guthrie, Jhon Edwin Arias, Yeison Alberto Garces-Gomez, Angela Ines Guzman-Alvis, Cristiam Victoriano Portilla-Cabrera, Somnath Mondal, Andrew J. Allyn, Auroop R. Ganguly

entry.summary: Proposes a functional interpretability framework for Google AlphaEarth Foundation embeddings, investigating whether embedding dimensions exhibit hierarchical or specialized organization for land cover classification.

entry.title: Integrating Inductive Biases in Transformers via Distillation for Financial Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yu-Chen Den, Kuan-Yu Chen, Kendro Vincent, Darby Tien-Hao Chang

entry.summary: Proposes distilling inductive biases from CNNs and RNNs into Transformer models for financial time series forecasting. Addresses the observation that simpler architectures can outperform Transformers on financial data.

entry.title: Binary Latent Protein Fitness Landscapes for Quantum Annealing Optimization

author.name: Truong-Son Hy

entry.summary: Proposes Q-BIOLAT, a framework modeling protein fitness landscapes in binary latent spaces, enabling QUBO-based combinatorial optimization including potential quantum annealing applications.

entry.title: WINFlowNets: Warm-up Integrated Networks Training of Generative Flow Networks for Robotics and Machine Fault Adaptation

author.name: Zahin Sufiyan, Shadan Golestan, Yoshihiro Mitsuka, Shotaro Miwa, Osmar Zaiane

entry.summary: Introduces WINFlowNets, a CFlowNets framework enabling co-training of flow and retrieval networks for robotic control, removing the dependency on pre-training data.

entry.title: Efficient Soft Actor-Critic with LLM-Based Action-Level Guidance for Continuous Control

author.name: Hao Ma, Zhiqiang Pu, Xiaolin Ai, Huimu Wang

entry.summary: GuidedSAC uses LLMs as supervisors to provide action-level guidance for Soft Actor-Critic reinforcement learning, analyzing trajectories with state information and visual replays. The authors prove convergence guarantees are preserved while improving convergence speed.

entry.title: FoMo X: Modular Explainability Signals for Outlier Detection Foundation Models

author.name: Simon Kl\"uttermann, Tim Katzke, Phuong Huong Nguyen, Emmanuel M\"uller

entry.summary: FoMo-X provides a modular framework for adding lightweight explainability signals to outlier detection foundation models (specifically PFNs), addressing the black-box nature of zero-shot anomaly detection without requiring expensive post-hoc explanation methods.

entry.title: Federated Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Distributional Critic Regularization

author.name: David Millard, Cecilia Alm, Rashid Ali, Pengcheng Shi, Ali Baheri

entry.summary: Formalizes federated distributional RL where clients parametrize quantile value functions and proposes TR-FedDistRL with Wasserstein barycenter-based trust regions to preserve distributional information during federation.

entry.title: Unified Policy Value Decomposition for Rapid Adaptation

author.name: Cristiano Capone, Luca Falorsi, Andrea Ciardiello, Luca Manneschi

entry.summary: Introduces a unified policy-value decomposition framework where policy and value functions share a low-dimensional goal embedding for rapid task adaptation in RL, using a bilinear actor-critic decomposition inspired by gain modulation in neuroscience.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Radiology Report Generation: Radiologist-Like Workflow with Clinically Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Kaito Baba, Satoshi Kodera

entry.summary: MARL-Rad proposes a multi-agent RL framework for radiology report generation where region-specific agents and a global agent are jointly trained with clinically verifiable rewards. Achieves SOTA clinical efficacy on MIMIC-CXR and IU X-ray.

entry.title: Shielded Reinforcement Learning Under Dynamic Temporal Logic Constraints

author.name: Sad{\i}k Bera Y\"uksel, Ali Tevfik Buyukkocak, Derya Aksaray

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining shielded RL with Signal Temporal Logic (STL) for imposing complex spatio-temporal constraints during learning, going beyond simple safety constraints to periodic recharging or time-bounded visits.

entry.title: OPERA: Online Data Pruning for Efficient Retrieval Model Adaptation

author.name: Haoyang Fang, Shuai Zhang, Yifei Ma, Hengyi Wang, Cuixiong Hu, Katrin Kirchhoff, Bernie Wang, George Karypis

entry.summary: OPERA introduces a data pruning framework for efficient retrieval model adaptation that exploits heterogeneous training pair quality, using a two-stage dynamic pruning strategy to balance ranking quality and query diversity.

entry.title: Structured SIR: Efficient and Expressive Importance-Weighted Inference for High-Dimensional Image Registration

author.name: Ivor J. A. Simpson, Neill D. F. Campbell

entry.summary: Presents Structured SIR, a memory-efficient importance-weighted inference method for probabilistic image registration that enables expressive, multi-modal uncertainty characterization for dense 3D tasks.

entry.title: Per-Domain Generalizing Policies: On Learning Efficient and Robust Q-Value Functions (Extended Version with Technical Appendix)

author.name: Nicola J. M\"uller, Moritz Oster, Isabel Valera, J\"org Hoffmann, Timo P. Gros

entry.summary: Advocates learning Q-value functions instead of state-value functions for per-domain generalizing policies in planning, showing they are cheaper to evaluate and, with proper regularization, outperform standard approaches.

entry.title: Verification and Validation of Physics-Informed Surrogate Component Models for Dynamic Power-System Simulation

author.name: Petros Ellinas, Indrajit Chaudhuri, Johanna Vorwerk, Spyros Chatzivasileiadis

entry.summary: Formulates verification and validation of physics-informed ML surrogates for power-system dynamic simulation, deriving finite-horizon error bounds linking component-level accuracy to system-level algebraic coupling sensitivity.

entry.title: SIA: A Synthesize-Inject-Align Framework for Knowledge-Grounded and Secure E-commerce Search LLMs with Industrial Deployment

author.name: Zhouwei Zhai, Mengxiang Chen, Anmeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SIA, a Synthesize-Inject-Align framework for deploying knowledge-grounded and secure LLMs for e-commerce search, addressing knowledge hallucination via knowledge graph integration and security vulnerabilities via safety-aware training.

entry.title: Polyglot-Lion: Efficient Multilingual ASR for Singapore via Balanced Fine-Tuning of Qwen3-ASR

author.name: Quy-Anh Dang, Chris Ngo

entry.summary: Presents Polyglot-Lion, compact multilingual ASR models for Singapore's languages (English, Mandarin, Tamil, Malay) via balanced fine-tuning of Qwen3-ASR, achieving competitive performance with a model 6x smaller than the state-of-the-art.

entry.title: Diverging Transformer Predictions for Human Sentence Processing: A Comprehensive Analysis of Agreement Attraction Effects

author.name: Titus von der Malsburg, Sebastian Pad\'o

entry.summary: Evaluates 11 autoregressive transformers on English agreement attraction, finding good alignment with human reading times for prepositional phrases but significant degradation for object-extracted relative clauses, with predictions diverging across models.

entry.title: Probing Cultural Signals in Large Language Models through Author Profiling

author.name: Valentin Lafargue, Ariel Guerra-Adames, Emmanuelle Claeys, Elouan Vuichard, Jean-Michel Loubes

entry.summary: Probes cultural biases in LLMs by evaluating zero-shot author profiling from song lyrics, finding systematic cultural alignment where most models default toward North American ethnicity while DeepSeek aligns more with Asian ethnicity.

entry.title: Omni IIE Bench: Benchmarking the Practical Capabilities of Image Editing Models

author.name: Yujia Yang, Yuanxiang Wang, Zhenyu Guan, Tiankun Yang, Chenxi Bao, Haopeng Jin, Jinwen Luo, Xinyu Zuo, Lisheng Duan, Haijin Liang, Jin Ma, Xinming Wang, Ruiwen Tao, Hongzhu Yi

entry.summary: Introduces Omni IIE Bench for evaluating instruction-based image editing consistency across semantic scales, with single-turn consistency tests and multi-turn coordination tasks to diagnose editing model failures.

entry.title: ACE-LoRA: Graph-Attentive Context Enhancement for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: M. Arda Ayd{\i}n, Melih B. Yilmaz, Aykut Ko\c{c}, Tolga \c{C}ukur

entry.summary: Proposes ACE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for medical VLMs using LoRA with graph-attentive context enhancement to balance specialization and generalization in medical image analysis.

entry.title: Adaptive Anchor Policies for Efficient 4D Gaussian Streaming

author.name: Ashim Dahal, Rabab Abdelfattah, Nick Rahimi

entry.summary: Proposes Efficient Gaussian Streaming (EGS), a reinforcement-learned policy for adaptive anchor selection in 4D Gaussian Splatting that dynamically adjusts anchor count and selection based on scene complexity.

entry.title: OnlineHMR: Video-based Online World-Grounded Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Yiwen Zhao, Ce Zheng, Yufu Wang, Hsueh-Han Daniel Yang, Liting Wen, Laszlo A. Jeni

entry.summary: OnlineHMR proposes a fully online framework for world-grounded human mesh recovery from monocular video, addressing the gap between offline methods and real-time AR/VR applications. It uses a two-branch architecture with causal key-value cache and sliding-window learning for streaming inference.

entry.title: UniSem: Generalizable Semantic 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Unposed Images

author.name: Guibiao Liao, Qian Ren, Kaimin Liao, Hua Wang, Zhi Chen, Luchao Wang, Yaohua Tang

entry.summary: UniSem proposes a unified framework for semantic 3D reconstruction from sparse unposed images using 3D Gaussian Splatting, with Error-aware Gaussian Dropout for depth quality and improved semantic generalization.

entry.title: Learning Coordinate-based Convolutional Kernels for Continuous SE(3) Equivariant and Efficient Point Cloud Analysis

author.name: Jaein Kim, Hee Bin Yoo, Dong-Sig Han, Byoung-Tak Zhang

entry.summary: ECKConv presents coordinate-based kernel convolution for SE(3) equivariant point cloud analysis, achieving both rigorous symmetry and scalability through the intertwiner framework with explicit kernel design.

entry.title: ReLaGS: Relational Language Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yaxu Xie, Abdalla Arafa, Alireza Javanmardi, Christen Millerdurai, Jia Cheng Hu, Shaoxiang Wang, Alain Pagani, Didier Stricker

entry.summary: ReLaGS constructs hierarchical language-distilled Gaussian scenes with 3D semantic scene graphs without scene-specific training. Combines Gaussian pruning, multi-view language alignment, and GNN-based relational reasoning for unified 3D perception.

entry.title: TAPESTRY: From Geometry to Appearance via Consistent Turntable Videos

author.name: Yan Zeng, Haoran Jiang, Kaixin Yao, Qixuan Zhang, Longwen Zhang, Lan Xu, Jingyi Yu

entry.summary: TAPESTRY generates photorealistic turntable videos from untextured 3D models for texture synthesis, addressing geometric consistency and appearance stability challenges in existing video diffusion models.

entry.title: Evidence Packing for Cross-Domain Image Deepfake Detection with LVLMs

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Fei Wang, Kun Li, Yiqi Nie, Junjie Chen, Zhangling Duan, Zhaohong Jia

entry.summary: Proposes training-free LVLM framework for deepfake detection using evidence-driven reasoning with patch-level analysis, avoiding costly fine-tuning while achieving cross-domain generalization.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision Language Models with Quantization-Aware Integrated Gradients

author.name: Ziwei Xiang, Fanhu Zeng, Hongjian Fang, Rui-Qi Wang, Renxing Chen, Yanan Zhu, Yi Chen, Peipei Yang, Xu-Yao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes fine-grained post-training quantization for LVLMs using quantization-aware integrated gradients, measuring sensitivity at the token level rather than modality level to capture cross-token interactions.

entry.title: A Creative Agent is Worth a 64-Token Template

author.name: Ruixiao Shi, Fu Feng, Yucheng Xie, Xu Yang, Jing Wang, Xin Geng

entry.summary: CAT framework learns compressed 64-token creative templates for text-to-image generation, enabling reusable creative concepts without instance-specific reasoning or repeated LLM queries. Addresses computational cost of creative prompt engineering.

entry.title: SpiderCam: Low-Power Snapshot Depth from Differential Defocus

author.name: Marcos A. Ferreira, Tianao Li, John Mamish, Josiah Hester, Yaman Sangar, Qi Guo, Emma Alexander

entry.summary: SpiderCam is an FPGA-based depth-from-defocus camera that produces 480x400 sparse depth maps at 32.5 FPS while consuming only 624 mW. It achieves sub-Watt total system power through algorithmic improvements and memory-local streaming computation on constrained hardware.

entry.title: LaDe: Unified Multi-Layered Graphic Media Generation and Decomposition

author.name: Vlad-Constantin Lungu-Stan, Ionut Mironica, Mariana-Iuliana Georgescu

entry.summary: LaDe is a latent diffusion framework for generating flexible numbers of semantically meaningful design layers from text prompts. Combines LLM-based prompt expansion with a Latent Diffusion Transformer using 4D RoPE positional encoding.

entry.title: Visual SLAM with DEM Anchoring for Lunar Surface Navigation

author.name: Adam Dai, Guillem Casadesus Vila, Grace Gao

entry.summary: Presents a stereo visual SLAM system for lunar surface navigation that integrates learned feature detection with global constraints from digital elevation models to reduce drift over long traverses.

entry.title: Interpreting Context-Aware Human Preferences for Multi-Objective Robot Navigation

author.name: Tharun Sethuraman, Subham Agrawal, Nils Dengler, Jorge de Heuvel, Teena Hassan, Maren Bennewitz

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline for interpreting context-aware human navigation preferences expressed in natural language, using VLMs to extract structured preferences that condition a multi-objective RL policy.

entry.title: AgentVLN: Towards Agentic Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Zihao Xin, Wentong Li, Yixuan Jiang, Ziyuan Huang, Bin Wang, Piji Li, Jianke Zhu, Jie Qin, Shengjun Huang

entry.summary: AgentVLN formulates vision-language navigation as a POSMDP with a VLM-as-Brain paradigm, using a plug-and-play skill library to decouple semantic reasoning from perception and planning for edge deployment.

entry.title: Huddle: Parallel Shape Assembly using Decentralized, Minimalistic Robots

author.name: Khai Yi Chin, Tingwei Meng, Zhe Chen, Daniel Bassett, Yuri Ivanov

entry.summary: Huddle proposes a decentralized algorithm for parallel shape assembly using minimalistic robots that require only local neighbor communication, with no pose localization or global coordination needed.

entry.title: ManiTwin: Scaling Data-Generation-Ready Digital Object Dataset to 100K

author.name: Kaixuan Wang, Tianxing Chen, Jiawei Liu, Honghao Su, Shaolong Zhu, Minxuan Wang, Zixuan Li, Yue Chen, Huan-ang Gao, Yusen Qin, Jiawei Wang, Qixuan Zhang, Lan Xu, Jingyi Yu, Yao Mu, Ping Luo

entry.summary: Introduces ManiTwin, an automated pipeline for generating simulation-ready 3D objects from single images, and ManiTwin-100K, a dataset of 100K annotated 3D assets for robotic manipulation training. Each asset includes physical properties, language descriptions, and manipulation proposals.

entry.title: CraniMem: Cranial Inspired Gated and Bounded Memory for Agentic Systems

author.name: Pearl Mody, Mihir Panchal, Rishit Kar, Kiran Bhowmick, Ruhina Karani

entry.summary: Presents CraniMem, a neurocognitively-motivated multi-stage memory system for LLM agents with goal-conditioned gating, utility tagging, bounded episodic buffer, and structured long-term knowledge graph with scheduled consolidation.

entry.title: Theoretical Foundations of Latent Posterior Factors: Formal Guarantees for Multi-Evidence Reasoning

author.name: Aliyu Agboola Alege

entry.summary: Companion theoretical paper to LPF providing formal guarantees including convergence, calibration bounds, and analysis of LPF-SPN exact inference vs learned neural aggregation for multi-evidence reasoning.

entry.title: Argumentative Human-AI Decision-Making: Toward AI Agents That Reason With Us, Not For Us

author.name: Stylianos Loukas Vasileiou, Antonio Rago, Francesca Toni, William Yeoh

entry.summary: Argues for convergence of computational argumentation and LLMs to create Argumentative Human-AI Decision-Making, where agents engage in dialectical reasoning processes rather than just justifying decisions.

entry.title: From Workflow Automation to Capability Closure: A Formal Framework for Safe and Revenue-Aware Customer Service AI

author.name: Cosimo Spera, Garima Agrawal, Riccardo De Maria

entry.summary: Applies the safety non-compositionality result to customer service AI, showing how networks of specialized agents can reach forbidden goals through emergent conjunctive dependencies, and proposes a formal framework for safe automation.

entry.title: Domain-Independent Dynamic Programming with Constraint Propagation

author.name: Imko Marijnissen, J. Christopher Beck, Emir Demirovi\'c, Ryo Kuroiwa

entry.summary: Integrates constraint propagation from CP into Domain-Independent Dynamic Programming, enabling DP solvers to prune states and transitions using constraint propagation on combinatorial optimization problems.

entry.title: Exploring the Use of VLMs for Navigation Assistance for People with Blindness and Low Vision

author.name: Yu Li, Yuchen Zheng, Giles Hamilton-Fletcher, Marco Mezzavilla, Yao Wang, Sundeep Rangan, Maurizio Porfiri, Zhou Yu, John-Ross Rizzo

entry.summary: Evaluates vision-language models (GPT-4V, GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, Llava) for assisting blind and low-vision navigation, testing spatial reasoning, obstacle counting, and wayfinding understanding. Reveals significant performance disparities between models.

entry.title: A federated learning framework with knowledge graph and temporal transformer for early sepsis prediction in multi-center ICUs

author.name: Yue Chang, Guangsen Lin, Jyun Jie Chuang, Shunqi Liu, Xinkui Li, Yaozheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning framework combining knowledge graphs and temporal transformers for early sepsis prediction across multiple ICUs, with meta-learning for cross-institution adaptation while preserving privacy.

entry.title: Counteractive RL: Rethinking Core Principles for Efficient and Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ezgi Korkmaz

entry.summary: Proposes Counteractive RL, a theoretically-founded paradigm for efficient learning in high-dimensional MDPs based on experiences obtained through counteractive actions, aiming to address the computational complexity vs. policy success tradeoff.

entry.title: RadAnnotate: Large Language Models for Efficient and Reliable Radiology Report Annotation

author.name: Saisha Pradeep Shetty, Roger Eric Goldman, Vladimir Filkov

entry.summary: Presents RadAnnotate, an LLM-based framework for radiology report annotation that uses RAG-guided synthetic reports and confidence-based selective automation to reduce expert labeling effort.

entry.title: SEAHateCheck: Functional Tests for Detecting Hate Speech in Low-Resource Languages of Southeast Asia

author.name: Ri Chi Ng, Aditi Kumaresan, Yujia Hu, Roy Ka-Wei Lee

entry.summary: Introduces SEAHateCheck, a hate speech detection benchmark for four Southeast Asian languages (Indonesian, Tagalog, Thai, Vietnamese), building on HateCheck's functional testing framework with culturally relevant test cases validated by local experts.

entry.title: AW-MoE: All-Weather Mixture of Experts for Robust Multi-Modal 3D Object Detection

author.name: Hongwei Lin, Xun Huang, Chenglu Wen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces AW-MoE for weather-robust multi-modal 3D object detection in autonomous driving, using Image-guided Weather-aware Routing to select weather-specific experts, addressing performance conflicts from training on mixed weather data.

entry.title: Attention-guided Evidence Grounding for Spoken Question Answering

author.name: Ke Yang, Bolin Chen, Yuejie Li, Yueying Hua, Jianhao Nie, Yueping He, Bowen Li, Chengjun Mao

entry.summary: Proposes Attention-guided Evidence Grounding (AEG) for spoken question answering, using cross-modal attention of Speech LLMs to locate key evidence in latent space. Introduces Learning to Focus on Evidence fine-tuning to calibrate attention.

entry.title: Manifold-Matching Autoencoders

author.name: Laurent Cheret, Vincent L\'etourneau, Isar Nejadgholi, Chris Drummond, Hussein Al Osman, Maia Fraser

entry.summary: Studies Manifold-Matching Autoencoders (MMAE) that align pairwise distances in latent and input spaces, outperforming similar methods on nearest-neighbor and persistent homology metrics. Provides scalable approximation of Multi-Dimensional Scaling.

entry.title: Can Linguistically Related Languages Guide LLM Translation in Low-Resource Settings?

author.name: Aishwarya Ramasethu, Niyathi Allu, Rohin Garg, Harshwardhan Fartale, Dun Li Chan

entry.summary: Investigates whether linguistically similar pivot languages and few-shot demonstrations can help LLMs translate low-resource languages without parameter updates. Studies in-context learning approaches for data-scarce machine translation.

entry.title: Real-Time Decoding of Movement Onset and Offset for Brain-Controlled Rehabilitation Exoskeleton

author.name: Kanishka Mitra, Satyam Kumar, Frigyes Samuel Racz, Deland Liu, Ashish D. Deshpande, Jos\'e del R. Mill\'an

entry.summary: Implements online dual-state motor imagery control of an upper-limb exoskeleton using non-invasive EEG, enabling users to both initiate and terminate robot-assisted movements. Demonstrates reliable start-stop command delivery with 61.5% and 64.5% hit rates.

entry.title: Contextual Preference Distribution Learning

author.name: Benjamin Hudson, Laurent Charlin, Emma Frejinger

entry.summary: Proposes a sequential learning-and-optimization pipeline for contextual preference distribution learning, targeting risk-averse formulations in human choice settings that can be expressed as linear programs.

entry.title: CLeAN: Continual Learning Adaptive Normalization in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Isabella Marasco, Davide Evangelista, Elena Loli Piccolomini, Michele Colajanni

entry.summary: CLeAN introduces an adaptive normalization technique for continual learning that handles sequential data without requiring access to the full dataset. Addresses the overlooked problem of data normalization in dynamic environments like cybersecurity and finance.

entry.title: Benchmarking Reinforcement Learning via Stochastic Converse Optimality: Generating Systems with Known Optimal Policies

author.name: Sinan Ibrahim, Gr\'egoire Ouerdane, Hadi Salloum, Henni Ouerdane, Stefan Streif, Pavel Osinenko

entry.summary: Introduces a rigorous RL benchmarking framework based on stochastic converse optimality, providing conditions under which prescribed value functions and policies are optimal for constructed systems. Enables systematic generation of benchmark families.

entry.title: RangeAD: Fast On-Model Anomaly Detection

author.name: Luca Hinkamp, Simon Kl\"uttermann, Emmanuel M\"uller

entry.summary: RangeAD proposes 'On-Model AD' that leverages neuron-wise output ranges from an existing primary model for anomaly detection, instead of running a separate AD model. Achieves strong performance with lower inference cost.

entry.title: A Controlled Comparison of Deep Learning Architectures for Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting: Evidence from 918 Experiments

author.name: Nabeel Ahmad Saidd

entry.summary: Provides a controlled comparison of 9 deep learning architectures across 918 experiments for multi-horizon financial forecasting, using a strict five-stage protocol including fixed-seed Bayesian HPO and statistical testing.

entry.title: EEG-Based Brain-LLM Interface for Human Preference Aligned Generation

author.name: Junzi Zhang, Jianing Shen, Weijie Tu, Yi Zhang, Hailin Zhang, Tom Gedeon, Bin Jiang, Yue Yao
