entry.summary: Proposes a brain-LLM interface using EEG signals to guide image generation models at test time, targeting users with speech or motor impairments. Specifically uses EEG to align LLM outputs with human preferences.

entry.title: TharuChat: Bootstrapping Large Language Models for a Low-Resource Language via Synthetic Data and Human Validation

author.name: Prajwal Panth, Agniva Maiti

entry.summary: Presents Tharu-LLaMA (3B), a specialized instruction-following model for the Tharu language (1.7M speakers), using synthetic data generation and human validation to bootstrap LLM capabilities for this low-resource language.

entry.title: Informative Semi-Factuals for XAI: The Elaborated Explanations that People Prefer

author.name: Saugat Aryal, Mark T. Keane

entry.summary: Explores 'even if' semi-factual explanations in XAI, studying how elaborated explanations that change multiple features are preferred by users over minimal single-feature changes, contrary to common algorithmic approaches.

entry.title: The Convergence Frontier: Integrating Machine Learning and High Performance Quantum Computing for Next-Generation Drug Discovery

author.name: Narjes Ansari, C\'esar Feniou, Nicola\"i Gouraud, Daniele Loco, Siwar Badreddine, Baptiste Claudon, F\'elix Aviat, Marharyta Blazhynska, Kevin Gasperich, Guillaume Michel, Diata Traore, Corentin Villot, Thomas Pl\'e, Olivier Adjoua, Louis Lagard\`ere, Jean-Philip Piquemal

entry.summary: Survey/position paper on the convergence of HPC, machine learning, and quantum computing for drug discovery, highlighting ML foundation models like FeNNix-Bio1 and the potential role of hybrid QPU-GPU architectures.

entry.title: CTG-DB: An Ontology-Based Transformation of ClinicalTrials.gov to Enable Cross-Trial Drug Safety Analyses

author.name: Jeffery L. Painter, Fran\c{c}ois Haguinet, Andrew Bate

entry.summary: Presents CTG-DB, an open-source pipeline transforming ClinicalTrials.gov XML data into a relational database with standardized adverse event terminology via MedDRA mapping, enabling cross-trial drug safety analyses.

entry.title: TDMM-LM: Bridging Facial Understanding and Animation via Language Models

author.name: Luchuan Song, Pinxin Liu, Haiyang Liu, Zhenchao Jin, Yolo Yunlong Tang, Zichong Xu, Susan Liang, Jing Bi, Jason J Corso, Chenliang Xu

entry.summary: Bridges facial understanding and animation via language models, synthesizing 80 hours of facial video data and training LMs for bidirectional facial motion-language tasks (motion to text and text to motion using 3D facial parameters).

entry.title: KGS-GCN: Enhancing Sparse Skeleton Sensing via Kinematics-Driven Gaussian Splatting and Probabilistic Topology for Action Recognition

author.name: Yuhan Chen, Yicui Shi, Guofa Li, Liping Zhang, Jie Li, Jiaxin Gao, Wenbo Chu

entry.summary: Proposes KGS-GCN combining kinematics-driven Gaussian splatting with probabilistic topology for skeleton-based action recognition, transforming discrete joint coordinates into continuous spatiotemporal representations.

entry.title: TrackDeform3D: Markerless and Autonomous 3D Keypoint Tracking and Dataset Collection for Deformable Objects

author.name: Yeheng Zong, Yizhou Chen, Alexander Bowler, Chia-Tung Yang, Ram Vasudevan

entry.summary: Presents TrackDeform3D, a markerless autonomous 3D keypoint tracking system for deformable objects that enables large-scale dataset collection without motion capture setups or manual annotation.

entry.title: Directing the Narrative: A Finetuning Method for Controlling Coherence and Style in Story Generation

author.name: Jianzhang Zhang, Yijing Tian, Jiwang Qu, Chuang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for consistent story visualization with Group-Shared Attention (GSA) for cross-sample information flow within attention layers, addressing character identity drift in sequential image generation.

entry.title: MCoT-MVS: Multi-level Vision Selection by Multi-modal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Xuri Ge, Chunhao Wang, Xindi Wang, Zheyun Qin, Zhumin Chen, Xin Xin

entry.summary: MCoT-MVS introduces multi-modal chain-of-thought reasoning for composed image retrieval, using an MLLM to generate reasoning cues that guide attention-aware multi-level vision feature selection. Addresses the problem of irrelevant visual noise in reference images.

entry.title: Towards Motion-aware Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Chaeyun Kim, Seunghoon Yi, Yejin Kim, Yohan Jo, Joonseok Lee

entry.summary: Introduces motion-aware referring image segmentation, addressing the finding that existing methods significantly underperform on motion-related queries. Proposes data augmentation with motion-centric phrases and Multimodal Radial Contrastive Learning (MRaCL).

entry.title: EI: Early Intervention for Multimodal Imaging based Disease Recognition

author.name: Qijie Wei, Hailan Lin, Xirong Li

entry.summary: Proposes Early Intervention (EI) framework for multimodal medical imaging that uses semantic tokens from reference modalities to steer target modality embedding early in the process, addressing both fusion limitations and domain shift challenges.

entry.title: Prompt-Free Universal Region Proposal Network

author.name: Qihong Tang, Changhan Liu, Shaofeng Zhang, Wenbin Li, Qi Fan, Yang Gao

entry.summary: PF-RPN introduces a prompt-free universal region proposal network that identifies potential objects without relying on exemplar images, categories, or text descriptions. Uses learnable query embeddings with visual features for initial localization.

entry.title: FrescoDiffusion: 4K Image-to-Video with Prior-Regularized Tiled Diffusion

author.name: Hugo Caselles-Dupr\'e (Obvious Research, Paris, France), Mathis Koroglu (Obvious Research, Paris, France, Institute of Intelligent Systems and Robotics - Sorbonne University, Paris, France), Guillaume Jeanneret (Institute of Intelligent Systems and Robotics - Sorbonne University, Paris, France), Arnaud Dapogny (Institute of Intelligent Systems and Robotics - Sorbonne University, Paris, France), Matthieu Cord (Institute of Intelligent Systems and Robotics - Sorbonne University, Paris, France)

entry.summary: FrescoDiffusion enables coherent 4K image-to-video generation using prior-regularized tiled diffusion, specifically designed for large-format complex images like frescoes. Training-free method that augments tiled denoising with precomputed latent priors.

entry.title: WeatherReasonSeg: A Benchmark for Weather-Aware Reasoning Segmentation in Visual Language Models

author.name: Wanjun Du, Zifeng Yuan, Tingting Chen, Fucai Ke, Beibei Lin, Shunli Zhang

entry.summary: WeatherReasonSeg benchmarks VLM reasoning-based segmentation under adverse weather conditions (rain, snow, fog), testing whether models maintain reliable reasoning when visual cues are degraded. Includes synthetic and real-world weather components.

entry.title: DiffVP: Differential Visual Semantic Prompting for LLM-Based CT Report Generation

author.name: Yuhe Tian, Kun Zhang, Haoran Ma, Rui Yan, Yingtai Li, Rongsheng Wang, Shaohua Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: DiffVP proposes Differential Visual Prompting for CT report generation, conditioning on semantic scan-to-reference differences rather than absolute features. Inspired by radiological cognitive subtraction for highlighting clinically relevant changes.

entry.title: CrowdGaussian: Reconstructing High-Fidelity 3D Gaussians for Human Crowd from a Single Image

author.name: Yizheng Song, Yiyu Zhuang, Qipeng Xu, Haixiang Wang, Jiahe Zhu, Jing Tian, Siyu Zhu, Hao Zhu

entry.summary: CrowdGaussian reconstructs multi-person 3D Gaussian Splatting representations from single images, addressing challenges of occlusion, low clarity, and appearance variation in crowd scenes.

entry.title: Identity as Presence: Towards Appearance and Voice Personalized Joint Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Yingjie Chen, Shilun Lin, Cai Xing, Qixin Yan, Wenjing Wang, Dingming Liu, Hao Liu, Chen Li, Jing Lyu

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework for identity-aware joint audio-video generation enabling fine-grained control over facial appearance and voice timbre across multiple identities, with automatic data curation pipeline.

entry.title: Interpretable Traffic Responsibility from Dashcam Video via Legal Multi Agent Reasoning

author.name: Jingchun Yang, Jinchang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces C-TRAIL, a multimodal legal dataset that aligns dashcam videos with Chinese traffic regulations for automated traffic responsibility determination. Proposes a multi-agent LLM reasoning system bridging video perception and legal analysis.

entry.title: GMT: Goal-Conditioned Multimodal Transformer for 6-DOF Object Trajectory Synthesis in 3D Scenes

author.name: Huajian Zeng, Abhishek Saroha, Daniel Cremers, Xi Wang

entry.summary: GMT is a multimodal transformer framework for generating goal-directed 6-DOF object manipulation trajectories in 3D environments, jointly leveraging bounding boxes, point clouds, semantic categories, and target poses.

entry.title: EchoGen: Cycle-Consistent Learning for Unified Layout-Image Generation and Understanding

author.name: Kai Zou, Hongbo Liu, Dian Zheng, Jianxiong Gao, Zhiwei Zhao, Bin Liu

entry.summary: EchoGen unifies layout-to-image generation and image grounding through cycle-consistent training, enabling images with accurate layouts while maintaining robust grounding capabilities.

entry.title: A Lensless Polarization Camera

author.name: Noa Kraicer, Shay Elmalem, Erez Yosef, Hani Barhum, Raja Giryes

entry.summary: Proposes a compact lensless polarization camera using a diffuser and striped polarization mask, combined with computational reconstruction to recover full Stokes polarization information.

entry.title: Neural Radiance Maps for Extraterrestrial Navigation and Path Planning

author.name: Adam Dai, Shubh Gupta, Grace Gao

entry.summary: Proposes using Neural Radiance Fields to construct maps from sparse orbital images for autonomous navigation on Mars and other extraterrestrial bodies, enabling efficient storage and online re-planning.

entry.title: SafeLand: Safe Autonomous Landing in Unknown Environments with Bayesian Semantic Mapping

author.name: Markus Gross, Andreas Greiner, Sai Bharadhwaj Matha, Felix Soest, Daniel Cremers, Henri Mee{\ss}

entry.summary: SafeLand is a vision-based system for safe autonomous UAV landing using semantic segmentation to build online ground maps, handling dynamic obstacles like humans without prior maps or LiDAR.

entry.title: The Comprehension-Gated Agent Economy: A Robustness-First Architecture for AI Economic Agency

author.name: Rahul Baxi

entry.summary: Proposes the Comprehension-Gated Agent Economy (CGAE), a formal architecture where AI agents' economic permissions are bounded by verified comprehension functions derived from adversarial robustness audits across three dimensions.

entry.title: Persona-Conditioned Risk Behavior in Large Language Models: A Simulated Gambling Study with GPT-4.1

author.name: Sankalp Dubedy

entry.summary: Investigates whether GPT-4.1 reproduces human-like risk behaviors in a simulated gambling environment when assigned different socioeconomic personas, finding the model reproduces behavioral economic patterns like loss aversion.

entry.title: Enhancing Linguistic Generalization of VLA: Fine-Tuning OpenVLA via Synthetic Instruction Augmentation

author.name: Dongik Shin

entry.summary: Proposes enhancing OpenVLA's linguistic generalization through parameter-efficient fine-tuning with LLM-generated synthetic instruction augmentation using LoRA on Bridge Dataset V2.

entry.title: Follow the Clues, Frame the Truth: Hybrid-evidential Deductive Reasoning in Open-Vocabulary Multimodal Emotion Recognition

author.name: Yu Liu, Lei Zhang, Haoxun Li, Hanlei Shi, Yuxuan Ding, Leyuan Qu, Taihao Li

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid-evidential deductive reasoning approach for open-vocabulary multimodal emotion recognition that reconstructs emotional states by synthesizing multiple evidence-grounded rationales from diverse latent perspectives.

entry.title: Discovering the Hidden Role of Gini Index In Prompt-based Classification

author.name: Ruixi Lin

entry.summary: Reveals a hidden connection between Gini Index and class accuracy disparities in prompt-based classification, proposing it as both a diagnostic measure and optimization metric for debiasing minority class performance.

entry.title: Automated Self-Testing as a Quality Gate: Evidence-Driven Release Management for LLM Applications

author.name: Alexandre Cristov\~ao Maiorano

entry.summary: Presents an automated self-testing framework for LLM applications that implements quality gates with evidence-based release decisions across five dimensions, evaluated through 38 runs across 20+ releases of a production system.

entry.title: Mastering the Minority: An Uncertainty-guided Multi-Expert Framework for Challenging-tailed Sequence Learning

author.name: Ye Wang, Zixuan Wu, Lifeng Shen, Jiang Xie, Xiaoling Wang, Hong Yu, Guoyin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UME framework for imbalanced sequential learning combining Ensemble LoRA for parameter efficiency, Dempster-Shafer theory for expert specialization, and uncertainty-guided conflict resolution.

entry.title: Morphemes Without Borders: Evaluating Root-Pattern Morphology in Arabic Tokenizers and LLMs

author.name: Yara Alakeel, Chatrine Qwaider, Hanan Aldarmaki, Sawsan Alqahtani

entry.summary: Evaluates how LLMs and tokenizers handle Arabic root-pattern (non-concatenative) morphology, testing whether models capture genuine morphological structure or rely on surface memorization using a new test set.

entry.title: Evaluating Causal Discovery Algorithms for Path-Specific Fairness and Utility in Healthcare

author.name: Nitish Nagesh, Elahe Khatibi, Thomas Hughes, Mahdi Bagheri, Pratik Gajane, Amir M. Rahmani

entry.summary: Evaluates causal discovery algorithms for path-specific fairness in healthcare using expert-constructed proxy ground-truth graphs for Alzheimer's and heart failure data.

entry.title: RecBundle: A Next-Generation Geometric Paradigm for Explainable Recommender Systems

author.name: Hui Wang, Tianzhu Hu, Mingming Li, Xi Zhou, Chun Gan, Jiao Dai, Jizhong Han, Songlin Hu, Tao Guo

entry.summary: Proposes RecBundle, a recommender system framework using Fiber Bundles from differential geometry to disentangle topologically grounded user associations from semantically driven historical interactions, addressing information cocoon effects.

entry.title: Open-Source Reproduction and Explainability Analysis of Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation

author.name: Surya Vardhan Yalavarthi

entry.summary: Open-source reproduction of Corrective RAG (CRAG) replacing proprietary components with Wikipedia API and Phi-3-mini, plus first explainability analysis of CRAG's T5-based retrieval evaluator using attribution methods.

entry.title: Robust Generative Audio Quality Assessment: Disentangling Quality from Spurious Correlations

author.name: Kuan-Tang Huang, Chien-Chun Wang, Cheng-Yeh Yang, Hung-Shin Lee, Hsin-Min Wang, Berlin Chen

entry.summary: Uses domain adversarial training to disentangle true audio quality perception from spurious correlations (like dataset-specific signatures) in generative audio quality assessment. Systematically investigates domain definition strategies from explicit metadata to implicit clusters.

entry.title: $D^3$-RSMDE: 40$\times$ Faster and High-Fidelity Remote Sensing Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Ruizhi Wang, Weihan Li, Zunlei Feng, Haofei Zhang, Mingli Song, Jiayu Wang, Jie Song, Li Sun

entry.summary: Proposes D³-RSMDE for fast remote sensing depth estimation, combining ViT for preliminary depth maps with diffusion refinement, achieving 40× speedup over pure diffusion approaches.

entry.title: PlotTwist: A Creative Plot Generation Framework with Small Language Models

author.name: Abhinav Thorat, Ravi Kolla, Jyotin Goel, Niranjan Pedanekar

entry.summary: Presents PlotTwist, a framework enabling Small Language Models (≤5B parameters) to generate creative plots through structured decomposition and preference alignment, avoiding the cost of aligning frontier LLMs.

entry.title: Bridging the High-Frequency Data Gap: A Millisecond-Resolution Network Dataset for Advancing Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Subina Khanal, Seshu Tirupathi, Merim Dzaferagic, Marco Ruffini, Torben Bach Pedersen

entry.summary: Introduces a millisecond-resolution network dataset from operational 5G deployment for time series foundation models, addressing the gap in high-frequency data for TSFM pre-training.

entry.title: IOSVLM: A 3D Vision-Language Model for Unified Dental Diagnosis from Intraoral Scans

author.name: Huimin Xiong, Zijie Meng, Tianxiang Hu, Chenyi Zhou, Yang Feng, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: Presents IOSVLM, an end-to-end 3D vision-language model for dental diagnosis from intraoral scans. Represents scans as point clouds and handles multi-disease co-occurrence with limited paired 3D-text data.

entry.title: SCE-LITE-HQ: Smooth visual counterfactual explanations with generative foundation models

author.name: Ahmed Zeid, Sidney Bender

entry.summary: Proposes SCE-LITE-HQ, a scalable counterfactual explanation framework leveraging pretrained generative models without task-specific retraining. Operates in latent space with smoothed gradients for stability.

entry.title: Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning for Patient-Independent ECG Reconstruction

author.name: Youssef Youssef, Jitin Singla

entry.summary: Proposes pathology-aware multi-view contrastive learning for reconstructing 12-lead ECG from reduced lead sets. Achieves 76% reduction in reconstruction error by aligning latent representations with clinical labels.

entry.title: TimeAPN: Adaptive Amplitude-Phase Non-Stationarity Normalization for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yue Hu, Jialiang Tang, Siwei Yu, Baosheng Yu, Jing Zhang, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: TimeAPN proposes a normalization framework for time series forecasting that explicitly models amplitude and phase non-stationarity in both time and frequency domains. This addresses the distribution shift problem in long-term forecasting that existing methods handle only implicitly.

entry.title: DECODE: Dual-Enhanced Conditioned Diffusion for EEG Forecasting

author.name: Mehran Shabanpour, Sadaf Khademi, Konstantinos N Plataniotis, Arash Mohammadi

entry.summary: DECODE uses diffusion models conditioned on both natural language descriptions and temporal history for EEG signal forecasting during cognitive events. Combines semantic guidance from language models with Langevin dynamics.

entry.title: EEG-SeeGraph: Interpreting functional connectivity disruptions in dementias via sparse-explanatory dynamic EEG-graph learning

author.name: Fengcheng Wu (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China), Zhenxi Song (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China), Guoyang Xu (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China), Kaisong Hu (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China), Zirui Wang (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China), Yi Guo (Institute of Neurological Diseases, Shenzhen Bay Laboratory, Shenzhen), Zhiguo Zhang (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen, China)

entry.summary: SeeGraph proposes a sparse-explanatory dynamic EEG-graph network for dementia diagnosis that models time-evolving functional connectivity with interpretable edge masks, remaining robust to noise and cross-site variability.

entry.title: Ensemble Self-Training for Unsupervised Machine Translation

author.name: Ido Aharon, Jonathan Shaki, Sarit Kraus

entry.summary: Presents an ensemble-driven self-training framework for unsupervised machine translation, inducing diversity through auxiliary languages and using token-level ensemble decoding for pseudo-translation generation.

entry.title: Pixel-level Counterfactual Contrastive Learning for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Marceau Lafargue-Hauret, Raghav Mehta, Fabio De Sousa Ribeiro, M\'elanie Roschewitz, Ben Glocker

entry.summary: Proposes pixel-level counterfactual contrastive learning for medical image segmentation, combining counterfactual generation with dense contrastive learning methods and introducing visualization algorithms for representation quality.

entry.title: Cascade-Aware Multi-Agent Routing: Spatio-Temporal Sidecars and Geometry-Switching

author.name: Davide Di Gioia

entry.summary: Identifies an observability gap in AI reasoning systems using symbolic graph networks: schedulers don't model how failures propagate differently in tree-like versus cyclic delegation graphs. Proposes spatio-temporal sidecars for geometry-aware routing.

entry.title: Mutually Causal Semantic Distillation Network for Zero-Shot Learning

author.name: Shiming Chen, Shuhuang Chen, Guo-Sen Xie, Xinge You

entry.summary: Proposes MSDN++ for zero-shot learning, using mutually causal semantic distillation to discover intrinsic semantic knowledge between visual and attribute features through bidirectional attention rather than unidirectional approaches.

entry.title: Stochastic set-valued optimization and its application to robust learning

author.name: Tommaso Giovannelli, Jingfu Tan, Luis Nunes Vicente

entry.summary: Develops a stochastic set-valued optimization framework for robust machine learning using hyperbox sets, connecting to multi-objective optimization with quantile-based objectives and providing convergence guarantees.

entry.title: AgriChat: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Agriculture Image Understanding

author.name: Abderrahmene Boudiaf, Irfan Hussain, Sajid Javed

entry.summary: Introduces AgriChat, a multimodal LLM for agriculture, with a Vision-to-Verified-Knowledge pipeline that generates training data by grounding visual captioning in verified phytopathological literature to eliminate biological hallucinations.

entry.title: PhysQuantAgent: An Inference Pipeline of Mass Estimation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Hisayuki Yokomizo, Taiki Miyanishi, Yan Gang, Shuhei Kurita, Nakamasa Inoue, Yusuke Iwasawa

entry.summary: Proposes PhysQuantAgent, a framework for real-world object mass estimation using VLMs with RGB-D videos, along with VisPhysQuant benchmark dataset for evaluating physical quantity estimation under realistic sensing.

entry.title: Continual Multimodal Egocentric Activity Recognition via Modality-Aware Novel Detection

author.name: Wonseon Lim, Hyejeong Im, Dae-Won Kim

entry.summary: Proposes MAND for multimodal egocentric activity recognition that addresses modality imbalance (RGB dominance over IMU) in open-world continual learning settings through modality-aware novelty detection.

entry.title: Accurate Shift Invariant Convolutional Neural Networks Using Gaussian-Hermite Moments

author.name: Jaspreet Singh, Petra Bosilj, Grzegorz Cielniak

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian-Hermite Sampling (GHS), a downsampling strategy using Gaussian-Hermite polynomials to achieve accurate shift invariance in CNNs prior to training.

entry.title: LLM-Powered Flood Depth Estimation from Social Media Imagery: A Vision-Language Model Framework with Mechanistic Interpretability for Transportation Resilience

author.name: Nafis Fuad, Xiaodong Qian

entry.summary: Presents FloodLlama, a fine-tuned VLM for continuous flood depth estimation from street-level images using a 190K synthetic image dataset and TikTok data pipeline. Achieves centimeter-resolution depth estimation for transportation resilience.

entry.title: Generalist Multimodal LLMs Gain Biometric Expertise via Human Salience

author.name: Jacob Piland, Byron Dowling, Christopher Sweet, Adam Czajka

entry.summary: Investigates whether general-purpose multimodal LLMs can perform iris presentation attack detection when augmented with human expert knowledge, operating under privacy constraints that prevent sending biometric data to cloud services.

entry.title: DANCE: Dynamic 3D CNN Pruning: Joint Frame, Channel, and Feature Adaptation for Energy Efficiency on the Edge

author.name: Mohamed Mejri, Ashiqur Rasul, Abhijit Chatterjee

entry.summary: Proposes DANCE, a dynamic pruning framework for 3D CNNs with input-aware activation variability amplification and adaptive activation pruning for energy-efficient edge video processing.

entry.title: MedSAD-CLIP: Supervised CLIP with Token-Patch Cross-Attention for Medical Anomaly Detection and Segmentation

author.name: Thuy Truong Tran, Minh Kha Do, Phuc Nguyen Duy, Min Hun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MedSAD-CLIP for medical anomaly detection using supervised CLIP adaptation with Token-Patch Cross-Attention for fine-grained text-visual alignment, improving lesion localization in medical images.

entry.title: Motion-Adaptive Temporal Attention for Lightweight Video Generation with Stable Diffusion

author.name: Rui Hong, Shuxue Quan

entry.summary: Proposes a motion-adaptive temporal attention mechanism for parameter-efficient video generation on top of frozen Stable Diffusion models. Dynamically adjusts temporal attention based on estimated motion content - local for high-motion, global for low-motion sequences.

entry.title: Revisiting Cross-Attention Mechanisms: Leveraging Beneficial Noise for Domain-Adaptive Learning

author.name: Zelin Zang, Yehui Yang, Fei Wang, Liangyu Li, Baigui Sun

entry.summary: Introduces 'beneficial noise' concept for domain adaptation, regularizing cross-attention with controlled perturbations to help models ignore style distractions. Proposes DACSM framework with Domain-Adaptive Transformer for cross-scale matching.

entry.title: AdapTS: Lightweight Teacher-Student Approach for Multi-Class and Continual Visual Anomaly Detection

author.name: Manuel Barusco, Davide Dalle Pezze, Francesco Borsatti, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: AdapTS proposes a unified Teacher-Student framework for multi-class and continual visual anomaly detection optimized for edge deployment. Uses lightweight trainable adapters injected into a frozen backbone with segmentation-guided training.

entry.title: Anchoring and Rescaling Attention for Semantically Coherent Inbetweening

author.name: Tae Eun Choi, Sumin Shim, Junhyeok Kim, Seong Jae Hwang

entry.summary: Introduces keyframe-anchored attention bias and rescaled temporal RoPE for generative inbetweening, improving semantic coherence and temporal consistency when synthesizing intermediate frames between sparse keyframes.

entry.title: SARE: Sample-wise Adaptive Reasoning for Training-free Fine-grained Visual Recognition

author.name: Jingxiao Yang, DaLin He, Miao Pan, Ge Su, Wenqi Zhang, Yifeng Hu, Tangwei Li, Yuke Li, Xuhong Zhang

entry.summary: SARE proposes sample-wise adaptive reasoning for training-free fine-grained visual recognition, dynamically selecting inference strategies based on recognition difficulty and consolidating error-specific experience for reuse.

entry.title: AdaRadar: Rate Adaptive Spectral Compression for Radar-based Perception

author.name: Jinho Park, Se Young Chun, Mingoo Seok

entry.summary: AdaRadar proposes adaptive spectral compression for radar data in autonomous driving, dynamically adjusting compression ratios based on feedback to handle varying conditions while maintaining perception accuracy.

entry.title: On the Degrees of Freedom of Gridded Control Points in Learning-Based Medical Image Registration

author.name: Wen Yan, Qianye Yang, Yipei Wang, Shonit Punwani, Mark Emberton, Vasilis Stavrinides, Yipeng Hu, Dean Barratt

entry.summary: GridReg replaces dense voxel-wise decoding in learning-based medical image registration with sparse control-point predictions, substantially reducing parameters and memory while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: SLAM Adversarial Lab: An Extensible Framework for Visual SLAM Robustness Evaluation under Adverse Conditions

author.name: Mohamed Hefny, Karthik Dantu, Steven Y. Ko

entry.summary: SAL is a modular framework for evaluating visual SLAM robustness under adversarial conditions like fog and rain, with severity levels in real-world units and automated failure-point detection.

entry.title: AERR-Nav: Adaptive Exploration-Recovery-Reminiscing Strategy for Zero-Shot Object Navigation

author.name: Jingzhi Huang, Junkai Huang, Haoyang Yang, Haoang Li, Yi Wang

entry.summary: AERR-Nav is a zero-shot object navigation framework for multi-floor environments that dynamically adjusts between exploration, recovery, and reminiscing states to handle challenges like getting stuck at intersections.

entry.title: Attractor-Keyed Memory

author.name: Natalia G. Berloff

entry.summary: Shows that physical selectors (lasers, Ising machines, condensates) produce repeatable signatures that can be mapped to arbitrary payloads via linear decoders, merging selection and memory access into one event.

entry.title: Full Stack Navigation, Mapping, and Planning for the Lunar Autonomy Challenge

author.name: Adam Dai, Asta Wu, Keidai Iiyama, Guillem Casadesus Vila, Kaila Coimbra, Thomas Deng, Grace Gao

entry.summary: Presents a full-stack autonomy system for lunar navigation integrating semantic segmentation, visual odometry, SLAM, and planning, developed for the Lunar Autonomy Challenge.

entry.title: P$^{3}$Nav: End-to-End Perception, Prediction and Planning for Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Tianfu Li, Wenbo Chen, Haoxuan Xu, Xinhu Zheng, Haoang Li

entry.summary: P³Nav integrates perception, prediction, and planning in an end-to-end framework for vision-and-language navigation, augmenting scene understanding before planning rather than focusing solely on visual-textual alignment.

entry.title: From Optimizable to Interactable: Mixed Digital Twin-Empowered Testing of Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperation Systems

author.name: Jianghong Dong, Chunying Yang, Mengchi Cai, Chaoyi Chen, Qing Xu, Jianqiang Wang, Keqiang Li

entry.summary: Introduces an L5 'Interactable' digital twin level for vehicle-infrastructure cooperation testing that incorporates human behaviors through mixed reality, extending beyond simulation-only testing.

entry.title: Are a Thousand Words Better Than a Single Picture? Beyond Images -- A Framework for Multi-Modal Knowledge Graph Dataset Enrichment

author.name: Pengyu Zhang, Klim Zaporojets, Jie Liu, Jia-Hong Huang, Paul Groth

entry.summary: Presents Beyond Images, a pipeline for enriching multi-modal knowledge graphs by retrieving additional entity images, converting visuals to textual descriptions, and fusing descriptions via LLM to generate entity-aligned summaries.

entry.title: LED: A Benchmark for Evaluating Layout Error Detection in Document Analysis

author.name: Inbum Heo, Taewook Hwang, Jeesu Jung, Sangkeun Jung

entry.summary: Proposes LED benchmark for evaluating layout error detection in document analysis, defining 8 standardized error types with injection algorithms for realistic error simulation.

entry.title: Joint Degradation-Aware Arbitrary-Scale Super-Resolution for Variable-Rate Extreme Image Compression

author.name: Xinning Chai, Zhengxue Cheng, Xin Li, Rong Xie, Li Song

entry.summary: ASSR-EIC proposes a joint degradation-aware arbitrary-scale super-resolution framework for variable-rate extreme image compression, avoiding the need to train separate diffusion models per bitrate. Addresses limitations at ultra-low bitrate regimes.

entry.title: PCA-Seg: Revisiting Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic and Part Segmentation

author.name: Jianjian Yin, Tao Chen, Yi Chen, Gensheng Pei, Xiangbo Shu, Yazhou Yao, Fumin Shen

entry.summary: PCA-Seg proposes parallel cost aggregation for open-vocabulary semantic and part segmentation, addressing knowledge interference between class-level semantics and spatial context in serial aggregation approaches.

entry.title: Part-Aware Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Grounding via Prototypical Semantic and Geometric Alignment

author.name: Dongqiang Gou, Xuming He

entry.summary: Proposes part-aware open-vocabulary 3D affordance grounding using prototypical semantic and geometric alignment, with LLM-generated part-aware instructions to recover missing semantics for linking affordance regions.

entry.title: ProGVC: Progressive-based Generative Video Compression via Auto-Regressive Context Modeling

author.name: Daowen Li, Ruixiao Dong, Ying Chen, Kai Li, Ding Ding, Li Li

entry.summary: ProGVC proposes progressive-based generative video compression using visual auto-regressive models, unifying progressive transmission, entropy coding, and detail synthesis within a single codec framework.

entry.title: Neural-Symbolic Logic Query Answering in Non-Euclidean Space

author.name: Lihui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HYQNET, a neural-symbolic model for answering first-order logic queries on knowledge graphs using hyperbolic space. It decomposes queries into relation projections and logical operations over fuzzy sets, leveraging hyperbolic GNNs for knowledge graph completion.

entry.title: Context-Length Robustness in Question Answering Models: A Comparative Empirical Study

author.name: Trishita Dhara, Siddhesh Sheth

entry.summary: Empirical study of how LLM accuracy degrades with increasing context length on SQuAD and HotpotQA, isolating context length effects from task difficulty by systematically adding irrelevant context.

entry.title: Prompt Engineering for Scale Development in Generative Psychometrics

author.name: Lara Lee Russell-Lasalandra, Hudson Golino

entry.summary: Monte Carlo simulation examining how prompt engineering strategies affect LLM-generated personality assessment items, finding adaptive prompting with network psychometric methods reliably improves structural validity.

entry.title: Proactive Rejection and Grounded Execution: A Dual-Stage Intent Analysis Paradigm for Safe and Efficient AIoT Smart Homes

author.name: Xinxin Jin, Zhengwei Ni, Zhengguo Sheng, Victor C. M. Leung

entry.summary: Proposes a Dual-Stage Intent-Aware Framework for smart home IoT that separates high-level intent understanding from physical execution, using a semantic firewall to prevent entity hallucinations in LLM-controlled devices.

entry.title: Learning to Predict, Discover, and Reason in High-Dimensional Discrete Event Sequences

author.name: Hugo Math

entry.summary: Applies NLP-inspired approaches to learn patterns in automotive diagnostic trouble code sequences, treating the tens-of-thousands of unique DTCs as analogous to natural language vocabulary for predicting vehicle faults.

entry.title: From Natural Language to Executable Option Strategies via Large Language Models

author.name: Haochen Luo, Zhengzhao Lai, Junjie Xu, Yifan Li, Tang Pok Hin, Yuan Zhang, Chen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Option Query Language (OQL), a domain-specific intermediate representation for translating natural language trading intents into executable option strategies via LLMs as semantic parsers.

entry.title: Prompt Programming for Cultural Bias and Alignment of Large Language Models

author.name: Maksim Eren, Eric Michalak, Brian Cook, Johnny Seales Jr

entry.summary: Studies cultural bias in LLMs and proposes prompt programming techniques to improve cultural alignment, extending prior work to open-source models and automated prompt generation. Evaluates how culture-specific prompting can reduce misalignment with target population values.

entry.title: Finder: A Multimodal AI-Powered Search Framework for Pharmaceutical Data Retrieval

author.name: Suyash Mishra, Srikanth Patil, Satyanarayan Pati, Sagar Sahu, Baddu Narendra

entry.summary: Presents Finder, an AI-powered multimodal search framework for pharmaceutical data that unifies retrieval across text, images, audio, and video using hybrid vector search. Has processed over 291K documents across 98 languages.

entry.title: XLinear: Frequency-Enhanced MLP with CrossFilter for Robust Long-Range Forecasting

author.name: Xiang Ao

entry.summary: Proposes XLinear, an MLP-based time series forecaster that uses frequency-domain operations (Enhanced Frequency Attention) for capturing long-range dependencies while maintaining MLP robustness to noise.

entry.title: Evidential Domain Adaptation for Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Incomplete Degradation

author.name: Yubo Hou, Mohamed Ragab, Yucheng Wang, Min Wu, Abdulla Alseiari, Chee-Keong Kwoh, Xiaoli Li, Zhenghua Chen

entry.summary: Proposes evidential domain adaptation for remaining useful life prediction with incomplete degradation trajectories, using evidential deep learning to handle extrapolation uncertainty from missing late degradation stages.

entry.title: Parallelised Differentiable Straightest Geodesics for 3D Meshes

author.name: Hippolyte Verninas, Caner Korkmaz, Stefanos Zafeiriou, Tolga Birdal, Simone Foti

entry.summary: Provides a parallel GPU implementation and two differentiability methods for computing straightest geodesics on triangle meshes, enabling gradient-based learning on Riemannian surfaces.

entry.title: FlatLands: Generative Floormap Completion From a Single Egocentric View

author.name: Subhransu S. Bhattacharjee, Dylan Campbell, Rahul Shome

entry.summary: Introduces FlatLands, a dataset and benchmark of 270K+ observations from 17K+ indoor scenes for generating complete bird's-eye-view floor maps from a single egocentric image. Compares training-free, deterministic, ensemble, and generative approaches for this task. Useful for indoor navigation but relatively niche.

entry.title: Diffusion Models for Joint Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Alejandro Paredes La Torre

entry.summary: Explores joint audio-video generation using diffusion models, releasing two paired datasets (13h video game clips, 64h concert performances) and training MM-Diffusion from scratch. Investigates joint latent space approaches.

entry.title: MemX: A Local-First Long-Term Memory System for AI Assistants

author.name: Lizheng Sun

entry.summary: Presents MemX, a local-first long-term memory system for AI assistants built in Rust with vector recall, keyword recall, RRF, four-factor re-ranking, and confidence-based rejection. Achieves 91.3% Hit@1 on custom Chinese-language benchmarks.

entry.title: A Scoping Review of AI-Driven Digital Interventions in Mental Health Care: Mapping Applications Across Screening, Support, Monitoring, Prevention, and Clinical Education

author.name: Yang Ni, Fanli Jia

entry.summary: PRISMA-ScR scoping review mapping AI-driven mental health technologies across screening, treatment support, monitoring, prevention, and clinical education, synthesizing 36 empirical studies through early 2024.

entry.title: DanceHA: A Multi-Agent Framework for Document-Level Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Lei Wang, Min Huang, Eduard Dragut

entry.summary: Introduces DanceHA, a multi-agent framework for document-level aspect-based sentiment intensity analysis with divide-and-conquer decomposition and human-AI collaborative annotation. Releases Inf-ABSIA dataset.

entry.title: Data-driven generalized perimeter control: Z\"urich case study

author.name: Alessio Rimoldi, Carlo Cenedese, Alberto Padoan, Florian D\"orfler, John Lygeros

entry.summary: Proposes data-driven predictive control for urban traffic management using behavioral systems theory, validated on a high-fidelity simulation of Zürich. Avoids the need for explicit traffic modeling while handling sparse data and hard constraints.

entry.title: Federated Multi Agent Deep Learning and Neural Networks for Advanced Distributed Sensing in Wireless Networks

author.name: Nadine Muller, Stefano DeRosa, Su Zhang, Chun Lee Huan

entry.summary: Survey of multi-agent deep learning for distributed sensing in wireless networks, covering 2021-2025 research on federated training, graph neural networks, and reinforcement learning for 5G-Advanced and 6G systems.

entry.title: Classifier Pooling for Modern Ordinal Classification

author.name: Noam H. Rotenberg, Andreia V. Faria, Brian Caffo

entry.summary: Presents a model-agnostic ordinal classification method with open-source Python implementation. Shows it outperforms non-ordinal methods especially with small datasets or many classes.

entry.title: QuantFL: Sustainable Federated Learning for Edge IoT via Pre-Trained Model Quantisation

author.name: Charuka Herath, Yogachandran Rahulamathavan, Varuna De Silva, Sangarapillai Lambotharan

entry.summary: QuantFL proposes a sustainable federated learning framework that leverages pre-trained model initialization to enable aggressive quantization on IoT edge devices, reducing carbon footprint from uplink transmission. Shows that pre-training concentrates update statistics enabling simpler quantization.

entry.title: AdaMuS: Adaptive Multi-view Sparsity Learning for Dimensionally Unbalanced Data

author.name: Cai Xu, Changhao Sun, Ziyu Guan, Wei Zhao

entry.summary: AdaMuS addresses dimensionally unbalanced multi-view learning where different views have extreme dimensional disparities (e.g., 10^6 vs 10^1). Uses adaptive sparsity learning to prevent bias toward high-dimensional views.

entry.title: Predicting Trajectories of Long COVID in Adult Women: The Critical Role of Causal Disentanglement

author.name: Jing Wang, Jie Shen, Yiming Luo, Amar Sra, Qiaomin Xie, Jeremy C. Weiss

entry.summary: Uses a causal network based on LLMs to predict Long COVID trajectories in women, integrating clinical profiles with wearable data. Addresses diagnostic overlap between PASC and hormonal transitions like menopause.

entry.title: Dropout Robustness and Cognitive Profiling of Transformer Models via Stochastic Inference

author.name: Ant\^onio Junior Alves Caiado, Michael Hahsler

entry.summary: Analyzes dropout-induced variability across 19 transformer models using MC Dropout, decomposing performance into memory and reasoning components. Provides a cognitive profiling framework for model reliability assessment.

entry.title: DeepStage: Learning Autonomous Defense Policies Against Multi-Stage APT Campaigns

author.name: Trung V. Phan, Tri Gia Nguyen, Thomas Bauschert

entry.summary: DeepStage uses deep RL for adaptive defense against multi-stage Advanced Persistent Threats, modeling enterprise environments as POMDPs with graph neural encoders aligned to MITRE ATT&CK framework stages.

entry.title: An End-to-End Framework for Functionality-Embedded Provenance Graph Construction and Threat Interpretation

author.name: Kushankur Ghosh, Mehar Klair, Kian Kyars, Euijin Choo, J\"org Sander

entry.summary: Auto-Prov uses LLMs to automatically construct provenance graphs from heterogeneous logs, embed functional attributes, and summarize detected attacks for analyst investigation in cybersecurity.

entry.title: Tabular LLMs for Interpretable Few-Shot Alzheimer's Disease Prediction with Multimodal Biomedical Data

author.name: Sophie Kearney, Shu Yang, Zixuan Wen, Weimin Lyu, Bojian Hou, Duy Duong-Tran, Tianlong Chen, Jason H. Moore, Marylyn D. Ritchie, Chao Chen, Li Shen

entry.summary: TAP-GPT adapts TableGPT2 for few-shot Alzheimer's disease prediction from tabular biomarker data using tabular prompts, evaluating across ADNI-derived datasets including MRI, PET, and biomarker data.

entry.title: SA-CycleGAN-2.5D: Self-Attention CycleGAN with Tri-Planar Context for Multi-Site MRI Harmonization

author.name: Ishrith Gowda, Chunwei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes SA-CycleGAN-2.5D for harmonizing MRI data across different scanners using self-attention CycleGAN with tri-planar context, addressing scanner-induced covariate shifts in multi-site neuroimaging.

entry.title: A Progressive Visual-Logic-Aligned Framework for Ride-Hailing Adjudication

author.name: Weiming Wu, Zi-Jian Cheng, Jie Meng, Peng Zhen, Shan Huang, Qun Li, Guobin Wu, Lan-Zhe Guo

entry.summary: Introduces RideJudge, a framework for automated ride-hailing dispute adjudication using multimodal LLMs with progressive visual-logic alignment to bridge the gap between general visual semantics and evidentiary protocols.

entry.title: Tarab: A Multi-Dialect Corpus of Arabic Lyrics and Poetry

author.name: Mo El-Haj

entry.summary: Introduces the Tarab Corpus, a large-scale Arabic corpus of 2.56 million verses and 13.5 million tokens spanning song lyrics and poetry across multiple Arabic dialects and 14+ centuries. It covers Classical Arabic, MSA, and six regional varieties, making it the largest open Arabic creative text corpus.

entry.title: STARK: Spatio-Temporal Attention for Representation of Keypoints for Continuous Sign Language Recognition

author.name: Suvajit Patra, Soumitra Samanta

entry.summary: Introduces STARK, a unified spatio-temporal attention network for continuous sign language recognition that computes attention across keypoints spatially and within local windows temporally, achieving competitive results with fewer parameters.

entry.title: CineSRD: Leveraging Visual, Acoustic, and Linguistic Cues for Open-World Visual Media Speaker Diarization

author.name: Liangbin Huang, Xiaohua Liao, Chaoqun Cui, Shijing Wang, Zhaolong Huang, Yanlong Du, Wenji Mao

entry.summary: Proposes CineSRD, a multimodal speaker diarization framework for films and TV series that leverages visual, acoustic, and linguistic cues to handle open-world challenges like many speakers, cross-modal asynchrony, and in-the-wild variability.

entry.title: PaAgent: Portrait-Aware Image Restoration Agent via Subjective-Objective Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yijian Wang, Qingsen Yan, Jiantao Zhou, Duwei Dai, Wei Dong

entry.title: BEV-SLD: Self-Supervised Scene Landmark Detection for Global Localization with LiDAR Bird's-Eye View Images

entry.title: A Proposal-Free Query-Guided Network for Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Hongbing Li, Jiamin Liu, Shuo Zhang, Bo Xiao

entry.title: Material Magic Wand: Material-Aware Grouping of 3D Parts in Untextured Meshes

Uses a part encoder trained with contrastive learning on material similarity.

entry.title: VirPro: Visual-referred Probabilistic Prompt Learning for Weakly-Supervised Monocular 3D Detection

entry.title: MM-OVSeg:Multimodal Optical-SAR Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Remote Sensing

entry.title: Face anonymization preserving facial expressions and photometric realism

entry.title: LoGSAM: Parameter-Efficient Cross-Modal Grounding for MRI Segmentation

entry.title: PC-CrossDiff: Point-Cluster Dual-Level Cross-Modal Differential Attention for Unified 3D Referring and Segmentation

entry.title: Topology-Guided Biomechanical Profiling: A White-Box Framework for Opportunistic Screening of Spinal Instability on Routine CT

entry.title: FastLoop: Parallel Loop Closing with GPU-Acceleration in Visual SLAM

entry.title: Interpretable AI-Assisted Early Reliability Prediction for a Two-Parameter Parallel Root-Finding Scheme

author.name: Bruno Carpentieri, Andrei Velichko, Mudassir Shams, Paola Lecca

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable AI-assisted reliability diagnostic framework for parameterized root-finding schemes, using kNN-LLE proxy stability profiling and early prediction of solver convergence behavior.

entry.title: Solving Slop

author.name: Noam Makavy

entry.summary: Analyzes the AI 'slop' problem through an economic lens - content production costs have plummeted via LLMs while consumption capacity hasn't scaled, degrading content quality. Proposes solutions including charging for posting and requiring social endorsement.

entry.title: A Dynamic Survey of Fuzzy, Intuitionistic Fuzzy, Neutrosophic, Plithogenic, and Extensional Sets

author.name: Takaaki Fujita, Florentin Smarandache

entry.summary: A survey paper covering various generalized set-theoretic frameworks including fuzzy, intuitionistic fuzzy, neutrosophic, plithogenic, and extensional sets, organizing the extensive literature on mathematical uncertainty modeling.

entry.title: Survey of Various Fuzzy and Uncertain Decision-Making Methods

author.name: Takaaki Fujita, Florentin Smarandache

entry.summary: A survey of uncertainty-aware multi-criteria decision-making methods under fuzzy and uncertain conditions, organizing the field into problem settings, weight elicitation, and solution procedures.

entry.title: Algorithmic Trading Strategy Development and Optimisation

author.name: Owen Nyo Wei Yuan, Victor Tan Jia Xuan, Ong Jun Yao Fabian, Ryan Tan Jun Wei

entry.summary: Develops an algorithmic trading strategy combining technical indicators with FinBERT sentiment analysis on earnings calls, showing improvement over baselines on S&P 500 data.

entry.title: Detecting Sentiment Steering Attacks on RAG-enabled Large Language Models

author.name: Isha Andrade, Shalaka S Mahadik, Mithun Mukherjee, Pranav M Pawar, Raja Muthalagu

entry.summary: The abstract describes IoT intrusion detection systems using CNN and LSTM, which appears misaligned with the title about sentiment steering attacks on RAG-enabled LLMs. Likely a metadata error.

entry.title: Objective Mispricing Detection for Shortlisting Undervalued Football Players via Market Dynamics and News Signals

author.name: Chinenye Omejieke, Shuyao Chen, Xia Cui

entry.summary: Presents a framework for identifying undervalued football players using objective mispricing detection, comparing estimated market values from structured data to observed valuations. Tests whether NLP features from news complement market signals.

entry.title: Facial beauty prediction fusing transfer learning and broad learning system

author.name: Junying Gan, Xiaoshan Xie, Yikui Zhai, Guohui He, Chaoyun Mai, Heng Luo

entry.summary: Fuses transfer learning with Broad Learning System (BLS) for facial beauty prediction, using CNN-based feature extraction with BLS for fast model building.

entry.title: An interactive version of the extropians mailing list

author.name: beyarkay

entry.summary: A community project that created an interactive, searchable interface for the 130k-message extropians mailing list from the 1990s, including UMAP embeddings visualization and clustering. Features notable early transhumanist/AI thinkers like Yudkowsky, Bostrom, and Kurzweil.

entry.title: Two Skillsets You Need to Launch an Impactful AI Safety Project

author.name: Luc Brinkman

entry.summary: A guide for aspiring AI safety entrepreneurs about common failure modes when launching safety projects, emphasizing the need for both technical AI safety skills and entrepreneurial/impact-measurement skills.

entry.title: I'm starting a substack

author.name: leogao

entry.summary: Leo Gao announces he is starting a Substack. Minimal content in the post itself.

entry.title: Principles of Intelligence is hiring

author.name: DusanDNesic

entry.summary: A hiring announcement from Principles of Intelligence (PrincInt) for research engineers, scientists, and a fellowship program director, focused on mechanistic interpretability research including SAEs, weight-based decomposition, and interpretable-by-design architectures.

entry.title: The Hundred Schools of Dietary Advice

author.name: axelcore

entry.summary: A discussion of why dietary advice is so contradictory, exploring how incentive structures, observational study limitations, and information overload create epistemic confusion for laypeople. Uses nutrition as a case study for broader rationality themes.

entry.title: LessWrong's UX may not be living up to its ideas

author.name: neo

entry.summary: A meta-discussion about LessWrong's UX being unfriendly to newcomers, proposing improvements like curated curricula and better onboarding to make the AI safety knowledge base more accessible.

entry.title: Newcomb's Paradox Simulation

author.name: shakelush

entry.summary: A programming-oriented attempt to simulate Newcomb's Paradox, finding that simulations naturally support one-boxing and struggling to construct a simulation supporting two-boxing.

entry.title: LessOnline ticket sales are live! (Earlybird pricing until April 7)

author.name: Ruby

entry.summary: Announcement for the 2026 LessOnline festival (June 5-7 in Berkeley), with ticket pricing and logistics information.
